original: etatpramukhā aśītikoṭisaṃkhyā yogīśvarā bodhisattvās teṣāṃ madhye vajrapāṇim avalokya smitam īṣaddhasitam akārṣīt. sarvajñeti śeṣaḥ. bhagavān paracittajñatayā catuṣpīṭhaśravaṇakāṅkṣiṇīṃ parṣadaṃ pratītya vajrapāṇiṃ saṃgānakṣamaṃ vīkṣya mām ayam adhyeṣatām iti hasitena prasannatāṃ darśitavān iti bhāvaḥ.

original: [1.1.3] so 'py adhyeṣituṃ prakrānta iti darśayann āha: samanantaretyādi. samanantara ity avyavahite. vajrapāṇīti vajrapāṇiḥ. āsanād iti candramaṇḍalāt. ekāṃsam ity eko 'ṃso yasya tat tathā sthitisaṃbandhāt. uttarāsaṅgam uttarīyam. pṛthivyām iti nāsane. kṛtakarapuṭa iti kṛtaṃ karayoḥ puṭaṃ yena sa tathā. kṛtāñjalir ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: saḥ api adhyeṣitum prakrāntaḥ iti darśayan āha samanantara ityādi samanantaraḥ iti avyavahite vajrapāṇi iti vajrapāṇiḥ āsanāt iti candra maṇḍalāt eka aṃsam iti ekaḥ ṃsaḥ yasya tat tathā sthiti saṃbandhāt uttarāsaṅgam uttarīyam pṛthivyām iti na āsane kṛta kara puṭaḥ iti kṛtam karayoḥ puṭam yena sa tathā kṛtāñjaliḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tataś cānāgatānām apy adhyeṣaṇāśikṣaṇam.
analyzed: tatas ca anāgatānām api adhyeṣaṇa aśikṣaṇam

original: [1.1.4] adhyeṣaṇām āha: śrotum icchāmītyādi. jñānendreti jñānāny ādarśādīni, teṣv indro vajradharo deśakaḥ. atha vādarśādijñānasvarūpatvena jñānāni vairocanādayas tathāgatāḥ. teṣām indro 'dhikṛtas tajjanakatvāt. tasya saṃbodhanaṃ jñānendreti. rahoyogasya lakṣaṇam iti: raha iti guhyam, tac ca mudrājñānaṃ samayādikaṃ ca.
analyzed: adhyeṣaṇām āha śrotum icchāmi ityādi jñāna indra iti jñānāni ādarśa ādīni teṣu indraḥ vajradharaḥ deśakaḥ atha vā ādarśa ādi jñāna svarūpa tvena jñānāni vairocana ādayaḥ tathāgatāḥ teṣām indraḥ dhikṛtaḥ tad janaka tvāt tasya saṃbodhanam jñāna indra iti rahaḥ yogasya lakṣaṇam iti rahaḥ iti guhyam tat ca mudrā jñānam samaya ādikam ca

original: yogaḥ śāntikapauṣṭādikaṃ karma vāruṇādayo vā yogāḥ. rahaso yogasya ca lakṣaṇaṃ rūpam. kathaṃ sundari-m-ākāśam iti: sundarī pṛthvī. ākāśaṃ nabhaḥ. śabdāpaśabdau cātra nālocanīyau, tayoḥ kalpitatvāt. āp tejaḥ kathaṃ bhaved iti subodham.
analyzed: yogaḥ śāntika pauṣṭa ādikam karma vāruṇa ādayaḥ vā yogāḥ rahasaḥ yogasya ca lakṣaṇam rūpam katham sundarim ākāśam iti sundarī pṛthvī ākāśam nabhaḥ śabda apaśabdau ca atra na ālocanīyau tayoḥ kalpita tvāt tejaḥ katham bhavet iti su bodham

original: [1.1.5] anāpānasya śvāsānām iti: anā nirgamaḥ, apānaḥ praveśaḥ, dharmasaṃketatvāt. śvāsānām iti vāyoḥ. kathaṃ dhyānasya dhīyata iti: nirgamapraveśasvarūpavāyoḥ kathaṃ dhyānaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ. rāṣṭrapālādidevānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ kīdṛśaṃ bhavet. rāṣṭraṃ śarīraṃ pālayantīti rāṣṭrapālā vairocanādayas tathāgatāḥ.
analyzed: śvāsānām iti anā nirgamaḥ apānaḥ praveśaḥ dharma saṃketa tvāt śvāsānām iti vāyoḥ katham dhyānasya dhīyate iti nirgama praveśa svarūpa vāyoḥ katham dhyānam bhavati iti bhāvaḥ rāṣṭrapāla ādi devānām maṇḍalam kīdṛśam bhavet rāṣṭram śarīram pālayanti iti rāṣṭrapālāḥ vairocana ādayaḥ tathāgatāḥ

original: ta evādāv eva sattvārthaṃ prati dīvyanti vajraḍākinyādinānāsiddhinirmāṇair vyavaharantīti devāḥ. teṣāṃ maṇḍalaṃ siddhiḥ, sattvārthamaṇḍaṃ sāraṃ kāryatvena lātīti kṛtvā. atha vā rāṣṭrapālāḥ kṣetrapālās ta evādidevās teṣāṃ maṇḍalaṃ māṇḍaleyasahitaṃ kīdṛśam iti. atha vā rāṣṭrapālāni skandhadhātvāyatanāni ta evādidevā vairocanādirūpatvāt.
analyzed: te eva ādau eva sattva artham prati dīvyanti vajra ḍākinī ādi nānā siddhi nirmāṇaiḥ vyavaharanti iti devāḥ teṣām maṇḍalam siddhiḥ sattva artha maṇḍam sāram kārya tvena lāti iti kṛtvā atha vā rāṣṭrapālāḥ kṣetrapālāḥ te eva ādidevāḥ teṣām maṇḍalam māṇḍaleya sahitam kīdṛśam iti atha vā rāṣṭrapālāni skandha dhātu āyatanāni te eva ādidevāḥ vairocana ādi rūpa tvāt

original: jñānavijñānadehasya kathaṃ karmādi yuñjayed iti: jñānaṃ sadasadādijñānam, vijñānaṃ jīvitam, tadyuktasya dehasya kathaṃ karmādi sukṛtādikarma yujyata iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: jñāna vijñāna dehasya katham karma ādi yuñjayet iti jñānam sat asat ādi jñānam vijñānam jīvitam tad yuktasya dehasya katham karma ādi sukṛta ādi karma yujyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.1.6] śṛṇu vajra yathātattvaṃ saṃsārapāralakṣaṇam iti: he vajrapāṇe yathātattvaṃ tattvena saṃsārapāralakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇv iti saṃbandhaḥ. saṃsārapāraṃ bodhiṃ lakṣayati yena vakṣyamāṇena vāyutattvena tat tathā. tad evāha: śvāsakarmādi sarveṣāṃ karma yuñjanti jñāninām iti. śvāsakarma śvāsakriyā. tac cādiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ pradhānabhūtam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: śṛṇu vajra yathātattvam saṃsāra pāra lakṣaṇam iti he vajrapāṇe yathātattvam tattvena saṃsāra pāra lakṣaṇam śṛṇu iti saṃbandhaḥ saṃsāra pāram bodhim lakṣayati yena vakṣyamāṇena vāyu tattvena tat tathā tat eva āha śvāsa karma ādi sarveṣām karma yuñjanti jñāninām iti śvāsa karma śvāsa kriyā tat ca ādiḥ śreṣṭham pradhāna bhūtam iti arthaḥ

original: sarveṣāṃ jñānināṃ prāṇināṃ yuñjanti yogaṃ gacchati śvāsakarma. tat katham ity āha: karmeti. tṛtīyālope sati padam. māhendrādiyogakarmaṇety arthaḥ.
analyzed: sarveṣām jñāninām prāṇinām yuñjanti yogam gacchati śvāsa karma tat katham iti āha karma iti tṛtīyā lope sati padam māhendra ādi yoga karmaṇā iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.7] śvāsakarma darśayann āha: ayutaṃ dve sahasrāṇi śataṣaṣṭheti m-aṅkataḥ | ghaṭiṣaṣṭheti śvāsānām ahorātraṃ ca kīrtitam iti. ayutaṃ dve iti: ayutadvayam. sahasrāṇīti sahasram ekam. śataṣaṣṭheti ṣaṭ śatāni. itīttham. m-aṅkata ity aṅkena gaṇanayety arthaḥ. ghaṭiṣaṣṭheti: ghaṭīśabdena daṇḍaḥ, ṣaṣṭheti ṣaṣṭiḥ.
analyzed: śvāsa karma darśayan āha ayutam dve sahasrāṇi śata ṣaṣṭhā iti maṅkataḥ ghaṭi ṣaṣṭhā iti śvāsānām ahorātram ca kīrtitam iti ayutam dve iti ayuta dvayam sahasrāṇi iti sahasram ekam śata ṣaṣṭhā iti ṣaḍ śatāni iti ittham maṅkataḥ iti aṅkena gaṇanayā iti arthaḥ ghaṭi ṣaṣṭhā iti ghaṭī śabdena daṇḍaḥ ṣaṣṭhā iti ṣaṣṭiḥ

original: ṣaṭśatābhyadhikaikaviṃśatisahasrāṇi śvāsānām. kutrety āha: ghaṭiṣaṣṭheti ṣaṣṭighaṭīṣu. ṣaṣṭir ghaṭyo 'horātram, ahorātre ca tāvantaḥ śvāsā iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: ṣaṣ śata abhyadhika ekaviṃśati sahasrāṇi śvāsānām kutra iti āha ghaṭi ṣaṣṭha iti ṣaṣṭi ghaṭīṣu ṣaṣṭiḥ ghaṭyaḥ horātram ahorātre ca tāvantaḥ śvāsāḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.1.8] hārādolasya śvāsānāṃ gaṇitā dola m-aṅkitam iti: hārā vāyoḥ praveśaḥ. dolā nirgamaḥ. tayor hārādolayoḥ śvāsayor madhye, gaṇiteti gaṇanayā, doleti dolayā, m-aṅkitam ity aṅkitā lakṣitety arthaḥ. vāyor gaṇanā nirgameṇa kartavyeti bhāvaḥ. hārā dolasya līyante dvayaśvāsasya buddhimān iti: dvayoḥ śvāsayor madhye hārā dolāyāṃ līyate.
analyzed: śvāsānām gaṇitā dola maṅkitam iti hārāḥ vāyoḥ praveśaḥ dolā nirgamaḥ tayoḥ hārā dolayoḥ śvāsayoḥ madhye gaṇitā iti gaṇanayā dolā iti dolayā maṅkitam iti aṅkitā lakṣitā iti arthaḥ vāyoḥ gaṇanā nirgameṇa kartavyā iti bhāvaḥ hārāḥ dolasya līyante dvaya śvāsasya buddhimān iti dvayoḥ śvāsayoḥ madhye hārāḥ dolāyām līyate

original: dolayā sahaikībhavatīty arthaḥ. buddhimān iti buddhimann iti vajrapāṇeḥ saṃbodhanam.
analyzed: dolayā saha ekībhavati iti arthaḥ buddhimān iti buddhiman iti vajrapāṇeḥ saṃbodhanam

original: [1.1.9] bāhyam aṅkita sthātavyam iti śvāsakarmato 'nyat. aṅkitaṃ likhitam. kiṃ tad ity āha: bhuvanaṃ dvādaśaṃ tatheti. bhuvanaṃ koṣṭhakāni dvādaśa. yathādinabhi m-aṅkānāṃ dvādaśakoṣṭhasthāpanam iti teṣu koṣṭhakeṣu yasya māsasya yāni dināni teṣāṃ ye 'ṅkā likhanāni teṣāṃ sthāpanaṃ vāmāvartena pratipadādīn dvādaśyantāṃs tithīn likhed ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: bāhyam sthātavyam iti śvāsa karmataḥ aṅkitam likhitam kim tat iti āha bhuvanam dvādaśam tathā iti bhuvanam koṣṭhakāni dvādaśa dvādaśa koṣṭha sthāpanam iti teṣu koṣṭhakeṣu yasya māsasya yāni dināni teṣām ye ṅkāḥ likhanāni teṣām sthāpanam vāma āvartena pratipad ādīn dvādaśī antān tithīn likhet iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.10] pūrva pauṣādi sthātavyaṃ dvādaśaṃ krama tatparam iti pūrvasmin koṣṭhake puṣyamāsam ādau likhitvā śeṣeṣu koṣṭhakeṣu māghādimāsān vāmāvartataḥ krameṇa likhed ity arthaḥ. tatparam iti bhaktiparo yogī. meṣādayo 'pi rāśayo 'tra draṣṭavyāḥ. likhanam evāha: rohitetyādi.
analyzed: sthātavyam dvādaśam krama tatparam iti pūrve koṣṭhake puṣya māsam ādau likhitvā śeṣeṣu koṣṭhakeṣu māgha ādi māsān vāma āvartataḥ krameṇa likhet iti arthaḥ tad param iti bhakti paraḥ yogī meṣa ādayaḥ pi rāśayaḥ draṣṭavyāḥ likhanam eva āha rohita ityādi

original: pratimāsaṃ pratipadādīni dināni puṣyādayo māsā meṣādayo rāśayaś ca krameṇa rohitādiśabdavācyāḥ.
analyzed: pratimāsam pratipad ādīni dināni puṣya ādayaḥ māsāḥ meṣa ādayaḥ rāśayaḥ ca krameṇa rohita ādi śabda vācyāḥ

original: [1.1.11] dvādaśaṃ bhuvaneśvaram iti dvādaśabhuvanānāṃ koṣṭhakānām īśvarā rohitādayaḥ. ekasminn evāhorātre dvādaśa rohitādayo bhavantīty api draṣṭavyam. yathā
analyzed: dvādaśam bhuvaneśvaram iti dvādaśa bhuvanānām koṣṭhakānām īśvarāḥ rohita ādayaḥ ekasmin eva ahorātre dvādaśa rohita ādayaḥ bhavanti iti api draṣṭavyam yathā

original: rohitāmakare tisraś catvāro mohakūrmayoḥ |
analyzed: rohitāmakare tisraḥ catvāraḥ moha kūrmayoḥ

original: bhadravṛṣabhayoḥ pañca raṇḍākāme ca pañca ca |
analyzed: bhadra vṛṣabhayoḥ pañca raṇḍā kāme ca pañca ca

original: bhidrivyākulibhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ mikirasvapne ca sapta ca ||
analyzed: bhidri vyākulibhyām ṣaṣṭham mikira svapne ca sapta ca

original: iti. prabhāte trayo daṇḍā rohitā. tataḥ pare catvāro daṇḍā mohitā. tataḥ pare pañca daṇḍā bhadram. tataḥ pare tāvanto daṇḍā vṛṣabhaḥ. tataḥ pare catvāro daṇḍāḥ kūrmaḥ. tataḥ pare trayo daṇḍā makaraḥ. tataḥ pare pañca daṇḍā raṇḍā. tataḥ pare sapta daṇḍā mikiraḥ. tataḥ pare ṣaḍ daṇḍā bhidriḥ. tataḥ pare tāvanto daṇḍā vyākuliḥ.
analyzed: iti prabhāte trayaḥ daṇḍāḥ rohitā tatas pare catvāraḥ daṇḍāḥ mohitā tatas pare pañca daṇḍāḥ bhadram tatas pare tāvantaḥ daṇḍāḥ vṛṣabhaḥ tatas pare catvāraḥ daṇḍāḥ kūrmaḥ tatas pare trayaḥ daṇḍāḥ makaraḥ tatas pare pañca daṇḍāḥ raṇḍā tatas pare sapta daṇḍāḥ mikiraḥ tatas pare ṣaṭ daṇḍāḥ bhidriḥ tatas pare tāvantaḥ daṇḍāḥ vyākuliḥ

original: tataḥ pare sapta daṇḍāḥ svapnaḥ. tataḥ pare pañca daṇḍāḥ kāmaḥ. ittham ahorātreṇa ṣaṣṭi daṇḍāḥ. tithimāsarāśidaṇḍair militair yathoktaṃ niyamena bhavati. vyastair vyastaṃ vinyāsam upasaṃharann āha: asya sthāpitakoṣṭhānāṃ pūrvādikramataṃ nyased iti. eṣu koṣṭheṣu sthāpiteṣu pūrvādikramato nyāsaḥ kartavya ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: tatas pare sapta daṇḍāḥ svapnaḥ tatas pare pañca daṇḍāḥ kāmaḥ ittham ahorātreṇa ṣaṣṭi daṇḍāḥ tithi māsa rāśi daṇḍaiḥ militaiḥ yathoktam niyamena bhavati vyastaiḥ vyastam vinyāsam upasaṃharan āha asya sthāpita koṣṭhānām pūrva ādi kramatam nyaset iti eṣu koṣṭheṣu sthāpiteṣu pūrva ādi kramataḥ nyāsaḥ kartavyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: kiṃ tu māghādiṣu tithayo bhrāmyanti nāmabhedena, yathā māghe mohitā pratipat, bhadrādayo rohitāntāḥ, dvitīyādayo dvādaśyantāḥ. evam anyatrāpi. bhadrādikam ādiṃ kṛtvā pratipadādayo gaṇayitavyāḥ.
analyzed: kim tu māgha ādiṣu tithayaḥ bhrāmyanti nāma bhedena yathā māghe mohitā pratipad bhadra ādayaḥ rohita antāḥ dvitīya ādayaḥ dvādaśī antāḥ evam anyatra api bhadra ādikam ādim kṛtvā pratipad ādayaḥ gaṇayitavyāḥ

original: [1.1.12] rohiteti rohitāyām. saubhāgyam iti priyadaránaḥ. krūracittā tu mandāgīti krūracitto 'pakāraṃ smarati nopakāram. mandāgīti mandānalaḥ. videśāprabhv iti viprakṛṣṭadeśe rājyādilābhī bhavati nityaśaḥ.
analyzed: rohitā iti rohitāyām saubhāgyam iti priyadaránaḥ krūra cittā tu mandāgī iti upakāram smarati na upakāram mandāgī iti manda analaḥ iti viprakṛṣṭa deśe rājya ādi lābhī bhavati nityaśas

original: [1.1.13] maithunapriya iti suratārthaṃ sthānāsthānavicārako na bhavatīty arthaḥ. nityānāṃ prītivākyaṃ tu sarvavid ity aparuṣābhidhāyī sarvatra nityam. rohitā devatā pūjyam iti rohitāyāṃ jāto devatāpūjako bhavati. āyu sattaribhis tatheti saptativarṣāyuś ca.
analyzed: maithuna priyaḥ iti surata artham sthāna asthāna vicārakaḥ na bhavati iti arthaḥ nityānām prīti vākyam tu sarva vid iti aparuṣa abhidhāyī sarvatra nityam rohitā devatā pūjyam iti rohitāyām jātaḥ devatā pūjakaḥ bhavati āyuḥ sattaribhiḥ tathā iti saptati varṣa āyuḥ ca

original: [1.1.14] rohitā arthadātasya prīti sarve nivartata iti rohitāyām arthaḥ kalāntarādinā dattaḥ prītyā sarvasmān nivartate, sarvo vārthaḥ. rohitā kṣatam aṅgasyeti rohitājātasyāṅgaṃ kṣataṃ bhavati. śriyābhiś ca samāgama iti parasmāl lakṣmīm ākarṣayatīty arthaḥ.
analyzed: rohitā sarve nivartate iti rohitāyām artha dātasya sarve nivartate iti rohitāyām arthaḥ kalā antara ādinā dattaḥ prītyā sarvasmāt nivartate sarvaḥ vā arthaḥ rohitā kṣatam aṅgasya iti rohitā jātasya aṅgam kṣatam bhavati ca samāgamaḥ iti parasmāt lakṣmīm ākarṣayati iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.15] rohitā sthānam āśritya dhanam ity ābhivasthitam iti: rohitāyāṃ sthānāśrayaṇād dhanamitrādyavasthito bhavatīti bhāvaḥ. rohitā vrajate sthānam iti: rohitāyāṃ kvacid gantavyam ity arthaḥ. sarva cintābhi sidhyatīti: gataś cābhimataṃ sādhayatīti bhāvaḥ. vivāha agnikāryaṃ tu śāntikarma prayuñjata iti:
analyzed: rohitā sthānam āśritya dhanam iti iti rohitāyām sthāna āśrayaṇāt dhanamitra ādi avasthitaḥ bhavati iti bhāvaḥ rohitā vrajate sthānam iti rohitāyām kvacid gantavyam iti arthaḥ sidhyati iti gataḥ ca abhimatam sādhayati iti bhāvaḥ vivāha agni kāryam tu śānti karma prayuñjate iti

original: rohitāyāṃ vivāhahomādikaṃ phaladaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ. dhātuvādapratimābharaṇādikam agnikāryam iti kecit.
analyzed: rohitāyām vivāha homa ādikam phala dam bhavati iti bhāvaḥ dhātuvāda pratimā ābharaṇa ādikam agni kāryam iti kecid

original: [1.1.16] mohitā arthayogānāṃ gaṇitena tu jñāyata iti: mohitāyāṃ arthayogo 'rthasaṃgrahaḥ, sa ca dvādaśakoṣṭhagaṇanayā jñāyate kartavya ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: mohitā artha yogānām gaṇitena tu jñāyate iti mohitāyām artha yogaḥ rtha saṃgrahaḥ sa ca dvādaśa koṣṭha gaṇanayā jñāyate kartavyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.17] alpavittas tv ity asthūlalakṣmyaḥ. maithunapriya nityaśa iti priyamaithunaḥ. krūrā vyasaninaṃ nityam apriyāṇy api bhāṣata iti: vyasanī vivādī.
analyzed: alpa vittaḥ tu iti a sthūlalakṣmyaḥ maithuna priya nityaśas iti priya maithunaḥ krūrāḥ vyasaninam nityam apriyāṇi api bhāṣate iti vyasanī vivādī

original: [1.1.18] nityaṃ krodha ahaṃkāraṃ pāpakārī durātmaka iti: krodheti kruddhaḥ. ahaṃkāram iti mānī. pāpakārīti prāṇātipātādikārī. durātmaka iti vikṛtakāyaḥ. saṃbhinnā parasolāpīti: saṃbhinnālāpapāruṣyālāpau yasya staḥ sa tathā. cyuti sarvābhi cetaneti: cetanāyā jīvitasya sarvābhiḥ sarveṇa prakāreṇa cyutir bhavati.
analyzed: nityam krodha ahaṃkāram pāpa kārī durātmakaḥ iti krodha iti kruddhaḥ ahaṃkāram iti mānī pāpa kārī iti prāṇa atipāta ādi kārī durātmakaḥ iti vikṛta kāyaḥ saṃbhinnā parasolāpī iti saṃbhinna ālāpa pāruṣya ālāpau yasya staḥ sa tathā cetanā iti cetanāyāḥ jīvitasya sarvābhiḥ sarveṇa prakāreṇa cyutiḥ bhavati

original: cyuta śastrābhi cetaneti kvacit pāṭhaḥ. mohitājātasya śastraiś cetanā cyutā bhavatīty arthaḥ.
analyzed: cyuta śastra abhi cetanā iti kvacid pāṭhaḥ mohita ajātasya śastraiḥ cetanā cyutā bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.19] varṣa aśīti catvāri āyūnāṃ tu prakīrtitam iti: caturaśītivarṣāyur iti bhāvaḥ. m-ucchāhyāyogabhūmyādīti: utsāhy ayogabhūmāv asthāna ity arthaḥ. vicchāhyā yogabhūmyaśa iti: vicchāhyā vicchāhī, anutsāhīty arthaḥ. kvety āha: yogabhūmau satsthāna ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: catvāri āyūnām tu prakīrtitam iti caturaśīti varṣa āyuḥ iti bhāvaḥ mucchāhya ayogabhūmi ādi iti utsāhī ayogabhūmau asthāne iti arthaḥ vicchāhyā yogabhūmi aśaḥ iti vicchāhī anutsāhī iti arthaḥ kva iti āha yogabhūmau sat sthāne iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.20] kṣatam aṅgasya dehānāṃ mṛtyūnāṃ tu samāgamam iti: yac cyuta śastrābhi cetanety uddiṣṭaṃ tasya nirdeśo 'yam. yat kiṃcid artha dātavyaṃ gatasya na nivartata iti: ṛṇādinā datto 'rtho na nivartata iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: kṣatam aṅgasya dehānām mṛtyūnām tu samāgamam iti yat cyuta śastra abhi cetanā iti uddiṣṭam tasya nirdeśaḥ yam yat kiṃcid artha dātavyam gatasya na nivartate iti ṛṇa ādinā dattaḥ rthaḥ na nivartate iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.1.21] bhadra śobhanam āhāram iti: kṛṣyādikam āhāraḥ, sa ca bhadre kāryaḥ. bhadrakarmādi kārayed iti: śāntikādikaṃ karma. bhadra dāraka jātānāṃ śata varṣāṇi jīvatīti: bhadre jātaḥ śataṃ varṣāṇi jīvatīty arthaḥ.
analyzed: bhadra śobhanam āhāram iti kṛṣi ādikam āhāraḥ sa ca bhadre kāryaḥ bhadra karma ādi kārayet iti śāntika ādikam karma bhadra jātānām varṣāṇi jīvati iti bhadre jātaḥ śatam varṣāṇi jīvati iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.22] daridrā dharmacārī tv iti: daridrā dhanavikalaḥ. svargāpavargakāraṇaṃ puṇyaṃ dharmaḥ. ekapaṇṇīratā deha divyavāykyaṃ tu nāyaketi: ekapaṇṇī ekā patnī. divyadehavākyo 'sau bhavati. nāyakaḥ niyāmakaḥ.
analyzed: daridrā dharma cārī tu iti daridrā dhana vikalaḥ svarga apavarga kāraṇam puṇyam dharmaḥ ekapaṇṇī ratāḥ tu nāyaka iti ekapaṇṇī ekā patnī sau bhavati nāyakaḥ niyāmakaḥ

original: [1.1.23] sarvaśilpakalābhijña iti: śilpaṃ citralikhanādikam. kalā vidyāḥ. yathā: aṅgāni vedāś catvāro mīmāṃsā nyāyavistaraḥ | dharmaśāstraṃ purāṇaṃ ca trayīdaṃ sarvam ucyate || āyurvedo dhanurvedo gāndharvaṃ ceti te trayaḥ | arthaśāstraiḥ samaṃ jñeyā vidyā amur aṣṭādaśa || (MBh 1,113,40b, 12,122,25d) iti.
analyzed: sarva śilpa kalā abhijñaḥ iti śilpam citra likhana ādikam kalā vidyāḥ yathā aṅgāni vedāḥ catvāraḥ mīmāṃsā nyāya vistaraḥ dharma śāstram purāṇam ca  trayī SNF idam sarvam SNNe ucyate āyurvedaḥ dhanurvedaḥ gāndharvam SNNe ca  iti  te trayaḥ arthaśāstraiḥ PINe samam  jñeyāḥ vidyāḥ amuḥ aṣṭādaśan SNNe iti

original: śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chandovicitir jyotiṣaṃ ceti ṣaḍ aṅgāni. śikṣā hastiśikṣādiśāstram. kalpo 'nukalpaḥ smṛtiśāstrādi. yathārhaṃ sarvaśilpakalābhijñaḥ. sarvaśabdo hi bāhulyasūcakaḥ. svajaneṣu prītir asyeti sa tathā. kulaṃ daṇḍena bhuñjīteti: svakulaṃ daṇḍena bhogyatāṃ nayet. atha vā kulamāhātmyena bhogaṃ karoti. jala dehacyutis tatheti:
analyzed: śikṣā kalpaḥ vyākaraṇam niruktam chandovicitiḥ jyotiṣam ca iti ṣaḍ aṅgāni śikṣā hasti śikṣā ādi śāstram kalpaḥ nukalpaḥ smṛti śāstra ādi yathārham sarva śilpa kalā abhijñaḥ sarva śabdaḥ hi bāhulya sūcakaḥ sva janeṣu prītiḥ asya iti sa tathā kulam daṇḍena bhuñjīta iti sva kulam daṇḍena bhogya tām nayet atha vā kula māhātmyena bhogam karoti deha cyutiḥ tathā iti

original: jale dehacyutir mṛtyuḥ.
analyzed: jale deha cyutiḥ mṛtyuḥ

original: [1.1.24] vṛṣabhaṃ dārako jātā vīryavān balaśatruṣv iti: vṛṣabhe dārako jāto vīryavān baliṣu śatruṣu bhavati. śṛṅgāro 'rtham aiśvaryeti: tasya śṛṅgāro 'rtha aiśvaryaṃ ca bhavati. bahu paṇṇī tu mānayed iti: bahvīḥ patnīḥ saṃmānayet.
analyzed: vṛṣabham dārakaḥ jātāḥ vīryavān bala śatruṣu iti vṛṣabhe dārakaḥ jātaḥ vīryavān baliṣu śatruṣu bhavati śṛṅgāraḥ ṛtham aiśvarya iti tasya śṛṅgāraḥ ṛthaḥ aiśvaryam ca bhavati bahu tu mānayet iti bahvīḥ patnīḥ saṃmānayet

original: [1.1.25] bāndhave bahu sarveṣām iti: bāndhavair bahubhiḥ sarvadā yukto bhavatīty arthaḥ. pitarā āyu hanyata iti: jātamātraḥ pitur āyur hanti. vaṇijā vṛttikalpasyeti: vāṇijyena vṛttiṃ karotīty arthaḥ. āyuḥ saṣṭiṃ tu kalpayed iti: ṣaṣṭivarṣāyur ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: bāndhave bahu sarveṣām iti bāndhavaiḥ bahubhiḥ sarvadā yuktaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ pitarā āyu hanyate iti jāta mātraḥ pituḥ āyuḥ hanti vaṇijā vṛtti kalpasya iti vāṇijyena vṛttim karoti iti arthaḥ āyuḥ saṣṭim tu kalpayet iti ṣaṣṭi varṣa āyuḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.26] ālasyaṃ mukharaṃbhāṣīti: alaso mukharaś cety arthaḥ. krūrakarmā durātmaka iti vyākhyātam. mṛtyu śastrasya kalpante atha vā viṣa prāṇakair iti: sa śastreṇa sarpaviṣeṇa vā mriyata iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: ālasyam mukharaṃbhāṣi iti alasaḥ mukharaḥ ca iti arthaḥ krūra karmā durātmakaḥ iti vyākhyātam mṛtyu śastrasya kalpante atha vā prāṇakaiḥ iti sa śastreṇa sarpa viṣeṇa vā mriyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.1.27] kūrmāṇāṃ dārako jātaḥ nitya cintena vasthitam iti: citte 'navasthitam iti pāṭhāntaram. kūrme jāto nityaṃ cintāvasthitaḥ, cintāpara ity arthaḥ. citte vānavasthitaḥ, anavasthitacitta ity arthaḥ. svalparoṣeti: svalpe 'parādhe roṣo yasya sa tathā. alpato tuṣṭeti: alpamātreṇa tuṣṭa ity arthaḥ. bahubhāṣī svajanapriya iti subodham.
analyzed: kūrmāṇām dārakaḥ jātaḥ iti citte iti pāṭha antaram kūrme jātaḥ nityam cintā avasthitaḥ cintā paraḥ iti arthaḥ citte vā anavasthitaḥ anavasthita cittaḥ iti arthaḥ su alpa roṣa iti su alpe parādhe roṣaḥ yasya sa tathā tuṣṭa iti alpa mātreṇa tuṣṭaḥ iti arthaḥ bahu bhāṣī sva jana priyaḥ iti su bodham

original: [1.1.28] atikrodhī ugrasyeti: atikopy utkaṭaś cety arthaḥ. īśvara sarvadāyakā iti: īśvaraḥ sarvasvadāyakaś cety arthaḥ. hanyāt paṇṇikaputrāṇām iti: patnīṃ putraṃ ca hanti. svadeśe prabhu nityaśa iti subodham.
analyzed: ati krodhī ugrasya iti ati kopī utkaṭaḥ ca iti arthaḥ īśvara sarva dāyakāḥ iti īśvaraḥ sarvasva dāyakaḥ ca iti arthaḥ hanyāt paṇṇika putrāṇām iti patnīm putram ca hanti sva deśe prabhu nityaśas iti su bodham

original: [1.1.29] kṛṣikarmāṇi kalpasyeti: kṛṣikarmāṇi kalpayatīty arthaḥ. vyādhikuṣṭhena gṛhyata iti subodham. varṣa aśīti āyūnām iti: aśītivarṣāyur iti bhāvaḥ. svagṛhe mṛtyukas tatheti: samādhānena mriyata ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: kṛṣi karmāṇi kalpasya iti kṛṣi karmāṇi kalpayati iti arthaḥ vyādhi kuṣṭhena gṛhyate iti su bodham varṣa aśīti āyūnām iti aśīti varṣa āyuḥ iti bhāvaḥ sva gṛhe mṛtyukaḥ tathā iti samādhānena mriyate iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.30] makaraṃ dārako jāta āyu navatriṣaṣṭavad iti: makare jātasya dvāsaptativārṣikam āyuḥ. triṣaṣṭheti tryadhikā ṣaṣṭiḥ. atha vā ṣaḍadhikanavativarṣāyur iti vyākhyeyam. puṇyavān iti punātīti puṇyaṃ dānadevatāpūjādikam. śīlasaṃpanna iti: śīlaṃ kuśalapravṛttir akuśalanivṛttiḥ parārthacaryā ceti trividham. susvabhāvatā vā. vinayācārarakṣitam iti:
analyzed: makaram dārakaḥ jātaḥ nava tri ṣaṣṭa vat iti makare jātasya dvāsaptati vārṣikam āyuḥ tri ṣaṣṭhā iti tri adhikā ṣaṣṭiḥ atha vā ṣaṣ adhika navati varṣa āyuḥ iti vyākhyeyam puṇyavān iti punāti iti puṇyam dāna devatā pūjā ādikam śīla saṃpannaḥ iti śīlam kuśala pravṛttiḥ akuśala nivṛttiḥ parārtha caryā ca iti trividham su svabhāva tā vā vinaya ācāra rakṣitam iti

original: vinaya indriyajayaḥ, ācāro lokavyavahāraḥ. anyat subodham.
analyzed: vinayaḥ indriya jayaḥ ācāraḥ lokavyavahāraḥ anyat su bodham

original: [1.1.31] saubhāgyayaśa rājata iti: saubhāgyayaśobhyāṃ rājata iti bhāvaḥ. ekapaṇṇīprabhāsvara iti: ekā patnī śreṣṭhā yasya sa tathā. ekapatnīvratāsana iti pāṭhāntaram. vratam ekāntaniścayaḥ, ekapatnīvrate 'stīti vyutpattyā.
analyzed: rājate iti saubhāgya yaśobhyām rājate iti bhāvaḥ ekapaṇṇī prabhāsvaraḥ iti ekā patnī śreṣṭhā yasya sa tathā eka patnī vrata āsanaḥ iti pāṭha antaram vratam ekānta niścayaḥ eka patnī vrate sti iti vyutpattyā

original: [1.1.32] kusīdā cinta nityānām iti: kutsite sīdantīti kusīdāḥ, teṣāṃ nityaṃ cintā yasya sa nityakusīdacitta iti bhāvaḥ. bāndhavai m-ekacchatriketi: bandhubhiḥ saha sādhāraṇadhana iti boddhavyam. prītivākyādi sarveṣām iti: sarvatra prītivāk. raṇe mṛtyu dhruvaṃ tatheti: raṇe mṛtyus tasya bhavatīti bhāvaḥ. pañcapañcāśa m-āyūnām iti:
analyzed: nityānām iti kutsite sīdanti iti kusīdāḥ teṣām nityam cintā yasya sa nitya kusīda cittaḥ iti bhāvaḥ bāndhavaiḥ bandhubhiḥ saha sādhāraṇa dhanaḥ iti boddhavyam prīti vākya ādi sarveṣām iti sarvatra prīti vāc raṇe mṛtyu dhruvam tathā iti raṇe mṛtyuḥ tasya bhavati iti bhāvaḥ pañcapañcāśat māyūnām iti

original: pañcapañcāśadvarṣāyur ity arthaḥ. atha vā ṣaṣṭitriṃśakair iti: triṣaṣṭivarṣāyur ity arthaḥ. etenāyuḥsaṃkhyākramadvayenāpamṛtyuḥ kathitaḥ. atha vā ṣaṣṭitriṃśakair ity anena navatriṣaṣṭavad ity asya pūrvavyākhyānopasaṃhāraḥ kriyata iti kecit.
analyzed: pañcapañcāśat varṣa āyuḥ iti arthaḥ atha vā ṣaṣṭi triṃśakaiḥ iti triṣaṣṭi varṣa āyuḥ iti arthaḥ etena āyuḥ saṃkhyā krama dvayena apamṛtyuḥ kathitaḥ atha vā ṣaṣṭi triṃśakaiḥ iti anena nava tri ṣaṣṭa vat iti asya pūrva vyākhyāna upasaṃhāraḥ kriyate iti kecid

original: [1.1.33] raṇḍā dārako jāta iti: raṇḍāyāṃ dārako jātaḥ. pāpabuddhiṃ tv iti: ānantaryādikaraṇabuddhiḥ. saṃbhinnālāpa sattvānām iti: sattveṣu saṃbhinnālāpī. daridreti daridraḥ. nitya vapphalīti: nityaṃ vacasi paraṃ madhuraḥ.
analyzed: raṇḍā dārakaḥ jātaḥ iti raṇḍāyām dārakaḥ jātaḥ pāpa buddhim tu iti ānantarya ādi karaṇa buddhiḥ saṃbhinna ālāpa sattvānām iti sattveṣu saṃbhinna ālāpī daridra iti daridraḥ nitya nityam vacasi param madhuraḥ

original: [1.1.34] rogyā iti rogī. rājadaṇḍahatātmana iti: hata ātmā yasyāsau hatātmā. rājadaṇḍeti rājadaṇḍena. maithunapriya nityānām iti subodham. viśvāsam ity anukūlacittatā.
analyzed: rogyāḥ iti rogī rāja daṇḍa hata ātmanaḥ iti hataḥ ātmā yasya asau hata ātmā rāja daṇḍa iti rāja daṇḍena maithuna priya nityānām iti su bodham viśvāsam iti anukūla citta tā

original: [1.1.35] saubhāgyam iti subhagaḥ. viṭaśilpādīti: viṭaśilpaṃ citrādikam. tadādi sarvaṃ hastivāhanādikaṃ vettīti śilpādisarvavit. śeṣaṃ vyākhyātam.
analyzed: saubhāgyam iti subhagaḥ viṭa śilpa ādi iti viṭa śilpam citra ādikam tad ādi sarvam hasti vāhana ādikam vetti iti śilpa ādi sarva vid śeṣam vyākhyātam

original: [1.1.36] mikiram iti: kālādhvanor atyantasaṃyoga iti (Aṣṭādhyāyī 2.3.5) dvitīyā. svakuloccayam iti: svakulam uccinoti vardhayatīti sa tathā. nītiśāstrāṇi saṃpannā vidyā vividhaśilpakair iti: nītiśāstrāṇi vidyābhiḥ saha prāptavān.
analyzed: iti kāla adhvanoḥ atyanta saṃyogaḥ iti aṣṭa adhyāyī dvitīyā sva kula uccayam iti sva kulam uccinoti vardhayati iti sa tathā nīti śāstrāṇi saṃpannāḥ vidyāḥ vividha śilpakaiḥ iti nīti śāstrāṇi vidyābhiḥ saha prāptavān

original: [1.1.37] ghorapāruṣyavākyānām iti: ghoravāk. alpa-m-arthasvarūpās tv iti: alpo 'rthaḥ svarūpaṃ ca yasya sa tathā. laghu sarvasya kāryavān iti: śīghraṃ sarvakāryakārīty arthaḥ.
analyzed: ghora pāruṣya vākyānām iti ghora vāc alpamartha svarūpāḥ tu iti alpaḥ rthaḥ svarūpam ca yasya sa tathā laghu sarvasya kāryavān iti śīghram sarva kārya kārī iti arthaḥ

original: % surūpaṃ?
analyzed: surūpam

original: [1.1.38] sahite jala dehānāṃ mṛtyūnāṃ tu na saṃśaya iti: sahite prakṣipya jale dehaṃ mriyata iti niścitam. aśītim āyur aṣṭasyeti: aṣṭāśītivarṣāyur iti bhāvaḥ. rājaśastrā cyutis tatheti: rājaśastreṇa tasya cyutiḥ, maraṇam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: sahite dehānām mṛtyūnām tu na saṃśayaḥ iti sahite prakṣipya jale deham mriyate iti niścitam aśītim āyuḥ aṣṭasya iti aṣṭāśīti varṣa āyuḥ iti bhāvaḥ rāja śastrā cyutiḥ tathā iti rāja śastreṇa tasya cyutiḥ maraṇam iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.39] bhidrikā dārako jāta iti: bhidrike jātaḥ. sa jātamātro mātaraṃ hantīty āha: jātā hanyati mātareti. pitarā hanty aṣṭavarṣā iti: aṣṭame varṣe pitaraṃ hantīty arthaḥ. tāvatkāla eva sa mātāpitṛrahitaḥ svagṛhe svecchayā prabhur bhavati.
analyzed: bhidrikā dārakaḥ jātaḥ iti bhidrike jātaḥ sa jāta mātraḥ mātaram hanti iti āha jātā hanyati mātarā iti pitarā hanti aṣṭa varṣāḥ iti aṣṭame varṣe pitaram hanti iti arthaḥ tāvat kāle eva sa mātā pitṛ rahitaḥ sva gṛhe sva icchayā prabhuḥ bhavati

original: [1.1.40] alpadravyasya krodhasyeti: alpārthaḥ krodhanaś cety arthaḥ. mūrkhavad iti mūrkhaḥ. svayaṃ cittāni karmāṇīti: svacittena karma karotīty arthaḥ. kvacic chvapacitāni karmāṇīti pāṭhaḥ. tatra caṇḍālakriyākārīty arthaḥ. balanāyakā iti senāpatiḥ.
analyzed: alpa dravyasya krodhasya iti alpa arthaḥ krodhanaḥ ca iti arthaḥ mūrkha vat iti mūrkhaḥ svayam cittāni karmāṇi iti sva cittena karma karoti iti arthaḥ kvacid śvapacitāni karmāṇi iti pāṭhaḥ tatra caṇḍāla kriyā kārī iti arthaḥ bala nāyakāḥ iti senāpatiḥ

original: [1.1.41] śatāni āyur aṣṭasyeti: aṣṭādhikaśatavarṣāyur ity arthaḥ. svagṛhe mṛtyukaṃ dhruvam iti: svagṛhe mriyata ity arthaḥ. svajanānāṃ prīti sarvasyeti: sarveṣv eva svajaneṣu tasya prītir ity arthaḥ. hīnadīnānukampakam iti: hīnā jātyādinā, dīnā duḥkhinaḥ.
analyzed: śatāni āyuḥ aṣṭasya iti aṣṭa adhika śata varṣa āyuḥ iti arthaḥ sva gṛhe mṛtyukam dhruvam iti sva gṛhe mriyate iti arthaḥ sva janānām sarvasya iti sarveṣu eva sva janeṣu tasya prītiḥ iti arthaḥ hīna dīna anukampakam iti hīnāḥ jāti ādinā dīnāḥ duḥkhinaḥ

original: [1.1.42] vyākulī dārako jāta iti: vyākulau jātaḥ. alpabuddhimān iti: alpabuddhiḥ. alpaprajñā tv iti jaḍaḥ.
analyzed: vyākulī dārakaḥ jātaḥ iti vyākulau jātaḥ alpa buddhimān iti alpa buddhiḥ alpa prajñā tu iti jaḍaḥ

original: [1.1.43] svajana prīti saubhāgyam iti: svajane prītiḥ saubhāgyaṃ ca. īśvaram arthagāvas tv iti: arthair gobhiś ca sa īśvara ity arthaḥ. tṛpaṇṇā gṛhādi ceti: patnītritayaṃ gṛhe tasyety arthaḥ.
analyzed: sva jana saubhāgyam iti sva jane prītiḥ saubhāgyam ca īśvaram artha gāvaḥ tu iti arthaiḥ gobhiḥ ca saḥ īśvaraḥ iti arthaḥ gṛhe tasya iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.44] dīrghāyu pitaraṃ māteti: pitā mātā ca tasya dīrghāyuṣau bhavataḥ.
analyzed: dīrgha āyu pitaram mātā iti pitā mātā ca tasya dīrgha āyuṣau bhavataḥ

original: [1.1.45] vaṇijena tu kalpasya mṛtyu yugala hetuneti: vaṇikkriyāyām eva mṛtyunā saha tasya yugalaṃ bhavati. mṛtyunā yogo bhavatīty āśayaḥ. hetunetīttham ity arthaḥ. ittham eva vaṇikkriyayaiva mṛtyunā yogo bhavatīti bhāvaḥ. yogārambhāni cihnāni gaṇitena tu jñāninām iti: jñāninā jñātavyāny uktāni cihnāni. rohitādiyogeṣv ārambho yeṣāṃ tāni tathā.
analyzed: vaṇijena tu kalpasya mṛtyu yugala hetunā iti vaṇij kriyāyām eva mṛtyunā saha tasya yugalam bhavati mṛtyunā yogaḥ bhavati iti āśayaḥ hetunā iti ittham iti arthaḥ ittham eva vaṇij kriyayā eva mṛtyunā yogaḥ bhavati iti bhāvaḥ yoga ārambhāni cihnāni gaṇitena tu jñāninām iti jñāninā jñātavyāni uktāni cihnāni rohita ādi yogeṣu ārambhaḥ yeṣām tāni tathā

original: kathaṃ jñātavyānīty āha: gaṇitena, dvādaśakoṣṭhagaṇanayā.
analyzed: katham jñātavyāni iti āha gaṇitena dvādaśa koṣṭha gaṇanayā

original: [1.1.46] svapnānām iti: svapne. dahyante sarvaśatrūṇām iti: śatravaḥ sarve dahyante tasyeti bhāvaḥ. anāthena tu bādhavān iti: mātrādihīne bāndhavaḥ.
analyzed: svapnānām iti svapne dahyante sarva śatrūṇām iti śatravaḥ sarve dahyante tasya iti bhāvaḥ anāthena tu bādhavān iti mātrā ādi hīne bāndhavaḥ

original: [1.1.47] daridrā nityakālānām iti: nityaṃ daridraḥ. pāpabuddhiṃ tu tatpara iti: pāpe buddhir asyeti sa tathā. tatparas tatkriyākārī. siṃghabhāvena ātmānam iti: matsakāśān nānyaḥ kaścid bhadro 'stīti mahāntam ātmānam eva manyata iti kriyā draṣṭavyā. pāruṣāpāla sarvavid iti subodham.
analyzed: daridrāḥ nitya kālānām iti nityam daridraḥ pāpa buddhim tu tatparaḥ iti pāpe buddhiḥ asya iti sa tathā tatparaḥ tad kriyā kārī siṃgha bhāvena ātmānam iti mad sakāśāt na anyaḥ kaścid asti iti mahāntam ātmānam eva manyate iti kriyā draṣṭavyā pāruṣāpāla sarva vid iti su bodham

original: [1.1.48] nirujaṃ sarvakāleṣv iti: janmaprabhṛti nīrogaḥ. bhogalābhaṃ tv iti subodham. sevakena tu bhoktavyam iti: sevakena sabhāvartanaṃ kartavyam ity arthaḥ. striyam ākramya bhuñjata iti: ākrāntyā surataṃ karotīty arthaḥ.
analyzed: nirujam sarva kāleṣu iti janma prabhṛti nīrogaḥ bhoga lābham tu iti su bodham sevakena tu bhoktavyam iti sevakena sabhā vartanam kartavyam iti arthaḥ striyam ākramya bhuñjate iti ākrāntyā suratam karoti iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.49] varṣa pañcāśate āyur iti: pañcāśadvarṣāyur ity arthaḥ. tasyaivam āyu kalpitam iti: nānyathāyuḥsaṃkhyeti bhāvaḥ. hanyasyeti hatasya.
analyzed: āyuḥ iti pañcāśat varṣa āyuḥ iti arthaḥ tasya evam āyu kalpitam iti na anyathā āyuḥ saṃkhyā iti bhāvaḥ hanyasya iti hatasya

original: [1.1.50] kāmānām iti kāme. varṣa ṣaṣṭi aṣṭāni jīvatīti: aṣṭaṣaṣṭivarṣāṇi jīvati. grāmagoṣṭheṣv iti grāmavān gomāṃś cety arthaḥ. aśvādīn tv iti: aśvagajādīn ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: kāmānām iti kāme varṣa ṣaṣṭi aṣṭāni jīvati iti aṣṭaṣaṣṭi varṣāṇi jīvati grāma goṣṭheṣu iti grāmavān gomān ca iti arthaḥ aśva ādīn tu iti aśva gaja ādīn iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.51] sarvasattvahitaṃkara iti subodham.
analyzed: sarva sattva hitaṃkaraḥ iti su bodham

original: [1.1.52] saubhāgya sarva sarveṣv iti: sarvathā sarveṣu subhaga ity arthaḥ. dvādaśakoṣṭhanyāsam upasaṃharann āha: yogacihnaṃ tu darśayed iti. yogānāṃ rohitādīnāṃ cihnaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yat tad anena krameṇa lakṣayet. ahaṃvākyaṃ na saṃśaya iti: mama vākyam etat, nātra saṃśayaḥ kārya iti vajradharasya vacanam iti.
analyzed: saubhāgya sarva sarveṣu iti sarvathā sarveṣu subhagaḥ iti arthaḥ dvādaśa koṣṭhanyāsam upasaṃharan āha yoga cihnam tu darśayet iti yogānām rohita ādīnām cihnam lakṣaṇam yat tat anena krameṇa lakṣayet ahaṃvākyam na saṃśayaḥ iti mama vākyam etat na atra saṃśayaḥ kāryaḥ iti vajradharasya vacanam iti

original: [1.1.53] idānīṃ naṣṭanakṣatronnayanaṃ kurvann āha: rohitetyādi. rohitāyāṃ jāto bālyataḥ prabhṛty eva niyamena devatāpūjakaḥ. mohitā arthalabdhavān iti: niyamena tathaivārthalābhī mohitājātaḥ. bhadra śobhanam āhāreti: bhadrajāto niyamena tathaiva śobhanāhāralābhī. vṛṣabhaṃ bahukrodhakā iti: vṛṣabhajāto niyamena tathaivātiśayena krodhī.
analyzed: idānīm naṣṭa nakṣatra unnayanam kurvan āha rohita ityādi rohitāyām jātaḥ bālyataḥ prabhṛti eva niyamena devatā pūjakaḥ mohitā artha labdhavān iti niyamena tathā eva artha lābhī mohitā jātaḥ bhadra śobhanam āhāra iti bhadra jātaḥ niyamena tathā eva śobhana āhāra lābhī vṛṣabham bahu krodhakāḥ iti vṛṣabha jātaḥ niyamena tathā eva atiśayena krodhī

original: [1.1.54] kūrma cintāparā khyāteti subodham. makare jātaḥ kathālāpī niyamena tathaiva bhavati. raṇḍā pāpasya saṃcintya mikiraṃ maithunāyatam iti subodham.
analyzed: cintāparā khyātā iti su bodham makare jātaḥ kathā ālāpī niyamena tathā eva bhavati raṇḍā pāpasya saṃcintya mikiram maithunāyatam iti su bodham

original: [1.1.55] bhidrijāto niyamena nidrālur bhavati. vyākulijāto niyamena nindākubhāṣādiyukto bhavati. svapnajāto niyamena cintāśauryādiyuktaḥ. kāmajāto niyamena gandharvo bhavati.
analyzed: bhidri jātaḥ niyamena nidrāluḥ bhavati vyākuli jātaḥ niyamena nindā ku bhāṣā ādi yuktaḥ bhavati svapna jātaḥ niyamena cintā śaurya ādi yuktaḥ kāma jātaḥ niyamena gandharvaḥ bhavati

original: [1.1.55 (excursus)] tathā hi prabhāte daṇḍatraye meṣabhoga aśvinī, bharaṇī, kṛttikāpādabhāgaś ca jñāyate. tato daṇḍacatuṣṭaye vṛṣabhoge kṛttikāpādatrayam, rohiṇī, tathā mṛgaśīrṣārdham. tato daṇḍapañcake mithunabhoge mṛgaśīrṣārdham, ārdrā, punarvasūpādatrayaṃ ca. tato 'pi tāvatsu daṇḍeṣu karkaṭakabhogeṣu punarvasūpādaḥ, puṣyā, āśleṣā ca.
analyzed: tathā hi prabhāte daṇḍa traye meṣa bhoga aśvinī bharaṇī kṛttikā pāda bhāgaḥ ca jñāyate tatas daṇḍa catuṣṭaye vṛṣa bhoge kṛttikā pāda trayam rohiṇī tathā mṛgaśīrṣa ardham tatas daṇḍa pañcake mithuna bhoge mṛgaśīrṣa ardham ārdrā punarvasu upāda traya ca tāvatsu daṇḍeṣu karkaṭaka bhogeṣu punarvasu upādaḥ puṣyāḥ āśleṣā ca

original: tato daṇḍacatuṣṭaye siṃghabhoge maghā, pūrvaphālgunī, uttaraphālgunīpādaś ca. tato daṇḍatraye kanyābhoge uttaraphālgunīpādatrayam, hastā, citrārdhaṃ ca. tato daṇḍapañcake tulābhoge citrārdham, svātiḥ, viśākhāpādatrayaṃ ca. tato 'pi saptasu daṇḍeṣu vṛścikabhogeṣu viśākhāpādaḥ, anurādhā, jyeṣṭhā ca.
analyzed: tatas daṇḍa catuṣṭaye siṃgha bhoge maghā pūrva phālgunī uttara phālgunī pādaḥ ca tatas daṇḍa traye kanyā bhoge uttara phālgunī pāda trayam hastā citra ardham ca tatas daṇḍa pañcake tulā bhoge citra ardham svātiḥ viśākhā pāda trayam ca saptasu daṇḍeṣu vṛścika bhogeṣu viśākhā pādaḥ anurādhā jyeṣṭhā ca

original: tato daṇḍaṣaṭke dhanurbhoge mūlā, pūrvāṣāḍhā, uttarāṣāḍhāpādaś ca. tato 'pi tāvatsu daṇḍeṣu makarabhogeṣu uttarāṣāḍhāpādatrayam, śravaṇā, dhaniṣṭhārdhaṃ ca. tato 'pi daṇḍasaptake kumbhabhoge dhaniṣṭhārdham, śatabhiṣā, pūrvabhādrapadāpādatrayaṃ ca. tato daṇḍapañcake mīnabhoge pūrvabhādrapadāpādaḥ, uttarabhādrapadā, revatī ca.
analyzed: tatas daṇḍa ṣaṭke dhanuḥ bhoge mūlā pūrvāṣāḍhā uttarāṣāḍhā pādaḥ ca tatas pi tāvatsu daṇḍeṣu makara bhogeṣu uttarāṣāḍhā pāda trayam śravaṇāḥ dhaniṣṭhā ardham ca tatas pi daṇḍa saptake kumbha bhoge dhaniṣṭhā ardham śatabhiṣā pūrvabhādrapadā pāda trayam ca tatas daṇḍa pañcake mīna bhoge pūrvabhādrapadā pādaḥ uttarabhādrapadāḥ revatī ca

original: ittham api trīṇi trīṇi nakṣatrāṇi jñāyante, na punar ekaṃ niścitam.
analyzed: ittham api trīṇi trīṇi nakṣatrāṇi jñāyante na punar ekam niścitam

original: [1.1.56–57] rohitāśabdavācyeṣu daṇḍatrayādiṣu yathākramaṃ śāntikādīni karmāṇi kartavyānīty āha: rohitā śāntikarmādītyādi subodham.
analyzed: rohitā śabda vācyeṣu daṇḍa traya ādiṣu yathākramam śāntika ādīni karmāṇi kartavyāni iti āha rohitā śānti karma ādi ityādi su bodham

original: [1.1.58] siddhi vṛṣabha rephāṇāṃ amṛtaṃ yoga jāyata iti: siddhir vṛṣabhe, rephāṇām iti rohitāmakararaṇḍāmikirāś catvāro yogāś cāmṛtatvāya jāyante. cakralikhanakālaṃ niyamayann āha: pūrvadiśādi saṃsthāpyetyādi. ādau rohitāṃ pūrvasyāṃ diśi saṃsthāpyaiśānyādau mohitādīn sthāpayed ity arthaḥ. gaṇitaṃ gaṇanayā kriyamāṇaṃ pūrvāhne budhaḥ kuryāt.
analyzed: vṛṣabha rephāṇām amṛtam yoga jāyate iti siddhiḥ vṛṣabhe rephāṇām iti rohitā makara raṇḍa amikirāḥ catvāraḥ yogāḥ ca amṛta tvāya jāyante cakra likhana kālam niyamayan āha pūrva diśā ādi saṃsthāpya ityādi ādau rohitām pūrvasyām diśi saṃsthāpya aiśānī ādau mohita ādīn sthāpayet iti arthaḥ gaṇitam gaṇanayā kriyamāṇam pūrvāhne budhaḥ kuryāt

original: [1.1.59] rohitā artha dātasyetyādinoddiṣṭaṃ nirdiśann āha: rohitetyādi. rohitāyāṃ datto 'rtho nivartamānaḥ sphīto nivartata iti bhāvaḥ. mohitā artha yogānām ity uddiṣṭaṃ nirdiśati: mohitetyādi. arthaḥ saṃgṛhīto na parair bādhyate.
analyzed: dātasya ityādinā uddiṣṭam nirdiśan āha rohita ityādi rohitāyām dattaḥ rthaḥ nivartamānaḥ sphītaḥ nivartate iti bhāvaḥ mohitā artha yogānām iti uddiṣṭam nirdiśati mohita ityādi arthaḥ saṃgṛhītaḥ na paraiḥ bādhyate

original: [1.1.60] bhadra gṛham ārambha śriyābhiś ca samāgamam iti: bhadre gṛhārambhe sati śrīr bhavati. vṛṣabhaṃ devayogasyeti: vṛṣabhe devatāpratimādyārambhaḥ śastaḥ, mantrārambhaś ca śasta ity āha: mantreṇāpi tu sidhyati.
analyzed: bhadra gṛham ārambha ca samāgamam iti bhadre gṛha ārambhe sati śrīḥ bhavati vṛṣabham deva yogasya iti vṛṣabhe devatā pratimā ādi ārambhaḥ śastaḥ mantra ārambhaḥ ca śastaḥ iti āha mantreṇa api tu sidhyati

original: [1.1.61] vivāhe kūrmayogasya aviyogena tu sarvaśa iti: kūrmayogavivāhe dampatyo ramaṇaṃ prītir apīti bhāvaḥ. makaraṃ kṣetram ārūḍhaṃ dhruvaṃ śasyābhi vardhata iti: makarayogena kṣetrārambhe śasyavṛddhir iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: vivāhe kūrmayogasya aviyogena tu sarvaśas iti kūrmayoga vivāhe dampatyoḥ ramaṇam prītiḥ api iti bhāvaḥ makaram kṣetram ārūḍham dhruvam śasya abhi vardhate iti makara yogena kṣetra ārambhe śasya vṛddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.1.62] raṇḍā strīṣu kāryāṇāṃ mṛtaś cāpi na muñcatīti: raṇḍāyogena strīsaṃgrahe kṛte sā strī janmāntare 'pi tasya bhavatīti bhāvaḥ. mikiraṃ vaṇijam āpnoti dṛśyate artha sāṃpratam iti: mikirayoge vaṇijavastuprāptyārambhe tat prāpnoti. prītyārambhe janmānuvedho dṛśyate.
analyzed: raṇḍā strīṣu kāryāṇām mṛtaḥ ca api na muñcati iti raṇḍā yogena strī saṃgrahe kṛte sā strī janma antare tasya bhavati iti bhāvaḥ mikiram vaṇijam āpnoti dṛśyate sāṃpratam iti mikira yoge vaṇija vastu prāpti ārambhe tat prāpnoti prīti ārambhe janma anuvedhaḥ dṛśyate

original: [1.1.63] bhidrika saṃgṛhya karmādi cirastāyi bhavat sadeti: bhidriyogena yat saṃgṛhyate tac cirasthāyīty arthaḥ. vyākulī gamanaṃ videśe nirujaṃ sthāna prāpyata iti: vyākuliyogena videśe gamanaṃ kriyate. tasmin nairujyena tiṣṭhati.
analyzed: saṃgṛhya karma ādi cira stāyi bhavat sadā iti bhidri yogena yat saṃgṛhyate tat cira sthāyi iti arthaḥ vyākulī gamanam videśe prāpyate iti vyākuli yogena videśe gamanam kriyate tasmin nairujyena tiṣṭhati

original: [1.1.64] svapnaṃ sarva sarveṇa dhruvaṃ nityābhi gacchatīti: svapne yad gataṃ tan nivartata ity arthaḥ. kāmam artha gatā caiva gatasya na nivartata iti: kāmayogena yo 'rtho gataḥ sa na nivartata iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: svapnam svapnam sarveṇa dhruvam nitya abhi gacchati iti svapne yat gatam tat nivartate iti arthaḥ kāmam artha gatā ca eva gatasya na nivartate iti kāma yogena yaḥ rthaḥ gataḥ sa na nivartate iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.1.65–67] nāgā api rohitādiśabdavācyā iti darśayann āha: vāsukītyādi subodham.
analyzed: nāgāḥ api rohita ādi śabda vācyāḥ iti darśayan āha vāsuki ityādi su bodham

original: [1.1.68] asya viṣakrama yogena viśeṣeṇa tu jñāpayed iti: eṣāṃ vāsukyādīnāṃ viṣakramaṇaṃ rohitādiyogena viśeṣeṇa bhedena jñātavyam iti bhāvaḥ. siddhi vṛṣabhetyādi vyākhyātam eva.
analyzed: asya yogena viśeṣeṇa tu jñāpayet iti eṣām vāsuki ādīnām viṣa kramaṇam rohita ādi yogena viśeṣeṇa bhedena jñātavyam iti bhāvaḥ vṛṣabha ityādi vyākhyātam eva

original: [1.1.69] yasya daṣṭābhi saṃbhāvyeti: yena daṣṭaḥ sattvas taṃ jñātvā viṣakramaṇaṃ jñāyata iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ. mṛtyūnāṃ tu samāgamam iti: yadi kāladaṃśas tadā mṛtyur eveti jñātvā nivartiteti [=nivarteteti?] bhāvaḥ. vakṣyamāṇena nyāyena kālo 'kālo jñātavyaḥ. anyathā viṣa saṃyojya viṣa saṃhārya yogata iti:
analyzed: yasya daṣṭā abhi saṃbhāvya iti yena daṣṭaḥ sattvaḥ tam jñātvā viṣa kramaṇam jñāyate iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ mṛtyūnām tu samāgamam iti yadi kāla daṃśaḥ tadā mṛtyuḥ eva iti jñātvā nivartitā iti nivarteta iti bhāvaḥ vakṣyamāṇena nyāyena kālaḥ kālaḥ jñātavyaḥ anyathā viṣa saṃyojya viṣa saṃhārya yogataḥ iti

original: yady akāladaṃśas tadā viṣaṃ vakṣyamāṇena yogena saṃharet. viṣaṃ saṃyojyeti: akālaviṣasaṃyogaḥ. dūtadaṃśasthānatithinakṣatravelābhiḥ kālo 'kālo vā jñātavya iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: yadi akāla daṃśaḥ tadā viṣam vakṣyamāṇena yogena saṃharet viṣam saṃyojya iti akāla viṣa saṃyogaḥ dūta daṃśa sthāna tithi nakṣatra velābhiḥ kālaḥ vā jñātavyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.1.70] idānīṃ māsānām ahorātraghaṭīniyamaṃ darśayitum āha: kramakrameṇa kartavyaṃ yathākālaṃ tu m-aṅkitam iti. dvādaśa koṣṭheṣu vāmāvartena puṣyādimāsān likhitvā gaṇanā kāryā. yasya koṣṭhasya yo māsas taṃ tatra likhitvety arthaḥ.
analyzed: idānīm māsānām ahorātra ghaṭī niyamam darśayitum āha krama krameṇa kartavyam yathākālam tu maṅkitam iti dvādaśa koṣṭheṣu vāma āvartena puṣya ādi māsān likhitvā gaṇanā kāryā yasya koṣṭhasya yaḥ māsaḥ tam tatra likhitvā iti arthaḥ

original: pauṣādikramam ādityeti: sūryagatyā puṣyamāsasyāmāvasyādir ity arthaḥ. ṛtuyānaṃ tv iti dakṣiṇayānamuttarayānaṃ ca. tayor madhye yad uttarayānaṃ tan mukhyam ity arthaḥ. dakṣiṇāyanottarāyaṇayor uttarāyaṇaṃ mukhyam iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: pauṣa ādi kramam āditya iti sūrya gatyā puṣya māsasya amāvasyā ādiḥ iti arthaḥ ṛtu yānam tu iti dakṣiṇa yānam uttara yānam ca tayoḥ madhye yat uttara yānam tat mukhyam iti arthaḥ dakṣiṇāyana uttarāyaṇayoḥ uttarāyaṇam mukhyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.1.71] pratyekaṃ daśa dviguṇa catvāri dināni ghaṭikaṃ budhaḥ | daśa trika ṣaṣṭhānāṃ rajanīghaṭim ārabhed iti: uttarāyaṇasaṃjñake puṣye māsi dineṣu pratyekaṃ dviguṇā daśa yāsu tā dviguṇadaśā ghaṭyaḥ. aparāś catasro ghaṭyaḥ. budha iti: evaṃ bhavatīti budho jānīyād iti kriyādhyāhāraḥ.
analyzed: pratyekam catvāri dināni ghaṭikam budhaḥ daśa ṣaṣṭhānām rajanī ghaṭim ārabhet iti uttarāyaṇa saṃjñake puṣye māsi dineṣu pratyekam dviguṇāḥ daśa yāsu tāḥ dviguṇa daśāḥ ghaṭyaḥ aparāḥ catasraḥ ghaṭyaḥ budhaḥ iti evam bhavati iti budhaḥ jānīyāt iti kriyā adhyāhāraḥ

original: pratyekaṃ rajanīṣu punar ghaṭyo daśānāṃ trikaṃ yāsu tā daśatrikāḥ. ṣaṣṭhānām iti ṣaḍ ghaṭikāḥ. evaṃ sarvatra praguṇīkṛtya boddhavyam. puṣyamāsasya caturviṃśatighaṭikāni dināni, rajanyaś ca ṣaṭtriṃśadghaṭikā iti piṇḍārthaḥ.
analyzed: pratyekam rajanīṣu punar ghaṭyaḥ daśānām trikam yāsu tāḥ daśa trikāḥ ṣaṣṭhānām iti ṣaḍ ghaṭikāḥ evam sarvatra praguṇīkṛtya boddhavyam puṣya māsasya caturviṃśati ghaṭikāni dināni rajanyaḥ ca ṣaṭtriṃśat ghaṭikāḥ iti piṇḍa arthaḥ

original: [1.1.72] yathā dinaṃ dinaṃ kṛtvā gaṇitena samanvitam iti: yasya yasya māsasya yad yad dinaṃ tat tad gaṇanayā dvādaśakoṣṭhagatayā jñeyam. etac ca grahaṇakavākyam. prathamakoṣṭhagataṃ māsaṃ darśayitvā dvitīyakoṣṭhagataṃ māsaṃ darśayann āha: dvitīyena tv ityādi.
analyzed: yathā dinam dinam kṛtvā gaṇitena samanvitam iti yasya yasya māsasya yat yat dinam tat tat gaṇanayā dvādaśa koṣṭha gatayā jñeyam etat ca grahaṇaka vākyam prathama koṣṭha gatam māsam darśayitvā dvitīya koṣṭha gatam māsam darśayan āha dvitīyena tu ityādi

original: [1.1.73] daśa dviguṇa ṣaṣṭhasyeti: ṣaḍviṃśati ghaṭikāni. dinābhyām iti dināni. daśa trika catvārīti: catustriṃśadghaṭikā rajanyaḥ. etac ca māghasya.
analyzed: daśa ṣaṣṭhasya iti ṣaḍviṃśati ghaṭikāni dinābhyām iti dināni daśa catvāri iti catustriṃśat ghaṭikāḥ rajanyaḥ etat ca māghasya

original: [1.1.74] phālgunasya darśayann āha: daśetyādi. aṣṭāviṃśatighaṭikāni dināni. dvekasyeti dve. dvātriṃśadghaṭikā rajanyaḥ.
analyzed: phālgunasya darśayan āha daśa ityādi aṣṭāviṃśati ghaṭikāni dināni dve ekasya iti dve dvātriṃśat ghaṭikāḥ rajanyaḥ

original: [1.1.75] viṣumadhya dvayaṃ yujya ghaṭi triṃśat prakalpitam iti: caitre māsi triṃśadghaṭikam ahorātraṃ iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: viṣu madhya dvayam triṃśat prakalpitam iti caitre māsi triṃśat ghaṭikam ahorātram iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.1.76] vaiśākhasyāhorātrāṇy āha: daśa tribhir dvidhā atrānteti. triṃśad ghaṭikā atrānte dve ghaṭike. dvātriṃśadghaṭikāni dinānīty arthaḥ. daśa dvibhir aṣṭasyeti: aṣṭāviṃśatighaṭikā rajanya ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: vaiśākhasya ahorātrāṇi āha daśa tribhiḥ dvidhā atra anta iti triṃśat ghaṭikā atra ante dve ghaṭike dvātriṃśat ghaṭikāni dināni iti arthaḥ daśa dvibhiḥ aṣṭasya iti aṣṭāviṃśati ghaṭikāḥ rajanyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.77] jyeṣṭhadinasyāha: daśa tridhetyādi. catustriṃśadghaṭikāni dinānīti bhāvaḥ. pūrvato dinābhyām iti dinaṃ pravartate. daśa dviguṇetyādi: ṣaḍviṃśatighaṭikā rajanya ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: jyeṣṭha dinasya āha daśa tridhā ityādi catustriṃśat ghaṭikāni dināni iti bhāvaḥ pūrvatas dinābhyām iti dinam pravartate daśa dviguṇa ityādi ṣaḍviṃśati ghaṭikāḥ rajanyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.78] āṣāḍhasyāha: daśa triguṇetyādi. ṣaṣṭhasyeti ṣaṭ. dinābhyām iti dināni. ṣaṭtriṃśadghaṭikāni dināni. rajanīghaṭikāś caturviṃśatir iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: āṣāḍhasya āha daśa triguṇa ityādi ṣaṣṭhasya iti ṣaṣ dinābhyām iti dināni ṣaṭtriṃśat ghaṭikāni dināni rajanī ghaṭikāḥ caturviṃśatiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.1.79] dakṣiṇāyana saṃproktaṃ ṛtukālasya jñāpayed iti: puṣyamāsasyāmāvāsīm ārabhya triṃśaddinaṃ māsaṃ kṛtvā ṣaṇ māsā uttarāyanam. idānīm āṣāḍhāmāvāsīm ārabhya tathaiva ṣaṇ māsā dakṣiṇāyanam iti bhāvaḥ. ittham ṛtukālo jñāyatām.
analyzed: dakṣiṇāyana saṃproktam ṛtu kālasya jñāpayet iti puṣya māsasya amāvāsīm ārabhya triṃśat dinam māsam kṛtvā ṣaṭ māsāḥ uttarāyanam idānīm āṣāḍha amāvāsīm ārabhya tathā eva ṣaṭ māsāḥ dakṣiṇāyanam iti bhāvaḥ ittham ṛtu kālaḥ jñāyatām

original: [1.1.80] śrāvaṇasyāha: daśa triguṇetyādi. catustriṃśadghaṭikāni dināni. ṣaṣṭhasyeti ṣaṭ. ṣaḍviṃśadghaṭikā rātraya ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: śrāvaṇasya āha daśa triguṇa ityādi catustriṃśat ghaṭikāni dināni ṣaṣṭhasya iti ṣaṣ ṣaḍviṃśat ghaṭikāḥ rātrayaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.81] bhādrasyāha: daśa triguṇetyādi. dvekasyeti dve. dvātriṃśadghaṭikāni dināni. aṣṭasyeti: aṣṭau. aṣṭāviṃśatighaṭikā rātraya iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: bhādrasya āha daśa triguṇa ityādi dve ekasya iti dve dvātriṃśat ghaṭikāni dināni aṣṭasya iti aṣṭau aṣṭāviṃśati ghaṭikāḥ rātrayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.1.82] āśvinasyāha: daśa triguṇa lakṣasya viśukādi dinaṃ ghaṭi | daśa triguṇa rātrāṇāṃ viśumadhyadinaṃ tatheti. lakṣasyeti lakṣaya. dināni triṃśadghaṭikāni, rātrayaś ca triṃśadghaṭikā ity arthaḥ. viśumadhyadinam iti: caitraviśudināny apy evam iti nirdeśaḥ.
analyzed: āśvinasya āha lakṣasya viśuka ādi dinam daśa triguṇa rātrāṇām tathā iti lakṣasya iti lakṣaya dināni triṃśat ghaṭikāni rātrayaḥ ca triṃśat ghaṭikāḥ iti arthaḥ viśu madhya dinam iti caitra viśu dināni api evam iti nirdeśaḥ

original: [1.1.83] kārttikadināny āha: daśa dviguṇetyādi. m-aṣṭasyeti: aṣṭau. aṣṭāviṃśadghaṭikāni dināni. śeṣaṃ subodham.
analyzed: kārttika dināni āha daśa dviguṇa ityādi maṣṭasya iti aṣṭau aṣṭāviṃśat ghaṭikāni dināni śeṣam su bodham

original: [1.1.84] mārgaśīrṣasyāha: daśa dviguṇetyādi subodham.
analyzed: mārgaśīrṣasya āha daśa dviguṇa ityādi su bodham

original: [1.1.85] daśa dviguṇa catvāra ghaṭisaṃkhyā dinaṃ kṛtam | daśa trika tathā ṣaṣṭha rajanīghaṭi kalpitam iti: puṣyasyāhorātraghaṭyupasaṃhāraḥ kṛtaḥ.
analyzed: dinam kṛtam iti puṣyasya ahorātra ghaṭī upasaṃhāraḥ kṛtaḥ

original: [1.1.86] daśaguṇa trikaṃ pañcāśad vā ghaṭibhyo śvāsa nālivad iti: daśaguṇa trikaṃ śatatrayaṃ pañcāśadveti ṣaṣṭiḥ. nālivad iti: yathaikasmin daṇḍe ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatrayaṃ śvāsās tathānyeṣv api daṇḍeṣu. ghaṭiṣaṣṭety uddiṣṭasya nirdeśam āha: ghaṭiṣaṣṭikasaṃkhyasya ahorātrasya dhīyata iti. ṣaṣṭyā daṇḍair ahorātram ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: trikam pañcāśat vā nāli vat iti daśaguṇa trikam śata trayam pañcāśat vā iti ṣaṣṭiḥ nāli vat iti yathā ekasmin daṇḍe ṣaṣṭi adhika śata trayam śvāsāḥ tathā anyeṣu api daṇḍeṣu ghaṭi ṣaṣṭā iti uddiṣṭasya nirdeśam āha ghaṭi ṣaṣṭika saṃkhyasya ahar rātrasya dhīyate iti ṣaṣṭyā daṇḍaiḥ ahar rātram iti arthaḥ

original: śatatrikas tathā ṣaṣṭīti kvacit pāṭhaḥ. tac ca tathaiva saṃkhyā.
analyzed: śatatrikaḥ tathā ṣaṣṭi iti kvacid pāṭhaḥ tat ca tathā eva saṃkhyā

original: [1.1.87] yathākramabhi māsānāṃ tathā kramabhi m-aṅkitam iti: yathākrameṇa māsakramas, tathā koṣṭheṣu ghaṭītrayādikramo draṣṭavya ity arthaḥ. ghaṭīśvāsādi saṃpūrṇa iti viśumati. kramavartiṃ tu cchindiketi: viśumantaṃ vihāya krameṇa dinasya rātreś ca vṛddhihrāsaś ca bhavatīty arthaḥ.
analyzed: māsānām tathā maṅkitam iti yathā krameṇa māsa kramaḥ tathā koṣṭheṣu ghaṭī traya ādi kramaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ iti arthaḥ ghaṭī śvāsa ādi saṃpūrṇaḥ iti viśumati krama vartim tu chindikā iti viśumantam vihāya krameṇa dinasya rātreḥ ca vṛddhi hrāsaḥ ca bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: [1.1.88] śvāsakrama saṃgṛhya karmākarma viśeṣata iti: śvāsakrameṇa vāyavyādiyogacatuṣṭayaṃ jñātvā śāntikādi śubhaṃ karma, abhicārādikam aśubhaṃ karma, viśeṣeṇa kuryād iti bhāvaḥ. tatra vāyavyaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ, āgneyaṃ caturaṅgulaṃ, vāruṇaṃ dvādaśāṅgulaṃ, māhendraṃ ṣodaśāṅgulam iti. ayutam ityādy uddiṣṭasya nirdeśam āha: kharādibhītyādi.
analyzed: saṃgṛhya karma akarma viśeṣataḥ iti śvāsa krameṇa vāyavya ādi yoga catuṣṭayam jñātvā śāntika ādi śubham karma abhicāra ādikam aśubham karma viśeṣeṇa kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ tatra vāyavyam ṣaṣ aṅgulam āgneyam catur aṅgulam vāruṇam dvādaśa aṅgulam māhendram ṣodaśa aṅgulam iti ayutam ityādi uddiṣṭasya nirdeśam āha khara ādi bhī ityādi

original: khaś ca raś ca kharau. tāv ādī yayo rāśyos tau kharādī. khādīni caturviṃśaty akṣarāṇi, rādīni ṣaṭ. tataś ca khādī rādiś ceti rāśidvayam. khādirādibhyāṃ rāśibhyām ity arthaḥ. etena caturviṃśaty aṅkaḥ ṣaḍ aṅkaś ca grāhyaḥ. ṛtuṃ kṛtveti: ṣaḍ ṛtavaḥ. tadaṅko grāhyaḥ. caturviṃśateḥ ṣaḍdvayasya caikībhāvena ṣaṭtriṃśad bhavati. yānadvebhi m-aṅkitam iti:
analyzed: khaḥ ca raḥ ca kha rau tau ādī yayoḥ rāśyoḥ tau kha ra ādī kha ādīni caturviṃśatī akṣarāṇi rādīni ṣaḍ tatas ca khādī rādiḥ ca iti rāśi dvayam khādiḥ ādibhyām rāśibhyām iti arthaḥ etena caturviṃśatī aṅkaḥ ṣaṣ aṅkaḥ ca grāhyaḥ ṛtum kṛtvā iti ṣaṭ ṛtavaḥ tad aṅkaḥ grāhyaḥ caturviṃśateḥ ṣaṣ dvayasya ca ekībhāvena ṣaṭtriṃśat bhavati iti

original: ṣaṭtriṃśad aṅka eva dvisthānīkāryaḥ. tato 'ṣṭādaśāṣṭādaśa bhavanti.
analyzed: ṣaṭtriṃśat aṅke eva dvi sthānīkāryaḥ ṣṭādaśa aṣṭādaśa bhavanti

original: [1.1.89] dvebhi daśaguṇaṃ kṛtveti: dvāv api bhāgau daśaguṇau kṛtveti bhāvaḥ. tata ekaikabhāge 'śītyadhikaṃ śatam ekaikaṃ bhavati. tataḥ śatadvayasyaikam aṅkam ekenāṅkenāṣṭāṅkam aṣṭāṅkena yojayitvā, adho bindum upari bindusamīpe dadyāt. ayutadvayaṃ sahasram ekaṃ ṣac chatāni bhavanti. ekasminn evāhorātre tāvantaḥ śvāsāḥ. ato vakṣyati:
analyzed: daśaguṇam kṛtvā iti dvau api bhāgau daśaguṇau kṛtvā iti bhāvaḥ tatas eka eka bhāge śīti adhikam śatam ekaikam bhavati tatas śata dvayasya ekam aṅkam ekena aṅkena aṣṭa aṅkam aṣṭa aṅkena yojayitvā adhas bindum upari bindu samīpe dadyāt ayuta dvayam sahasram ekam ṣaṣ śatāni bhavanti ekasmin eva ahorātre tāvantaḥ śvāsāḥ atas vakṣyati

original: asya m-aṅkena yoktavya ahorātreṇa śvāsiketi. varṣe ca tāvanto daṇḍāḥ. ata āha: varṣe ghaṭim eva ceti. ghaṭīśabdena daṇḍaḥ.
analyzed: asya maṅkena yoktavya ahorātreṇa śvāsikā iti varṣe ca tāvantaḥ daṇḍāḥ atas āha varṣe ghaṭim eva ca iti ghaṭī śabdena daṇḍaḥ

original: [1.1.90] jyotiṣaṃ darśayann āha: vākye svaram abhisaṃgṛhya svaram aṅkābhi sthāpitam iti. praṣṭāpuṣpanāma grāhayitavyaḥ. tasya puṣpanāmagrahaṇavākye svaram akṣarāṇi kakārādīni yāvanti tāvanti gṛhītvā. atha vā kakārādisaṃbaddhān svarān vā, tāni tān vā, aṅkena sthāpayet. tena kiṃ syād iti noktaṃ, tasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt. bhuvaneśvarābhi saṃsthāpyeti:
analyzed: jyotiṣam darśayan āha vākye svaram abhisaṃgṛhya svaram aṅka abhi sthāpitam iti praṣṭā puṣpanāma grāhayitavyaḥ tasya puṣpanāma grahaṇa vākye svaram akṣarāṇi kakāra ādīni yāvanti tāvanti gṛhītvā atha vā kakāra ādi saṃbaddhān svarān vā tāni tān vā aṅkena sthāpayet tena kim syāt iti na uktam tasya vakṣyamāṇa tvāt bhuvana īśvara abhi saṃsthāpya iti

original: bhuvaneṣu dvādaśakoṣṭhakeṣv īśvarā akārādayaḥ saṃsthāpyāḥ. kiṃ kṛtvety āha: napuṃsādibhi varjitam iti. ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ etān svarān varjayitvā. etena śubhāśubhapratītaye sādhanam uktam.
analyzed: bhuvaneṣu dvādaśa koṣṭhakeṣu īśvarāḥ akāra ādayaḥ saṃsthāpyāḥ kim kṛtvā iti āha napuṃsa ādibhiḥ varjitam iti ṛ ṝ ḷ ḷ etān svarān varjayitvā etena śubha aśubha pratītaye sādhanam uktam

original: [1.1.91–101] akāra ityādinā tad evāha. tac ca subodham.
analyzed: akāraḥ ityādinā tat eva āha tat ca su bodham

original: [1.1.102] yathā pūrva akārasya tathā antaṃ ceti: yathā akārasya phalaṃ, tathā aḥkārasyāpīty arthaḥ. vākye puṣpanāmākṣarāṇi gṛhītvā kīdṛśīni kartavyānīty āha: ṣaḍguṇam ityādi. vākye yāny akṣarāṇy aṅkārūḍhāni, tāni ṣaḍguṇāni kartavyāni. pūrvasya tṛguṇasya ceti: ṣaḍguṇīkṛtānām akṣarāṅkānāṃ yaḥ pūrvo bhāgaḥ, sa triguṇīkartavyaḥ.
analyzed: yathā pūrvaḥ akārasya tathā antam ca iti yathā akārasya phalam tathā aḥkārasya api iti arthaḥ vākye puṣpa nāma akṣarāṇi gṛhītvā kīdṛśīni kartavyāni iti āha ṣaḍguṇam ityādi vākye yāni akṣarāṇi aṅka ārūḍhāni tāni ṣaḍguṇāni kartavyāni pūrvasya tṛguṇasya ca iti ṣaḍguṇīkṛtānām akṣara aṅkānām yaḥ pūrvaḥ bhāgaḥ sa triguṇīkartavyaḥ

original: [1.1.103] ṣaṣṭipañcam idaṃ miśram iti: pañcaṣaṣṭiṃ tatra prakṣipet. vākye yāny akṣarāṇi ṣaḍguṇīkṛtāni punas triguṇīkṛtāni pañcaṣaṣṭimiśrāṇi bhuvanena dvādaśāṅkena cchedayed dhared ity arthaḥ. śeṣākṣaraṃ tu saṃgṛhyeti: nāmākṣarāṅkeṣu tathābhūteṣu kṛteṣu yaḥ śeṣo 'ṅkas tadvarṇaphalaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ. ete ca dvādaśa svarā rohitādiśabdavācyāḥ.
analyzed: ṣaṣṭi pañcam idam miśram iti pañcaṣaṣṭim tatra prakṣipet vākye yāni akṣarāṇi ṣaḍguṇīkṛtāni punar triguṇīkṛtāni pañcaṣaṣṭi miśrāṇi bhuvanena dvādaśa aṅkena chedayet dharet iti arthaḥ śeṣa akṣaram tu saṃgṛhya iti nāma akṣara aṅkeṣu tathābhūteṣu kṛteṣu yaḥ śeṣaḥ ṅkaḥ tad varṇa phalam bhavati iti bhāvaḥ ete ca dvādaśa svarāḥ rohita ādi śabda vācyāḥ

original: atha vā pūrvasya tṛguṇasya ceti: ye pūrvaṃ puṣpanāmākṣarāṅkā gṛhītās te prathamaṃ triguṇīkartavyāḥ. paścāt ta eva ṣaḍguṇīkartavyā iti. śeṣaṃ pūrvavat.
analyzed: atha vā pūrvasya tṛguṇasya ca iti ye pūrvam puṣpa nāma akṣara aṅkāḥ gṛhītāḥ te prathamam triguṇīkartavyāḥ paścāt te eva ṣaḍguṇīkartavyāḥ iti śeṣam pūrvavat

original: [1.1.104] atha vā horacihnasya gaṇitena svarādikam iti: jñānaḍākinīmantreṇa khaṭikām abhimantrya tayā gomūtradhārākāreṇa jñānaḍākinīmantraṃ sakṛd āvartyaṃ kurvan rekhām ākarṣayet. yāvaddūraṃ cittaṃ viśrāmyati, tāvad ākṛṣya rekhā gaṇayitvā tatsaṃkhyasya svarasya phalaṃ pūrvoktanyāyena jñātavyam iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: atha vā hora cihnasya gaṇitena svara ādikam iti jñāna ḍākinī mantreṇa khaṭikām abhimantrya tayā go mūtra dhārā ākāreṇa jñāna ḍākinī mantram sakṛt āvartyam kurvan rekhām ākarṣayet yāvat dūram cittam viśrāmyati tāvat ākṛṣya rekhāḥ gaṇayitvā tad saṃkhyasya svarasya phalam pūrva ukta nyāyena jñātavyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: atha vā puṣpa nikṣipya tathā bhūmyādi lakṣayed iti: dvādaśakoṣṭheṣu dvādaśa svarān krameṇa vinyasya kāryaṃ buddhisthīkṛtya puṣpaṃ dāpayet. yasmin patati tat puṣpaṃ, tatsvaraphalaṃ bhavati. bhūmyādi dvādaśa koṣṭhāni. darśayet sarva satyeneti: sarvaṃ śubhāśubhaṃ tattvena paśyed ity arthaḥ. satyam etad iti niścinvann āha:
analyzed: atha vā puṣpa nikṣipya tathā bhūmi ādi lakṣayet iti dvādaśa koṣṭheṣu dvādaśa svarān krameṇa vinyasya kāryam puṣpam dāpayet yasmin patati tat puṣpam tad svara phalam bhavati bhūmi ādi dvādaśa koṣṭhāni darśayet sarva satyena iti sarvam śubha aśubham tattvena paśyet iti arthaḥ satyam etat iti niścinvan āha

original: yogaśāstraṃ tu śaṃsitas tv iti. yogaśāstraṃ mantranayaḥ. tanniyamenārthakaram, sarvabuddhaiḥ praśaṃsitatvād iti.
analyzed: yoga śāstram tu śaṃsitaḥ tu iti yoga śāstram mantra nayaḥ tad niyamena artha karam sarva buddhaiḥ praśaṃsita tvāt iti

original: [1.1.col.] iti prakaraṇe ātmapīṭha iti: vāyvāditattvasyātmaiva svaśarīram eva pīṭham āsanam ādhāraḥ. ityuktakrameṇa vāyvāditattvaṃ prakriyate prastūyate. anena veti. itiprakaraṇam ātmapīṭham eva. ity ātmapīṭhe catuṣpīṭhanibandhe prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ ||
analyzed: iti prakaraṇe ātma pīṭha iti vāyu ādi tattvasya ātmā eva sva śarīram eva pīṭham āsanam ādhāraḥ iti ukta krama vāyu ādi tattvam prakriyate prastūyate anena vā iti iti prakaraṇa ātma pīṭha eva iti ātma pīṭha catuṣpīṭha nibandhe prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ

original: [1.2.1] idānīṃ kālajñānatadvañcanādipaṭalam āha: bhagavan śrotum icchāmi jñānatattvaṃ viśeṣata iti. jñānatattvaṃ viṣāpaharaṇādikam. kathaṃ cihnam idam aṅga iti mṛtyucihnam. kathaṃ tattvaṃ samāśritam iti mantratattvam.
analyzed: idānīm kāla jñāna tad vañcana ādi paṭalam āha bhagavan śrotum icchāmi jñāna tattvam viśeṣataḥ iti jñāna tattvam viṣa apaharaṇa ādikam katham cihnam idam aṅge iti mṛtyu cihnam katham tattvam samāśritam iti mantra tattvam

original: [1.2.2] śṛṇu vajramahārāja m-aṅgacihnasya darśitam iti: nirmāṇādikāyai rājata iti rājā. vajra evākṣobhya eva mahārājo yasyāsau vajramahārājaḥ saṃbodhyate. aṅgacihnaṃ darśitaṃ darśayitavyam anantaram, śṛṇu. mṛtyukālam iva sthitam iti mṛtyukālo niyataṃ jñāyata iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: śṛṇu vajra mahā rāja maṅga cihnasya darśitam iti nirmāṇa ādi kāyai rājate iti rājā vajraḥ eva akṣobhyaḥ eva mahā rājaḥ yasya asau vajra mahā rājaḥ saṃbodhyate aṅga cihnam darśitam darśayitavyam anantaram śṛṇu mṛtyu kālam iva sthitam iti mṛtyu kālaḥ niyatam jñāyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.2.3] cihnam āha: śvāsā ityādi. śvāsānāṃ visphuraṇam anyathātvaṃ nyūnātirekitvaṃ sahajāvasthāto 'nyathātvam. ṣaṇmāsair avaśyaṃ cyutir bhavati. atha vā prātaḥsamaye śvāsasya visphuraṇamātreṇāvartavivartanirgamena. kiṃ kṛtvā visphuraṇam ity āha: bhayaṃ kiṃcit tathādṛṣṭveti. āghātaśramādikam apīha gṛhyate, bhayasyopalakṣaṇatvāt.
analyzed: cihnam āha śvāsāḥ ityādi śvāsānām visphuraṇam anyathātvam nyūna atireki tvam sahaja avasthātaḥ nyathātvam ṣaṣ māsaiḥ avaśyam cyutiḥ bhavati atha vā prātar samaye śvāsasya visphuraṇa mātreṇa āvarta vivarta nirgamena kim kṛtvā visphuraṇam iti āha bhayam kiṃcid tathā dṛṣṭvā iti āghāta śrama ādikam api iha gṛhyate bhayasya upalakṣaṇa tvāt

original: tataś ca bhayādinā vinā yadi śvāsavisphuraṇaṃ bhavati tadā mṛtyur iti bhāvaḥ. bhayādinā hi prakṛtir anyathā bhavati. kapole ghūrṇasandhiketi kapolayoḥ kūpakau yati syātām, bhayādinā vinety anyatrāpi jñeyam, tadā niyamena mṛtyur bhavatīti.
analyzed: tatas ca bhaya ādinā vinā yadi śvāsa visphuraṇam bhavati tadā mṛtyuḥ iti bhāvaḥ bhaya ādinā hi prakṛtiḥ anyathā bhavati kapole ghūrṇa sandhikā iti kapolayoḥ kūpakau yati syātām bhaya ādinā vinā iti anyatra api jñeyam tadā niyamena mṛtyuḥ bhavati iti

original: [1.2.4] ata āha: āpatsu yadi mātreṇeti. āpadviṣayam etad ity arthaḥ. śvāsā chijjati cchijjatīti śvāsānyathātvam. pūrvāhne rohitābhāga iti prātar daṇḍatraye sati. bhayādiviraheṇa sarvatra nimittaṃ satyaṃ bhavatīti jñātavyam.
analyzed: atas āha āpatsu yadi mātreṇa iti āpad viṣayam etat iti arthaḥ śvāsā chijjati chijjati iti śvāsa anyathātvam pūrvāhne rohitābhāgaḥ iti prātar daṇḍa traye sati bhaya ādi viraheṇa sarvatra nimittam satyam bhavati iti jñātavyam

original: [1.2.5] nāse māṃsika vicchidyeti nāsāmāṃsikavicchede. dina saptā na saṃśaya iti dinaiḥ saptabhir mṛtyur asaṃśayo bhavati. yadā nāsāmāṃsavicchedo bhavati tadā nāsā vakratāṃ yāti, mṛtyuś ca saptāhika iti bhāvaḥ. cakṣurambarasaṃchede troṭā pañcāhikas tatheti: ambaram udakaṃ lotam ity arthaḥ. saṃchedo 'bhāvaḥ. troṭeti mṛtyuḥ.
analyzed: nāse māṃsika vicchidya iti nāsā māṃsika vicchede na saṃśayaḥ iti dinaiḥ saptabhiḥ mṛtyuḥ asaṃśayaḥ bhavati yadā nāsā māṃsa vicchedaḥ bhavati tadā nāsā vakratām yāti mṛtyuḥ ca saptāhikaḥ iti bhāvaḥ cakṣuḥ ambara saṃchede pañcāhikaḥ tathā iti ambaram udakam lotam iti arthaḥ saṃchedaḥ bhāvaḥ troṭa iti mṛtyuḥ

original: cakṣuṣor netrayor udakavirahe pañcāhiko mṛtyur iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: cakṣuṣoḥ netrayoḥ udaka virahe pañcāhikaḥ mṛtyuḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.2.6] kapolena tu pārśvānāṃ ajīvo m-ekarātrata iti: kapolapārśve nāḍīdvayaṃ yadā truṭyati tadā kapolau dīrghanimnajoḍikādhāriṇau stas tadaiva ca mṛtyur ekāhiko bhavatīty arthaḥ. kūpakau tu yadā kapolayos tadā ṣāṇmāsiko mṛtyur iti jñeyam. udukarṇakaviccheda ghaṭi pañcā na saṃśaya iti: udukarṇaśabdena karṇapuṭam.
analyzed: kapolena tu pārśvānām ajīvaḥ mā eka rātrāt iti kapola pārśve nāḍī dvayam yadā truṭyati tadā kapolau staḥ tadā eva ca mṛtyuḥ ekāhikaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ kūpakau tu yadā kapolayoḥ tadā ṣāṇmāsikaḥ mṛtyuḥ iti jñeyam na saṃśayaḥ iti udukarṇa śabdena karṇapuṭam

original: yadā karṇapuṭadvayanāḍīdvayaṃ truṭyati tadā karṇau svasthānataḥ patataḥ, pañcaghaṭikāvadhiś ca mṛtyus tadā.
analyzed: yadā karṇapuṭa dvaya nāḍī dvayam truṭyati tadā karṇau sva sthānataḥ patataḥ pañca ghaṭikā avadhiḥ ca mṛtyuḥ tadā

original: [1.2.7] jihvā kālam idaṃ sūtraṃ dvirātryā cyuti dehinām iti: jihvāyāṃ kālasūtraṃ yadā tadā dvyāhikī cyutir iti bhāvaḥ. dantadanturabhilagnau trirātryā mṛtyu-m-āgamam iti: yadā dantasandhināḍī truṭyati tadā dantapaṅktidvayaṃ niḥsandhi bhavati, dinatrayeṇa ca mṛtyuḥ.
analyzed: jihvā kālam idam sūtram dvi rātryā cyuti dehinām iti jihvāyām kāla sūtram yadā tadā dvyāhikī cyutiḥ iti bhāvaḥ danta dantuḥ abhilagnau tri rātryā mṛtyum āgamam iti yadā danta sandhi nāḍī truṭyati tadā danta paṅkti dvayam niḥsandhi bhavati dina trayeṇa ca mṛtyuḥ

original: [1.2.8] grīvāpārśva bahir nāḍīti: grīvāpārśvayor nāḍīdvayaṃ bahir bhavati yadā pārśvadvayam unnataṃ bhavati pakṣam eva na saṃśaya iti pakṣāvadhir asaṃśayo mṛtyuḥ. hṛdipañjaranimnānāṃ pakṣaṃ vaidyācikitsayeti: yadā hṛtpañjaramagnā nāḍī truṭyati tadā hṛdi gartaṃ bhavati, tadā ca pakṣāvadhir mṛtyuḥ. vaidyacikitsā ca na tatra kācit.
analyzed: bahis nāḍī iti grīvā pārśva bahis nāḍī iti grīvā pārśvayoḥ nāḍī dvayam bahis bhavati yadā pārśva dvayam unnatam bhavati pakṣam eva na saṃśayaḥ iti pakṣa avadhiḥ asaṃśayaḥ mṛtyuḥ hṛdipañjara nimnānām pakṣam vaidya ācikitsayā iti yadā hṛd pañjara magnā nāḍī truṭyati tadā hṛdi gartam bhavati tadā ca pakṣa avadhiḥ mṛtyuḥ vaidya cikitsā ca na tatra kācid

original: [1.2.9] nakhāśoṇita dehānāṃ dinam aṣṭā na saṃśaya iti: yadā nakhavāhinyo nāḍyas truṭyanti tadā najhā aśoṇitā bhavanti. akasmāc chvetā ity arthaḥ. tadāṣṭabhir eva dinair mṛtyur ity arthaḥ. akasmād eva yady etāni cihnāni bhavanti tadā mṛtyur eveti boddhavyam. aṣṭa cihnāni aṅgasya mṛtyukālaṃ tu darśitam iti:
analyzed: dehānām dinam aṣṭā na saṃśayaḥ iti yadā nakha vāhinyaḥ nāḍyaḥ truṭyanti tadā aśoṇitāḥ bhavanti akasmāt śvetāḥ iti arthaḥ tadā aṣṭabhiḥ eva dinaiḥ mṛtyuḥ iti arthaḥ akasmāt eva yadi etāni cihnāni bhavanti tadā mṛtyuḥ eva iti boddhavyam aṣṭa cihnāni aṅgasya mṛtyu kālam tu darśitam iti

original: aśnoti vyāpnotīty asminn arthe ṣaṣṭhīlope saty aṣṭeti padaṃ mṛtyukālaviśeṣaṇam. aṅgasyety aṅgeṣu. mṛtyukālaṃ mṛtyukālasya. darśitaṃ darśitāni. mṛtyukālasya cihnavyāpakasyāṅgeṣu cihnāni prāg darśitānīti bhāvaḥ. yatraiteṣu cihneṣu kim api cihnaṃ prāṇino 'ṅge syāt tatra niyamena mṛtyuḥ.
analyzed: aśnoti vyāpnoti iti asmin arthe ṣaṣṭhī lope sati aṣṭa iti padam mṛtyu kāla viśeṣaṇam aṅgasya iti aṅgeṣu mṛtyu kālam mṛtyu kālasya darśitam darśitāni mṛtyu kālasya cihna vyāpakasya aṅgeṣu cihnāni prāk darśitāni iti bhāvaḥ yatra eteṣu cihneṣu kim api cihnam prāṇinaḥ ṅge syāt tatra niyamena mṛtyuḥ

original: [1.2.10] idānīṃ mṛtyuvañcanam āha: nāse māṃsikavicchede jñānabījena pīḍayed iti. nāsānāḍīvicchede tatpūraṇārthaṃ jñānabījaṃ jñānaḍākinībījaṃ hūṃkāras tenāmṛtadhārākarālena pīḍayet. tat sthānam āpyāyayed ity arthaḥ. atha vā hūṃkārapariṇatāṃ jñānaḍākinīṃ vakṣyamāṇarūpāṃ tasmin sthāne bhāvayet. ataḥ sā nāḍī pūrṇā bhavati.
analyzed: idānīm mṛtyu vañcanam āha nāse māṃsika vicchede jñāna bījena pīḍayet iti nāsā nāḍī vicchede tad pūraṇa artham jñāna bījam jñāna ḍākinī bījam hūṃkāraḥ tena amṛta dhārā karālena pīḍayet tat sthānam āpyāyayet iti arthaḥ atha vā hūṃkāra pariṇatām jñāna ḍākinīm vakṣyamāṇa rūpām tasmin sthāne bhāvayet atas sā nāḍī pūrṇā bhavati

original: nāḍīvicchedadvāreṇa hi mṛtyur viśati. sā cet pūrṇā so 'pi nivartata iti bhāvaḥ. sarvatra yadbījenāpyāyanaṃ kriyate taddevatāyogena tat kartavyam. cakṣurambaratroṭānāṃ vajrībījena tejayed iti:
analyzed: nāḍī viccheda dvāreṇa hi mṛtyuḥ viśati sā ced pūrṇā nivartate iti bhāvaḥ sarvatra yat bījena āpyāyanam kriyate tad devatā yogena tat kartavyam cakṣuḥ ambara troṭānām vajrī bījena tejayet iti

original: cakṣurnāḍīdvayavicchede yadi troṭā bhavati tatra sthāne vajrībījaṃ suṃkāras tena tadbījapariṇatayā vā vajraḍākinyāmṛtadhārākarālavapuṣāpyāyanaṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: cakṣuḥ nāḍī dvaya vicchede yadi troṭā bhavati tatra sthāne vajrī bījam suṃkāraḥ tena tad bīja pariṇatayā vā vajra ḍākinyā amṛta dhārā karāla vapuṣā āpyāyanam kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.2.11] kapolena tu pārśvānāṃ ghorībījena pīḍayed iti: kapolapārśvanāḍīvicchede ghoraḍākinībījaṃ kṣuṃkāras tena tadbījapariṇatā ghoraḍākinī tayā vā pūraṇaṃ vidadhyād iti bhāvaḥ. karṇāntā uduka cchinnā vettālībīja jāpitam iti: karṇapuṭadvayanāḍīvicchede sati vettālībījaṃ yuṃkāraṃ tadbījapariṇatāṃ vā vettālīṃ tatra bhāvayet.
analyzed: kapolena tu pārśvānām ghorī bījena pīḍayet iti kapola pārśva nāḍī vicchede ghora ḍākinī bījam kṣuṃkāraḥ tena tad bīja pariṇatā ghoraḍākinī tayā vā pūraṇam vidadhyāt iti bhāvaḥ iti karṇa puṭa dvaya nāḍī vicchede sati vettālī bījam tad bīja pariṇatām vā vettālīm tatra bhāvayet

original: [1.2.12] jihvā kālam idaṃ sūtraṃ caṇḍālībīja cintitam iti: jihvākālasūtre caṇḍālībījaṃ huṃkāraṃ tatpariṇatāṃ vā caṇḍālīṃ tatra dhyāyād iti boddhavyam. dantadantābhilagnasya siṃghībījena tāḍitam iti: dantanāḍīvicchede siṃghībījaṃ smryuṃ tatpariṇatāṃ vā siṃghīṃ tatra bhāvayet.
analyzed: jihvā kālam idam sūtram caṇḍālī bīja cintitam iti jihvā kāla sūtre caṇḍālī bījam huṃkāram tad pariṇatām vā caṇḍālīm tatra dhyāyāt iti boddhavyam danta danta abhilagnasya siṃghī bījena tāḍitam iti danta nāḍī vicchede siṃghī bījam tad pariṇatām vā siṃghīm tatra bhāvayet

original: [1.2.13] grīvāpārśva bahir nāḍī vyāghrībījena pīḍayed iti: grīvāpārśvanāḍīdvayavicchede vyāghrībījaṃ hmryuṃ tatpariṇatāṃ vā vyāghrīṃ tatra bhāvayet. hṛdipañjaranimnānāṃ jambukībīja dhāritam iti: hṛdi pañjaranāḍīvicchede jambukībījaṃ ymryuṃ tatpariṇatāṃ vā jambukīṃ tatra cintayet.
analyzed: bahis nāḍī vyāghrī bījena pīḍayet iti grīvā pārśva nāḍī dvaya vicchede vyāghrī bījam tad pariṇatām vā vyāghrīm tatra bhāvayet hṛdi pañjara nimnānām dhāritam iti hṛdi pañjara nāḍī vicchede jambukī bījam tad pariṇatām vā jambukīm tatra cintayet

original: [1.2.14] nakhāśoṇitahastānāṃ ulūkībījena gṛhyata iti: hastanakhanāḍīviccheda ulūkībījaṃ kṣmryuṃ tatpariṇatām ulūkīṃ vā tatra bhāvayet. mṛtyucihnāni m-aṅgasya ebhi bījena rakṣitam iti: yāni mṛtyucihnāni śarīragatāni, bījair jñānaḍākinyādiyoginīsaṃbaddhais tāni pūrvoktakrameṇa rakṣitavyānīti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: nakha śoṇita hastānām ulūkī bījena gṛhyate iti hasta nakha nāḍī vicchedaḥ ulūkī bījam tad pariṇatām ulūkīm vā tatra bhāvayet mṛtyu cihnāni maṅgasya bījena rakṣitam iti yāni mṛtyu cihnāni śarīra gatāni bījaiḥ jñāna ḍākinī ādi yoginī saṃbaddhaiḥ tāni pūrva ukta krameṇa rakṣitavyāni iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.2.15] paścād vidhivac cakraṃ jñāna vijñāna rakṣitam iti: paścād aparaṃ vidhiṃ vakṣya ity adhyāhāryam. tam evāha: vidhivad ityādi. jñānena vijñānaṃ rakṣituṃ vidhiḥ kārya iti bhāvaḥ. aparai rakṣāṃ vakṣya iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ. tatrāpareṇa prakāreṇa rakṣāṃ prāṇasthitiṃ vakṣya iti vyākhyā. vidhim āha: āmetyādi. āmabhāṇḍadvayam apakvaśarāvadvayam.
analyzed: paścāt vidhivat cakram jñāna vijñāna rakṣitam iti paścāt aparam vidhim vakṣye iti adhyāhāryam tam eva āha vidhivat ityādi jñānena vijñānam rakṣitum vidhiḥ kāryaḥ iti bhāvaḥ aparaiḥ rakṣām vakṣye iti kvacid pāṭhaḥ tatra apareṇa prakāreṇa rakṣām prāṇa sthitim vakṣye iti vyākhyā vidhim āha āma ityādi āma bhāṇḍa dvayam apakva śarāva dvayam

original: rocanakuṅkumair iti: gorocanayā kuṅkumena vā. atha vā kuṅkumarocanābhyāṃ miśrībhūtābhyāṃ cakraṃ likhed iti saṃbandhaḥ.
analyzed: rocana kuṅkumaiḥ iti gorocanayā kuṅkumena vā atha vā kuṅkuma rocanābhyām miśrībhūtābhyām cakram likhet iti saṃbandhaḥ

original: [1.2.16] nava koṣṭhādi bhāgasyeti: adhaḥśarāve catuḥsūtrasamāyogān nava bhāgā nava koṣṭhakāni bhavanti. adha iti kuta ity āha: ūrdhva dvādaśabhāgavad iti. uparitanaśarāve koṇeṣu caturṣu catuḥsūtrayogād dvādaśa bhāgā dvādaśa koṣṭhakāni bhavanti. dvādaśabhāgavad dvādaśakoṣṭhavad ity arthaḥ. likhen madhya sya nāmaṃ tv iti:
analyzed: nava koṣṭha ādi bhāgasya iti adhas śarāve catur sūtra samāyogāt nava bhāgāḥ nava koṣṭhakāni bhavanti adhas iti kutas iti āha ūrdhva dvādaśa bhāga vat iti uparitana śarāve koṇeṣu caturṣu catur sūtra yogāt dvādaśa bhāgāḥ dvādaśa koṣṭhakāni bhavanti dvādaśa bhāga vat dvādaśa koṣṭha vat iti arthaḥ likhet tu iti

original: cakramadhyakoṣṭhake sādhyasya nāma likhet. bījaveṣṭanabhis tatheti: bījāni mantrākṣarāṇi tair veṣṭanāni taiḥ saha mantrākṣarair garbhayitvā nāma likhed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: cakra madhya koṣṭhake sādhyasya nāma likhet bīja veṣṭanabhiḥ tathā iti bījāni mantra akṣarāṇi taiḥ veṣṭanāni taiḥ saha mantra akṣaraiḥ garbhayitvā nāma likhet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.2.17] garbhaṇam āha: praṇamāsvara pūrvasyeti. praṇamāsvareti: praṇavasvara oṃkāra ity arthaḥ. sa pūrvaṃ prathamaṃ bhavati. kasmād bhavati prathamam ity āśaṅkāyāṃ sādhyanāmata iti draṣṭavyam. sādhyanāma ca kutrety āha: pūrvasmin rakṣavākyata iti. rakṣaśabdāt pūrvasmin. antena tu bījasya pañcabuddhābhimaṇḍitam iti:
analyzed: garbhaṇam āha praṇamāsvara pūrvasya iti praṇamāsvara iti praṇava svaraḥ oṃkāraḥ iti arthaḥ sa pūrvam prathamam bhavati kasmāt bhavati prathamam iti āśaṅkāyām sādhya nāmataḥ iti draṣṭavyam sādhya nāma ca kutra iti āha pūrvasmin rakṣa vākyataḥ iti rakṣa śabdāt pūrvasmin antena tu bījasya pañca buddha abhimaṇḍitam iti

original: tasya rakṣaśabdasyānte 'vasāne pañcabuddhābhimaṇḍitaṃ bījaṃ hūṃkāra ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: tasya rakṣa śabdasya ante vasāne pañcabuddha abhimaṇḍitam bījam hūṃkāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [1.2.18] huta-akṣara antasyeti: hūṃkārasyāpy ante hutākṣaraṃ svāhākāraḥ. oṃ devadattaṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ svāheti samudāyārthaḥ. rakṣaśabdo dvir ukta upadeśāt. svara ūrdhvaṃ tu nimnakair iti: ūrdhvaśabdo bahirvācakaḥ. nimnakair iti nemiḥ. navakoṣṭhakabahī rekhādvayarūpāyāṃ nemyāṃ ṣoḍaśa svarā iti bhāvaḥ. ūrdhvaśarāve 'py evaṃ svarā nemyāṃ likhanīyāḥ.
analyzed: antasya iti hūṃkārasya api ante huta akṣaram svāhākāraḥ om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa hūm svāhā iti samudāya arthaḥ rakṣa śabdaḥ dvis uktaḥ upadeśāt svaraḥ ūrdhvam tu nimnakaiḥ iti ūrdhva śabdaḥ bahis vācakaḥ nimnakaiḥ iti nemiḥ rekhā dvaya rūpāyām nemyām ṣoḍaśa svarāḥ iti bhāvaḥ ūrdhva śarāve pi evam svarāḥ nemyām likhanīyāḥ

original: atha vā, ūrdhvaṃ tv iti: ūrdhvaśarāvam. nimnakair iti: adhaḥśarāvam. śeṣaṃ pūrvavat. punar veṣṭanam āha: khaphadviguṇabījasyeti. kho huṃkāraḥ. pho yuṃkāraḥ. dviguṇabījaṃ kṣuṃkāraḥ. vajrīdevatināmata iti: vajrīdevatī nāmnā vajraḍākinī, tasyā bījaṃ suṃkāraḥ.
analyzed: atha vā ūrdhvam tu iti ūrdhva śarāvam nimnakaiḥ iti adhas śarāvam śeṣam pūrvavat punar veṣṭanam āha khapha dviguṇa bījasya iti khaḥ huṃkāraḥ phaḥ yuṃkāraḥ dviguṇa bījam kṣuṃkāraḥ vajrīdevati nāmataḥ iti vajrīdevatī nāmnā vajraḍākinī tasyāḥ bījam suṃkāraḥ

original: [1.2.19] pañcasaṃyuktabījasyeti: pañcabuddhasaṃyuktabījaṃ hūṃkāraḥ sarvatra. praṇameti: ādau sarvatra praṇavaḥ. huta antimeti: ante sarvatra svāhākāraḥ. tad ayam arthaḥ:
analyzed: pañca saṃyukta bījasya iti pañca buddha saṃyukta bījam hūṃkāraḥ sarvatra praṇama iti ādau sarvatra praṇavaḥ huta antima iti ante sarvatra svāhākāraḥ tat ayam arthaḥ

original: oṃ devadattaṃ rakṣa rakṣa huṃ hūṃ svāhā, oṃ devadattaṃ rakṣa rakṣa yuṃ hūṃ svāhā, oṃ devadattaṃ rakṣa rakṣa kṣuṃ hūṃ svāhā, oṃ devadattaṃ rakṣa rakṣa suṃ hūṃ svāheti yoginīnāṃ vyatikrameṇa mantroddhāraḥ. hūṃkārasya pañcabuddhāṃśatvam āha: daṇḍam ityādi. daṇḍo hakārasyādhobhāge rekhā. lokeśvaro 'mitābhaḥ. kuṭila ūkāraḥ. sa vajrapāṇir akṣobhyaḥ.
analyzed: om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa hum   svāhā om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa yum   svāhā om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa     svāhā om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa     svāhā om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa     svāhā om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa     svāhā om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa     svāhā om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa     svāhā iti yoginīnām vyatikrameṇa mantra uddhāraḥ hūṃkārasya pañca buddha aṃśa tvam āha daṇḍam ityādi daṇḍaḥ hakārasya adhobhāge rekhā lokeśvaraḥ

original: [1.2.20] aṅgam iti hakāraḥ. sa mañjuvaro ratnasambhavaḥ. ghaṇṭam iti: ardhacandraḥ. sa maitreyo 'moghasiddhiḥ. makāra jvalita ūrdhvaṃ sa vai saṃsāramocaka iti: makāro 'nusvāraḥ. sa eva vairocanaḥ. sa itthaṃ pañcabuddhātmako hūṃkāraḥ saṃsāramocakaḥ.
analyzed: aṅgam iti hakāraḥ sa mañjuvaraḥ ratnasambhavaḥ ghaṇṭam iti ardhacandraḥ sa maitreyaḥ mogha siddhiḥ makāra jvalitaḥ ūrdhvam sa vai saṃsāra mocakaḥ iti makāraḥ nusvāraḥ saḥ eva vairocanaḥ saḥ ittham pañca buddha ātmakaḥ hūṃkāraḥ saṃsāra mocakaḥ

original: [1.2.21] pūrvadiśādi saṃsthāpya devya ḍākini vajriṇam iti: navakoṣṭhasya cakrasya pūrvakoṣṭhake vajraḍākinīmantraṃ likhet. oṃ devadattaṃ rakṣa rakṣa suṃ hūṃ svāheti. uttare ghoranāmānāṃ bījaṃ tasyaiva yojayed iti: vāmāvartata uttare ghoranāmnī ḍākinī tasyā bījaṃ mantras tad yojayet. likhed ity arthaḥ. oṃ devadattaṃ rakṣa rakṣa kṣuṃ hūṃ svāheti.
analyzed: pūrva diśā ādi saṃsthāpya devya ḍākini vajriṇam iti nava koṣṭhasya cakrasya pūrva koṣṭhake vajra ḍākinī mantram likhet om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa sum   svāhā iti uttare ghora nāmānām bījam tasya eva yojayet iti vāma āvartataḥ uttare ghora nāmnī ḍākinī tasyāḥ bījam mantraḥ tat yojayet likhet iti arthaḥ om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa     svāhā iti

original: [1.2.22] vettālī paścimasthā tv iti: vettālyā bījaṃ mantraṃ paścime likhet. oṃ devadattaṃ rakṣa rakṣa yuṃ hūṃ svāheti. caṇḍālītyādi: dakṣiṇe caṇḍālībījaṃ mantraṃ pūrṇoktito 'tisaṃpūrṇaṃ likhet. oṃ devadattaṃ rakṣa rakṣa huṃ hūṃ svāheti krameṇa mantralikhanam.
analyzed: vettālī paścima sthā tu iti vettālyāḥ bījam mantram paścime likhet om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa yum   svāhā iti caṇḍālī ityādi dakṣiṇe caṇḍālī bījam mantram pūrṇa uktyāḥ ti saṃpūrṇam likhet om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa hum   svāhā iti krameṇa mantra likhanam

original: [1.2.23] īśāna ityādi: aiśānakoṇe siṃghinīmantro yathā smryuṃ. āgneyakoṇe vyāghrīmantro yathā hmryuṃ. nairṛte koṇe jambūkīmantro yathā ymryuṃ. vāyavyakoṇa ulūkīmantro yathā kṣmryuṃ. hūṃkṛtir iti: hūṃkāroccāraṇātmikā ḍākinī, ulūkānukaraṇāt. atra vidarbhaṇaṃ nāsti. upadeśābhāvāt.
analyzed: īśānaḥ ityādi aiśāna koṇe siṃghinī mantraḥ yathā āgneya koṇe vyāghrī mantraḥ yathā hmryum nairṛte koṇe jambūkī mantraḥ yathā vāyavya koṇe ulūkī mantraḥ yathā hūṃkṛtiḥ iti hūṃkāra uccāraṇa ātmikā ḍākinī ulūka anukaraṇāt atra vidarbhaṇam na asti upadeśa abhāvāt

original: [1.2.24] bījakoṇyā tu koṇyānāṃ catvāro ṣaḍbhir akṣarair iti: ity uktakrameṇa siṃghinyādīnāṃ catvāri bījāni ṣaḍakṣarāṇi saṃyuktarūpāṇi koṇe koṇe nyasanīyānīty arthaḥ. mantranyāsopasaṃhāram āha: yathetyādi. yasyā diśo yad bījaṃ, tasyāṃ tad vinyased iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: bīja koṇyā tu koṇyānām catvāraḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ akṣaraiḥ iti iti ukta krameṇa siṃghinī ādīnām catvāri bījāni ṣaṣ akṣarāṇi saṃyukta rūpāṇi koṇe koṇe nyasanīyāni iti arthaḥ mantra nyāsa upasaṃhāram āha yathā ityādi yasyāḥ diśaḥ yat bījam tasyām tat vinyaset iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.2.25] ūrdhva dvādaśa sthānasya svarabījasya sthāpayed iti: ūrdhvaśarāve dvādaśa koṣṭhake dvādaśa svarāṃl likhed iti. adhaḥśarāvavan madhyakoṣṭhamantranyāsam āha: praṇamā huta antasyeti. oṃkāraḥ svāhākāraḥ praṇamāhutaśabdābhyām. antasyeti hūṃkāraḥ. tad ayam arthaḥ: oṃ devadattaṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ svāheti cakramadhye lekhyo mantraḥ.
analyzed: dvādaśa sthānasya svarabījasya sthāpayet iti ūrdhva śarāve dvādaśa koṣṭhake dvādaśa svarān likhet iti adhas śarāva vat madhya koṣṭha mantra nyāsam āha antasya iti oṃkāraḥ svāhākāraḥ praṇamā huta śabdābhyām antasya iti hūṃkāraḥ tat ayam arthaḥ om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa hūm svāhā iti cakra madhye lekhyaḥ mantraḥ

original: pūrvakoṣṭhe ṛ, uttare ṝ, paścime ḷ, dakṣiṇe ḹ. etad evāha: diśaṃ napuṃsake sthāpayed iti: uktakrameṇa dikṣu napuṃsakasvarān sthāpayet. vidikṣv itarān upadeśataḥ. aiśāne dakṣiṇāvartena i ī, āgneye u ū, nairṛte e ai, vāyavye o au. svarabījasya sthāpayed ity asya samudāyārthaḥ.
analyzed: pūrva koṣṭhe uttare paścime ḷ dakṣiṇe etat eva āha diśam napuṃsake sthāpayet iti ukta krameṇa dikṣu napuṃsaka svarān sthāpayet vidikṣu itarān upadeśataḥ aiśāne dakṣiṇa āvartena āgneye nairṛte vāyavye svara bījasya sthāpayet iti asya samudāya arthaḥ

original: [1.2.26] dīpinyādīnāṃ napuṃsakacatuṣṭayaṃ bījam. tad evāha: dīpinītyādi. yathāsthāneṣu sthātavyaṃ praṇamā huta antimeti: pūrvaṃ yathā navakoṣṭhakacakramadhye praṇavasvāhāhūṃkārāḥ sthāpitās, tathaivātrāpi dvādaśakoṣṭhaka iti bhāvaḥ. yathā oṃ devadattaṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ svāheti.
analyzed: dīpinī ādīnām napuṃsaka catuṣṭayam bījam tat eva āha dīpinī ityādi yathā sthāneṣu sthātavyam antimā iti pūrvam yathā nava koṣṭhaka cakra madhye praṇava svāhā hūṃkārāḥ sthāpitāḥ tathā eva atra api dvādaśa koṣṭhake iti bhāvaḥ yathā om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa   svāhā iti

original: [1.2.27] yasyā yad bījaṃ, tasyās tad diṅniyamena darśayann āha: pūrva ityādi. pūrvakoṣṭhaṃ ḍākinyās, tata ṛkāras tadbījam. uttaraṃ dīpinyās, tata ṝkāras tadbījam. paścimaṃ cūṣiṇyās, tata ḷkāras tadbījam. dakṣiṇaṃ kambojikāyās tata ḹkāras tadbījam.
analyzed: yasyāḥ yat bījam tasyāḥ tat diś niyamena darśayan āha pūrvaḥ ityādi pūrva koṣṭham ḍākinyāḥ tatas ṛkāraḥ tat bījam uttaram dīpinyāḥ tatas ṝkāraḥ tat bījam paścimam cūṣiṇyāḥ tatas ḷkāraḥ tat bījam dakṣiṇam kambojikāyāḥ tatas ḍāraḥ tat bījam

original: [1.2.28] yathetyādi nirdeśasya pratinirdeśam āha: madhya ityādi. mantrasahitaṃ sādhyanāma cakramadhye likhanīyam. katham ity āha: yathā nāmaṃ tu ūrdhvagam iti. ūrdhvagaṃ pūrvaṃ yathā nāma likhitaṃ navakoṣṭhake cakre, tathaivety arthaḥ. atha vā praṇavarakṣarakṣaśabdayor madhye sādhyanāma likhitavyam iti vyākhyā. śeṣaṃ pūrvavat.
analyzed: yathā ityādi nirdeśasya pratinirdeśam āha madhye ityādi mantra sahitam sādhya nāma cakra madhye likhanīyam katham iti āha yathā nāmam tu ūrdhva gam iti ūrdhva gam pūrvam yathā nāma likhitam nava koṣṭhake cakre tathā eva iti arthaḥ atha vā praṇava rakṣa rakṣa śabdayoḥ madhye sādhya nāma likhitavyam iti vyākhyā śeṣam pūrvavat

original: yathā nimnaṃ tu ūrdhvagam iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ. nimnam iti madhyam. ūrdhvagam ity upariśarāvam. tad ayam arthaḥ: yathā
analyzed: yathā nimnam tu ūrdhva gam iti kvacid pāṭhaḥ nimnam iti madhyam ūrdhva gam iti upari śarāvam tat ayam arthaḥ yathā

original: pūrvacakramadhyanyāsas, tathātrāpīti. dvayetyādi: śarāvadvayaṃ saṃpuṭaṃ kṛtvā raktasūtreṇa veṣṭayitvā ...
analyzed: pūrva cakra madhya nyāsaḥ tathā atra api iti dvaya ityādi śarāva dvayam saṃpuṭam kṛtvā rakta sūtreṇa veṣṭayitvā

original: [1.2.29] ... samantataḥ same pradeśe raktacandanalipte ca sthāpayitvā pūjayet. pūjām āha: vividhetyādi. ādhānakābalim iti: candanalipte pradeśe yantraṃ sthāpayituṃ prāg eva balir deyaḥ. ādhānakābalir āmamatsyamāṃsapalāṇḍuraśonādibhiḥ piṣṭakādibhiś ca yo dīyate.
analyzed: samantataḥ same pradeśe raktacandana lipte ca sthāpayitvā pūjayet pūjām āha vividha ityādi ādhānakā balim iti candana lipte pradeśe yantram sthāpayitum prāk eva baliḥ deyaḥ ādhānakā baliḥ āma matsya māṃsa palāṇḍu raśona ādibhiḥ piṣṭaka ādibhiḥ ca yaḥ dīyate

original: [1.2.30] madhye sthāpya yantrasyeti: pradeśamadhye yantraṃ sthāpayitvā vajrasattvam ahaṃ paṭhed iti saṃbandhaḥ. kiṃbhūtaṃ yantram ity āha: pañcetyādi. śarāvasaṃpuṭopari jñānaḍākinīvajraḍākinīghorīvettālīcaṇḍāībhāvanā kartavyety arthaḥ. ātmavajrikayogasyeti: ātmānaṃ jñānaḍākinīrūpaṃ nirmāya vajrasattvam ahaṃ paṭhed iti saṃbandhaḥ.
analyzed: madhye sthāpya yantrasya iti pradeśa madhye yantram sthāpayitvā vajra sattvam aham paṭhet iti saṃbandhaḥ kiṃbhūtam yantram iti āha pañca ityādi śarāva saṃpuṭa upari jñānaḍākinī vajraḍākinī ghorī vettālī caṇḍāī bhāvanā kartavyā iti arthaḥ ātmavajrikayogasya iti ātmānam jñānaḍākinī rūpam nirmāya vajra sattvam aham paṭhet iti saṃbandhaḥ

original: saparikarām ekākinīṃ vā jñānaḍākinīṃ bhāvayitvety arthaḥ. vajrasattvam ahaṃ paṭhed iti: jñānaḍākinīyogātmā vajrasattvāhaṃkāraṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ. atha vā naiḥsvābhāvyaṃ bhāvayet.
analyzed: sa parikarām ekākinīm vā jñāna ḍākinīm bhāvayitvā iti arthaḥ vajra sattvam aham paṭhet iti jñāna ḍākinī yoga ātmā vajra sattva ahaṃkāram kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ atha vā naiḥsvābhāvyam bhāvayet

original: [1.2.31] vajrahasta karāgre tu vajra cintita saṃspṛśed iti: kareṇa vajraṃ gṛhītvā śarāvasampuṭaṃ saṃspṛśet. madhye ukta bījasyeti: śarāvamadhye yal likhitaṃ mantrapadaṃ, taj japed aṣṭau śatāni. oṃ devadattaṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ svāheti.
analyzed: saṃspṛśet iti kareṇa vajram gṛhītvā śarāva sampuṭam saṃspṛśet madhye ukta bījasya iti śarāva madhye yat likhitam mantra padam tat japet aṣṭau śatāni om devadattam rakṣa rakṣa hūm svāhā iti
