original: [1.2.32] vidher anuśaṃsām āha: pūrvajanmādipāpasya devatādiṃ tu veṣṭayed iti. pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ devatādikaṃ veṣṭayet. na punar anena vidhinā rakṣitaṃ sādhyaśarīram iti bhāvaḥ. pīḍā sarvaṃ na aṅgasya naivākālikamṛtyuketi: na ca śarīrapīḍā na cākālamaraṇaṃ sādhyasya jāyate.
analyzed: vidheḥ anuśaṃsām āha pūrva janma ādi pāpasya devatā ādim tu veṣṭayet iti pūrva janma kṛtam pāpam devatā ādikam veṣṭayet na punar anena vidhinā rakṣitam sādhya śarīram iti bhāvaḥ pīḍā sarvam na aṅgasya na eva ākālika mṛtyukā iti na ca śarīra pīḍā na ca akāla maraṇam sādhyasya jāyate

original: [1.2.33] nīrujaṃ sarvakāleṣv iti: yāvad yantraṃ sthāpayitvā mantram aṣṭaśatāvartaṃ kuryāt, tāvat sarvakāla eva. yadā tv akālamṛtyur vyādhir vā dṛśyate, tadā sa ekavārāṣṭaśatāvartitena mantreṇa mṛtyur vyādhir vā vinaśyati. glānaṃ pārśvata yojitam | āyubhraṣṭasya dehānāṃ ṣaṇmāsam adhikaṃ bhaved iti: glānasya pārśve yantraṃ sthāpayitvā mantraṃ japet.
analyzed: nīrujam sarva kāleṣu iti yāvat yantram sthāpayitvā mantram aṣṭaśata āvartam kuryāt tāvat sarva kāle eva yadā tu akāla mṛtyuḥ vyādhiḥ vā dṛśyate tadā saḥ eka vāra aṣṭaśata āvartitena mantreṇa mṛtyuḥ vyādhiḥ vā vinaśyati glānam yojitam āyu bhraṣṭasya dehānām ṣaṣ māsam adhikam bhavet iti glānasya pārśve yantram sthāpayitvā mantram japet

original: tadā bhraṣṭāyuḥśarīrasyāpi ṣāṇmāsikam āyur adhikaṃ bhavet.
analyzed: tadā bhraṣṭa āyuḥ śarīrasya api ṣāṇmāsikam āyuḥ adhikam bhavet

original: [1.2.34] sthāpyam anyatra sthāne nitya pūjābhis tatparam iti: anyatrāpi yantraṃ sthāpayitvā pūjāpuraḥsaraṃ mantre japte pūrvoktaṃ bhavati. ata āha: vijñānaṃ kasya muktaya iti. ko vijñānān mukto bhavaty anena vidhineti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: sthāpyam anyatra sthāne pūjābhiḥ tatparam iti anyatra api yantram sthāpayitvā pūjā puraḥsaram mantre japte pūrva uktam bhavati atas āha vijñānam kasya muktaye iti kaḥ vijñānāt muktaḥ bhavati anena vidhinā iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.2.35] idānīṃ viṣacikitsām āha: aparair ityādi. aparaṃ karma kathyata iti saṃbandhaḥ. śvāsam ātmānaṃ parīkṣyam iti: ātmanaḥ śvāsaṃ parīkṣya tatreti viṣāpahāravidhau yatnaḥ kāryaḥ. etad evāha: kāraṇād iti. śvāsaparīkṣām āha: samaśvāsenetyādi. yatra sthāne vāyur vahati, tatra yadi praṣṭā bhavati tadaiva samaśvāsaṃ sthānaṃ nāsāpuṭaṃ bhavati.
analyzed: idānīm viṣa cikitsām āha aparaiḥ ityādi aparam karma kathyate iti saṃbandhaḥ śvāsam ātmānam parīkṣyam iti ātmanaḥ śvāsam parīkṣya tatra iti viṣa apahāra vidhau yatnaḥ kāryaḥ etat eva āha kāraṇāt iti śvāsa parīkṣām āha samaśvāsena ityādi yatra sthāne vāyuḥ vahati tatra yadi praṣṭā bhavati tadā eva samaśvāsam sthānam nāsāpuṭam bhavati

original: tatra sati ca sarvasiddhir bhavati.
analyzed: tatra sati ca sarva siddhiḥ bhavati

original: [1.2.36] dāyiṇa dāyiṇasthāne vāme vāmena buddhimān | tasya sthāne tu vākyānāṃ sarvasiddhiṃ tu kathyata: ity anena pūrvoktaṃ spaṣṭayati. yadā dakṣiṇapuṭasthe vāyau dakṣiṇastha eva dūtaḥ pṛcchati, evaṃ vāmapuṭasthe vāyau vāmasthaḥ pṛcchati, tadā sarvasiddhiḥ. tasya sthāne tu vākyānām iti:
analyzed: dāyiṇa sthāne vāme vāmena buddhimān tasya sthāne tu vākyānām sarva siddhim tu kathyate iti anena pūrva uktam spaṣṭayati yadā dakṣiṇa puṭa sthe vāyau dakṣiṇa sthaḥ eva dūtaḥ pṛcchati evam vāma puṭa sthe vāyau vāma sthaḥ pṛcchati tadā sarva siddhiḥ tasya sthāne tu vākyānām iti

original: yatrastho vāyur bhavati, tasmin sthitvā vākyam abhidadhāti dūtaḥ. tadā samaśvāsaṃ sthānaṃ bhavati, sarvasiddhiś ceti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: yatrasthaḥ vāyuḥ bhavati tasmin sthitvā vākyam abhidadhāti dūtaḥ tadā samaśvāsam sthānam bhavati sarva siddhiḥ ca iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.2.37] vivartāśvāsa vākyānām iti: śvāsasya vāyor vivartā nivṛttir yasmād dakṣiṇavāmapuṭayor ekasmād iti sa vivartāśvāsety ucyate. vāyuśūnyaṃ puṭam ity arthaḥ. vākyānām iti: śūnye puṭe sthitvā vākyam abhidhatte yadā, tadā siddhir dūrata iti saṃbandhaḥ. «devadattaḥ sarpeṇa daṣṭas tatra kiṃ kartavyam» ityādi praśnaḥ.
analyzed: vivarta āśvāsa vākyānām iti śvāsasya vāyoḥ vivartā nivṛttiḥ yasmāt dakṣiṇa vāma puṭayoḥ ekasmāt iti sa vivarta āśvāsa iti ucyate vāyu śūnyam puṭam iti arthaḥ vākyānām iti śūnye puṭe sthitvā vākyam abhidhatte yadā tadā siddhiḥ dūratas iti saṃbandhaḥ devadattaḥ sarpeṇa daṣṭaḥ tatra kim kartavyam ityādi praśnaḥ

original: itthaṃ śvāsaṃ parīkṣya siddhyasiddhī ca jñātvā daṣṭake gantavyaṃ na gantavyaṃ vā. etad eva sphuṭayann āha: kṣaṇetyādi. kṣaṇeti vāyupraveśaḥ. prāṇasyeti: vāyunirgamaḥ. dvayayogaṃ tv iti: tayor dvayor yogayor madhye †kṣaṇena† jñāpayed iti saṃbandhaḥ.
analyzed: ittham śvāsam parīkṣya siddhi asiddhī ca jñātvā daṣṭake gantavyam na gantavyam vā etat eva sphuṭayan āha kṣaṇa ityādi kṣaṇa iti vāyu praveśaḥ prāṇasya iti vāyu nirgamaḥ dvaya yogam tu iti tayoḥ dvayoḥ yogayoḥ madhye kṣaṇena jñāpayet iti saṃbandhaḥ

original: [1.2.38] kiṃ tad ity āha: sarvakāryeṣv iti. sarvakāryāṇi tāni ca kānīty āha: pauṣṭikaṃ parikīrtitam iti. pauṣṭikādīni kāryāṇīty arthaḥ. na kevalaṃ viṣacikitsāyāṃ kṣaṇo yogaḥ praśasyata iti bhāvaḥ. vāyor nirgame yad ārabhyate, na tat sidhyatīty āha: prāṇa ityādi. siddhir dūram iti: tasya kāryasya siddhir dūravartinī bhavatīti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: kim tat iti āha sarva kāryeṣu iti sarva kāryāṇi tāni ca kāni iti āha pauṣṭikam parikīrtitam iti pauṣṭika ādīni kāryāṇi iti arthaḥ na kevalam viṣa cikitsāyām kṣaṇaḥ yogaḥ praśasyate iti bhāvaḥ vāyoḥ nirgame yat ārabhyate na tat sidhyati iti āha prāṇe ityādi siddhiḥ dūram iti tasya kāryasya siddhiḥ dūra vartinī bhavati iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.2.39] daṣṭādiviṣa cintantu cikitsā tatra kāraṇeti: daṣṭakaviṣaharaṇe sādhyāsādhyatām uktaprakāreṇa cintayitvā cikitsā tatra sādhye kartavyety arthaḥ. ādiśabdād glānādāv api. punaḥ katham ity āha: pūrvetyādi. pūrvapaṭaloktalakṣaṇayogenājñāṃ jñātvā nāgānāṃ cikitsā kāryety arthaḥ. sarvavid iti yoginā.
analyzed: daṣṭa ādi viṣa cintantu cikitsā tatra kāraṇā iti daṣṭaka viṣa haraṇe sādhya asādhyatām ukta prakāreṇa cintayitvā cikitsā tatra sādhye kartavyā iti arthaḥ ādi śabdāt glāna ādau api punar katham iti āha pūrva ityādi pūrva paṭala ukta lakṣaṇa yogena ājñām jñātvā nāgānām cikitsā kāryā iti arthaḥ sarva vid iti yoginā

original: [1.2.40] pūrvoktalakṣaṇam āha: caturyogādidaṣṭasya mṛtyūnāṃ tu na saṃśaya iti: mikire yoge kuliśo daśati, bhidrike śataśīrṣaḥ, svapne karālaḥ, kāme kāladaṣṭa iti caturṣu yogeṣu teṣu daṣṭasya mṛtyur eva na saṃśayaḥ. śeṣeṣu saṃgrahaḥ. tad evāha: cikitsā anyetyādi. cikitsānyasarvayogadaṣṭasya. katham ity āha: viṣasaṃhāryayogata iti.
analyzed: pūrva ukta lakṣaṇam āha catur yoga ādi daṣṭasya mṛtyūnām tu na saṃśayaḥ iti mikire yoge kuliśaḥ daśati bhidrike śataśīrṣaḥ svapne karālaḥ kāme kāladaṣṭaḥ iti caturṣu yogeṣu teṣu daṣṭasya mṛtyuḥ eva na saṃśayaḥ śeṣeṣu saṃgrahaḥ tat eva āha cikitsā anyā ityādi cikitsā anya sarva yoga daṣṭasya katham iti āha viṣa saṃhārya yogataḥ iti

original: vakṣyamāṇena viṣasaṃharaṇayogena.
analyzed: vakṣyamāṇena viṣa saṃharaṇa yogena

original: [1.2.41] viṣasaṃharaṇakramam āha: nyased akṣaravinyāsaṃ daṣṭadehasya sarvavid iti. akṣarāṇām aṣṭānāṃ vividhaprakāreṇa nyāsaṃ bhāvanāṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ. etad evāha: aṣṭetyādi. aṣṭākṣaramantrasyeti: aṣṭāv akṣarāṇi mantrāḥ. aṣṭa-m-aṅge tu sthāpitam iti: aṣṭasu mūrdhādiṣv aṅgeṣu sthāpitāni santi daṣṭaṃ rakṣantīti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: viṣa saṃharaṇa kramam āha nyaset akṣara vinyāsam daṣṭa dehasya sarva vid iti akṣarāṇām aṣṭānām vividha prakāreṇa nyāsam bhāvanām kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ etat eva āha aṣṭa ityādi aṣṭa akṣara mantrasya iti aṣṭau akṣarāṇi mantrāḥ aṣṭam aṅge tu sthāpitam iti aṣṭasu mūrdha ādiṣu aṅgeṣu sthāpitāni santi daṣṭam rakṣanti iti bhāvaḥ

original: yathā mūrdhni kṣuṃ, nāsākarṇadvayayor yuṃ, cakṣurdvaye huṃ, kaṇṭhe suṃ, grīvāyāṃ smryuṃ, skandhadvaye hmryuṃ, hṛdaye ymryuṃ, nābhau kṣmryuṃ.
analyzed: yathā mūrdhni kṣum nāsā karṇa dvayayoḥ yum cakṣuḥ dvaye hum kaṇṭhe sum grīvāyām smryum skandha dvaye hmryum hṛdaye ymryum nābhau kṣmryum

original: [1.2.42] sitavarṇasya saṃcintyeti: tāni bījāni yady api nānāvarṇāni, tathāpi viṣaharaṇe sitavarṇāni cintanīyāni. evaṃ kṛtvā hared bīja viṣaṃ mana iti. bījaṃ hared vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa. bījaṃ mṛtyukāraṇam. viṣaṃ mana iti: svacittamātram etad viṣam iti bhāvaḥ. madhye maṇḍala sthāna iti: maṇḍalaṃ dehas, tanmadhye hṛdi, jñāna vijñāna stambhitam iti:
analyzed: sita varṇasya saṃcintya iti tāni bījāni yadi api nānā varṇāni tathā api viṣa haraṇe sita varṇāni cintanīyāni evam kṛtvā haret bīja viṣam manaḥ iti bījam haret vakṣyamāṇa krameṇa bījam mṛtyu kāraṇam viṣam manaḥ iti sva citta mātram etat viṣam iti bhāvaḥ madhye maṇḍala sthāne iti maṇḍalam dehaḥ tad madhye hṛdi jñāna vijñāna stambhitam iti

original: jñānena hūṃkāreṇa vijñānaṃ stambhitaṃ bhavati daṣṭasyeti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: jñānena hūṃkāreṇa vijñānam stambhitam bhavati daṣṭasya iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.2.43] aṅge rakṣitayogasya paścād bāhyaṃ tu kārayed iti: pūrvakrameṇa daṣṭasya prathamaṃ śarīre rakṣite paścād bāhyaṃ  bhāṇḍādītyādi. m-udakapūrṇaṃ kṣīreṇa miśritam iti. mṛdādimaye bhāṇḍe jalena kṣīramiśreṇa pūrṇe ...
analyzed: aṅge rakṣita yogasya paścāt bāhyam tu kārayet iti pūrva krameṇa daṣṭasya prathamam śarīre rakṣite paścāt bāhyam bhāṇḍa ādi ityādi m udaka pūrṇam kṣīreṇa miśritam iti mṛd ādi maye bhāṇḍe jalena kṣīra miśreṇa pūrṇe

original: [1.2.44] ... tanmadhye śvetapadmam aṣṭadalaṃ, tadupari kiñjalke candramaṇḍalaṃ, tadupari suṃkārapariṇatāṃ śvetacchatramaṇḍitāṃ ...
analyzed: tad madhye śveta padmam aṣṭa dalam tad upari kiñjalke candra maṇḍalam tad upari suṃkāra pariṇatām śveta chatra maṇḍitām

original: [1.2.45] ... dvibhujāṃ sattvaparyaṅkāṃ sarpābharaṇabhūṣitāṃ śvetāṃ khaṭvāṅgakapālavyagrabhujadvayāṃ suvasanām ...
analyzed: dvi bhujām sattva paryaṅkām sarpa ābharaṇa bhūṣitām śvetām khaṭvāṅga kapāla vyagra bhuja dvayām su vasanām

original: [1.2.46] ... aṣṭanāgaśirāṃsi kiñjalkacandrayor antare sthitāni samākramyopaviṣṭāṃ vajraḍākinīṃ vibhāvayet. etad evāha: madhye padmaṃ tv (44a) ityādi. idānīṃ padmadalasthapucchān nāgān āha: pūrva ityādi. pūrvadale sito vāsukiḥ. uttare pītas takṣakaḥ.
analyzed: aṣṭa nāga śirāṃsi kiñjalka candrayoḥ antare sthitāni samākramya upaviṣṭām vajra ḍākinīm vibhāvayet etat eva āha madhye padmam tu ityādi idānīm padma dala stha pucchān nāgān āha pūrve ityādi pūrva dale sitaḥ vāsukiḥ uttare pītaḥ takṣakaḥ

original: [1.2.47] paścime raktaḥ karkoṭaḥ. dakṣiṇe kṛṣṇaḥ padmaḥ. aiśānakoṇe sitapīto mahāpadmaḥ. āgneye sitakṛṣṇaḥ śaṅkhapālaḥ.
analyzed: paścime raktaḥ karkoṭaḥ dakṣiṇe kṛṣṇaḥ padmaḥ aiśāna koṇe sita pītaḥ mahāpadmaḥ āgneye sita kṛṣṇaḥ śaṅkhapālaḥ

original: [1.2.48] nairṛte raktakṛṣṇaḥ kuliśapālaḥ. vāyavye pītarakto huluṇḍaka ity aṣṭau nāgā ity upasaṃharann āha: cintayed aṣṭanāgasya śiram ākramya āsana iti. vajraḍākinī nāgaśirāṃsy ākramyāsīnety arthaḥ.
analyzed: nairṛte rakta kṛṣṇaḥ kuliśapālaḥ vāyavye pīta raktaḥ huluṇḍakaḥ iti aṣṭau nāgāḥ iti upasaṃharan āha cintayet aṣṭa nāgasya śiram ākramya āsane iti vajra ḍākinī nāga śirāṃsi ākramya āsīnā iti arthaḥ

original: [1.2.49] pūjām āha: pūjayed ityādi. sarvavastūni sarvair vastubhiḥ. puṣpadhūpadīpagandhanivedyair ity arthaḥ. balim āha: baliṃ daded iti. viṣāpaharaṇakāle 'pi vajraḍākinīyogaḥ kārya iti darśayati: ātmetyādi. ātmadehe vajraḍākinīyogaṃ cintayed ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: pūjām āha pūjayet ityādi sarva vastūni sarvaiḥ vastubhiḥ puṣpa dhūpa dīpa gandha nivedyaiḥ iti arthaḥ balim āha balim dadet iti viṣa apaharaṇa kāle vajra ḍākinī yogaḥ kāryaḥ iti darśayati ātma ityādi ātma dehe vajra ḍākinī yogam cintayet iti arthaḥ

original: [1.2.50] mayūrapicchakena pūrvavidhānānantaraṃ viṣaṃ hared ity āha: mayūreṇetyādi. m-anya yogavad iti: ākṛṣya tyajed ity arthaḥ. kvety āha: sarvākarṣita pādasya pādānām ambu līyata iti. ākṛṣṭaṃ viṣaṃ pādayos talaṃ yāvat tato 'pi kṣīramiśrodakabhāṇḍe kṣiped ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: mayūrapicchakena pūrva vidhāna anantaram viṣam haret iti āha mayūreṇa ityādi yogavat iti ākṛṣya tyajet iti arthaḥ kva iti āha sarva ākarṣita pādasya pādānām ambu līyate iti ākṛṣṭam viṣam pādayoḥ talam yāvat kṣīra miśra udaka bhāṇḍe kṣipet iti arthaḥ

original: [1.2.51] viṣaharaṇamantram āha: oṃ hrīḥ ṭaṭṭaṇḍara hūṃ phaṭ svāheti. atropadeśāt hūṃkāratrayaṃ phaṭkāratrayaṃ ca draṣṭavyam.
analyzed: viṣa haraṇa mantram āha om hrīḥ ṭaṭ ṭaṇḍara hūm phaṭ svāhā iti atra upadeśāt hūṃkāra trayam phaṭkāra trayam ca draṣṭavyam

original: [1.2.52] pūrvasevayā vinā na sādhyasiddhir ity āha: vajrasattvetyādi. ādau vajrasattvayogena pratyekaṃ lakṣam ekaṃ mantrān vāsukyādisaṃbaddhān japet.
analyzed: pūrva sevayā vinā na sādhya siddhiḥ iti āha vajra sattva ityādi ādau vajra sattva yogena pratyekam lakṣam ekam mantrān vāsuki ādi saṃbaddhān japet

original: [1.2.53–60] mantrān āha: oṃ vāsukītyādi.
analyzed: mantrān āha om vāsukī ityādi

original: [1.2.61] viṣāpaharaṇakāle vidarbhaṇam āha: oṃ hrīr ityādi. amukasyeti dvitīyārthe ṣaṣṭhī.
analyzed: viṣa apaharaṇa kāle vidarbhaṇam āha om hrīḥ ityādi amukasya iti dvitīyā arthe ṣaṣṭhī

original: [1.2.62] sarvākarṣitetyādinirdeśam (50c) āha: ākṛṣyetyādi. mayūrapicchake oṃ vāsuki hrīḥ ṭaṭṭaṇḍara devadattaṃ nirviṣaṃ kuru hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ svāhetītarān api mantrān itthaṃ vinyasya japaṃś ca tenaiva śirasaḥ pādāntaṃ yāvad apamārjyāpamārjya kṣīrodake viṣaṃ prakṣipet. kṣīra kṛṣṇena sāṃpratam iti: tataḥ kṣīraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhavati.
analyzed: sarva ākarṣita ityādi nirdeśam āha ākṛṣya ityādi mayūrapicchake om vāsuki hrīḥ ṭaṭṭaṇḍara devadattam nirviṣam kuru hūm hūm hūm phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā iti itarān api mantrān ittham vinyasya japan ca tena eva śirasaḥ pāda antam yāvat apamārjya apamārjya kṣīra udake viṣam prakṣipet kṣīra kṛṣṇena sāṃpratam iti tatas kṣīram kṛṣṇam bhavati

original: kṣīre kṛṣṇībhūte yogāntaram āha: sarṣapetyādi. śvetasarṣapaśvetapuṣpaśvetacandanāni miśrayitvā ...
analyzed: kṣīre kṛṣṇībhūte yoga antaram āha sarṣapa ityādi śveta sarṣapa śveta puṣpa śveta candanāni miśrayitvā

original: [1.2.63] ... taiḥ sarvamantrābhimantritair daṣṭakasya hṛdayaṃ mantram uccārayann eva tāḍayet. tāḍane sati daṣṭasya hṛdayaṃ calati. hṛdaye ca calite kiṃ kuryād ity āha: jñāna stambhita dhāritam iti. jñānena hūṃkāreṇa vijñānaṃ stambhanīyam. hṛdi hūṃkāraṃ bhāvayitvā vijñānaṃ stambhayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: taiḥ sarva mantra abhimantritaiḥ daṣṭakasya hṛdayam mantram uccārayan eva tāḍayet tāḍane sati daṣṭasya hṛdayam calati hṛdaye ca calite kim kuryāt iti āha jñāna stambhita dhāritam iti jñānena hūṃkāreṇa vijñānam stambhanīyam hṛdi hūṃkāram bhāvayitvā vijñānam stambhayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.2.64] vijñāne dhārite śvāsā visphurantīty āha: jñānetyādi. ātmaśvāsena pīḍayed iti. ātmanaḥ śvāsena daṣṭakasya nirgacchantaṃ śvāsaṃ pīḍayet paryāvartya praveśayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: vijñāne dhārite śvāsāḥ visphuranti iti āha jñāna ityādi ātma śvāsena pīḍayet iti ātmanaḥ śvāsena daṣṭakasya nirgacchantam śvāsam pīḍayet paryāvartya praveśayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.2.65] tasmin sati śvāso 'ntar līyate. śvāsasyāntarlaye hastapādādikaṃ calati. sarvāṅgakampane sati kiṃ kuryād ity āha: ātma gītaṃ tu kārayed iti. ātmanā gītam uccārayen mantrī. oṃ hūṃ te netyādi (4.4.93cd) gītam.
analyzed: tasmin sati śvāsaḥ ntar līyate śvāsasya antar laye hasta pāda ādikam calati sarva aṅga kampane sati kim kuryāt iti āha ātma gītam tu kārayet iti ātmanā gītam uccārayet mantrī om   te na ityādi gītam

original: [1.2.66] etad evoddiśati: hūṃkāretyādi. tricchoṭikādānapūrvakaṃ gānam ity āha: tribhi cchoṭyena uddhṛta iti. choṭikātrayeṇa daṣṭa uttiṣṭhatīti bhāvaḥ. utthitaś ca daṣṭako vajraḍākinīyogātmā kartavyas tena rakṣitaḥ syāt. etad evāha: daṣṭā uddhṛtamātreṇa rakṣā tasyaiva kārayed iti.
analyzed: etat eva uddiśati hūṃkāra ityādi tri śoṭikā dāna pūrvakam gānam iti āha tribhiḥ śoṭyena uddhṛtaḥ iti choṭikā trayeṇa daṣṭaḥ uttiṣṭhati iti bhāvaḥ utthitaḥ ca daṣṭakaḥ vajra ḍākinī yoga ātmā kartavyaḥ tena rakṣitaḥ syāt etat eva āha daṣṭā uddhṛta mātreṇa rakṣā tasya eva kārayet iti

original: [1.2.67] tat kṣīrodakaṃ viṣāvilaṃ nāgādhiṣṭhite hrade prakṣiped ity āha: saṃhāryetyādi. idānīṃ pradhānaviṣamantrasya pūrvasevām āha: candretyādi. vajrasattvaṃ śuklaṃ dvibhujaṃ vajraparyaṅkinaṃ padmoparicandramaṇḍalasthaṃ vāmadakṣiṇaghaṇṭāvajradharaṃ bhāvayan ...
analyzed: tat kṣīra udakam viṣa āvilam nāga dhiṣṭhite hrade prakṣipet iti āha saṃhārya ityādi idānīm pradhāna viṣa mantrasya pūrva sevām āha candra ityādi vajra sattvam śuklam dvi bhujam vajra paryaṅkinam padma upari candra maṇḍala stham vāma dakṣiṇa ghaṇṭā vajra dharam bhāvayan

original: [1.2.68] ... lakṣatrayam oṃ hrīr ityādi (51) mantraṃ japet. tasya mantrasya tena pūrvasevā syād iti bhāvaḥ. prathamamantrasya trilakṣo japaḥ, śeṣāṇām ekalakṣa iti niścitam. itthaṃ viṣaharamantraḥ sidhyatīty āha: viṣetyādi. viṣasaṃhāro yogināṃ bhavati.
analyzed: lakṣa trayam om hrīḥ ityādi mantram japet tasya mantrasya tena pūrva sevā syāt iti bhāvaḥ prathama mantrasya tri lakṣaḥ japaḥ śeṣāṇām eka lakṣaḥ iti niścitam ittham viṣa hara mantraḥ sidhyati iti āha viṣa ityādi viṣa saṃhāraḥ yoginām bhavati

original: [1.2.69] asādhyadaṃśasthānam āha: mukha ityādi. tilaka iti bhrūmadhye. cakṣūṇām iti cakṣurdvaye. ūrdhva grīvaṃ tu nāsayor iti: ūrdhve tāluni, grīvāyāṃ, nāsāpuṭadvaye. hṛdaya guhya nābhasyeti: hṛdayaṃ liṅgaṃ, guhyaṃ gudamārgaḥ, nābhasya nābhau. aṅguṣṭhādvaya pādayor iti: hastapādāṅguṣṭheṣu pādayoś ca.
analyzed: asādhya daṃśa sthānam āha mukhe ityādi tilakaḥ iti bhrū madhye cakṣūṇām iti cakṣuḥ dvaye ūrdhva grīvam tu nāsayoḥ iti ūrdhve tāluni grīvāyām nāsāpuṭa dvaye hṛdaya guhya nābhasya iti hṛdayam liṅgam guhyam guda mārgaḥ nābhasya nābhau pādayoḥ iti hasta pāda aṅguṣṭheṣu pādayoḥ ca

original: eṣu sthāneṣu yo daṣṭaḥ, sa cikitsārho na bhavati. etad evāha: acikicchena tu daṣṭasyeti: daṣṭo 'cikitsyo bhavatīty arthaḥ. hetumṛtyuṃ tv iti: mṛtyuhetur daṃśa iti śeṣaḥ.
analyzed: eṣu sthāneṣu yaḥ daṣṭaḥ sa cikitsā arhaḥ na bhavati etat eva āha acikicchena tu daṣṭasya iti cikitsyaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ hetu mṛtyum tu iti mṛtyu hetuḥ daṃśaḥ iti śeṣaḥ

original: [1.2.70] idānīṃ nāgaprastāvāyātaṃ varṣāpaṇavidhim āha: śṛṇv ityādi. mahārājeti: vajrapāṇeḥ saṃbodhanam. manoramyetyādi: nāgādhiṣṭhitahradasamīpe sāmānyajalādhāravāyavyakoṇe vā maṇḍalaṃ kāryam ity āha:
analyzed: idānīm nāga prastāva āyātam varṣāpaṇa vidhim āha śṛṇu ityādi mahā rāja iti vajrapāṇeḥ saṃbodhanam manaḥ ramya ityādi nāga adhiṣṭhita hrada samīpe sāmānya jala ādhāra vāyavya koṇe vā maṇḍalam kāryam iti āha

original: [1.2.71] vitānetyādi: vitānādiyutaṃ nistoraṇaṃ caturasratvādiyutaṃ nāgāṣṭakabhūṣitaṃ pañcabhī rajobhir maṇḍalaṃ vartayet.
analyzed: vitāna ityādi vitāna ādi yutam nistoraṇam catur asra tu ādi yutam nāga aṣṭaka bhūṣitam pañcabhiḥ rajobhiḥ maṇḍalam vartayet

original: [1.2.72] tasya caturṣu dvāreṣu pārśvadvayasthitam utthāpitaphaṇam anyonyabhogaveṣṭitānyonyaṃ nāgadvayadvayam.
analyzed: tasya caturṣu dvāreṣu pārśva dvaya sthitam utthāpita phaṇam anyonya bhoga veṣṭita anyonyam nāga dvaya dvayam

original: [1.2.73] nāgān āha: jayabhadrasyetyādi. jayo bhadraś ca pūrvadvārapārśvadvaye. evam uttatrāpi. śrīnanda uttareṇa tv iti śrīr nandaś ca. suvṛṣṭipriya paścāta iti: paścime suvṛṣṭiḥ priyaś ca. dhruvaghoraṃ tu dakṣiṇa iti: dhruvo ghoraś ca. ete cāṣṭakulapratibaddhā yathākramaṃ tadvarṇāḥ prākārabhūtāḥ.
analyzed: nāgān āha jayabhadrasya ityādi jayaḥ bhadraḥ ca pūrva dvāra pārśva dvaye evam śrī nandaḥ uttareṇa tu iti śrīḥ nandaḥ ca suvṛṣṭipriya paścātas iti paścime suvṛṣṭiḥ priyaḥ ca dhruva ghoram tu dakṣiṇe iti dhruvaḥ ghoraḥ ca ete ca aṣṭa kula pratibaddhāḥ yathākramam tad varṇāḥ prākāra bhūtāḥ

original: [1.2.74–76ab] ata āha: aṣṭa prākāra nāgasyeti. vidiśe kula-m-aṣṭakam iti: maṇḍalamadhyāṣṭadalapadmadaleṣu nāgāṣṭakam. vidiśa iti: diśi vidiśīty arthaḥ. etad evāha: Vāsukītyādi. eṣāṃ varṇaḥ pūrvokta eva.
analyzed: atas āha aṣṭa nāgasya iti vidiśe kulam aṣṭakam iti maṇḍala madhya aṣṭadala padma daleṣu nāga aṣṭakam vidiśe iti diśi vidiśi iti arthaḥ etat eva āha Vāsukī ityādi eṣām varṇaḥ pūrva uktaḥ eva

original: [1.2.76cd] maṇḍalabahiś cāṣṭau megharājā likhanīyāḥ. tad evāha: megheśvaretyādi.
analyzed: maṇḍala bahis ca aṣṭa megharājāḥ likhanīyāḥ tat eva āha megheśvara ityādi

original: [1.2.77] pūrvasyāṃ diśi garjitaḥ. āgneyyāṃ ghūrṇitaḥ. dakṣiṇasyāṃ ghoraḥ. nairṛtyām āvartaḥ. vāruṇyāṃ ghanaḥ. vāyavyāṃ caṇḍaḥ. kauveryāṃ varṣaḥ. aiśānyāṃ prapūraṇaḥ. eṣāṃ digvidiṅnāgavarṇāḥ krameṇa draṣṭavyāḥ.
analyzed: pūrvasyām diśi garjitaḥ āgneyyām ghūrṇitaḥ dakṣiṇasyām ghoraḥ nairṛtyām āvartaḥ vāruṇyām ghanaḥ vāyavyām caṇḍaḥ kauveryām varṣaḥ aiśānyām prapūraṇaḥ eṣām diś vidiś nāga varṇāḥ krameṇa draṣṭavyāḥ

original: [1.2.78] etad evāha: yathā pūrvādi saṃsthāpya diśavarṇaṃ tu dhyāpayed iti. ete ca puruṣaśarīrā ekaphaṇanāgamukhāḥ. madhye vajraḍākinyāṃ padmāsanam āsīnām iti: kiñjalke padmāsanasthā vajraḍākinīty arthaḥ.
analyzed: etat eva āha yathā pūrva ādi saṃsthāpya diśa varṇam tu dhyāpayet iti ete ca puruṣa śarīrāḥ eka phaṇa nāga mukhāḥ madhye vajra ḍākinyām padmāsanam āsīnām iti kiñjalke padmāsana sthā vajra ḍākinī iti arthaḥ

original: [1.2.79] khaṭvāṅgetyādi subodham.
analyzed: khaṭvāṅga ityādi su bodham

original: [1.2.80] sarpāveṣṭitapadmasyeti: pūrvoktam eva padmaṃ sarpaveṣṭitaṃ lekhyam. atha vā pūrvoktapadmakiñjalke punaḥ padmaṃ sarpaveṣṭitaṃ tatra sarpāsanasthā pūrvoktā vajraḍākinī lekhyeti. ata āha: sarpāsana yojayed iti. pūjām āha: udārāṇām ityādi. kṣīraśarāvāṣṭakādipūjā deyā.
analyzed: sarpa āveṣṭita padmasya iti pūrva uktam eva padmam sarpa veṣṭitam lekhyam atha vā pūrva ukta padma kiñjalke punar padmam sarpa veṣṭitam tatra sarpāsana sthā pūrva uktā vajra ḍākinī lekhyā iti atas āha sarpāsana yojayet iti pūjām āha udārāṇām ityādi kṣīra śarāva aṣṭaka ādi pūjā deyā

original: [1.2.81] vividha manyaketi: vividhā pūjā, manyako yogī. sa kīdṛśa ity āha: yogī jñānasyeti. jñānasamāpanna ity arthaḥ. sa ātmānaṃ vajraḍākinīrūpaṃ dhyātvā mantraṃ japed iti śeṣaḥ. pūrvoktamaṇḍalaṃ vartayitvā paścād vajraḍākinīrūpo mantraṃ japed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: manyaka iti vividhā pūjā manyakaḥ yogī sa kīdṛśaḥ iti āha yogī jñānasya iti jñāna samāpannaḥ iti arthaḥ saḥ ātmānam vajra ḍākinī rūpam dhyātvā mantram japet iti śeṣaḥ pūrva ukta maṇḍalam vartayitvā paścāt vajra ḍākinī rūpaḥ mantram japet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.2.82–83] upacāramantra iti: prokṣaṇācamanādyupacāramantraḥ.
analyzed: upacāra mantraḥ iti prokṣaṇa ācamana ādi upacāra mantraḥ

original: [1.2.84–92] oṃ vāsukītyādayo nāgāṣṭakamantrāḥ.
analyzed: om vāsukī ityādayaḥ nāga aṣṭaka mantrāḥ

original: [1.2.93–94] oṃ ghilītyādir aṣṭamegharājamantraḥ. atra ca ṭhakāratrayeṇa phaṭkāratrayam uktam. tena ṭhakāratrayasthāne phaṭkāratrayam. yathā phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ svāheti.
analyzed: om ghili ityādiḥ aṣṭa megharāja mantraḥ atra ca ṭhakāra trayeṇa phaṭkāra trayam uktam tena ṭhakāra traya sthāne phaṭkāra trayam yathā phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā iti

original: [1.2.95–96] pānāvartaṃ kṛtvā tu aṣṭadiśaṃ tu darśayed iti: pānaśabdena pāṇiḥ. pāṇibhyām āvarte kṛte mudrā bhavati. aṣṭasu dikṣu tāṃ mudrāṃ meghebhyo darśayet. tata ākṛṣṭā meghā bhaveyuḥ. ataś coktaṃ prāk: aṣṭadiśaṃ tu karṣitam iti (76d).
analyzed: pāna āvartam kṛtvā tu aṣṭa diśam tu darśayet iti pāna śabdena pāṇiḥ pāṇibhyām āvarte kṛte mudrā bhavati aṣṭasu dikṣu tām mudrām meghebhyaḥ darśayet tatas ākṛṣṭāḥ meghāḥ bhaveyuḥ atas ca uktam prāk aṣṭa diśam tu karṣitam iti

original: [1.2.97] vāmahastam ityādi: vāmahastaṃ muṣṭiṃ kṛtvā aṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhike prasārya tasyopari dakṣiṇakaphoṇiṃ dattvā dakṣiṇahastaṃ phaṇākāreṇa dhārayed iti nāgānāṃ mudrā. mantrāś ca pūrvam uktā iyaṃ mudrā bhinnā mantreṇa, na tv ākāreṇa.
analyzed: vāma hastam ityādi vāma hastam muṣṭim kṛtvā aṅguṣṭha kaniṣṭhike prasārya tasya upari dakṣiṇa ka phoṇim dattvā dakṣiṇa hastam phaṇa ākāreṇa dhārayet iti nāgānām mudrāḥ mantrāḥ ca pūrvam uktāḥ iyam mudrā bhinnā mantreṇa na tu ākāreṇa

original: [1.2.98] ata āha: aṣṭau nāgarājamudreti. meghānāṃ tu mantramudrayor abhedaḥ. pūrvoktaḥ kamalāvarto mudrā. mantraś ca: oṃ ghilītyādi (93).
analyzed: atas āha aṣṭau nāga rāja mudrā iti meghānām tu mantra mudrayoḥ abhedaḥ pūrva uktaḥ kamalāvartaḥ mudrā mantraḥ ca om ghilī ityādi

original: [1.2.99] oṃ vajraḍākini varṣa varṣāpaya hūṃ bhū ho svāheti: vajraḍākinyā varṣāpaṇārthaṃ mūlamantraḥ.
analyzed: om vajra ḍākini varṣa varṣāpaya hūm bhū ho svāhā iti vajra ḍākinyāḥ varṣāpaṇa artham mūlamantraḥ

original: [1.2.100] yady api nāgānāṃ meghānāṃ ca varṣāpaṇārthaṃ mantrāḥ kathitāḥ, tathāpi tatra vajraḍākinyāḥ pradhāno mantraḥ. ata āha: mūlamantra iti.
analyzed: yadi api nāgānām meghānām ca varṣa āpaṇa artham mantrāḥ kathitāḥ tathā api tatra vajra ḍākinyāḥ pradhānaḥ mantraḥ atas āha mūlamantraḥ iti

original: [1.2.101] lakṣatrayādijāpasya pūrvasevādi kārayed iti: ādau pratyekamantrāṇāṃ trilakṣe jape kṛte pūrvasevā syād iti bhāvaḥ.  ebhir ityādi: ebhir mantraiḥ pūrvasevāsiddhaiḥ paścān maṇḍalalikhanādikarmaṇi kṛte niyataṃ varṣāpaṇaṃ yoginaḥ sidhyatīti śeṣaḥ.
analyzed: lakṣa traya ādi jāpasya pūrva sevā ādi kārayet iti ādau pratyeka mantrāṇām tri lakṣe jape kṛte pūrva sevā syāt iti bhāvaḥ ebhiḥ ityādi ebhiḥ mantraiḥ pūrva sevā siddhaiḥ paścāt maṇḍala likhana ādi karmaṇi kṛte niyatam varṣa āpaṇam yoginaḥ sidhyati iti śeṣaḥ

original: [1.2.102] aparair dūtīnimittaṃ tv iti: aparaṃ dūtalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyata iti śeṣaḥ. vāyulakṣaṇadaṃśalakṣaṇebhyo 'paratvaṃ lakṣaṇasya. kekaraṃ palita kubjānām iti: kekaraḥ palitamastakaḥ, kubjaḥ, ghoravastrādīti kṛṣṇavastraḥ, daṇḍaketi daṇḍī.
analyzed: aparaiḥ dūtī nimittam tu iti aparam dūta lakṣaṇam vakṣyate iti śeṣaḥ vāyu lakṣaṇa daṃśa lakṣaṇebhyaḥ paratvam lakṣaṇasya kekaram kubjānām iti kekaraḥ palita mastakaḥ kubjaḥ ghora vastra ādi iti kṛṣṇa vastraḥ daṇḍaka iti daṇḍī

original: [1.2.103] yugalo strībhir āgatyeti: striyā sahāgata ity arthaḥ. muktakeśādīti muktakeśaḥ. ādiśabdān nakārādipūrvābhidhāyī. kranditeti krandan rudann ity arthaḥ. nagnam ākramya vākyeṣv iti: nagnaḥ, ākramya vākyeṣv iti balātkāravādī. catvāro cyuti yogavad iti: mikirabhidrikasvapnakāmāś catvāro yogāḥ. teṣu yo dūta āgataḥ, sa cyutihetur iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: strībhiḥ āgatya iti striyā saha āgataḥ iti arthaḥ mukta keśa ādi iti mukta keśaḥ ādi śabdāt nakāra ādi pūrva abhidhāyī krandita iti krandan rudan iti arthaḥ nagnam ākramya vākyeṣu iti nagnaḥ ākramya vākyeṣu iti balātkāra vādī catvāraḥ yoga vat iti mikira bhidrika svapnakāmāḥ catvāraḥ yogāḥ teṣu yaḥ dūtaḥ āgataḥ sa cyuti hetuḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.2.104] yathā dūtasya ātmānaṃ parīkṣe dvayakāraṇam iti: itthaṃ dūtalakṣaṇaṃ vīkṣyātmagataṃ vāyvādilakṣaṇaṃ ca tābhyāṃ siddhyasiddhī jñātvā gantavyaṃ na gantavyaṃ veti bhāvaḥ. yadītyādi: śubhalakṣaṇe gatasya yoginaḥ siddhiḥ. anyathā hānir asiddhir ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: yathā dūtasya ātmānam parīkṣe dvaya kāraṇam iti ittham dūta lakṣaṇam vīkṣya ātma gatam vāyu ādi lakṣaṇam ca tābhyām siddhi asiddhī jñātvā gantavyam na gantavyam vā iti bhāvaḥ yadi ityādi śubha lakṣaṇe gatasya yoginaḥ siddhiḥ anyathā hāniḥ asiddhiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [1.2.col.] itiprakaraṇa iti: ity uktakrameṇa mṛtyulakṣaṇatadvañcanādi prakriyate 'sminn itītiprakaraṇam. ity ātmapīṭhe catuṣpīṭhanibandhe dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ.
analyzed: iti prakaraṇa iti iti ukta krama mṛtyu lakṣaṇa tad vañcana ādi prakriyate smin iti iti prakaraṇa iti ātmapīṭha catuṣpīṭha nibandha dvitīyaḥ paṭala

original: [1.3.1] prākṛtaskandhaparityāgapūrvakaṃ devatābhāvanā kāryeti śūnyatāpaṭalam āha: bhagavann ityādi. yogārambha viśeṣata iti: devatābhāvanārambhaṃ viśeṣato 'tiśayena jñātum icchāmīti saṃbandhaḥ. kena jñātavya mantreṣv iti: kathaṃ mantrā jñātavyā ity arthaḥ. kathaṃ jñānaṃ tu dhārayed iti:
analyzed: prākṛta skandha parityāga pūrvakam devatā bhāvanā kāryā iti śūnyatā paṭalam āha bhagavan ityādi yoga ārambha viśeṣataḥ iti devatā bhāvanā ārambham viśeṣataḥ utiśayena jñātum icchāmi iti saṃbandhaḥ kena jñātavya mantreṣu iti katham mantrāḥ jñātavyāḥ iti arthaḥ katham jñānam tu dhārayet iti

original: śāntikādisiddhinimittaṃ jñānaṃ kathaṃ dhārayec cittasthīkuryāt.
analyzed: śāntika ādi siddhi nimittam jñānam katham dhārayet

original: [1.3.2] prativacanam āha: śṛṇv ityādi. yathātattvam aviparītam. devatātmakair iti: devatāyogabhāvanārtham, atha vā devatātmakatvāya vakṣyamāṇaṃ śṛṇv iti. śrotavyam āha: prathamam ityādi. devatābhāvanātaḥ prathamaṃ śūnyaṃ dehaṃ saṃcintya, paścād devatāṃ bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ. etad evāha: prakṣālya mala dehinām iti.
analyzed: prativacanam āha śṛṇu ityādi yathātattvam aviparītam devatā ātmakaiḥ iti devatā yoga bhāvanā artham atha vā devatā ātmaka tvāya vakṣyamāṇam śṛṇu iti śrotavyam āha prathamam ityādi devatā bhāvanātaḥ prathamam śūnyam deham saṃcintya paścāt devatām bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ etat eva āha prakṣālya dehinām iti

original: dehasya malaṃ grāhyādyabhiniveśaṃ śūnyatayā prakṣālya devatā bhāvyety arthaḥ.
analyzed: dehasya malam grāhya ādi abhiniveśam śūnyatayā prakṣālya devatā bhāvyā iti arthaḥ

original: [1.3.3] asya nirdeśam āha: rūpam ityādi. rūpyata iti rūpaṃ skandhapañcakam. śūnyādīti: tad rūpaṃ svabhāvanimittapraṇidhānaśūnyam. śūnyādīty ādiśabdād dhi śūnyatānimittāpraṇihitalakṣaṇais tribhir vimokṣai rūpaṃ bhāvyam. na kevalaṃ skandhapañcakaṃ trivimokṣaviśuddhaṃ bhāvyam ity ata āha: tāvad aṣṭādaśaṃ mana iti.
analyzed: asya nirdeśam āha rūpam ityādi rūpyataḥ iti rūpam skandha pañcakam śūnya ādi iti tat rūpam svabhāva nimitta praṇidhāna śūnyam śūnya ādi iti ādi śabdāt dhi śūnyatā nimitta apraṇihita lakṣaṇaiḥ tribhiḥ vimokṣaiḥ rūpam bhāvyam na kevalam skandha pañcakam tri vimokṣa viśuddham bhāvyam iti atas āha tāvat aṣṭādaśam manaḥ iti

original: cakṣuḥśrotraghrāṇajihvākāyamanāṃsīndriyāṇi ṣaṭ. rūpaśabdagandharasasparśadharmā viṣayāḥ ṣaṭ. tadvijñānāni ṣaṭ. ittham aṣṭādaśa dhātavaḥ. ete ca trivimokṣaviśuddhāḥ pūrvam eva bhāvyāḥ, pūrvasyeti vacanāt. etat svabhāvādiśūnyam ity atra kiṃ pramāṇam ity āha: mana iti. yadi kalpanāmātrād anyad rūpam eṣāṃ, tadā svacittam eva pramāṇam.
analyzed: cakṣuḥ śrotra ghrāṇa jihvā kāya manāṃsi indriyāṇi ṣaḍ rūpa śabda gandha rasa sparśa dharmāḥ viṣayāḥ ṣaṭ tad vijñānāni ṣaḍ ittham aṣṭādaśa dhātavaḥ ete ca tri vimokṣa viśuddhāḥ pūrvam eva bhāvyāḥ pūrvasya iti vacanāt etat svabhāva ādi śūnyam iti atra kim pramāṇam iti āha manaḥ iti yadi kalpanā mātrāt anyat rūpam eṣām tadā sva cittam eva pramāṇam

original: sadasadrūpaṃ sarvaṃ cittam eva kalpayatīti bhāvaḥ. idānīṃ yathākathaṃcit prakārabhedaṃ darśayann āha: rūpadhātvetītyādi. rūpaṃ śvetapītādi dīrghahrasvādisvalakṣaṇaṃ dadhātīti dhātuḥ. rūpaṃ ca tad dhātuś ceti rūpadhātuś cakṣurviṣayaḥ.
analyzed: sat asat rūpam sarvam cittam eva kalpayati iti bhāvaḥ idānīm yathā kathaṃcid prakāra bhedam darśayan āha rūpa dhātu eti ityādi rūpam śveta pīta ādi dīrgha hrasva ādi sva lakṣaṇam dadhāti iti dhātuḥ rūpam ca tat dhātuḥ ca iti rūpa dhātuḥ cakṣuḥ viṣayaḥ

original: sa ca śūnyaḥ svabhāvena grāhyādilakṣaṇena, yathā ghaṭaḥ śūnya ity ukte jalādineti gamyate, na tu svayam eva ghaṭo nāstīti. nanu grāhyādirūpād anyat kim asya rūpadhāto rūpaṃ yenāstīti vyavahartavyam. satyam. tenaiva vicārāsahena satyamṛṣātvarahitena jalacandra iva so 'stīti vyavahriyate. atrāpi svacittam eva pramāṇam. śabdaṃ tasyaiva kārayed iti:
analyzed: sa ca śūnyaḥ svabhāvena grāhya ādi lakṣaṇena yathā ghaṭaḥ śūnyaḥ iti ukte jala ādinā iti gamyate na tu svayam eva ghaṭaḥ na asti iti nanu grāhya ādi rūpāt anyat kim asya rūpa dhātoḥ rūpam yena asti iti vyavahartavyam satyam tena eva vicāra asahena satya mṛṣātva rahitena jala candraḥ iva saḥ u sti iti vyavahriyate atra api sva cittam eva pramāṇam śabdam tasya eva kārayet iti

original: śabdo 'pi tathaiva grāhyādiśūnya ity arthaḥ. evam uttaratrāpi.
analyzed: śabdaḥ tathā eva grāhya ādi śūnyaḥ iti arthaḥ evam uttaratra api

original: [1.3.4] rūpaṃ tasyaiva kārayed iti: rūpyate bhidyate sarveṣv eva viṣayeṣv iti rūpaṃ dharmadhātuviṣayaḥ sukharūpaḥ.
analyzed: rūpam tasya eva kārayet iti rūpyate bhidyate sarveṣu eva viṣayeṣu iti rūpam dharmadhātu viṣayaḥ sukha rūpaḥ

original: [1.3.5] rūpādiviṣayānantaraṃ cakṣurādīndriyāṇi darśayati: cakṣur ityādi. cakṣuṣo rūpasya ca śūnyatvāt tayor madhye vijñānaṃ katham aśūnyaṃ bhavatv iti bhāvaḥ. tajjaṃ vijñānaṃ katham ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: rūpa ādi viṣaya anantaram cakṣuḥ ādi indriyāṇi darśayati cakṣuḥ ityādi cakṣuṣaḥ rūpasya ca śūnyatvāt tayoḥ madhye vijñānam katham a śūnyam bhavatu iti bhāvaḥ tad jam vijñānam katham iti arthaḥ

original: [1.3.6] evaṃ śrotraghrāṇajihvās tadvijñānāni ca śūnyānīti draṣṭavyam.
analyzed: evam śrotra ghrāṇa jihvāḥ tad vijñānāni ca śūnyāni iti draṣṭavyam

original: [1.3.7] kāyam iti tvagindriyam. mano bahiḥ śūnyānāṃ manaś cāpi vikalpayed iti: antar bahir api manaḥ śūnyam. eko manaḥśabdo 'ntarvācī. idaṃ sarvaṃ manaś cittaṃ kartṛbhūtaṃ vikalpayet.
analyzed: kāyam iti tvac indriyam manaḥ bahis śūnyānām manaḥ ca api vikalpayet iti antar bahis api manaḥ śūnyam ekaḥ manaḥ śabdaḥ ntar vācī idam sarvam manaḥ cittam kartṛ bhūtam vikalpayet

original: [1.3.8] līyata ityādi: mano 'pi cākāśākāreṇa layaṃ gacchati. itthaṃ śūnyaṃ sarvaṃ cintayet. vyavahitaṃ sarvam āha: kṣayam ityādi. tridhātukaṃ traidhātukaṃ meruṃ dvīpāntarāṇi ca ...
analyzed: līyate ityādi manaḥ pi ca ākāśa ākāreṇa layam gacchati ittham śūnyam sarvam cintayet vyavahitam sarvam āha kṣayam ityādi tridhātukam traidhātukam merum dvīpa antarāṇi ca

original: [1.3.9] ... śūnyatvenālambya, ūrdhvam ākāśam, madhyaṃ pṛthvīm, nimnagā pātālam, kṣayaṃ śūnyaṃ sarvaṃ saṃcintya devatāyogaṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ. daśasu dikṣu lokadhātavo ye, ...
analyzed: śūnya tvena ālambya ūrdhvam ākāśam madhyam pṛthvīm nimnagā pātālam kṣayam śūnyam sarvam saṃcintya devatā yogam kuryāt iti arthaḥ daśasu dikṣu lokadhātavaḥ ye

original: [1.3.10] ... te 'pi kṣīyante śūnyīkriyante. ātmabhāvānām iti: ātmagraho 'pi śūnyaḥ kartavyaḥ. bhāvam ambaramiśritam iti: itthaṃ sakalaṃ bhāvagrāmam ākāśasamarasasamatayā śūnyaṃ saṃcintya devatāṃ bhāvayed ity arthaḥ. yogīnām iti: yogī. vicakṣaṇa iti grahaśūnyaḥ.
analyzed: te pi kṣīyante śūnyīkriyante ātma bhāvānām iti ātma grahaḥ api śūnyaḥ kartavyaḥ bhāvam ambara miśritam iti ittham sakalam bhāva grāmam ākāśa sama rasa sama tayā śūnyam saṃcintya devatām bhāvayet iti arthaḥ yogīnām iti yogī vicakṣaṇaḥ iti graha śūnyaḥ

original: [1.3.11] kathaṃ jñānaṃ tu dhārayed ity (1d) uddiṣṭaṃ nirdiśati: paśyanta ityādi. itthaṃ śūnyatāṃ bhāvayantaś cittaṃ ca samatārūpeṇa dhārayantaḥ, cittasamatayā parīkṣaṃ tatra kāraṇāt. kāraṇaṃ nimittaṃ parīkṣaṇīyam ity arthaḥ. śūnyatāṃ bhāvayan śāntikādisiddhinimittaṃ paśyed iti bhāvaḥ. tad evāha: dīpenetyādi.
analyzed: katham jñānam tu dhārayet iti uddiṣṭam nirdiśati paśyantaḥ ityādi ittham śūnyatām bhāvayantaḥ cittam ca samatā rūpeṇa dhārayantaḥ citta samatayā tatra kāraṇāt kāraṇam nimittam parīkṣaṇīyam iti arthaḥ śūnyatām bhāvayan śāntika ādi siddhi nimittam paśyet iti bhāvaḥ tat eva āha dīpena ityādi

original: yadā dīpākāraṃ paśyati, tadā śāntikaṃ sidhyati. rajarajaṃ tv iti: yadā raktavarṇaṃ paśyati, tadā pauṣṭikaṃ sidhyati.
analyzed: yadā dīpa ākāram paśyati tadā śāntikam sidhyati rajarajam tu iti yadā rakta varṇam paśyati tadā pauṣṭikam sidhyati

original: [1.3.12] sūryetyādi: yadā sūryamaṇḍalākāraṃ paśyati, tadā raktakarmādi vaśyākṛṣṭī sidhyataḥ. kṛṣṇadhūmāyate śeṣa iti: kṛṣṇākāraṃ dhūmrākāraṃ yadā paśyati, tadābhicāraḥ sidhyati.
analyzed: sūrya ityādi yadā sūrya maṇḍala ākāram paśyati tadā raktakarma ādi vaśyā ākṛṣṭī sidhyataḥ kṛṣṇadhūmāyate śeṣaḥ iti kṛṣṇa ākāram dhūmra ākāram yadā paśyati tadā abhicāraḥ sidhyati

original: [1.3.13] ākulavāyuvarṇasyeti: ākulaṃ vyākulaṃ vāyuvarṇaṃ kṛṣṇākāraṃ yadā paśyati, tadoccāṭanaṃ sidhyati. sitavarṇaṃ candrākāraṃ rūpaṃ yadā paśyati, ...
analyzed: ākula vāyu varṇasya iti ākulam vyākulam vāyu varṇam kṛṣṇa ākāram yadā paśyati tadā uccāṭanam sidhyati sita varṇam candra ākāram rūpam yadā paśyati

original: [1.3.14] ... tadā yogasiddhiḥ. gatisaṃsthānabuddhimān iti: anena krameṇa yā gatiḥ pūrvam āsīd bhaviṣyati ca, tāṃ jānāti. candrākāre sthirībhūte gatiṃ vettīty arthaḥ. idānīṃ śūnyatānantaraṃ devatāṃ bhāvayed iti darśayitum āha: paścād ityādi. paścād iti śūnyatāyā anantaram. yogam utpanna iti: devatāyoga utpādanīyaḥ. kenety āha: aṅkurādibhi cetaneti.
analyzed: tadā yoga siddhiḥ gati saṃsthāna buddhimān iti anena krameṇa yā gatiḥ pūrvam āsīt bhaviṣyati ca tām jānāti candra ākāre sthirībhūte gatim vetti iti arthaḥ idānīm śūnyatā anantaram devatām bhāvayet iti darśayitum āha paścāt ityādi paścāt iti śūnyatāyāḥ anantaram yogam utpannaḥ iti devatā yogaḥ utpādanīyaḥ kena iti āha aṅkura ādibhiḥ cetanā iti

original: aṅkurādibhīti bījākṣaraṃ, tad eva cetanā cintanīyam ity arthaḥ. bījādinā devatotpādanīyeti piṇḍārthaḥ. etac ca sthāne sthāne vakṣyati, iha tv ārambhamātram uktam. cetasā sarvaviṣayagrāmaṃ gṛhītvā kṣaṇadvayaṃ yadi tiṣṭhed yogī, sarvam atītādikaṃ tadā jānātīti śūnyatābhāvanāyāḥ phalam aparam ity upadeśaḥ.
analyzed: aṅkura ādibhiḥ iti bīja akṣaram tat eva cetanā cintanīyam iti arthaḥ bīja ādinā devatā utpādanīyā iti piṇḍa arthaḥ etat ca sthāne sthāne vakṣyati iha tu ārambha mātram uktam cetasā sarva viṣaya grāmam gṛhītvā kṣaṇa dvayam yadi tiṣṭhet yogī sarvam atīta ādikam tadā jānāti iti śūnyatā bhāvanāyāḥ phalam aparam iti upadeśaḥ

original: [1.3.15] vinā śūnyatayā devatāyoge ko virodha ity āha: yo jñātvā śūnyatā bhāvā mukti śīghraṃ tu cetaseti. yo yogī bhāvānāṃ śūnyatāṃ jñātvā devatāyogaṃ kurute, sa muktaḥ śīghraṃ syād iti. cetasā cetayasveti vajrapāṇiṃ saṃbodhya bhagavatoktam. kim ity evam ity āha: jñānenetyādi.
analyzed: vinā śūnyatayā devatā yoge kaḥ virodhaḥ iti āha yaḥ jñātvā śūnyatāḥ bhāvāḥ mukti śīghram tu cetasā iti yaḥ yogī bhāvānām śūnyatām jñātvā devatā yogam kurute sa muktaḥ śīghram syāt iti cetasā cetayasva iti vajrapāṇim saṃbodhya bhagavatā uktam kim iti evam iti āha jñānena ityādi

original: jñānena śūnyatājñānena jñeyaṃ skandhādikam ālokya jñeyānāṃ devatānāṃ gatim īkṣayā gatiṃ svarūpaṃ nirūpya ca yas tadyogaṃ kurute, sa muktaḥ śīghraṃ syād iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ.
analyzed: jñānena śūnyatā jñānena jñeyam skandha ādikam ālokya jñeyānām devatānām gatim īkṣayā gatim svarūpam nirūpya ca yaḥ tad yogam kurute sa muktaḥ śīghram syāt iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ

original: [1.3.16] prakṣālya mala dehinām ity (2d) asya nirdeśam āha: mātaram ityādi. mātaram iti mātā tṛṣṇā viṣayātṛptiḥ. yathā mātā putraṃ maraṇe 'pi na tyajati, tathā tṛṣṇāpi puruṣam. mātṛsādharmyān mātā tṛṣṇā. pitaram iti: pitā moha ātmātmīyādigrahaḥ. yathā pitā janayati, tathā moho 'pi. mohavaśād dhi sattva utpadyate. hatveti: svarūpāt pracyāvya.
analyzed: dehinām iti asya nirdeśam āha mātaram ityādi mātaram iti mātā tṛṣṇā viṣaya atṛptiḥ yathā mātā putram maraṇe na tyajati tathā tṛṣṇā api puruṣam mātṛ sādharmyāt mātā tṛṣṇā pitaram iti pitā mohaḥ ātma ātmīya ādi grahaḥ yathā pitā janayati tathā mohaḥ u pi moha vaśāt hi sattvaḥ utpadyate hatvā iti svarūpāt pracyāvya

original: rājānam iti: ahaṃkāro rājā. ahaṃkāraprabhavaṃ hi sarvam iti. tathāha: ahaṃkārodbhavaṃ sarvam iti. dvau ca śrotriyāv iti: rāgadveṣau dharmasaṃketāt. rāṣṭraṃ sānucaram iti: rāṣṭraṃ śarīram. rājante kleśādayo 'sminn iti kṛtvā. anu saha carantīty anucarāḥ. skandhāyatanadhātavaś ca taiḥ saha vartata iti sānucaram.
analyzed: rājānam iti ahaṃkāraḥ rājā ahaṃkāra prabhavam hi sarvam iti tathā āha ahaṃkāra udbhavam sarvam iti dvau ca śrotriyau iti rāga dveṣau dharma saṃketāt rāṣṭram sa anucaram iti rāṣṭram śarīram rājante kleśa ādayaḥ smin iti kṛtvā anu saha caranti iti anucarāḥ skandha āyatana dhātavaḥ ca taiḥ saha vartate iti sa anucaram

original: tad evam etat sarvaṃ nirābhāsīkṛtya śuddho bhavati. sa cānyair api tathocyate. iyaṃ ca gāthā paṭalapiṇḍārthābhidhāyikā.
analyzed: tat evam etat sarvam nirābhāsīkṛtya śuddhaḥ bhavati sa ca anyaiḥ api tathā ucyate iyam ca gāthā paṭala piṇḍa artha abhidhāyikā

original: [1.3.col.] itiprakaraṇa iti: ity uktakrameṇa śūnyatā pauṣṭikādinimittaṃ ca prakriyate 'sminn itītiprakaraṇam ātmapīṭham eva. ity ātmapīṭhe catuṣpīṭhanibandhe tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ.
analyzed: iti prakaraṇa iti iti ukta krama śūnyatā pauṣṭika ādi nimittam ca prakriyate smin iti iti prakaraṇa ātma pīṭha eva iti ātma pīṭha catuṣpīṭha nibandha tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ

original: [1.4.1] idānīṃ śūnyatānantaraṃ devatāyogapradeśamātraṃ darśayituṃ caturthaṃ paṭalam āha: śṛṇv ityādi. vajreti vajrapāṇe. advayaṃ jñānaṃ śṛṇv iti saṃbandhaḥ. yathāmārgam iti: mārgānatikrameṇa. dvayavarjitam iti: grāhyādirahitam. etenaitad uktam: advayajñānam eva devatātmako bodhimārga iti. sa cādvayajñānātmako devatāyogo mārgaḥ.
analyzed: idānīm śūnyatā anantaram devatā yoga pradeśa mātram darśayitum caturtham paṭalam āha śṛṇu ityādi vajra iti vajrapāṇe advayam jñānam śṛṇu iti saṃbandhaḥ yathāmārgam iti mārga anatikrameṇa dvaya varjitam iti grāhya ādi rahitam etena etat uktam advaya jñānam eva devatā ātmakaḥ bodhi mārgaḥ iti sa ca advaya jñāna ātmakaḥ devatā yogaḥ mārgaḥ

original: keṣām arthāyety āha: saṃsāretyādi. saṃsāra evārṇavo bālair duravagāhatvāt. ghorāṇāṃ ghoro dustaratvāt. punaḥ kīdṛśa ity āha: uttīrṇam iti, utkṛṣṭaḥ. kair ity āha: jalaśatrukair iti. rāgādayaḥ kleśā eva jalaśatravo makarādayaḥ, taiḥ pūrṇa ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: keṣām arthāya iti āha saṃsāra ityādi saṃsāraḥ eva arṇavaḥ bālaiḥ duravagāha tvāt ghorāṇām ghoraḥ dustara tvāt punar kīdṛśaḥ iti āha uttīrṇam iti utkṛṣṭaḥ kaiḥ iti āha jalaśatrukaiḥ iti rāga ādayaḥ kleśāḥ eva jalaśatravaḥ makara ādayaḥ taiḥ pūrṇaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [1.4.2] madhyevartitadehānām iti: tasya saṃsārārṇavasya madhye vartamānadehānām. kiṃ teṣām ity āha: uttāryalakṣyam ucyata iti. teṣāṃ lakṣyo devatāyogaḥ. uttāryaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ saṃsārārṇavottaraṇāyety arthaḥ. ucyata iti munibhir āsaṃsāraṃ bhāṣyata ity arthaḥ. advayajñānalakṣaṇaṃ tāvad āha: lakṣyetyādi. lakṣyo devatāyogaḥ. lakṣaṇaṃ tannirīkṣaṇakriyā.
analyzed: madhye vartita dehānām iti tasya saṃsāra arṇavasya madhye vartamāna dehānām kim teṣām iti āha uttārya lakṣyam ucyate iti teṣām lakṣyaḥ devatā yogaḥ uttāryaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ saṃsāra arṇava uttaraṇāya iti arthaḥ ucyate iti munibhiḥ āsaṃsāram bhāṣyate iti arthaḥ advaya jñāna lakṣaṇam tāvat āha lakṣya ityādi lakṣyaḥ devatā yogaḥ lakṣaṇam tad nirīkṣaṇa kriyā

original: lakṣayatīti lakṣo yogī. vijñā vijñānam. jñāneneti jñānaṃ viṣayavijñaptiḥ.
analyzed: lakṣayati iti lakṣaḥ yogī vijñā vijñānam jñānena iti jñānam viṣaya vijñaptiḥ

original: [1.4.3] jñāneneti śūnyatājñānena. jñeyaṃ skandhādikam. etenaitad uktam: etal lakṣyādikaṃ skandhādikaṃ ca śūnyatayā cintanīyam iti. lakṣyādikaṃ grāhyādirahitam iti jñānam advayam iti bhāvaḥ. kuta evam ity āha: jñeyānāṃ gati īkṣayeti. yato jñeyānāṃ lakṣyādīnāṃ svarūpanirūpaṇena gatiḥ svarūpajñānaṃ bhavati. gati īkṣābhi cetasyeti:
analyzed: jñānena iti śūnyatā jñānena jñeyam skandha ādikam etena etat uktam etat lakṣya ādikam skandha ādikam ca śūnyatayā cintanīyam iti lakṣya ādikam grāhya ādi rahitam iti jñānam advayam iti bhāvaḥ kutas evam iti āha jñeyānām gati īkṣaya iti yatas jñeyānām lakṣya ādīnām svarūpa nirūpaṇena gatiḥ svarūpa jñānam bhavati gati īkṣā abhi cetasyā iti

original: jñeyanirūpaṇena tattvajñasya yoginaḥ. kim ity āha: pathetyādi. patheti panthā, advayajñānānuviddho devatāyogo mārgaḥ. anena ca svecchayā saṃbodhir adhigamyatām iti. ata āha: svecchābhi gamyatām iti.
analyzed: jñeya nirūpaṇena tattva jñasya yoginaḥ kim iti āha pathā ityādi pathā iti panthāḥ advaya jñāna anuviddhaḥ devatā yogaḥ mārgaḥ anena ca sva icchayā saṃbodhiḥ adhigamyatām iti atas āha sva icchā abhi gamyatām iti

original: [1.4.4] mārgasya śūnyatānuvedhānuśaṃsām āha: bhavantv ityādi. saṃsārādi vā pāśeti: saṃsārapāśo vā bhavatu, tathāpi kuñjarā marmamūrchiteti. puruṣakuñjaro yogī, marmaṇā svarūpajñānena mūrchitaḥ pravṛddhaḥ. tena kim ity āha: sahasram ekeṣu cāyogī pūrvajanma gatiṃ gata iti.
analyzed: mārgasya śūnyatā anuvedha anuśaṃsām āha bhavantu ityādi saṃsāra ādi vā pāśa iti saṃsāra pāśaḥ vā bhavatu tathā api kuñjarāḥ marma mūrchita iti puruṣa kuñjaraḥ yogī marmaṇā svarūpa jñānena mūrchitaḥ pravṛddhaḥ tena kim iti āha sahasram ekeṣu ca ayogī pūrva janma gatim gataḥ iti

original: janmasahasram api pūrvam akṣaṇaprāpto bhūtaḥ, tathāpi gatiṃ sadgatiṃ gacchati. yady api saṃsārapāśabaddho janmasahasram akṣaṇaprāpto 'yogīdānīṃ śūnyatājñānānuviddhadevatāyogamārgabhāvako 'siddhāv api sadgatiṃ mṛtaḥ prāpnotīty arthaḥ.
analyzed: janma sahasram api pūrvam akṣaṇa prāptaḥ bhūtaḥ tathā api gatim sat gatim gacchati yadi api saṃsāra pāśa baddhaḥ janma sahasram akṣaṇa prāptaḥ yogī idānīm siddhau api sat gatim mṛtaḥ prāpnoti iti arthaḥ

original: [1.4.5] etad evāha: samatetyādi. śūnyatayā samatāṃ pūrvoktalakṣaṇāṃ saṃcintya devatā bhāvyeti bhāvaḥ. śūnyatāṃ bhāvayitvā kimarthaṃ devatā bhāvyety āha: śūnyetyādi. śūnyena śūnyatayā pariśuddhaṃ dehakṣetraṃ yasyāsau śūnyakṣetrādidehas tasya bījāropaṃ tu mantrāropaḥ praśasyate. kiṃbhūtasya tasyety āha: buddhimān iti.
analyzed: etat eva āha samatā ityādi śūnyatayā samatām pūrva ukta lakṣaṇām saṃcintya devatā bhāvyā iti bhāvaḥ śūnyatām bhāvayitvā kimartham devatā bhāvyā iti āha śūnya ityādi śūnyena śūnyatayā pariśuddham deha kṣetram yasya asau śūnya kṣetra ādi dehaḥ tasya bīja āropam tu mantra āropaḥ praśasyate kimbhūtasya tasya iti āha buddhimān iti

original: dharmapravicayo buddhiḥ, so 'syeti tadvān, buddhimatas tasya. śūnyatāpariśuddhe dehe mantrāropo buddhimato bodhyāvāhaka iti piṇḍārthaḥ. tathā ca pariśuddhe kṣetre bījam uptaṃ niyamenāṅkurajanakaṃ dṛśyate.
analyzed: dharma pravicayaḥ buddhiḥ saḥ sya iti tadvān buddhimataḥ tasya śūnyatā pariśuddhe dehe mantra āropaḥ buddhimataḥ bodhya āvāhakaḥ iti piṇḍa arthaḥ tathā ca pariśuddhe kṣetre bījam uptam niyamena aṅkura janakam dṛśyate

original: [1.4.6] kim ivety āha: yathaiva mātaṅgagṛhasya agnikā devādhiṣṭhānaprakaraṇam ucyatām | samāśritā śreṣṭhakulena paṇḍitā tathaiva bhavanāni samādhicetaneti. yathā mātaṅgagṛham agnikety agninā dagdham iti draṣṭavyam. tathābhūtaṃ tat kiṃ syād ity āha: devādhiṣṭhānaṃ devatāropas tat prakriyate yujyate 'sminn iti tat tathā.
analyzed: kim iva iti āha yathā eva mātaṅga gṛhasya agnikā deva adhiṣṭhāna prakaraṇam ucyatām samāśritā śreṣṭha kulena paṇḍitā tathā eva bhavanāni samādhi cetanā iti yathā mātaṅga gṛham agnikā iti agninā dagdham iti draṣṭavyam tathābhūtam tat kim syāt iti āha deva adhiṣṭhānam devatā āropaḥ tat prakriyate yujyate smin iti tat tathā

original: devatādhiṣṭhānāya yuktaṃ bhavatīty ucyatām ity ucyata ity arthaḥ. dāhe hi tac chuddham iti bhāvaḥ. na kevalaṃ devatāropāya yujyate. samāśriteti samāśritāḥ śreṣṭhakulam iti matvā tan mātaṅgagṛhaṃ vahnipariśuddham. ke ta ity āha: paṇḍiteti paṇḍitāḥ. vahnidagdhaṃ mātaṅgagṛhaṃ yat, tatra devatāpaṇḍitāgāraṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: devatā adhiṣṭhānāya yuktam bhavati iti ucyatām iti ucyate iti arthaḥ dāhe hi tat śuddham iti bhāvaḥ na kevalam devatā āropāya yujyate samāśrita iti samāśritāḥ śreṣṭha kulam iti matvā tat mātaṅga gṛham vahni pariśuddham ke te iti āha paṇḍita iti paṇḍitāḥ vahni dagdham mātaṅga gṛham yat tatra devatā paṇḍita āgāram bhavati iti bhāvaḥ

original: yathaivaṃ tathā bhavanāni śarīrāṇi śūnyatāvahnidagdhāni, samādhicetaneti: devatāyogasyāropasthānāni bhavantīti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: yathā evam tathā bhavanāni śarīrāṇi śūnyatā vahni dagdhāni samādhi cetanā iti devatā yogasya āropa sthānāni bhavanti iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.4.7] aṣṭākṣaramantrasya aṣṭasthāne tu kalpitam (par. 1.2.41cd) ity uddiṣṭaṃ nirdiśan kena jñātavya mantreṣv iti (1.3.1c) praśnaṃ visraṣṭum āha: nyased ityādi. devatādiyoge saṃvṛtte nyased akṣaravinyāsam iti saṃbandhaḥ. nyased iti nyasyed ity arthaḥ. nyāsam āha– ūrdhvam ityādi. ūrdhvaṃ tālu, tatrāgniṃ kṣuṃkāraṃ kalpayet. pṛthivīdvayabījasyeti:
analyzed: aṣṭa akṣara mantrasya aṣṭa sthāne tu kalpitam iti uddiṣṭam nirdiśan kena mantreṣu iti praśnam visraṣṭum āha nyaset ityādi devatā ādi yoge saṃvṛtte nyaset akṣara vinyāsam iti saṃbandhaḥ nyaset iti nyasyet iti arthaḥ nyāsam āha ūrdhvam ityādi ūrdhvam tālu tatra agnim kṣuṃkāram kalpayet pṛthivī dvaya bījasya iti

original: huṃkāradvayam. cakṣus tasyaiva yojayed iti: huṃkāradvayaṃ tac cakṣuṣor yojayet.
analyzed: huṃkāra dvayam cakṣuḥ tasya eva yojayet iti huṃkāra dvayam tat cakṣuṣoḥ yojayet

original: [1.4.8] vāyuśūnyādibījasyeti: śūnyatāviśuddhaṃ vāyubījaṃ yuṃkāraṃ yojayed iti (7d) pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ. kutrety āha: nāsā karṇādi cetaseti. nāsāpuṭadvaye karṇadvaye ca. cetaseti: cittasvarūpam ity arthaḥ. amṛtā-ambubījānām iti: amṛtabījaṃ suṃkāraḥ, tac cāmbuviśuddham. jihvendriya prabhur īśvara iti: tad bījaṃ jihvendriye niyojanīyam.
analyzed: vāyuśūnya ādi bījasya iti śūnyatā viśuddham vāyubījam yuṃkāram yojayet iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ kutra iti āha nāsā karṇa ādi cetasā iti nāsā puṭa dvaye karṇa dvaye ca cetasā iti citta svarūpam iti arthaḥ amṛta aambu bījānām iti amṛta bījam suṃkāraḥ tat ca ambu viśuddham jihvā indriya prabhuḥ īśvaraḥ iti tat bījam jihvā indriye niyojanīyam

original: kutaḥ? yataḥ prabhutvaṃ tasya tatra. prabhur ity asya nirdeśa īśvara iti.
analyzed: kutas yatas prabhu tvam tasya tatra prabhuḥ iti asya nirdeśaḥ īśvaraḥ iti

original: [1.4.9] yasya kūṭa kramā gṛhyeti: kūṭabījāni krameṇa yasya yatra sthānaṃ, tatra tatra caturṣu sthāneṣu yojayed iti saṃbandhaḥ. tad evāha: grīva ityādi. grīvāyāṃ mohaviśuddhaṃ bījaṃ smryuṃ. bāhubhyāṃ kleśakas tatheti: bāhumūladvaye kleśaviśuddhaṃ bījaṃ hmryuṃ.
analyzed: yasya kūṭa kramāḥ gṛhya iti kūṭa bījāni krameṇa yasya yatra sthānam tatra tatra caturṣu sthāneṣu yojayet iti saṃbandhaḥ tat eva āha grīvaḥ ityādi grīvāyām moha viśuddham bījam bāhubhyām kleśakaḥ tathā iti bāhumūla dvaye kleśa viśuddham bījam

original: [1.4.10] calitā hṛdayadeśe tv iti: caliteti vāyuḥ. tadviśuddhaṃ bījaṃ ymryuṃ, tac ca hṛdaye yojayed iti śeṣaḥ. paśubhyāṃ nābhimūlayor iti: paśuśabdenollūkī, tasyā bījaṃ kṣmryuṃ, tac ca nābhimūle. etāny uparyuparibhāvena kūṭarūpatvāt kūṭabījāni. kalana aṅga aṣṭeneti: aṣṭāṅgakavacanam idam iti bhāvaḥ. kiṃ tad ity āha: bīja aṣṭāṅga vāritam iti.
analyzed: calitā hṛdaya deśe tu iti calitā iti vāyuḥ tad viśuddham bījam tat ca hṛdaye yojayet iti śeṣaḥ paśubhyām nābhimūlayoḥ iti paśu śabdena ullūkī tasyāḥ bījam tat ca nābhimūle etāni upari upari bhāvena kūṭa rūpa tvāt kūṭa bījāni aṅga aṣṭena iti aṣṭāṅgaka vacanam idam iti bhāvaḥ kim tat iti āha bīja aṣṭāṅga vāritam iti

original: aṣṭabhir bījair aṣṭāṅgarakṣaṇaṃ yat tad ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: aṣṭabhiḥ bījaiḥ aṣṭāṅga rakṣaṇam yat tat iti arthaḥ

original: [1.4.11] yuktetyādi: jñānaḍākinīrūpam ātmānaṃ vibhāvya bījair aṣṭasv aṅgeṣu yuktaḥ syād iti bhāvaḥ. jñānaḍākinīrūpam āha: padma-m-āsanetyādi. sūryamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam iti: padmopari sūryamaṇḍalopaviṣṭam iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: yukta ityādi jñāna ḍākinī rūpam ātmānam vibhāvya bījaiḥ aṣṭasu aṅgeṣu yuktaḥ syāt iti bhāvaḥ jñāna ḍākinī rūpam āha padmam āsana ityādi sūrya maṇḍala maṇḍitam iti padma upari sūrya maṇḍala upaviṣṭam iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.4.12] uparisthaśvetacchattraṃ pihitam. etad evāha: śvetetyādi.
analyzed: upari stha śveta chattram pihitam etat eva āha śveta ityādi

original: [1.4.13] kirīṭi vajrā-ūrdhvānām iti: makuṭāgroparidhṛtavajram. paṭṭāveṣṭavilambitam iti: paṭabaddhamukuṭam. pratyekamukheṣu dhṛtanetratrayam. etad evāha: trinetram iti. hasitakrodham iti: hasitavāmamukham, kruddhadakṣiṇamukham, śṛṅgārālasapradhānamukham. suśobheti: atiśuklavastrayuktam.
analyzed: kirīṭi iti makuṭa agra upari dhṛta vajram paṭṭāveṣṭa vilambitam iti paṭa baddha mukuṭam pratyeka mukheṣu dhṛta netra trayam etat eva āha trinetram iti hasita krodham iti hasita vāma mukham kruddha dakṣiṇa mukham śṛṅgāra alasa pradhāna mukham suśobhā iti ati śukla vastra yuktam

original: [1.4.14] asītyādi: asiparaśuvajradhāri dakṣiṇabhujatrayam. tarjanīśaktikhaṭvāṅgadhāri vāmabhujatrayam.
analyzed: asi ityādi asi paraśu vajra dhāri dakṣiṇa bhuja trayam tarjanī śakti khaṭvāṅga dhāri vāma bhuja trayam

original: [1.4.15] vairocanādibuddhameghaughaṃ sphārayantaṃ tenaiva sattvārthaṃ kurvāṇaṃ vividharaśmikarālam. evaṃbhūtaṃ jñānaḍākinīrūpam ātmānaṃ bhāvayet. śvāsaniścalam iti: niścalaḥ śvāso yatra, tac chvāsaniścalam. tad yathā bhavati tathā bhāvayed iti kriyāviśeṣaṇam. etena cittaikāgratā sūcitā, yatas tasyāṃ satyāṃ śvāso niścalo bhavati.
analyzed: vairocana ādi buddha megha ogham sphārayantam tena eva sattva artham kurvāṇam vividha raśmi karālam evaṃbhūtam jñāna ḍākinī rūpam ātmānam bhāvayet śvāsa niścalam iti niścalaḥ śvāsaḥ yatra tat śvāsa niścalam tat yathā bhavati tathā bhāvayet iti kriyā viśeṣaṇam etena citta ekāgra tā sūcitā yatas tasyām satyām śvāsaḥ niścalaḥ bhavati

original: yāvac charīra eva śvāso līyate, tāvad bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: yāvat śarīre eva śvāsaḥ līyate tāvat bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.4.16] idānīṃ sūkṣmayogam āha: mana ityādi. mana iti hūṃkāraḥ. jñāna vijñānaṃ ceti: tasyaiva paryāyau. sphaṭikākāraṃ tu cintayed iti: hūṃkāraṃ śuklaṃ cintayed ity arthaḥ. alītyādi: ālīr ūkāraḥ. kālir hakāraḥ. tadyoge tad bījam uddhṛtam.
analyzed: idānīm sūkṣma yogam āha manaḥ ityādi manaḥ iti hūṃkāraḥ jñāna vijñānam ca iti tasya eva paryāyau sphaṭika ākāram tu cintayet iti hūṃkāram śuklam cintayet iti arthaḥ alī ityādi ālīḥ ūkāraḥ kāliḥ hakāraḥ tad yoge tat bījam uddhṛtam

original: [1.4.17] tat kutra bhāvayed ity āha: bhrūmadhya ityādi. bindusthāne tv iti: hūṃkārasyādhomukhasya binduṃ bhruvor madhye sthāpayitvā hūṃkāraṃ bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ. ihāpi śvāsaniścalam iti (15d) yojyam. etac ca devatāyogānantaraṃ bhāvyam. bījabhāvaṃ hūṃkāra eva bhāvya ity arthaḥ. kenety āha: yoginām iti. yoginety arthaḥ.
analyzed: tat kutra bhāvayet iti āha bhrū madhye ityādi bindu sthāne tu iti hūṃkārasya adhomukhasya bindum bhruvoḥ madhye sthāpayitvā hūṃkāram bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ iha api śvāsa niścalam iti yojyam etat ca devatā yoga anantaram bhāvyam bīja bhāvam hūṃkāraḥ eva bhāvyaḥ iti arthaḥ kena iti āha yoginām iti yoginā iti arthaḥ

original: candramaṇḍalopaviṣṭaṃ bhrūmadhyāsaktabinduṃ sravadamṛtadhāraṃ hūṃkāraṃ cintayed iti bhāvaḥ. tadanantaraṃ mantraṃ japed ity āha: japed ityādi. akṣarasya jñānaḍākinyā bījam akṣarabījaṃ japet. katamat tad ity āha: pañcabuddhābhimaṇḍitam iti. asya pañcabuddhamaṇḍitatvaṃ prāg darśitam eva.
analyzed: candra maṇḍala upaviṣṭam bhrū madhya āsakta bindum sravat amṛta dhāram hūṃkāram cintayet iti bhāvaḥ tad anantaram mantram japet iti āha japet ityādi akṣarasya jñāna ḍākinyāḥ bījam akṣarabījam japet katamat tat iti āha pañca buddha abhimaṇḍitam iti asya pañca buddha maṇḍita tvam prāk darśitam eva

original: [1.4.18] hūṃkāroddhāram āha: anilānalasaptyartham iti. saptiśabdena saptamaḥ. anilasya yakārasya saptamaḥ sakāraḥ. analasya rephasya saptamo hakāraḥ. anilānalayoḥ saptiḥ. sa evārthyata ity artho grāhya ity arthaḥ. jātāv ekavacanam. vajrībījena coditam iti: vajrībījam anilasaptamaḥ.
analyzed: hūṃkāra uddhāram āha anila anala sapti artham iti sapti śabdena saptamaḥ anilasya yakārasya saptamaḥ sakāraḥ analasya rephasya saptamaḥ hakāraḥ anila analayoḥ saptiḥ saḥ eva arthyate iti arthaḥ grāhyaḥ iti arthaḥ jātau ekavacanam vajrī bījena coditam iti vajrī bījam anilasaptamaḥ

original: sakārasyārdhacandrasya cāmṛtasvarūpatvena sādharmyād vajrībījaśabdenārdhacandra eva. sakāro hi vajrībījam. tataś ca vajrībījenārdhacandreṇa coditaṃ yojitam analasaptamaṃ hakāram. japed iti (17c) pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ. punaḥ kīdṛśam ity āha: bindvityādi. ardhacandroparibindusamākrāntam, adho nādena dīrghokāreṇa cākrāntaṃ hakāraṃ japed iti.
analyzed: sakārasya ardhacandrasya ca amṛta svarūpa tvena sādharmyāt vajrī bīja śabdena ardhacandraḥ eva sakāraḥ hi vajrī bījam tatas ca vajrī bījena ardhacandreṇa coditam yojitam anala saptamam hakāram japet iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ punar kīdṛśam iti āha bindu ityādi ardhacandra upari bindu samākrāntam adhas nādena dīrgha ukāreṇa ca ākrāntam hakāram japet iti

original: samudāyena hūṃ iti bījaṃ jñānaḍākinyāḥ. dhārāvarṣa iti: amṛtadhārāṃ varṣatīti dhārāvarṣa iti sa hūṃkāraḥ smṛtaḥ. taṃ japed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: samudāyena hūm iti bījam jñānaḍākinyāḥ dhārā varṣaḥ iti amṛta dhārām varṣati iti dhārā varṣaḥ iti sa hūṃkāraḥ smṛtaḥ tam japet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.4.19] kathaṃ tad bījaṃ japed ity āha: guror ityādi. gurvakṣaram oṃkāraḥ. sa hūṃkārāt pūrvaṃ draṣṭavyaḥ. huta-akṣara antimeti: hūṃkārasyāntimaṃ hutākṣaraṃ svāhākāraḥ. antikāpāṭhe 'py antimam eva. oṃ hūṃ svāheti samudāyena bhavati. japed ityādi. jñānaḍākinīsamādhisaṃpanno lakṣatrayaṃ mantram imaṃ japet. tena pūrvasevā syāt.
analyzed: katham tat bījam japet iti āha guroḥ ityādi guru akṣaram oṃkāraḥ sa hūṃkārāt pūrvam draṣṭavyaḥ huta akṣara antima iti hūṃkārasya antimam huta akṣaram svāhākāraḥ antikā pāṭhe pi antimam eva om hūm svāhā iti samudāyena bhavati japet ityādi jñāna ḍākinī samādhi saṃpannaḥ lakṣa trayam mantram imam japet tena pūrva sevā syāt

original: [1.4.20] asyāṃ jāpitayogānām iti: anena bhāvanākrameṇa japayukto bhavati yo yogī, tasya cintitaṃ sarvaṃ sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ. cintitam artham āha: aṣṭau karmādi pūrvasyeti. śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ vaśyam ākṛṣṭir abhicāra uccāṭanaṃ vidveṣaḥ stambhanam ity aṣṭau karmāṇi pūrvaṃ bodheḥ prāg etāni tāvat sidhyanti, paścād bodhir apīti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: asyām jāpita yogānām iti anena bhāvanā krameṇa japa yuktaḥ bhavati yaḥ yogī tasya cintitam sarvam sidhyati iti bhāvaḥ cintitam artham āha aṣṭau karma ādi pūrvasya iti śāntikam pauṣṭikam vaśyam ākṛṣṭiḥ abhicāraḥ uccāṭanam vidveṣaḥ stambhanam iti aṣṭau karmāṇi pūrvam bodheḥ prāk etāni tāvat sidhyanti paścāt bodhiḥ api iti bhāvaḥ

original: japed ityāder (19c) nirdeśam āha. pūrvasevādītyādi paścāt karmakāle prāg uktāni sidhyanti. vidarbhaṇapūrvakaṃ jāpamātreṇa sarvaṃ sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: japet ityādeḥ nirdeśam āha pūrva sevā ādi ityādi paścāt karma kāle prāk uktāni sidhyanti vidarbhaṇa pūrvakam jāpa mātreṇa sarvam sidhyati iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.4.21] idānīṃ vajrakarttarīmantram āha: śṛṇv ityādi subodham. vajravākyasyeti: vajravākyaṃ vajraśabdaḥ pūrvaṃ deya ity arthaḥ. pūrvasya vargapūrvaṃ tu akṣaram iti: pūrvasya prathamasya vargasya pūrvam akṣaraṃ kakāra ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: idānīm vajra karttarī mantram āha śṛṇu ityādi su bodham vajra vākyasya iti vajra vākyam vajra śabdaḥ pūrvam deyaḥ iti arthaḥ pūrvasya varga pūrvam tu akṣaram iti pūrvasya prathamasya vargasya pūrvam akṣaram kakāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [1.4.22] yathāvarga caturthasya pūrvam akṣareti: caturthasya vargasya pūrvam akṣaraṃ takāra ity arthaḥ. tac ca dviguṇīkartavyam ity āha: dviguṇeti. repha ūrdhvānām iti: dviguṇasya takārasya mūrdhni rephaḥ. ikāraṃ rephayojitam iti: paścād aparo repha ikāreṇa yojayitavya ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: yathā varga caturthasya pūrvam akṣara iti caturthasya vargasya pūrvam akṣaram takāraḥ iti arthaḥ tat ca dviguṇīkartavyam iti āha dviguṇa iti rephaḥ ūrdhvānām iti dviguṇasya takārasya mūrdhni rephaḥ ikāram repha yojitam iti paścāt aparaḥ rephaḥ ikāreṇa yojayitavyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [1.4.23] yathāvarga dvitīyasya dvibhir akṣara binduketi: dvitīyasya vargasya dvitīyam akṣaraṃ chakāraḥ. tasya samīpe bindur eko deyaḥ. aṅkuśena tu pīḍasyeti: aṅkuśaśabdena hrasva ikāra iha tāvad gṛhyate. tena pīḍayed yojayec chaṃkāram. caturthasya tṛtīyakam iti: caturthasya vargasya tṛtīyo dakāraḥ.
analyzed: yathā varga dvitīyasya dvibhiḥ akṣara binduka iti dvitīyasya vargasya dvitīyam akṣaram chakāraḥ tasya samīpe binduḥ ekaḥ deyaḥ aṅkuśena tu pīḍasya iti aṅkuśa śabdena hrasvaḥ ikāraḥ iha tāvat gṛhyate tena pīḍayet yojayet śaṃkāram caturthasya tṛtīyakam iti caturthasya vargasya tṛtīyaḥ dakāraḥ

original: [1.4.24] dviguṇaṃ dvayam uccāryeti: chiṃkāro dakāraś ceti dvayaṃ dviguṇam uccāraṇīyam. yathā chiṃda chiṃdeti. anusvāro nakāro na kāryaḥ. pañcamena tu carcitam iti: pañcamo hūṃkāraḥ. tena carcito mantraḥ. praṇamākṣarapūrvasyeti: pūrvaṃ prathamata oṃkāraḥ. ghorākṣara antiketi: ghorākṣaraṃ phaṭkāraḥ. tac cānte deyam iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: dviguṇam dvayam uccārya iti chiṃkāraḥ dakāraḥ ca iti dvayam dviguṇam uccāraṇīyam yathā chinda chinda iti anusvāraḥ nakāraḥ na kāryaḥ pañcamena tu carcitam iti pañcamaḥ hūṃkāraḥ tena carcitaḥ mantraḥ praṇama akṣara pūrvasya iti pūrvam prathamatas oṃkāraḥ ghora akṣara antika iti ghora akṣaram phaṭkāraḥ tat ca ante deyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: oṃ vajrakarttari chiṃda chiṃda hūṃ phaḍ iti samudāyena mantraḥ.
analyzed: om vajrakarttari chiṃda chiṃda   phaṭ iti samudāyena mantraḥ

original: [1.4.25] asyānuśaṃsām āha: asya bījam ityādi. stambhanasyopalakṣaṇatvād imaṃ mantraṃ japan sarvakāryāṇi sādhayatīti bhāvaḥ. mudrām āha: dvābhyām ityādi. hastasaṃmiśram iti: dvau hastau miśrayitvā, bhuñjitasyaiva yojayed iti: bhuñjitaṃ bhojaṇaṃ bhakṣaṇam ity arthaḥ. tena dvau miśritau hastau yojayet.
analyzed: asya anuśaṃsām āha asya bījam ityādi stambhanasya upalakṣaṇa tvāt imam mantram japan sarva kāryāṇi sādhayati iti bhāvaḥ mudrām āha dvābhyām ityādi hasta saṃmiśram iti dvau hastau miśrayitvā bhuñjitasya eva yojayet iti bhuñjitam bhojaṇam bhakṣaṇam iti arthaḥ tena dvau miśritau hastau yojayet

original: etena hastadvayaṃ miśrayitvā bhakṣaṇābhinayena mukhaṃ ca darśayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: etena hasta dvayam miśrayitvā bhakṣaṇa abhinayena mukham ca darśayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [1.4.26] hastadvayaṃ miśrayitvā kīdṛśaṃ kartavyam ity āha: prasārya krodhamadhyamaṃ vai ubhau spṛśaspṛśena tv iti. hastadvayaṃ miśrayitvā, paścād vajramuṣṭidvayaṃ kṛtvā prasārya krodhāṃ tarjanīṃ madhyamaṃ madhyāṅguliṃ karttanābhinayena parasparaṃ spṛśet. mukhena ca bhakṣaṇābhinayaṃ kuryāt. pūrvamantram anayā mudrayā yojayan sarvakarmāṇi sādhayet.
analyzed: hasta dvayam miśrayitvā kīdṛśam kartavyam iti āha prasārya krodhamadhyamam vai ubhau spṛśa spṛśena tu iti hasta dvayam miśrayitvā paścāt vajra muṣṭi dvayam kṛtvā prasārya krodhām tarjanīm madhyamam madhya aṅgulim karttana abhinayena parasparam spṛśet mukhena ca bhakṣaṇa abhinayam kuryāt pūrva mantram anayā mudrayā yojayan sarva karmāṇi sādhayet

original: aṅguṣṭhaṃ hastāntaḥ praveśya sarvāṅgulyākramaṇād vajramuṣṭiḥ. ebhir ityādi: ebhir ity eṣā mudrā. chijjate sarva vastūnīti: chinatti sādhayatīty arthaḥ. kāni vastūnīty āha: śatrugrīvādi veti. amuṃ mantraṃ pūrvasevayā siddhaṃ yatra mudrāpūrvakaṃ yojayet, tac chatrugrīvākarṇanāsādikaṃ chinattīti bhāvaḥ. avaśyam eva kiṃ syād ity āha: mana iti.
analyzed: aṅguṣṭham hasta antar praveśya sarva aṅguli ākramaṇāt vajramuṣṭiḥ ebhiḥ ityādi ebhiḥ iti eṣā mudrā chijjate sarva vastūni iti chinatti sādhayati iti arthaḥ kāni vastūni iti āha śatrugrīva ādi vā iti amum mantram pūrva sevayā siddham yatra mudrā pūrvakam yojayet tat śatrugrīvā karṇa nāsā ādikam chinatti iti bhāvaḥ avaśyam eva kim syāt iti āha manaḥ iti

original: manovilāsa eṣa ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: manaḥ vilāsaḥ eṣaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [1.4.27] athetyādi. sarvakārya jalādiketi: vṛṣṭijalasya stambhanam iti bhāvaḥ. yathetyādi. yatheti nidarśane. vargasya antānāṃ tribhir akṣara gṛhyata iti. antyo vargaḥ pavargaḥ kavargād gaṇyamānaḥ. tasya tribhir akṣareti: tṛtīyam akṣaraṃ bakāraḥ. sa prathamaṃ gṛhyate.
analyzed: atha ityādi sarva kārya jala ādikā iti vṛṣṭi jalasya stambhanam iti bhāvaḥ yathā ityādi yathā iti nidarśane vargasya antānām tribhiḥ akṣara gṛhyate iti antyaḥ vargaḥ pavargaḥ kavargāt gaṇyamānaḥ tasya tribhiḥ akṣara iti tṛtīyam akṣaram bakāraḥ sa prathamam gṛhyate

original: [1.4.28] yathāvarga tṛtīyasya tribhir akṣareti: tṛtīyavargasya ṭavargasya tṛtīyam akṣaraṃ ḍakāraḥ. ekāreṇa tu pūrvasya tṛtīyo bhāgabījakair iti: pūrvam ekāraṃ dattvā tṛtīyabhāgabījakaśabdena bakāro gṛhyate. tataś ca baḍabe iti syāt.
analyzed: yathā varga tṛtīyasya tribhiḥ akṣara iti tṛtīya vargasya ṭavargasya tṛtīyam akṣaram ḍakāraḥ ekāreṇa tu pūrvasya tṛtīyaḥ bhāga bījakaiḥ iti pūrvam ekāram dattvā tṛtīya bhāga bījaka śabdena bakāraḥ gṛhyate tatas ca iti syāt

original: [1.4.29] pañcamasya tu pūrvasyeti: pañcamasya vargasya pūrvaḥ pakāraḥ. aṅkuśena tv iti: hrasva ikāro 'trāṅkuśaśabdena gṛhyate. pakāraṃ tena yojayed iti. visargākṣara madhyaṃ tv iti: visargākṣaraṃ bakāraḥ, sa madhye vajrībījāt. tad evāha: vajrībījaṃ tu antiketi. antimaṃ vajrībījaṃ hakāraḥ.
analyzed: pañcamasya tu pūrvasya iti pañcamasya vargasya pūrvaḥ pakāraḥ aṅkuśena tu iti hrasvaḥ ikāraḥ tra aṅkuśa śabdena gṛhyate pakāram tena yojayet iti madhyam tu iti visarga akṣaram bakāraḥ sa madhye vajrī bījāt tat eva āha vajrī bījam tu antika iti antimam vajrī bījam hakāraḥ

original: [1.4.30] repham aṅkuśa pārśveneti: hakārasyādho rephaṃ dattvā pārśve dīrgham īkāram aṅkuśaṃ dadyāt. ghātetyādi: phaṭkāro 'nte. praṇavā pūrva dātavyam iti: pūrvaṃ praṇavo deyaḥ. oṃ baḍabe piba hrī phaḍ iti samudāyena mantraḥ. stambhanābīja kalpitam iti: jalastambhanamantro 'yam.
analyzed: repham aṅkuśa pārśvena iti hakārasya adhas repham dattvā pārśve dīrgham īkāram aṅkuśam dadyāt ghāta ityādi phaṭkāraḥ nte dātavyam iti pūrvam praṇavaḥ deyaḥ om baḍabe piba hrī phaṭ iti samudāyena mantraḥ stambhanā bīja kalpitam iti jala stambhana mantraḥ yam

original: [1.4.31] mudrām āha: hastā dvāv ityādi. hastadvayenāñjaliṃ kṛtvā parasparato 'nāmāṅgulidvayaṃ mūlaparyantaṃ niṣkāśya tarjanībhyām anāmādvayāgram ākṛṣya madhyamāṅgulidvayamūle ...
analyzed: mudrām āha hastāḥ dvau ityādi hasta dvayena añjalim kṛtvā parasparataḥ nāma aṅguli dvayam mūla paryantam niṣkāśya tarjanībhyām a nāma advaya agram ākṛṣya madhyamā aṅguli dvaya mūle

original: [1.4.32] ... jyeṣṭhāṅgulidvayāgraṃ yojayed iti vaḍavāmukhamudrā. meghadevādi khādyatām iti: meghadevādistambhanam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: jyeṣṭha aṅguli dvaya agram yojayet iti vaḍavāmukha mudrā meghadeva ādi khādyatām iti meghadeva ādi stambhanam iti arthaḥ

original: [1.4.33] lakṣam ityādi subodham.
analyzed: lakṣam ityādi su bodham

original: [1.4.col.] devatāyogādyabhidhāyakaś caturthaḥ paṭalo 'yam, caturbhiḥ paṭalaiś cātmapīṭham. ata āha: iti ātmapīṭhaḥ samāpta iti. itiśabdaḥ pīṭhasamāptau. iti catuṣpīṭhanibandhe prathamam ātmapīṭhaṃ samāptam ||
analyzed: devatā yoga ādi abhidhāyaka caturtha paṭala yad caturbhiḥ paṭalaiḥ ca ātma pīṭha atas āha iti ātma pīṭha samāp iti iti śabdaḥ pīṭha samāptau iti catuṣpīṭha nibandha prathama ātma pīṭham samāp

original: [2.1.1] idānīṃ parapīṭhe śāntikādihomabalidānaśiṣyalakṣaṇakathanārthaṃ prathamaṃ paṭalam āha: bhagavann ityādi. śrotum icchāmīti saṃbandhaḥ. kiṃ tad ity āha: pratibimbasya kīdṛśam | śāntihomakriyāṇāṃ baliyuktyādikaṃ katham iti. śāntikādihomakriyāyāḥ pratibimbaṃ devatāyogaḥ kīdṛśaḥ. śāntikādihomakriyāyā eva praśnaḥ, tadaṅgasya pṛṣṭatvāt.
analyzed: idānīm para pīṭhe śāntika ādi homa bali dāna śiṣya lakṣaṇa kathana artham prathamam paṭalam āha bhagavan ityādi śrotum icchāmi iti saṃbandhaḥ kim tat iti āha pratibimbasya kīdṛśam śānti homa kriyāṇām bali yukti ādikam katham iti śāntika ādi homa kriyāyāḥ pratibimbam devatā yogaḥ kīdṛśaḥ śāntika ādi homa kriyāyāḥ eva praśnaḥ tad aṅgasya pṛṣṭa tvāt

original: baliyuktyādikam iti: balidānakāle ca yuktir devatāyogaḥ kīdṛśīti bhāvaḥ. atha vā: śāntikahomādikriyā kīdṛśī, pratibimbaṃ devatāyogaḥ tatra kīdṛśaṃ, balidānaṃ ca kīdṛśam, ādiśabdāc chiṣyalakṣaṇaṃ ca kīdṛśam iti yojyam.
analyzed: bali yukti ādikam iti bali dāna kāle ca yuktiḥ devatā yogaḥ kīdṛśī iti bhāvaḥ atha vā śāntika homa ādi kriyā kīdṛśī pratibimbam devatā yogaḥ tatra kīdṛśam bali dānam ca kīdṛśam ādi śabdāt śiṣya lakṣaṇam ca kīdṛśam iti yojyam

original: [2.1.2] etad eva visṛjann āha: śṛṇv ityādi. bimbādi-agracetasam iti: devatābimbasvarūpaṃ cittaṃ śṛṇu. śroṣyasīti bhāvaḥ. mantra mudrasyeti: mantraṃ mudrāṃ ca śṛṇv iti yojyam. kasyety āha: homasyeti. mantrety asya nirdeśaḥ: japeti. tasya mantrasya japam. dhyānābhibhāvanam iti: devatābimbasya nirdeśaḥ. homakāle devatāyogamantramudrāḥ śṛṇv iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: etat eva visṛjan āha śṛṇu ityādi bimba ādi agra cetasam iti devatā bimba svarūpam cittam śṛṇu śroṣyasi iti bhāvaḥ mantra mudrasya iti mantram mudrām ca śṛṇu iti yojyam kasya iti āha homasya iti mantra iti asya nirdeśaḥ japa iti tasya mantrasya japam dhyāna abhibhāvanam iti devatā bimbasya nirdeśaḥ homa kāle devatā yoga mantra mudrāḥ śṛṇu iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.1.3] kiṃ cāgnikarmādi pūrvasya jape jñāsyanti buddhimān iti. mantrajāpād agnikarma homakarma pūrvaṃ jñātavyaṃ buddhimateti bhāvaḥ. homāt pūrvaṃ tāvaj japādikaṃ kartavyam eva. atha vā japāt pūrvaṃ homādikaṃ jñeyam iti bhāvaḥ. bhūmiśodhitamātreṇa vedilakṣaṇa tatparam iti. homārthaṃ prathamaṃ bhūmiśodhanaṃ kāryam. tatparam iti:
analyzed: kim ca agnikarma ādi pūrvasya jape jñāsyanti buddhimān iti mantra jāpāt agnikarma homa karma pūrvam jñātavyam buddhimatā iti bhāvaḥ homāt pūrvam tāvat japa ādikam kartavyam eva atha vā japāt pūrvam homa ādikam jñeyam iti bhāvaḥ bhūmi śodhita mātreṇa tat param iti homa artham prathamam bhūmi śodhanam kāryam tat param iti

original: tataḥ paraṃ viditalakṣaṇaṃ kuṇḍaṃ khaned iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: tatas param vidita lakṣaṇam kuṇḍam khanet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.1.4] aṣṭāṅgulād ārabhya yāvat sahasrahastiketi: yāvat sahasrāṅgulam iti bhāvaḥ. atha vāṣṭāṅgulamānād ārabhya yāvad dhastamānam. hastamānāc ca yāvat sahasrahastamānaṃ kuṇḍapramāṇam uktam. aṣṭāṅgulam adhikaṃ gṛhyeti kvacit pāṭhaḥ. aṣṭāṅgulamānādhikaṃ gṛhyamānaṃ yāvat sahasrahastamānaṃ gṛhyata iti vyākhyā. mānam āha: aṣṭamaṃ ripughātaṃ tv iti.
analyzed: aṣṭa aṅgulāt ārabhya yāvat sahasra hastikā iti yāvat sahasra aṅgulam iti bhāvaḥ atha vā aṣṭa aṅgula mānāt ārabhya yāvat hasta mānam hasta mānāt ca yāvat sahasra hasta mānam kuṇḍa pramāṇam uktam aṣṭa aṅgulam adhikam gṛhya iti kvacid pāṭhaḥ aṣṭa aṅgula māna adhikam gṛhyamānam yāvat sahasra hasta mānam gṛhyate iti vyākhyā mānam āha aṣṭamam ripu ghātam tu iti

original: aṣṭāṅgulamānaṃ kuṇḍaṃ ripughātārthaṃ kāryam ity arthaḥ. tatrābhicārahoma iti bhāvaḥ. daśamaṃ pauṣṭikas tatheti: daśāṅgulaṃ pauṣṭikahomārtham.
analyzed: aṣṭa aṅgula mānam kuṇḍam ripu ghāta artham kāryam iti arthaḥ tatra abhicāra homaḥ iti bhāvaḥ daśamam pauṣṭikaḥ tathā iti daśa aṅgulam pauṣṭika homa artham

original: [2.1.5] dvādaśaṃ vaśasaṃyuktam iti: dvādaśāṅgulaṃ vaśahomārtham. caturdaśaṃ śāntim eva ceti: caturdaśāṅgulaṃ rogādyapanayahomārtham. ṣoḍaśākrāntasaṃyuktam iti: ṣoḍaṣāṅgulaṃ putrapautrādivṛddhihomārtham. aputreṇāpi putrārthaṃ homaḥ kārayitavyaḥ.
analyzed: dvādaśam vaśa saṃyuktam iti dvādaśa aṅgulam vaśa homa artham caturdaśam śāntim eva ca iti caturdaśa aṅgulam roga ādi apanaya homa artham ṣoḍaśa ākrānta saṃyuktam iti ṣoḍaṣa aṅgulam putra pautra ādi vṛddhi homa artham aputreṇa api putra artham homaḥ kārayitavyaḥ

original: [2.1.6] aṣṭādaśasthānasya gokulādibhi vardhata iti: aṣṭādaśāṅgulaṃ sthānaṃ gokulahastyaśvādikapauṣṭikaśāntihomārtham. viṃśa-m-aṅguṣṭha vedīnām iti: viṃśatyaṅgulaṃ vedīnāṃ kuṇḍam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: aṣṭādaśa sthānasya go kula ādibhiḥ vardhate iti aṣṭādaśa aṅgulam sthānam go kula hasti aśva ādika pauṣṭika śānti homa artham viṃśam aṅguṣṭha vedīnām iti viṃśati aṅgulam vedīnām kuṇḍam iti arthaḥ

original: [2.1.7] ākrāntasya tṛtīyena dvibhir bhāgaṃ tu khānitam iti: ākrāntasyeti kuṇḍapramāṇasya. tṛtīyeneti: bhāgatrayaṃ kṛtvā. bhāgadvayapramāṇena kuṇḍasya khananam. kuṇḍamukhasya parimāṇaṃ tribhāgaṃ kṛtvā bhāgadvayena khananam iti bhāvaḥ. sarveṣām eva kuṇḍānāṃ sāmānyena khananalakṣaṇam idam. khānitā-r-aṣṭabhāgaṃ tv iti: khātasyāṣṭamena bhāgena.
analyzed: ākrāntasya tṛtīyena dvibhiḥ bhāgam tu khānitam iti ākrāntasya iti kuṇḍa pramāṇasya tṛtīyena iti bhāga trayam kṛtvā bhāga dvaya pramāṇena kuṇḍasya khananam kuṇḍa mukhasya parimāṇam tri bhāgam kṛtvā bhāga dvayena khananam iti bhāvaḥ sarveṣām eva kuṇḍānām sāmānyena khanana lakṣaṇam idam khānitāraṣṭa bhāgam tu iti khātasya aṣṭamena bhāgena

original: kiṃ tad ity āha: oṣṭhenāpi tu kuṇḍiketi. kuṇḍasyauṣṭham iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: kim tat iti āha oṣṭhena api tu kuṇḍikā iti kuṇḍasya oṣṭham iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.1.8] oṣṭhasya ardhabhāgaṃ tu nemi bāhyaṃ tu kārayed iti: oṣṭhād bahir nemi-r-aṣṭādhikaṃ yuktaṃ padmeti nemer aṣṭamabhāgikaṃ padmam oṣṭhagatam. patrasya r-aṣṭamam iti: padmasyāṣṭamabhāgikaṃ padmapatram ity arthaḥ. atha vā: nemi-r-aṣṭādhikam iti nemer navamo bhāgaḥ. tatpramāṇaṃ nemigatam aṣṭadalaṃ padmam iti.
analyzed: oṣṭhasya ardha bhāgam tu nemi bāhyam tu kārayet iti oṣṭhāt bahis nemiḥ aṣṭa adhikam yuktam padma iti nemeḥ aṣṭama bhāgikam padmam oṣṭha gatam patrasya iti padmasya aṣṭama bhāgikam padma patram iti arthaḥ atha vā nemiḥ aṣṭa adhikam iti nemeḥ navamaḥ bhāgaḥ tad pramāṇam nemi gatam aṣṭadalam padmam iti

original: [2.1.9] bāhyānām iti: nemer bahiḥ padmaprākāra ekāṅgulaḥ. vajrāṇām iti: kuṇḍamadhye padmopari yoginīnāṃ cihnāni likhanīyāni. atha vā vajrasattvasya cihnaṃ vajram.
analyzed: bāhyānām iti nemeḥ bahis padma prākāraḥ eka aṅgulaḥ vajrāṇām iti kuṇḍa madhye padma upari yoginīnām cihnāni likhanīyāni atha vā vajra sattvasya cihnam vajram

original: [2.1.10] trivedīm abhicāre tv ityādinā kuṇḍānāṃ viśeṣalakṣaṇam āha. trivedīm abhicāre tv iti: tryasram ity arthaḥ. paripūrṇaṃ vaśasaṃyuktam iti: vartulam ity arthaḥ. atha vā pauṣṭikam eva ceti: pauṣṭikakuṇḍam api vartulam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: tri vedīm abhicāre tu ityādinā kuṇḍānām viśeṣa lakṣaṇam āha tri vedīm abhicāre tu iti tri asram iti arthaḥ paripūrṇam vaśa saṃyuktam iti vartulam iti arthaḥ atha vā pauṣṭikam eva ca iti pauṣṭika kuṇḍam api vartulam iti arthaḥ

original: [2.1.11] ardhacandram uccāṭā iti: ardhacandrākāram. aṣṭāṃśa karṣastambhanam ity: ākṛṣṭistambhanayor aṣṭāṃśaṃ kuṇḍam. kramakrameṇa yoktavyaṃ śāntipauṣṭivaśādikam iti: ukteṣu kuṇḍeṣu śāntyādikaṃ krameṇa draṣṭavyam iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: ardhacandram uccāṭāḥ iti ardhacandra ākāram karṣa stambhanam iti ākṛṣṭi stambhanayoḥ aṣṭa aṃśam kuṇḍam krama krameṇa yoktavyam śānti pauṣṭi vaśa ādikam iti ukteṣu kuṇḍeṣu śānti ādikam krameṇa draṣṭavyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.1.12] kuṇḍamadhye tv ityāder (9c) nirdeśam āha: pañcetyādi. pañcabuddhasvarūpāṇāṃ yoginīnāṃ yāni cihnāni yathādiśaṃ nyaset. tad evāha: yathādiśadiśaṃ nyased iti. tatra kuṇḍamadhye padme sūryāsane vajraṃ pūrvottarapaścimadakṣinadaleṣu khaṭvāṅgam eva. catur ityādi: oṣṭhasya catasṛṣu dikṣu krameṇa cakraratnapadmakhaḍgān likhet. etad evāha:
analyzed: kuṇḍa madhye tu ityādeḥ nirdeśam āha pañca ityādi pañca buddha svarūpāṇām yoginīnām yāni cihnāni yathādiśam nyaset tat eva āha yathādiśa diśam nyaset iti tatra kuṇḍa madhye padme sūryāsane vajram khaṭvāṅgam eva catuḥ ityādi oṣṭhasya catasṛṣu dikṣu krameṇa cakra ratna padma khaḍgān likhet etat eva āha

original: buddhacihnena laṃkṛtam iti.

original: [2.1.13] ardhacandropari vajraṃ varaṇḍakakoṇeṣu likhanīyam. etad evāha: candretyādi. yathā-m-āsana-m-abhisthānaiḥ kailāsam ucchritaṃ śubham iti: ācāryasyāsanāgravāmapārśve kailāsaḥ kāryaḥ.
analyzed: ardhacandra upari vajram varaṇḍaka koṇeṣu likhanīyam etat eva āha candra ityādi yathām āsanam abhisthānaiḥ kailāsam ucchritam śubham iti ācāryasya āsana agra vāma pārśve kailāsaḥ kāryaḥ

original: [2.1.14] kiyatpramāṇa ity āha: pauruṣārdhasaṃyuktam iti. pauruṣaṃ hastamātraṃ tasya cārdhaṃ vitastiḥ. tiryagucchrayābhyāṃ sārdhahastapramāṇa ity arthaḥ. aṅguṣṭhā dvādaśena tv iti: tatra ca sopānaṃ dvādaśāṅgulaṃ draṣṭavyam iti bhāvaḥ. dale aṣṭābhi sthānasya krama devābhi sthāpayed iti:
analyzed: kiyat pramāṇaḥ iti āha pauruṣa ardha saṃyuktam iti pauruṣam hasta mātram tasya ca ardham vitastiḥ tiryak ucchrayābhyām sārdha hasta pramāṇaḥ iti arthaḥ aṅguṣṭhāḥ dvādaśena tu iti tatra ca sopānam dvādaśa aṅgulam draṣṭavyam iti bhāvaḥ dale sthānasya sthāpayet iti

original: kuṇḍasya sarvathā bahir aṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tasya ca daleṣu pūrvādyaṣṭasu krameṇa devīnāṃ cihnāni likhet. tatra pūrvadale ḍākinīcihnaṃ mukhe hastadvayaṃ praviṣṭam. uttare dīpinīcihnaṃ mūrdhāñjalirūpam. paścime cūṣinīcihnaṃ rudhirāñjalipānarūpam. dakṣiṇe kāmbojīcihnaṃ musalākāram.
analyzed: kuṇḍasya sarvathā bahis aṣṭa dalam padmam tasya ca daleṣu pūrva ādi aṣṭasu krameṇa devīnām cihnāni likhet tatra pūrva dale ḍākinī cihnam mukhe hasta dvayam praviṣṭam uttare dīpinī cihnam mūrdhāñjali rūpam paścime cūṣinī cihnam rudhira añjali pāna rūpam dakṣiṇe kāmbojī cihnam musala ākāram

original: aiśānādidaleṣu siṃhīvyāghrījambukyulūkīnāṃ cihnam aṅkuśam eva kevalaṃ likhet. cihnāni kiṃvarṇānīty āha: ākrāntasyetyādi. ākrāntānām āropitānāṃ cihnānām. yoginām iti: yoginā. viśeṣeṇa tv iti: śāntikādikarmaviśeṣeṇa. tad ayam arthaḥ: cihnānāṃ varṇabhedaḥ karmabhedato draṣṭavyaḥ.
analyzed: aiśāna ādi daleṣu siṃhī vyāghrī jambukī ulūkīnām cihnam aṅkuśam eva kevalam likhet cihnāni kiṃvarṇāni iti āha ākrāntasya ityādi ākrāntānām āropitānām cihnānām yoginām iti yoginā viśeṣeṇa tu iti śāntika ādi karma viśeṣeṇa tat ayam arthaḥ cihnānām varṇa bhedaḥ karma bhedataḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

original: [2.1.15] oṃ hili hili oṃ kili kili oṃ vettāli hūṃ iti mantraḥ.
analyzed: om hili hili om kili kili om vettāli hūm iti mantraḥ

original: [2.1.16] upacāreti: hotavyavastuprokṣaṇādika upacāraḥ.

original: [2.1.17] bhūmiśodhanād ārabhya jñānaḍākinīrūpam ātmānaṃ dhyāyād ity āha: bhāvayed ityādi. jñānaḍākinīṃ bhāvayet. ātmadehena nirmitam iti: ātmānam eva jñānaḍākinīṃ bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ. kavacanam āha: kalanam ityādi. ātmasaṃsthāna iti: ātmamūrtau jñānaḍākinīrūpāyām. ātmānaṃ sthāneti pāṭhe 'py ayam evārthaḥ.
analyzed: bhūmi śodhanāt ārabhya jñānaḍākinī rūpam ātmānam dhyāyāt iti āha bhāvayet ityādi jñānaḍākinīm bhāvayet ātma dehena nirmitam iti ātmānam eva jñānaḍākinīm bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ kavacanam āha kalanam ityādi ātma saṃsthāne iti ātma mūrtau jñānaḍākinī rūpāyām ātmānam sthāna iti pāṭhe pi ayam eva arthaḥ

original: [2.1.18] jihvā āpam idaṃ caiveti: āpam idam ity amṛtaṃ jalam ity arthaḥ. tadviśuddhaṃ suṃbījaṃ, tac ca jihvāyām ity arthaḥ. jihvā āpaṃ caiveti pāṭhe 'pi sa evārthaḥ. ākāśaṃ karṇanāsayor iti: ākāsaṃ yuṃbījaṃ, tac ca karṇadvaye nāsāpuṭadvaye ca. pṛthvī ambum idaṃ yuktam iti: pṛthvīviśuddhaṃ huṃbījaṃ, tac cāmbunoś cakṣuṣor iti yāvat.
analyzed: jihvā āpam idam ca eva iti āpam idam iti amṛtam jalam iti arthaḥ tad viśuddham suṃ bījam tat ca jihvāyām iti arthaḥ jihvā āpam ca eva iti pāṭhe saḥ eva arthaḥ ākāśam karṇa nāsayoḥ iti ākāsam yuṃ bījam tat ca karṇa dvaye nāsā puṭa dvaye ca pṛthvī ambum idam yuktam iti pṛthvī viśuddham huṃ bījam tat ca ambunoḥ cakṣuṣoḥ iti yāvat

original: agni brahmam idaṃ tatheti: agniḥ kṣuṃbījaṃ, tac ca brahmasthāne tālunīty arthaḥ. vajraḍākinīvettālīcaṇḍālīghorīṇām etāni bījāni krameṇa jñeyāni.
analyzed: brahmam idam tathā iti agniḥ kṣuṃ bījam tat ca brahma sthāne tāluni iti arthaḥ vajra ḍākinī vettālī caṇḍālī ghorīṇām etāni bījāni krameṇa jñeyāni

original: [2.1.19] moha sārathi grīvebhya iti: mohaviśuddhaṃ smryuṃbījaṃ, tac ca sārathibhūtaṃ grīvāyām. calitā vāyus tadviśuddhaṃ ymryuṃbījaṃ, tac ca hṛdaye. kleśā ura sarvāṇām iti: uraśabdena bāhuḥ. kleśaviśuddhaṃ hmryuṃbījaṃ bāhumūlayoḥ. paśubhyām iti: paśuśabdenolūkī, tasyāḥ kṣmryuṃ bījaṃ, tac ca nābhimūle.
analyzed: moha sārathi grīvebhyaḥ iti moha viśuddham smryum bījam tat ca sārathi bhūtam grīvāyām calitā vāyuḥ tad viśuddham sarvāṇām iti ura śabdena bāhuḥ kleśa viśuddham bāhu mūlayoḥ paśubhyām iti paśu śabdena ulūkī tasyāḥ bījam tat ca nābhimūle

original: siṃhīvyāghrījambukyulūkīnāṃ krameṇaitāni bījāni.
analyzed: siṃhī vyāghrī jambukī ulūkīnām krameṇa etāni bījāni

original: [2.1.20] prakaraṇāyātaṃ kalanaṃ pratinirdiṣṭaṃ: kalana aṅgam aṣṭena aṣṭa devasya jñāpayed iti. aṣṭānāṃ devīnām aṣṭabhir bījair aṣṭāṅgakalanam iti bhāvaḥ. katham ity āha: tripatākenetyādi. vṛddhāṅguṣṭhena kanīyasim ākramya śeṣāṅgulimokṣe kṛte tripatākāmudrā bhavati. tayā pratibījaṃ nyasanīyam.
analyzed: prakaraṇa āyātam kalanam pratinirdiṣṭam kalana aṅgam aṣṭena aṣṭa devasya jñāpayet iti aṣṭānām devīnām aṣṭabhiḥ bījaiḥ aṣṭāṅga kalanam iti bhāvaḥ katham iti āha tripatākena ityādi vṛddha aṅguṣṭhena kanīyasim ākramya śeṣa aṅguli mokṣe kṛte tripatākāmudrā bhavati tayā pratibījam nyasanīyam

original: [2.1.21] jñānaḍākinīyogena hotavyam iti smārayann āha: nirmitam ityādi vyākhyātam.

analyzed: khaṭvāṅga vajra hastānām iti dakṣiṇe vajram vāme khaṭvāṅgam iti arthaḥ samāhita iti laukika vimukhaḥ yogī evam viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭām jñāna ḍākinīm bhāvayet iti saṃbandhaḥ ātma dehena ātma śarīreṇa ātmānam jñāna ḍākinīm bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ śvāsa niścalam iti vyākhyātam

original: [2.1.23] atha bhūmiśodhanaṃ kāryam iti: ādau devatāyogas tato bhūmiśodhanaṃ, tataḥ kuṇḍakhananam iti kramaḥ. tataś ca devatāyogād anantaraṃ bhūmiśodhanaṃ kāryam.
analyzed: atha bhūmi śodhanam kāryam iti ādau devatā yogaḥ tatas bhūmi śodhanam tatas kuṇḍa khananam iti kramaḥ tatas ca devatā yogāt anantaram bhūmi śodhanam kāryam

analyzed: agni ākarṣaṇam āha agni madhye ityādi kuṇḍa madhye gnim prajvālya tasya madhye ca padmam tad madhye ca raṃkāra pariṇatam sūrya stham kapila jaṭā dharam guḍa varṇam vāma dakṣiṇa kuṇḍikā akṣa sūtra dhāriṇam jvālā ākulam vahnim cintayitvā tādṛśam vahnim ākṛṣya tatra praveśayet

original: [2.1.40] etad evāha: vāmetyādi. kuṇḍasyauṣṭhe kuśaviṇḍikāyāṃ vāmahastamuṣṭiṃ dattvā madhyamāṃ tarjanīṃ ca samutthāpya madhyamātṛtīyaparvarekhāyāṃ tarjanīṃ kuñcitāṃ niveśyānayā mudrayā ...

original: agnimadhye sveṣṭadevatābhāvanākāle kuṇḍamadhyaṃ hotavyavastūni ca prokṣaṇena śodhayed ity arthaḥ.

analyzed: udakam sarṣapāḥ puṣpam vajram iti etat uktam pāṇinā vajram gṛhītvā sarṣapa puṣpa sahitena jalena pūrva ukta prokṣaṇa mudrā yuktena ca anena mantreṇa sarva śodhanam kāryam iti bhāvaḥ
