original: [2.1.61] ... tadupari hūṃkārapariṇataṃ pañcasūkavajraṃ, tadvaraṭake hūṃkāraṃ vīkṣya, tatsarvapariṇatāṃ raktādivarṇāṃ dakṣiṇavāmabhujakhaṭvāṅgavajradharāṃ (?) bhāvayet.
analyzed: tad upari hūṃkāra pariṇatam pañcasūka vajram tad varaṭake hūṃkāram vīkṣya tad sarva pariṇatām rakta ādi varṇām dakṣiṇa vāma bhuja khaṭvāṅga vajra dharām bhāvayet

original: [2.1.62] ātmaśvāsena niḥsṛtam iti: ātmanaḥ śarīrān nirgatā jñānasattvī. karmasyaiva tu varṇānām iti: śāntikādikarmānurūpavarṇā jñānasattvī. samayajñānaḍākiny api karmānurūpavarṇeti jñeyam. prāg uktaṃ ca: raktavarṇādīti (61b). ādiśabdād itare 'pi varṇā grāhyāḥ. yogapīṭhiketi: sattvaparyaṅkasthā.
analyzed: ātma śvāsena niḥsṛtam iti ātmanaḥ śarīrāt nirgatā jñāna sattvī karmasya eva tu varṇānām iti śāntika ādi karma anurūpa varṇā jñāna sattvī samaya jñāna ḍākinī api karma anurūpa varṇā iti jñeyam prāk uktam ca rakta varṇa ādi iti ādi śabdāt itare varṇāḥ grāhyāḥ yoga pīṭhikā iti sattva paryaṅka sthā

original: evaṃviśiṣṭāṃ jñānasattvīṃ svaśarīrān niścārya samayajñānaḍākinyā †...mantraṃ† bhāvayet. sā cāgnimadhyagatā jñānaḍākinī svadehasvabhāvā.
analyzed: evaṃviśiṣṭām jñānasattvīm sva śarīrāt niścārya samayajñāna ḍākinyāḥ mantram bhāvayet sā ca agni madhya gatā jñānaḍākinī sva deha svabhāvā

original: [2.1.63] ata āha: yata ityādi. pūjayed ityādi subodham.

original: [2.1.64–65] oṃ ṭha ṭha ṭha svāheti: ṭhaśabdena hūṃkāratrayam. oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ svāheti mantraḥ syāt.
analyzed: om ṭha ṭha ṭha svāhā iti ṭhaśabdena hūṃkāra trayam om hūm hūm hūm svāhā iti mantraḥ syāt

analyzed: daṇḍam iti sruvam

analyzed: dvau hastau saṃpuṭa muṣṭīnām madhyamā dvau prasārayet iti yā sarva vastu śodhana mudrā tasyāḥ mantraḥ yaṃ om hūm svāhā iti

original: [2.1.68] etad evāha: mūlamudrāmantra iti. bhūmiśodhanānantaraṃ sarvavastuśodhanaṃ mūlamudrayā pṛthakpṛthaṅmantrair agnimadhye sveṣṭadevatābhāvanākāle cānena mantreṇa pūrvamudrayā sarvavastuśodhanaṃ kāryam.
analyzed: etat eva āha mūlamudrā mantraḥ iti bhūmi śodhana anantaram sarva vastu śodhanam mūlamudrayā pṛthak pṛthak mantraiḥ agni madhye sva iṣṭadevatā bhāvanā kāle ca anena mantreṇa pūrva mudrayā sarva vastu śodhanam kāryam

original: [2.1.69] sarvapūjāmantrān āha: oṃ ityādi.
analyzed: sarva pūjā mantrān āha om ityādi

analyzed: dakṣiṇa hasta muṣṭeḥ aṅguṣṭha utthānena dīpa mudrā

analyzed: puṣpa mudrāyām iti puṣpa mudrāyām madhyamāṅguli samutthānāt dhūpa mudrā

original: [2.1.82–83] hastadvayaṃ prasārya madhyamādvayam aṅguṣṭhadvaye spṛśed iti balimudrā. yathākramaṃ mantrair mudrāṇāṃ yogaḥ.
analyzed: hasta dvayam prasārya madhyamā dvayam aṅguṣṭha dvaye spṛśet iti balimudrā yathākramam mantraiḥ mudrāṇām yogaḥ

original: [2.1.84] sakṛj japya sakṛd dāpya agnibhyāṃ mukhajihviketi: sakṛd āhutimantraṃ japtvā pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāt. agnimukhajihvāyām oṃ hūṃ 3 svāheti mantraṃ japtvā dadyād ity arthaḥ. sakṛj jāpyāhutyā mukhajihvikair iti pāṭhāntaram. ihāpy ayam evārthaḥ. saptādhikaṃ tu saṃgṛhya madhye madhyamapiṇḍiketi: saptāhutayo dātavyāḥ.
analyzed: sakṛt japya sakṛt dāpya agnibhyām mukhajihvikā iti sakṛt āhuti mantram japtvā pūrṇāhutim dadyāt agni mukha jihvāyām om   svāhā iti mantram japtvā dadyāt iti arthaḥ sakṛt jāpya āhutyā mukhajihvikaiḥ iti pāṭha antaram iha api ayam eva arthaḥ sapta adhikam tu saṃgṛhya madhye madhyama piṇḍikā iti sapta āhutayaḥ dātavyāḥ

original: madhya ity agneḥ, sveṣṭadevatājihvāmadhye. madhyamapiṇḍiketi: āhutisaṃjñā.
analyzed: madhye iti agneḥ sva iṣṭadevatā jihvā madhye madhyama piṇḍikā iti āhuti saṃjñā

original: [2.1.85] āhutyāvṛtta śeṣās tu śeṣākāreṇa tatparam iti: āhutau vṛttāyāṃ śeṣaṃ vastu hotavyam. prathamaṃ vahnimukhe pūrṇāhutiṃ dattvā hutaṃ yat tasmāc cheṣam iti boddhavyam. tasminn api pūrṇāhutidānapūrvakaṃ hute tadanyac cheṣam ity arthaḥ. etenaitad uktam: agnimukhe prathamam ekāhutiṃ hutvā sarvaṃ vastu juhuyāt.
analyzed: śeṣāḥ tu śeṣa ākāreṇa tat param iti āhutau vṛttāyām śeṣam vastu hotavyam prathamam vahni mukhe pūrṇāhutim dattvā hutam yat tasmāt śeṣam iti boddhavyam tasmin api pūrṇāhuti dāna pūrvakam hute tad anyat śeṣam iti arthaḥ etena etat uktam agni mukhe prathamam eka āhutim hutvā sarvam vastu juhuyāt

original: sarvavastuhomānte punaḥ pūrṇāhutir ekā. tadanantaraṃ vahnau sveṣṭadevatāmukhe pūrṇāhutiṃ dattvā taccheṣaṃ vastu juhuyāt. tato homāntaṃ pūrṇāhutiḥ. punaḥ sveṣṭadevatāṃ kṣamayitvā vahnidevatāṃ punar vibhāvya tanmukhe pūrṇāhutiṃ dattvā śeṣaṃ juhuyāt. tato 'pi homānte pūrṇāhutiḥ. tadanantaraṃ dānapatihastena vahnau pūrṇāhutir ekā dāpayitavyeti.
analyzed: sarva vastu homa ante punar pūrṇāhutiḥ ekā tad anantaram vahnau sva iṣṭadevatā mukhe pūrṇāhutim dattvā tad śeṣam vastu juhuyāt tatas homa antam pūrṇāhutiḥ punar sva iṣṭadevatām kṣamayitvā vahni devatām punar vibhāvya tad mukhe pūrṇāhutim dattvā śeṣam juhuyāt homa ante pūrṇāhutiḥ tad anantaram dānapati hastena vahnau pūrṇāhutiḥ ekā dāpayitavyā iti

original: itthaṃ saptāhutayo niṣpadyanta iti catuṣpīṭhe vyavasthitam. hutavṛtteti devānām ātmadehasya līyata iti: home vṛtte yā bhāvitā sveṣṭadevatā sātmani praveśayitavyeti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: ittham sapta āhutayaḥ niṣpadyante iti catuṣpīṭhe vyavasthitam huta vṛttā iti devānām ātma dehasya līyate iti home vṛtte yā bhāvitā sva iṣṭadevatā sā ātmani praveśayitavyā iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.1.86] saṃpūrṇaṃ sarvam āhutyā pūrṇamantraṃ tu mudraketi: sarvaṃ pūrṇāhutimantramudrādikaṃ kartavyam iti bhāvaḥ. ghṛta saṃpūrṇabhāṇḍena agnimadhye tu dāpayed iti: home vṛtte sveṣṭadevatātmadehe līyata ity (85d) uddiṣṭārthasyānena nirdeśaḥ kriyate.
analyzed: saṃpūrṇam sarvam āhutyā pūrṇamantram tu mudraka iti sarvam pūrṇāhuti mantra mudrā ādikam kartavyam iti bhāvaḥ ghṛta saṃpūrṇa bhāṇḍena agni madhye tu dāpayet iti home vṛtte sva iṣṭadevatā ātma dehe līyate iti uddiṣṭa arthasya anena nirdeśaḥ kriyate

original: sarvathā home vṛtte saptāhutyavasāne vahnimadhye sveṣṭadevatāṃ bhāvayitvā tanmukhe ghṛtasaṃpūrṇāṃ pātrīṃ sruvaṃ ca kṛtvā āhutir ekā dātavyā. tataś ca sveṣṭadevatāyāṃ pūrṇāhutidvayam. tataḥ punaḥ sveṣṭadevatānantaraṃ vahnau pūrṇāhutir ekā deyā. vahner apy āhutidvayaṃ syāt. prāk sveṣṭadevatāvahnyor ekaikāhutiḥ kṣiptā.
analyzed: sarvathā home vṛtte sapta āhuti avasāne vahni madhye sva iṣṭadevatām bhāvayitvā tad mukhe ghṛta saṃpūrṇām pātrīm sruvam ca kṛtvā āhutiḥ ekā dātavyā tatas ca sva iṣṭadevatāyām pūrṇāhuti dvayam tatas punar sva iṣṭadevatā anantaram vahnau pūrṇāhutiḥ ekā deyā vahneḥ api āhuti dvayam syāt prāk sva iṣṭadevatā vahnyoḥ ekaika āhutiḥ kṣiptā

original: [2.1.87] ātmabhāvaṃ tu m-ākarṣa ātmabhāvasya līyatām iti: katham ātmani sveṣṭadevatā līyata iti darśayati. ātmaśvāsenātmani sā praveśayitavyeti bhāvaḥ. paścād ātmadehena bhāvayantu vicakṣaṇa iti: paścād ātmani praviṣṭām ātmadehasadṛśīṃ bhāvayed ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: ātma bhāvam tu mā ākarṣaḥ ātma bhāvasya līyatām iti katham ātmani sva iṣṭadevatā līyate iti darśayati ātma śvāsena ātmani sā praveśayitavyā iti bhāvaḥ paścāt ātma dehena bhāvayantu vicakṣaṇaḥ iti paścāt ātmani praviṣṭām ātma deha sadṛśīm bhāvayet iti arthaḥ

original: [2.1.88] agnidevasya madhye tu bhāvayeta vicakṣaṇa iti: ātmani sveṣṭadevatāpraveśānantaram agnau prokṣaṇādikaṃ kṛtvā tanmadhye cāgniṃ prāguktanyāyena vibhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ. śeṣā tribhi m-āhutyā pūjābalidāpitair iti: dhyāte vahnau śeṣaṃ havyaṃ pūrṇāhutidānapūrvakaṃ vāratrayaṃ hutvā baliṃ pūjādikaṃ dattvā vahniṃ kṣamayet.
analyzed: agni devasya madhye tu bhāvayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ iti ātmani sva iṣṭadevatā praveśa anantaram agnau prokṣaṇa ādikam kṛtvā tad madhye ca agnim prāc ukta nyāyena vibhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ śeṣā pūjā bali dāpitaiḥ iti dhyāte vahnau śeṣam havyam pūrṇāhuti dāna pūrvakam vāra trayam hutvā balim pūjā ādikam dattvā vahnim kṣamayet

original: pūrvaṃ saptāhutayaḥ, paścād āhutidvayaṃ, adhunā āhutayas tisraḥ. samudāyena dvādaśāhutayaḥ. maṅgaletyādi: maṅgalagītaṃ vakṣyati (4.4.93). agre dvau hastāv ityādinā (44a) mudroktā.
analyzed: pūrvam sapta āhutayaḥ paścāt āhuti dvayam adhunā āhutayaḥ tisraḥ samudāyena dvādaśa āhutayaḥ maṅgala ityādi maṅgalagītam vakṣyati agre dvau hastau ityādinā mudrā uktā

original: [2.1.89] aparai hutakarmabhedaṃ tu pravakṣyāmi samāsata iti: aparaṃ śāntikādikarmabhedaṃ saṃkṣepena pravakṣyāmīti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: aparaiḥ huta karma bhedam tu pravakṣyāmi samāsatas iti aparam śāntika ādi karma bhedam saṃkṣepena pravakṣyāmi iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.1.90] kṣīrapeyaṃ tv iti: kṣīrapāyasam. kṣīramaṇḍa iti kecit.
analyzed: kṣīra peyam tu iti kṣīra pāyasam kṣīramaṇḍaḥ iti kecid

original: [2.1.91] agniprajvālanāya samidham āha: pañcetyādi. āmravaṭanyagrodhaparkaṭyaśvatthakāṣṭhāni grāhyāṇi. caturdaśāṅguṣṭhakrāntavad iti: caturdaśāṅgulam indhanam. śāntike kālasaṃprāpta iti prāg ukto vidhiḥ.
analyzed: agni prajvālanāya samidham āha pañca ityādi āmra vaṭa nyagrodha parkaṭī aśvattha kāṣṭhāni grāhyāṇi caturdaśa aṅguṣṭha krānta vat iti caturdaśa aṅgulam indhanam śāntike kāla saṃprāpte iti prāk uktaḥ vidhiḥ

original: [2.1.92] adhunā puṣṭikam āha: tilakṛṣṇādītyādi. kṛṣṇatila ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: adhunā puṣṭikam āha tila kṛṣṇa ādi ityādi kṛṣṇa tilaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [2.1.93] ghṛtakṣīrasya peyeneti: ghṛtamiśrakṣīrapāyasam. ākrāntā daśa-m-aṅgulam iti: daśāṅgulam indhanam. ākrānta daśamas tatheti pāṭhāntare 'pi tathaiva.
analyzed: ghṛta kṣīrasya peyena iti ghṛta miśra kṣīra pāyasam ākrāntā daśamaṅgulam iti daśa aṅgulam indhanam ākrānta daśamaḥ tathā iti pāṭha antare tathā eva

original: [2.1.94] vaśam āha: tilaraktasyetyādi. kṛṣṇasyeti: kṛṣṇatilaḥ, raktapuṣpam. aśurīti: rājikā. latāphalam iti kecit. madhu sarpiṣayojitam iti subodham. madhusarpeṇa yojitam iti pāṭhāntare madhughṛtābhyāṃ yojitam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: vaśam āha tila raktasya ityādi kṛṣṇasya iti kṛṣṇa tilaḥ rakta puṣpam aśurī iti rājikā latā phalam iti kecid madhu sarpiṣā yojitam iti subodham madhu sarpeṇa yojitam iti pāṭha antare madhu ghṛtābhyām yojitam iti arthaḥ

original: [2.1.95] nāgakāṣṭham iti: nāgakesarakāṣṭham. raktakarmādīti: vaśam ākṛṣṭiṃ ca sādhayed ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: nāgakāṣṭham iti nāgakesara kāṣṭham raktakarma ādi iti vaśam ākṛṣṭim ca sādhayet iti arthaḥ

original: [2.1.96] phalakālaketi: mahākālaphalam.
analyzed: phalakālaka iti mahākāla phalam

original: [2.1.97] kālavṛkṣasyeti: hariṭhetiprasiddhasya. kubjasyeti: kujākaṇḍetiprasiddhasya. bhallātaguḍim eva ceti: bhallātakakāṣṭham. aṣṭāṅguṣṭhakrāntasyeti: aṣṭāṅgulamānam indhanam abhicāre.
analyzed: kālavṛkṣasya iti hariṭhā iti prasiddhasya kubjasya iti kujākaṇḍā iti prasiddhasya bhallāta guḍim eva ca iti bhallātaka kāṣṭham aṣṭa aṅguṣṭha krāntasya iti aṣṭa aṅgula mānam indhanam abhicāre

original: [2.1.98–99] kāñcanasya tv iti: dhuttūravṛkṣasya. uccāṭane 'py aṣṭāṅgulamānam indhanam.
analyzed: kāñcanasya tu iti dhuttūra vṛkṣasya uccāṭane pi aṣṭa aṅgula mānam indhanam

original: [2.1.100–101] gṛhakākasya kāṣṭhādīti: kākagṛhakāṣṭham ity arthaḥ. m-utsiṣṭā dantakāṣṭhakair iti: khāditadantakāṣṭhaiḥ. devadāruvāsānāgakesarakāṣṭhāni kālavṛkṣakubjabhallātakakāṣṭhāni kāñcanavāsākāṣṭhāni kākagṛhakāṣṭhadantakhāditakāṣṭhāni vahniprajvālanārthaṃ, śeṣaṃ hotavyam.
analyzed: gṛha kākasya kāṣṭha ādi iti kākagṛha kāṣṭham iti arthaḥ dantakāṣṭhakaiḥ iti khādita dantakāṣṭhaiḥ devadāru vāsā nāgakesara kāṣṭhāni kālavṛkṣa kubja bhallātaka kāṣṭhāni kāñcana vāsā kāṣṭhāni kākagṛha kāṣṭha dantakhādita kāṣṭhāni vahni prajvālana artham śeṣam hotavyam

original: [2.1.102–105] sundarīti: pṛthvī. bhūr bhuvaḥ svar iti: punaḥ pṛthvī, antarikṣaṃ svargaś ceti. pṛthvīṃ kevalāṃ sādhayati lokatrayaṃ veti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: sundarī iti pṛthvī bhūḥ bhuvaḥ svar iti punar pṛthvī antarikṣam svargaḥ ca iti pṛthvīm kevalām sādhayati lokatrayam vā iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.1.106] athetyādinā śiṣyalakṣaṇam āha.
analyzed: atha ityādinā śiṣya lakṣaṇam āha

original: [2.1.107] paripūrṇaṃ sarvam aṅgasyeti: paripūrṇāvayavaḥ. atha vā: aṅgaśabdena śabdaśāstrādikam. tad evāha: vinītetyādi. vinīta iti jñātaśabdaśāstrādiḥ. śāntacāriketi: jitendriyaḥ. abhirati tribhi dharmasyeti: śrāvakapratyekamahāyāneṣu rataḥ. mahāyānamati sadeti: mahāyānābhyāse vyāsaktamatiḥ. tathā cāha:

original: [2.3.2] īdṛśam advayaṃ jñānaṃ yat tad eva sarvadharmā ity āha: adaityetyādi. sarve dharmāḥ padārthā advayasaṃjñāḥ. yatas te dvayavarjitā iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: īdṛśam advayam jñānam yat tat eva sarva dharmāḥ iti āha adaitya ityādi sarve dharmāḥ padārthāḥ advaya saṃjñāḥ yatas te dvaya varjitāḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: advayāḥ sarvadharmā vai dharmalakṣaṇavarjitāḥ |
analyzed: advayāḥ sarva dharmāḥ vai dharma lakṣaṇa varjitāḥ

original: iti vacanāt. itthaṃ sarvadharmāḥ svabhāvaśūnyā iti svabhāvaśūnyaṃ jagat. ānimittaṃ ca:
analyzed: iti vacanāt ittham sarva dharmāḥ svabhāva śūnyāḥ iti svabhāva śūnyam jagat ānimittam ca

original: na svato nāpi parato na dvābhyāṃ nāpy ahetutaḥ |
analyzed: na svatas nā api paratas na dvābhyām nā api ahetutaḥ

original: utpannā jātu vidyante bhāvāḥ kvacana kecana ||
analyzed: utpannāḥ jātu vidyante bhāvāḥ kvacana kecana

original: iti vacanāt. apraṇihitaṃ ca. na hi niḥsvabhāve jagati praṇidhānam upapadyate. devatāyogārambhamadhyāvasāneṣu śūnyatā bhāvyeti darśayati: rūpetyādi. rūpaskandhādīnāṃ śūnyatā, sā cādau madhye 'nte ca bhāvyety arthaḥ.
analyzed: iti vacanāt apraṇihitam ca na hi niḥsvabhāve jagati praṇidhānam upapadyate devatā yoga ārambha madhya avasāneṣu śūnyatā bhāvyā iti darśayati rūpa ityādi rūpa skandha ādīnām śūnyatā sā ca ādau madhye nte ca bhāvyā iti arthaḥ

original: [2.3.3] aśucyetyādi: aśucyam aśucisalobhatvam. śucīti tadviparītam. madhyam iti: śucyaśucirahitam. itthaṃ samatā samarasatā. taddarśanaṃ kevalaṃ syād ity arthaḥ. atha vā śucīti pavitram. aśuci tadanyat. śeṣaṃ pūrvavat. etac ca śuddhāśuddhiṃ tv ity (1d) asya nirdeśaḥ. sevyetyādi: sevyaṃ gamyam. asevitam agamyam. madhyaṃ taddvayarahitam.
analyzed: aśuci ityādi aśucyam aśuci sa lobha tvam śuci iti tad viparītam madhyam iti śuci aśuci rahitam ittham samatā samarasatā tad darśanam kevalam syāt iti arthaḥ atha vā śuci iti pavitram aśuci tad anyat śeṣam pūrvavat etat ca śuddha aśuddhim tu iti asya nirdeśaḥ sevya ityādi sevyam gamyam asevitam agamyam madhyam tad dvaya rahitam

original: itthaṃ samajñānasamudbhavam: jñānasya cittasya samatā samudbhavatīty arthaḥ.
analyzed: ittham sama jñāna samudbhavam jñānasya cittasya samatā samudbhavati iti arthaḥ

original: [2.3.4] samasaṃsthitadehānām iti: pūrvoktanyāyenaiva kāyasya samatā syād ity arthaḥ. samasaṃsthitavākyavad iti: vāco 'pi samatety arthaḥ. tad ayam arthaḥ: yathā cittaṃ svasaṃvinmātraṃ, tathā kāyo 'pi. yathā kāyo 'pi paramāṇuśo vibhajyamāno na ko 'pi, tathā cittam api.
analyzed: sama saṃsthita dehānām iti pūrva ukta nyāyena eva kāyasya samatā syāt iti arthaḥ sama saṃsthita vākya vat iti vācaḥ api samatā iti arthaḥ tat ayam arthaḥ yathā cittam sva saṃvid mātram tathā yathā kāyaḥ pi paramāṇuśaḥ vibhajyamānaḥ na tathā cittam api

original: yathā cittakāyau, tathā vāg api, bahirarthaṃ prati śabdasya paramārthato 'vācakatvāt. itthaṃ kāyādīnāṃ samatā. tathā cāha: utpādayantu bhavantaś cittaṃ kāyākāreṇa kāyaṃ cittākāreṇa cittaṃ vākpravyāhāreṇeti. etena kiṃ syād ity āha: sametyādi. samadarśanāt samatājñānaṃ saṃbhaved ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: yathā citta kāyau tathā vāc api bahis artham prati śabdasya paramārthataḥ vācaka tvāt ittham kāya ādīnām samatā tathā ca āha utpādayantu bhavantaḥ cittam kāya ākāreṇa kāyam citta ākāreṇa cittam vāc pravyāhāreṇa iti etena kim syāt iti āha sama ityādi sama darśanāt samatā jñānam saṃbhavet iti arthaḥ

original: [2.3.5] bhagavann ityādi, samatādṛṣṭiṃ tv iti: samatājñānaṃ. kīdṛśam iti: katham utpadyata ity arthaḥ. advayarūpāś ca dharmāḥ katham ātmarūpadevatārūpeṇa sākṣātkartavyā iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: bhagavan ityādi samatā dṛṣṭim tu iti samatā jñānam kīdṛśam iti katham utpadyate iti arthaḥ advaya rūpāḥ ca dharmāḥ katham ātma rūpa devatā rūpeṇa sākṣātkartavyāḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.3.6] praśnaṃ visraṣṭum āha: śṛṇv ityādi. yathātattvam aviparītam. advayojñānalakṣaṇam iti: advayajñānaṃ yathotpadyate, tac chṛṇv iti bhāvaḥ. varjitam ityādi subodham. tribhir ityādi: tribhiḥ svabhāvādibhiḥ śuddhā ityādimantram uccārayed ity arthaḥ. kadety āha: sarvayogādi agrata iti.
analyzed: praśnam visraṣṭum āha śṛṇu ityādi yathātattvam aviparītam advayaḥ jñāna lakṣaṇam iti advaya jñānam yathā utpadyate tat śṛṇu iti bhāvaḥ varjitam ityādi su bodham tribhiḥ ityādi tribhiḥ svabhāva ādibhiḥ śuddhāḥ ityādi mantram uccārayet iti arthaḥ kadā iti āha sarva yoga ādi agratas iti

original: sarvayogānām ādau vakṣyamāṇaṃ mantratrayam uccārayed ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: sarva yogānām ādau vakṣyamāṇam mantra trayam uccārayet iti arthaḥ

original: [2.3.7] tān evāha: svabhāvetyādi. svabhāvena sadasannityānityāstināstiheyopādeyagrāhyagrāhakādilakṣaṇena śuddhāḥ śūnyā riktāḥ. ke ta ity āha: sarvadharmā iti. utpādasthitibhaṅgānāṃ svalakṣaṇānāṃ dhāraṇād dharmāḥ skandhādayaḥ. te ca svabhāvena prakṛtyā śuddhāḥ. aham api tathety āha: svabhāvaśuddho 'ham iti.
analyzed: tān eva āha svabhāva ityādi svabhāvena sat asat nitya anitya astināsti heya upādeya grāhya grāhaka ādi lakṣaṇena śuddhāḥ śūnyāḥ riktāḥ ke te iti āha sarva dharmāḥ iti utpāda sthiti bhaṅgānām sva lakṣaṇānām dhāraṇāt dharmāḥ skandha ādayaḥ te ca svabhāvena prakṛtyā śuddhāḥ aham api tathā iti āha svabhāva śuddhaḥ ham iti

original: prakṛtipariśuddho 'py āgantukamalāpagamāya śodhyata iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: prakṛti pariśuddhaḥ pi āgantu kamala apagamāya śodhyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.3.8] vajretyādi: vajram advayajñānam, abhedyatvāt. tadvac chuddhāḥ.

[2.3.9] yogo devatālambanaṃ, tena śuddhāḥ, parityaktaprākṛtarūpāḥ. svahṛdi svabījaṃ vīkṣya tannirgatena raśmiprasareṇa gurusveṣṭadevatāvabhāsanaṃ kṛtvā puṣpādimudrābhiḥ puṣpādidānābhinayaṃ ca kṛtvā pāpadeśanāpuṇyānumodanāpuṇyapariṇāmanātriśaraṇagamanātmaniryātanāpraṇidhānamārgāśrayamaitryādibhāvanāṃ vidhāya paścāt triviśuddhim uccārayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: yogaḥ devatā ālambanam tena śuddhāḥ parityakta prākṛta rūpāḥ sva hṛdi sva bījam vīkṣya tad nirgatena raśmi prasareṇa guru sva iṣṭadevatā avabhāsanam kṛtvā puṣpa ādi mudrābhiḥ puṣpa ādi dāna abhinayam ca kṛtvā pāpa deśanā puṇya anumodanā puṇya pariṇāmanā tri śaraṇa gamana ātma niryātanā praṇidhāna mārga āśraya maitrī ādi bhāvanām vidhāya paścāt tri viśuddhim uccārayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.3.10] ebhi m-uccārya m-añjalyam anuttarasyaiva kārayed iti: anuttarajñānārthaṃ hṛdy añjaliṃ nidhāya pāpadeśanādikaṃ kṛtvā triviśuddhim uccārayed iti bhāvaḥ. sthānasampattim āha: manonukūletyādi. yaḥ kaścit pradeśo yadi mano'nukūlo bhavati, tatra dhyānam ārabhetety arthaḥ. atha vā parvatādau.
analyzed: ebhiḥ m uccārya m añjalyam anuttarasya eva kārayet iti anuttara jñāna artham hṛdi añjalim nidhāya pāpa deśanā ādikam kṛtvā tri viśuddhim uccārayet iti bhāvaḥ sthāna sampattim āha manaḥ nukūla ityādi yaḥ kaścid pradeśaḥ yadi manaḥ nukūlaḥ bhavati tatra dhyānam ārabheta iti arthaḥ atha vā parvata ādau

original: [2.3.11] patāketi: cihnarahitā. matsyapakṣyādicihnāṅko dhvajaḥ.
analyzed: patākā iti cihna rahitā matsya pakṣi ādi cihna aṅkaḥ dhvajaḥ

original: [2.3.12] samantād daśabhiḥ sthānair gandhamaṇḍalādibhis tatheti: tādṛśe pradeśe samantād daśa diśo vyāpya gandhena maṇḍalam ekam eva dhyānādikāle kuryād ity arthaḥ. ūrdhvam api gandhacchaṭākṣepān madhyalepāc ca daśadigvyāptiḥ. pūjādyanantaraṃ jñānaḍākinīrūpam ātmānaṃ dhyātvā vakṣyamāṇaṃ kuryād ity āha: jhaṭitetyādi.
analyzed: samantāt daśabhiḥ sthānaiḥ gandha maṇḍala ādibhiḥ tathā iti tādṛśe pradeśe samantāt daśa diśaḥ vyāpya gandhena maṇḍalam ekam eva dhyāna ādi kāle kuryāt iti arthaḥ ūrdhvam api gandha chaṭā ākṣepāt madhya lepāt ca daśa diś vyāptiḥ pūjā ādi anantaram jñāna ḍākinī rūpam ātmānam dhyātvā vakṣyamāṇam kuryāt iti āha jhaṭiti ityādi

original: jhaṭitety ekākinī jñānaḍākinī bhāvyety arthaḥ.
analyzed: jhaṭitā iti ekākinī jñāna ḍākinī bhāvyā iti arthaḥ

original: [2.3.13] pūjā kurvantam ātmana iti: pūjādikam ātmanā kṛtvety arthaḥ. kartavyam āha: hastam uttānakam ityādi. uttānadakṣiṇahaste jvaladākāraṃ vajraṃ pañcaśūkaṃ dhyātvā ...
analyzed: pūjā kurvantam ātmanaḥ iti pūjā ādikam ātmanā kṛtvā iti arthaḥ kartavyam āha hastam uttānakam ityādi uttāna dakṣiṇa haste jvalat ākāram vajram pañcaśūkam dhyātvā

original: [2.3.14] madhye karāsphālaṇaṃ kuryāt tataḥ pūrvasyāṃ diśi tato vāmāvartenottarādiṣv itthaṃ rasātalaparyantaṃ vajramayaṃ dhyātvā oṃ hūṃ phaḍ iti mantram uccārayan prāguktanyāyena prākārādikaṃ dhyāyāt. ādau paścimābhimukhenaiva dhyānam ārabdhavyam ity upadeśaḥ. enam eva mantram uccarati: hūṃkāreṇetyādi. ghāta antimeti phaṭkāro ghātaḥ.
analyzed: madhye kara āsphālaṇam kuryāt tatas pūrvasyām diśi tatas vāma āvartena uttara ādiṣu ittham rasātala paryantam vajra mayam dhyātvā om   phaṭ iti mantram uccārayan prāc ukta nyāyena prākāra ādikam dhyāyāt ādau paścima abhimukhena eva dhyānam ārabdhavyam iti upadeśaḥ enam eva mantram uccarati hūṃkāreṇa ityādi ghāta antima iti phaṭkāraḥ ghātaḥ

original: tata oṃ hūṃ phaḍ iti mantrapariṇataṃ catūratnamayasumerūpari sthitaṃ kāñcanamayam āgāraṃ saptaratnakhacitaṃ svecchāvistaraṃ dhyātvā tatra bhagavatīṃ dhyāyād iti śeṣaḥ.
analyzed: tatas om   phaṭ iti mantra pariṇatam catur ratna maya sumeru upari sthitam kāñcana mayam āgāram sapta ratna khacitam sva icchā vistaram dhyātvā tatra bhagavatīm dhyāyāt iti śeṣaḥ

original: [2.3.15] etad evāha: merumūrdhaṃ tv ityādi.
analyzed: etat eva āha meru mūrdham tu ityādi

original: [2.3.16] mudrām āha: baddhvetyādi. sarvamudrāṇāṃ madhye prathamaṃ samayamudrāṃ baddhvā darśayed iti śeṣaḥ. kāñcanāgāre bhagavatīṃ dhyātvā tasyai mudrāṃ darśayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: mudrām āha baddhvā ityādi sarva mudrāṇām madhye prathamam samayamudrām baddhvā darśayet iti śeṣaḥ kāñcana āgāre bhagavatīm dhyātvā tasyai mudrām darśayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.3.17] kathaṃ badhnīyān mudrām ity āha: vajramuṣṭītyādi. vāmamuṣṭiṃ hṛdi nidhāya dakṣiṇabāhum utkṣipya samayamudrāṃ darśayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: katham badhnīyāt mudrām iti āha vajra muṣṭi ityādi vāma muṣṭim hṛdi nidhāya dakṣiṇa bāhum utkṣipya samayamudrām darśayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.3.18] asyā mantram āha: yathetyādi. yatheti yasyā ity arthaḥ. vajramayaṃ bījaṃ hūṃkāraḥ. huta antimeti: svāhākāro 'nte kārya ity arthaḥ. oṃ hūṃ svāheti samudāyaḥ. asyetyādi: asyāḥ samayamudrāyā mantro darśita ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: asyāḥ mantram āha yathā ityādi yathā iti yasyāḥ iti arthaḥ vajra mayam bījam hūṃkāraḥ huta antimā iti svāhākāraḥ nte kāryaḥ iti arthaḥ om hūm svāhā iti samudāyaḥ asya ityādi asyāḥ samayamudrāyāḥ mantraḥ darśitaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [2.3.19] idānīm āsanam āha: siṃha-m-āsanetyādi. pañcasu sthāneṣu siṃhāsanāni pañca, teṣu ca pañca sūryamaṇḍalāni bhāvayet.
analyzed: idānīm āsanam āha siṃham āsana ityādi pañcasu sthāneṣu siṃhāsanāni pañca teṣu ca pañca sūrya maṇḍalāni bhāvayet

original: [2.3.20] madhyāsane jñānaḍākinī, śeṣeṣu vajraḍākinyādayaḥ. aparāṇy apy āsanāni vakṣyati. āsanabhāvanāpūrvakaṃ devatā bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ. ātmaśvāsena niḥsṛtyeti: samayasattvīṃ bhāvayitvā jñānasattvīm ātmanaḥ śarīrān niḥsārya samayasattvyāṃ praveśayed iti bhāvaḥ. jñānaḍākini madhyata iti: madhyasiṃhāsane jñānaḍākinī bhāvyeti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: madhyāsane jñānaḍākinī śeṣeṣu vajraḍākinī ādayaḥ aparāṇi api āsanāni vakṣyati āsana bhāvanā pūrvakam devatāḥ bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ ātma śvāsena niḥsṛtya iti samayasattvīm bhāvayitvā jñānasattvīm ātmanaḥ śarīrāt niḥsārya samayasattvyām praveśayet iti bhāvaḥ jñānaḍākini madhyatas iti madhya siṃhāsane jñānaḍākinī bhāvyā iti bhāvaḥ

original: tasyā rūpam āha: trimukham ityādi.
analyzed: tasyāḥ rūpam āha tri mukham ityādi

original: [2.3.21] keśa vicchārya pañcabuddhābhi maṇḍitam iti: keśān vitatīkṛtya pañcabhir buddhair maṇḍitā, spharadbhir ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: pañca buddha abhi maṇḍitam iti keśān vitatīkṛtya pañcabhiḥ buddhaiḥ maṇḍitā spharadbhiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [2.3.22] hasitakrodhaśṛṅgāreti: śṛṅgāri mūlamukhaṃ, hasitaṃ vāmaṃ, kruddhaṃ dakṣiṇam.
analyzed: hasita krodha śṛṅgāra iti śṛṅgāri mūla mukham hasitam vāmam kruddham dakṣiṇam

original: [2.3.23] khaṭvāṅga ūrdhvaśaś caiveti: ūrdhvakhaṭvāṅgaṃ bhāvayet.
analyzed: khaṭvāṅgaḥ ūrdhvaśas ca eva iti ūrdhva khaṭvāṅgam bhāvayet

original: [2.3.24] madhyamaṃ budha iti: etādṛśīṃ bhagavatīṃ jñānaḍākinīm ākāśaviśuddhyā madhyāsane dhyāyād iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: madhyamam budhaḥ iti etādṛśīm bhagavatīm jñānaḍākinīm ākāśa viśuddhyā madhyāsane dhyāyāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.3.25–34] ātma āpetīti: ātmaśabdaḥ svabhāvavācī. āpetīti jalam. jalasvabhāvety arthaḥ. evam agnyādisvabhāvā ghoraḍākinyādayo vāmāvartenottarādiṣu draṣṭavyāḥ.
analyzed: ātma āpeti iti ātma śabdaḥ svabhāva vācī āpeti iti jalam jala svabhāva iti arthaḥ evam agni ādi svabhāvāḥ ghora ḍākinī ādayaḥ vāma āvartena uttara ādiṣu draṣṭavyāḥ

original: [2.3.35] ātmapañcetīti: etāḥ pañcabhūtasvabhāvāḥ pañca ḍākinya iti. upasaṃhāra iti bhāvaḥ. pañcapañceti: pañcajñānaviśuddhā etāḥ pañceti bhāvaḥ. pūrvokteṣu siṃhāsaneṣu bhāvyāḥ. atha vā ekaikayoginyaḥ pañcajñānaviśuddhāḥ.
analyzed: ātma pañca iti iti etāḥ pañcabhūta svabhāvāḥ pañca ḍākinyaḥ iti upasaṃhāraḥ iti bhāvaḥ pañca pañca iti pañca jñāna viśuddhāḥ etāḥ pañca iti bhāvaḥ pūrva ukteṣu siṃhāsaneṣu bhāvyāḥ atha vā ekaika yoginyaḥ pañca jñāna viśuddhāḥ

original: [2.3.36] iśānyasya tv ityādi: aiśānyāṃ siṃhī siṃhamukhadhāriṇī sitapītobhayabhūmivarṇā. nāgendro hastī sa evāsanam.
analyzed: iśānī asya tu ityādi aiśānyām siṃhī siṃha mukha dhāriṇī sita pīta ubhaya bhūmi varṇā nāga indraḥ hastī saḥ eva āsanam

original: [2.3.37] vajrāṅkuśa tarjanyeti: dakṣiṇe bhuje vajralāñchito 'ṅkuśaḥ. vāme tarjanī.
analyzed: vajra aṅkuśa tarjanyā iti dakṣiṇe bhuje vajra lāñchitaḥ ṅkuśaḥ vāme tarjanī

original: [2.3.38] āgneyyāṃ saptaratnaghaṭitāsanasthā sitanīlobhayabhūmivarṇā vyāghrī.
analyzed: āgneyyām sapta ratna ghaṭita āsana sthā sita nīla ubhaya bhūmi varṇā vyāghrī

original: [2.3.39] aṅkuśavirajapāṇim iti: aṅkuśavirājito dakṣiṇaḥ pāṇir ity arthaḥ. tarjani pāśavad iti: pāśayuktā tarjanī vāma ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: aṅkuśa viraja pāṇim iti aṅkuśa virājitaḥ dakṣiṇaḥ pāṇiḥ iti arthaḥ tarjani pāśa vat iti pāśa yuktā tarjanī vāmaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [2.3.40] raktakṛṣṇasya varṇiketi: raktakṛṣṇobhayabhūmivarṇā.
analyzed: rakta kṛṣṇasya varṇikā iti rakta kṛṣṇa ubhaya bhūmi varṇā

original: [2.3.41] aṅkuśapāśatarjanyeti: aṅkuśo dakṣiṇe, pāśāṅkitā tarjanī vāme.

analyzed: sarva sarva vid iti ittham sarvam maṇḍalam yogī bhāvayet iti arthaḥ sva sva āsana upari paryaṅka ākāreṇa vāma pāda ākrāntam dakṣiṇam kiṃcid prasārayet iti sattva paryaṅke iti sattva paryaṅka sthāḥ yoginyaḥ siṃhāsana vat pūrvam eva nāga indra āsana ādīni preta āsanāni ca sūrya ākrāntāni bhāvyāni teṣu sva sva bīja pariṇatāḥ yoginyaḥ

original: ebhi bimbādi agrasya samayaṃ cāpi darśayed iti: āsāṃ yoginīnām agrataḥ samayamudrāṃ svāṃ svāṃ darśayed ity arthaḥ.

original: jñānaḍākinyā bījaṃ vihāya, anyāsāṃ yāni bījāni teṣāṃ madhye prathama ity arthaḥ. praṇamā huta antimeti vyākhyātam. oṃkāra ādau, svāhākāro 'nte mantroddhāraparisamāpte.
analyzed: jñānaḍākinyāḥ bījam vihāya anyāsām yāni bījāni teṣām madhye prathamaḥ iti arthaḥ vyākhyātam oṃkāraḥ ādau svāhākāraḥ nte mantra uddhāra parisamāpte

original: [2.3.57] uttarasyāṃ diśi ghorībījam idam ākāraḥ. oṃ ā svāheti samudāyo mantraḥ. asyetyādi: asya ākārasya prayuktasya bījasya pārśve daṇḍo 'para ākāra ity arthaḥ. tena ā3 iti bījam.
analyzed: uttarasyām diśi ghorī bījam idam ākāraḥ om ā svāhā iti samudāyaḥ mantraḥ asya ityādi asya ākārasya prayuktasya bījasya pārśve paraḥ ākāraḥ iti arthaḥ tena iti bījam

original: [2.3.58] paścimasyāṃ vettālyā bījam idam. oṃ ā3 svāheti samudāyo mantraḥ. asyetyādi: ābījasyopari bindur deyaḥ. tena āṃ iti bījam. oṃ āṃ svāheti samudāyo mantraḥ.

original: [2.3.59] napuṃsā pūrva bījasyeti: napuṃsakākṣarāṇi catvāri ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ iti, eṣāṃ pūrvaṃ prathamam akṣaraṃ ṛbījam. oṃ ṛ svāhetisamudāyo mantraḥ.

original: [2.3.60] napuṃsaketyādi: napuṃsakānāṃ dvitīyaṃ bījaṃ ṝ. oṃ ṝ svāheti mantraḥ.

original: [2.3.79] amṛtetyādi: amṛtā sakāraḥ. rephabindūnām iti: sakārasyādho repha upari binduś ca, tena sraṃ iti syāt. oṃ sraṃ svāheti mantrasamudāyaḥ. gandhamudrāyā evāṅguṣṭhatarjanīyogāt puṣpamudrā.

original: [2.3.80] vargapūrvakapūrvasyeti: vargapūrvakaḥ kavargaḥ. tasya pūrvakaḥ kakāraḥ. asyādha ukāra upari binduḥ, nādabinduṃ tv iti (83b) vakṣyamāṇavacanāt. tena kuṃ iti syāt. oṃ kuṃ svāheti mantrasamudāyaḥ.

original: [2.3.81] puṣpamudrāyā eva madhyamāṅgulisamutthānād dhūpamudrā.
analyzed: puṣpamudrāyāḥ eva madhyamāṅguli samutthānāt dhūpamudrā

original: [2.3.82] navāntabījeti: navamaṃ ca tad antabījaṃ ceti navāntabījaṃ kṣakāraḥ. yakāram ārabhya gaṇyamānatvena navamatvam. asyāpy adha ukāra upari binduḥ. tena kṣuṃ iti syāt. dakṣiṇahastamuṣṭiṃ kṛtvāṅguṣṭhotthāpanād dīpamudrā. oṃ kṣuṃ svāheti mantraḥ.
analyzed: nava anta bīja iti navamam ca tat anta bījam ca iti nava anta bījam kṣakāraḥ yakāram ārabhya gaṇyamāna tvena navama tvam asya api adhas ukāraḥ upari binduḥ tena kṣuṃ iti syāt dakṣiṇa hasta muṣṭim kṛtvā aṅguṣṭha utthāpanāt dīpa mudrā om   svāhā iti mantraḥ

original: [2.3.83] pūrvavargatrikaṃ gṛhyeti: pūrvavargaḥ kavargas tattrikas tṛtīyo gakāraḥ. nāda upadeśād dhrasva ukāraḥ. bindur anusvāraḥ. gakārasyādha upari ca ukāro binduś ca. tena guṃ iti syāt.
analyzed: pūrva varga trikam gṛhya iti pūrva vargaḥ kavargaḥ tad trikaḥ tṛtīyaḥ gakāraḥ nādaḥ upadeśāt hrasvaḥ ukāraḥ binduḥ anusvāraḥ gakārasya adhas upari ca ukāraḥ binduḥ ca tena guṃ iti syāt

original: [2.3.84] dvāv ityādi: hastadvayaṃ prasāryāṅguṣṭhadvayaṃ madhyamādvayaṃ ca cālayed iti balimudrā. oṃ guṃ svāheti mantraḥ.
analyzed: dvau ityādi hasta dvayam prasārya aṅguṣṭha dvayam madhyamā dvayam ca cālayet iti bali mudrā om guṃ svāhā iti mantraḥ

original: [2.3.85] mantramudrāyogena yathāyogaṃ gandhādipūjāṃ kuryād iti. pūjayed ebhi tattveneti: anena balitattvena pūjayet. sarvadevatā iti śeṣaḥ. balim āha: adaityābali pūrvavad iti. yatra pañcāmṛtāni pañcāṅkuśā āmamatsyamāṃsapalāṇḍvādikaṃ ca so 'daityābaliḥ. pūrvoktamantramudrābhyāṃ tair vastubhiḥ puṣpadhūpādibhiś ca devatāyogī baliṃ dadyād iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: mantra mudrā yogena yathāyogam gandha ādi pūjām kuryāt iti pūjayet tattvena iti anena bali tattvena pūjayet sarva devatāḥ iti śeṣaḥ balim āha pūrvavat iti yatra pañcāmṛtāni pañcāṅkuśāḥ āma matsya māṃsa palāṇḍu ādikam ca saḥ daityā baliḥ pūrva ukta mantra mudrābhyām taiḥ vastuṣu puṣpa dhūpa ādibhiḥ ca devatā yogī balim dadyāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: etad evāha: pañcetyādi. pūrvāṇīti: pañcāmṛtatvena prasiddhāni. gokudahanāḥ pañcāṅkuśābhidhānāḥ. abhimatāṃ siddhiṃ kuṣṇantīty aṅkuśāḥ.
analyzed: etat eva āha pañca ityādi pūrvāṇi iti pañca amṛta tvena prasiddhāni goku dahanāḥ pañcāṅkuśa abhidhānāḥ abhimatām siddhim kuṣṇanti iti aṅkuśāḥ

original: [2.3.86] śeṣaṃ subodham. mudrāmantraṃ tv iti: pūrvoktau balimudrāmantrau. balyādikāle viṃśatividhāṃ pūjām āha: paścād ityādi.
analyzed: śeṣam su bodham mudrā mantram tu iti pūrva uktau bali mudrā mantrau bali ādi kāle viṃśatividhām pūjām āha paścāt ityādi

original: [2.3.87] hūṃkāragītikākāram iti: hūṃkāroccāraṇasamaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ. pūrvayogiṇitoṣiketi: etat pradhānaṃ yoginītuṣṭikaram iti bhāvaḥ. vajramuṣṭidvayam ityādinā viṃśatividhāṃ pūjāṃ darśayati. vajraghaṇṭādhāraṇābhinayena vajramuṣṭidvayaṃ kaṭidvaye nidhāya hūṃkāroccāraṇapūrvakaṃ kaṭyaṅgaśiraś cālayet.
analyzed: hūṃkāra gītikā ākāram iti hūṃkāra uccāraṇa samam vakṣyamāṇam kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ pūrva yogiṇi toṣikā iti etat pradhānam yoginī tuṣṭi karam iti bhāvaḥ vajra muṣṭi dvayam ityādinā viṃśatividhām pūjām darśayati vajraghaṇṭā dhāraṇa abhinayena vajra muṣṭi dvayam kaṭi dvaye nidhāya hūṃkāra uccāraṇa pūrvakam kaṭi aṅga śiraḥ cālayet

original: [2.3.88] etad evāha: hūṃkāreṇetyādi.
analyzed: etat eva āha hūṃkāreṇa ityādi

original: [2.3.89–91] phomākāreṇeti: kāhalābhinayena.
analyzed: phoma ākāreṇa iti kāhala abhinayena

original: [2.3.92] vādyākāreṇeti: kaṃsatālādyākāreṇa.
analyzed: vādi ākāreṇa iti kaṃsa tāla ādi ākāreṇa

original: [2.3.93–96] dhvajākāreṇeti: vāmahastam ūrdhvaṃ kṛtvā tadupari dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ prasārayet.
analyzed: dhvaja ākāreṇa iti vāma hastam ūrdhvam kṛtvā tad upari dakṣiṇam bāhum prasārayet

original: [2.3.97–98] patākākāreṇeti: dakṣiṇabāhumātraṃ prasārayet.
analyzed: patākā ākāreṇa iti dakṣiṇa bāhu mātram prasārayet

original: [2.3.99] chatrākāreṇeti: hastadvayena cchatradhāraṇābhinayaṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: chatra ākāreṇa iti hasta dvayena chatra dhāraṇa abhinayam kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.3.100] mauñjyākāreṇeti: ūrdhvamardalavādanābhinayena.
analyzed: mauñjī ākāreṇa iti ūrdhva mardala vādana abhinayena

original: [2.3.101–106] mardalākāreṇeti: tiryaṅmardalavādanābhinayaṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: mardala ākāreṇa iti tiryak mardala vādana abhinayam kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.3.107] pūjayet sarvavastūni aṣṭa yogini tattvata iti: ebhir vajravajraghaṇṭādyabhinayavastubhis tattvataḥ prādhānyād aṣṭa yoginīḥ pūjayet. tad eva gītikākāraṃ hūṃkāram ātmanirmitam iti: hūṃkārapradhānaṃ gītaṃ, yat
analyzed: pūjayet sarva vastūni aṣṭa yogini tattvataḥ iti ebhiḥ vajra vajra ghaṇṭā ādi abhinaya vastubhiḥ tattvataḥ prādhānyāt aṣṭa yoginīḥ pūjayet tat eva gītikā ākāram hūṃkāram ātma nirmitam iti hūṃkāra pradhānam gītam yat

original: paṇamaha akāraṇa rūvu secchavi sattuha uttāru |
analyzed: paṇamaha akāraṇa rūvu secchavi sattuha uttāru

original: tennā hūṃ tennā hūṃ tennā te te hūṃ (4.4.93)
analyzed: tennā hūm tennā hūm tennā te te hūm

original: ityādi. tad eveti prasiddham. ātmanirmitam ity ātmanā gātavyam ity arthaḥ. etena gītapūjā darśitā.
analyzed: ityādi tat eva iti prasiddham ātma nirmitam iti ātmanā gātavyam iti arthaḥ etena gīta pūjā darśitā

original: [2.3.108] stutipūjāṃ darśayann āha: vajja hu ityādi. puṃdevatāyāḥ strīdevatāyāś ca sādhāraṇī stutiḥ. vajja hu iti: he vajra, abhedyadharmakāyātmakatvāt.
analyzed: stuti pūjām darśayan āha vajja hu ityādi pum devatāyāḥ strī devatāyāḥ ca sādhāraṇī stutiḥ vajja hu iti he vajra abhedya dharma kāya ātmaka tvāt

original: surataṃ sattvārthakriyā, tatra samarthāni māṃsadivyaprajñādharmabuddhacakṣurabhidhānāni pañca locanāni, tair darśanaṃ jagad arthopalambho yasya, sa suratasamarthalocanadarśanaḥ, tasya saṃbodhanaṃ suraasamatthaloaṇadaṃsaṇae.
analyzed: suratam sattva arthakriyā tatra samarthāni māṃsa divya prajñā dharma buddha cakṣuḥ abhidhānāni pañca locanāni taiḥ darśanam jagat artha upalambhaḥ yasya sa surata samartha locana darśanaḥ tasya saṃbodhanam sura asa mattha loaṇa daṃsaṇae

original: na kṣaratīty akṣaram advayajñānaṃ, tasya bhāvaḥ svabhāvo niḥsvabhāvatādikaṃ, sa svabhāvo yasya, so 'kṣarabhāvasvabhāvas, tasya saṃbodhanam akkharabhāvasahāvu. svabhāvaśūnye jagati svacittaṃ vilāsayati krīḍayatīti śūnyavilāsanas, tasya saṃbodhanaṃ suṇṇuvilāsaṇae.
analyzed: na kṣarati iti akṣaram advaya jñānam tasya bhāvaḥ svabhāvaḥ niḥsvabhāva tā ādikam sa svabhāvaḥ yasya saḥ kṣara bhāva svabhāvaḥ tasya saṃbodhanam svabhāva śūnye jagati sva cittam vilāsayati krīḍayati iti śūnya vilāsanaḥ tasya saṃbodhanam suṇṇu vilāsanae

original: [2.3.109] dharmāṇāṃ bhāvābhāvābhyāṃ vimuktā majjā tattvaṃ, tena viśeṣeṇa jñāta iti bhāvābhāvavimuktamajjāvijñātas tasya saṃbodhanaṃ bhāvābhāvavimuttiamajjavijāṇiae. bhañjia akkharu savva iti: sarvāṇi vācakāni śabdarūpāṇi bhaṅktvā tyaktvety arthaḥ. tataḥ kiṃ kṛtam ity āha: sesuvicintiae iti:
analyzed: dharmāṇām bhāva abhāvābhyām vimuktā majjā tattvam tena viśeṣeṇa jñātaḥ iti bhāva abhāva vimukta majjā vijñātaḥ tasya saṃbodhanam bhāva abhāva vimutti a majja vijāṇiae bhañjia savve iti sarvāṇi vācakāni śabda rūpāṇi bhaṅktvā tyaktvā iti arthaḥ tatas kim kṛtam iti āha iti

original: śeṣeṇāvācyena rūpeṇa vicintito yas tasya saṃbodhanaṃ sesuvicintiae iti.
analyzed: śeṣeṇa avācyena rūpeṇa vicintitaḥ yaḥ tasya saṃbodhanam iti

original: [2.3.110] dvandvāliṅganaṃ prajñopāyasamāpattiḥ, tena yogaḥ samādhis, tena salilaṃ bodhicittaṃ tad eva kāryaṃ, tena vyavaharatīti dvandvāliṅganayogasalilakāryakas, tasya saṃbodhanaṃ dondāliṅgaṇajouśalilākajjiae iti. dharmam advayaṃ nairātmyaṃ suṣṭhu prāpya mokṣaṃ viśeṣeṇa prāpto yas tasya saṃbodhanaṃ mokkhavipāviae iti.
analyzed: dvandva āliṅganam prajñā upāya samāpattiḥ tena yogaḥ samādhiḥ tena salilam bodhi cittam tat eva kāryam tena vyavaharati iti dvandva āliṅgana yoga salila kāryakaḥ tasya saṃbodhanam iti dharmam advayam nairātmyam suṣṭhu prāpya mokṣam viśeṣeṇa prāptaḥ yaḥ tasya saṃbodhanam mokkha vipāviae iti

original: [2.3.111] sukhākārasaṃsāravimohitānāṃ sattvānām arthe mokṣeṇa mokṣāsaṅgena vivarjitas tasya saṃbodhanaṃ suhasaṃsāravimohiamokkhavivajjiae iti.
analyzed: sukha ākāra saṃsāra vimohitānām sattvānām arthe mokṣeṇa mokṣa āsaṅgena vivarjitaḥ tasya saṃbodhanam iti

original: prajñayā na bhave sthānaṃ kṛpayā na śame sthitir
analyzed: prajñayā na bhave sthānam kṛpayā na śame sthitiḥ

original: iti vacanāt. dondāliṅgaṇetyādinā svaparārthopāyasampad uktā. dhammu adaia ityādinā svārthasampat. suhasaṃsāretyādinā ca parārthasampat. evaṃviśiṣṭaṃ bhagavantaṃ saṃbodhya yaḥ kaścit stuvann āha: savvetyādi. sarvasvabhāvena sarvaprakāreṇa kāyavākcittair ity arthaḥ, yoginyo mattās tvayā nartitāś ceti savvasahāveṃ joiṇi mattaviṇacciae ity asyārthaḥ.
analyzed: iti vacanāt dondā liṅgaṇa ityādinā sva para artha upāya sampad uktā ityādinā sva artha sampad suha saṃsāra ityādinā ca para artha sampad evaṃviśiṣṭam bhagavantam saṃbodhya yaḥ kaścid stuvan āha savva ityādi sarva svabhāvena sarva prakāreṇa kāya vāc cittaiḥ iti arthaḥ yoginyaḥ mattāḥ tvayā nartitāḥ ca iti savva sahāveṃ joiṇi matta vinacciae iti asya arthaḥ

original: [2.3.112] pañca vītyādi: kṣayānutpādajñānaṃ buddhānāṃ tattvaṃ, pañcāpi yoginyo buddhatattvam iti viśeṣeṇa lakṣitās tvayeti draṣṭavyam iti pañca vi yoiṇi buddhatattvavilakkhiae ity asyārthaḥ. anena dharmakāyaś ca bhagavataḥ sūcitaḥ. māyayā bahuvidharūpayā sattvāḥ pācitās tvayeti śeṣaḥ. itaś ca nirmāṇakāyo darśitaḥ.
analyzed: pañca vi ityādi kṣaya anutpāda jñānam buddhānām tattvam pañca api yoginyaḥ buddha tattvam iti viśeṣeṇa lakṣitāḥ tvayā iti draṣṭavyam iti pañca vi buddha tattva vilakkhiae iti asya arthaḥ anena dharmakāyaḥ ca bhagavataḥ sūcitaḥ māyayā bahuvidha rūpayā sattvāḥ pācitāḥ tvayā iti śeṣaḥ itas ca nirmāṇa kāyaḥ darśitaḥ

original: [2.3.112] vajreṇa śūnyatayā, suṣṭhu sāritam adhigataṃ, kāryaṃ nirvikalpatālakṣaṇaṃ yena, sa vajrasusāritakāryas tasya saṃbodhanaṃ vajjasusāriakajjeti. saṃbodhya kim uktam ity āha: dhammetyādi.
analyzed: vajreṇa śūnyatayā suṣṭhu sāritam adhigatam kāryam nirvikalpa tā lakṣaṇam yena sa vajra su sārita kāryaḥ tasya saṃbodhanam vajja su sāria kajja iti saṃbodhya kim uktam iti āha dhamma ityādi

original: jīvitamaraṇasukhaduḥkhādilakṣaṇadhāraṇād dharmāḥ sattvā viśiṣṭena krameṇa dharmadeśanārūpeṇa kliṣṭamohān nivartitās tvayeti śeṣa iti dhammavimohiae ity asyārthaḥ. saṃbhogakāyaś ca darśitaḥ. idānīṃ sattvān saṃbodhyāha: ṇamatetyādi. he sattvās! tam evaṃbhūtaṃ bhagavantaṃ namata! sāradharmaś ca yo bhagavāṃs taṃ namateti pūrveṇaiva saṃbandhaḥ.
analyzed: jīvita maraṇa sukha duḥkha ādi lakṣaṇa dhāraṇāt dharmāḥ sattvāḥ viśiṣṭena krameṇa dharma deśanā rūpeṇa kliṣṭa mohāt nivartitāḥ tvayā iti śeṣaḥ iti iti asya arthaḥ saṃbhoga kāyaḥ ca darśitaḥ idānīm sattvān saṃbodhya āha ṇamata ityādi he sattvāḥ tam evaṃbhūtam bhagavantam namata sāra dharmaḥ ca yaḥ bhagavān tam namata iti pūrveṇa eva saṃbandhaḥ

original: sārudhammu jjo iti vyākhyātam. yoginyaś ca yena mocitās taṃ namateti yojyam. joiṇimokkhiae iti sunītam.
analyzed: iti vyākhyātam yoginyaḥ ca yena mocitāḥ tam namata iti yojyam iti su nītam

original: [2.3.114] saṃskṛtastavam āha: namo 'stv ityādi. prajñopāyasamāpattir yogaḥ, sa evādhipaḥ śreṣṭhatvāt. tena sattvān mocayatīti yogādhipasattvamocakaḥ. yad vā: he yogādhipeti bhinnaṃ padam. evaṃviśiṣṭa bhagavaṃs tubhyaṃ nama iti bhāvaḥ. ātmeti: dharmadhātuḥ. tasmāj jātā ity ātmajāḥ. sarva ātmajā yasya, sa sarvātmajaḥ. ekabhāvata ity ekacetasā.
analyzed: saṃskṛta stavam āha namaḥ o stu ityādi prajñā upāya samāpattiḥ yogaḥ saḥ eva adhipaḥ śreṣṭha tvāt tena sattvān mocayati iti yoga adhipa sattva mocakaḥ yat vā he yoga adhipa iti bhinnam padam evam viśiṣṭa bhagavan tubhyam namaḥ iti bhāvaḥ ātmā iti dharmadhātuḥ tasmāt jātāḥ iti ātma jāḥ sarve ātma jāḥ yasya sa sarva ātmajaḥ eka bhāvataḥ iti ekacetasā

original: [2.3.115] saṃsāra evārṇavo bālair duravagāhatvāt. moho jñeyāvaraṇam. saṃsārārṇavasthitānāṃ mohacchedaka, namo 'stu. ta iti śeṣaḥ. tattvenaikaḥ śreṣṭhatvāt tattvajñas tvatsadṛśo nāparo 'stīti tattvaiketi saṃbodhanam.
analyzed: saṃsāraḥ eva arṇavaḥ bālaiḥ duravagāha tvāt mohaḥ jñeya āvaraṇam saṃsāra arṇava sthitānām moha chedaka namaḥ stu te iti śeṣaḥ tattvena ekaḥ śreṣṭha tvāt tattva jñaḥ tvad sadṛśaḥ na aparaḥ asti iti tattva eka iti saṃbodhanam

original: [2.3.116] itiviśeṣateti: viśeṣata ity arthaḥ. stavagītastotraśabdena stutigītam. tenopahāraṃ pūjāṃ kuryāt. tattvākhyānāt sadguṇākhyātiḥ stutiḥ. stutirūpaṃ gītaṃ stutigītam. paṇamahetyādigīte (4.4.93) tattvasyālpatvād gītamātraṃ, tataś cānayor bhedaḥ.
analyzed: iti viśeṣatā iti viśeṣataḥ iti arthaḥ stava gīta stotra śabdena stuti gītam tena upahāram pūjām kuryāt tattva ākhyānāt sat guṇa ākhyātiḥ stutiḥ stuti rūpam gītam stuti gītam paṇa mahā ityādi gīte tattvasya alpa tvāt gīta mātram tatas ca anayoḥ bhedaḥ

original: [2.3.117] stutyanantaraṃ ghaṇṭāṃ vādayet. etad evāha: hūṃkāretyādi. hūṃkārāntaritayā ceti. hūṃkāroccāraṇaviśeṣitāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ vādayet. hūṃkāroccāraṇapūrvakaṃ ghaṇṭāvādanam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: stuti anantaram ghaṇṭām vādayet etat eva āha hūṃkāra ityādi hūṃkāra antaritayā ca iti hūṃkāra uccāraṇa viśeṣitām ghaṇṭām vādayet hūṃkāra uccāraṇa pūrvakam ghaṇṭā vādanam iti arthaḥ

original: [2.3.118] atheti: ghaṇṭānādānantaram. akārṣīd iti: kuryād ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: atha iti ghaṇṭā nāda anantaram akārṣīt iti kuryāt iti arthaḥ

original: [2.3.119] trividhaṃ praṇidhānam āha: vajrāñjalītyādi. vajrāñjaliṃ hṛdi dhārayitvā ...
analyzed: trividham praṇidhānam āha vajra añjali ityādi vajra añjalim hṛdi dhārayitvā

original: [2.3.120–122] ... oṃ svabhāvaśuddhā ityādi mantratrayaṃ paṭhet.
analyzed: om svabhāva śuddhā ityādi mantra trayam paṭhet

original: [2.3.123] kamalāvartaṃ tu m-āvartya dakṣiṇe padma cintitam | vāme vajram utsṛjya mahāmudrāṃ tu darśayed iti: praṇidhānāntaraṃ kamalāvartaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇahaste padmabhājanaṃ cintayitvā vāmahastasya vṛddhāṅguṣṭhena kanīyasīm ākramya vāmahastaṃ padmabhāṇḍe niyojayed iti mahāmudrāṃ darśayet.
analyzed: kamala āvartam tu mā āvartya dakṣiṇe padma cintitam vāme vajram utsṛjya mahāmudrām tu darśayet iti praṇidhāna antaram kamala āvartam kṛtvā dakṣiṇa haste padma bhājanam cintayitvā vāma hastasya vṛddha aṅguṣṭhena kanīyasīm ākramya vāma hastam padma bhāṇḍe niyojayet iti mahāmudrām darśayet

original: [2.3.124] asyā mantraḥ: oṃ ha ho hrī svāheti.
analyzed: asyāḥ mantraḥ om ha ho hrī svāhā iti

original: [2.3.125] ata āha: mahāmudrāmantra iti.
analyzed: atas āha mahāmudrā mantraḥ iti

original: [2.3.126] madanāsvādane 'py anyatra mudrāmantrāv etāv eva. ata evāha: samaṃ tāpi ca yogīnāṃ sarvadevābhi cintayed iti. samam: ekakālam. tāpi ceti: taṃ madanaśodhanam. sarvadevābhīti: sarvadevatāyogaś ca jhaṭiti yoginā kārya iti bhāvaḥ. laukikādīn tu jñānīnāṃ bāhyamaṇḍala kalpitam iti:
analyzed: madana āsvādane pi anyatra mudrā mantrau etau eva atas eva āha samam ca ca cintayet iti samam eka kālam tā api ca iti tam madana śodhanam sarva deva abhi iti sarva devatā yogaḥ ca jhaṭiti yoginā kāryaḥ iti bhāvaḥ laukika ādīn tu jñānīnām bāhya maṇḍala kalpitam iti

original: laukikāḥ śreṣṭhāś ca jñāninaḥ kṣetrapālāḥ, tebhyo balidānārthaṃ bāhyamaṇḍalaṃ kalpitam. ātmano bahirbhūtatvād bāhyam. tatra raktacandanena kuṅkumena vā trikoṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā, tanmadhye vartulaṃ, tanmadhye ca catuḥsūtrayogena navakoṣṭhakaṃ maṇḍalam.
analyzed: laukikāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ ca jñāninaḥ kṣetrapālāḥ tebhyaḥ bali dāna artham bāhya maṇḍalam kalpitam ātmanaḥ bahis bhūta tvāt bāhyam tatra raktacandanena kuṅkumena vā tri koṇam maṇḍalam kṛtvā tad madhye vartulam tad madhye ca catur sūtra yogena nava koṣṭhakam maṇḍalam

original: tatra pūrvādikoṣṭhakeṣu yathākramaṃ kṛṣṇarudramahārudradevadattakṛṣṇakarālabībhatsanandātītavināyakā ete kṣetrapālāś, cāmuṇḍīghorīprabhṛtibhir dvātriṃśadyoginībhiḥ pratyekaṃ catasṛbhiś catasṛbhiḥ parivṛtāḥ svāyudhodyatapāṇayaḥ. madhyakoṣṭhake ca trayodaśātmikā jñānaḍākinī. iti bāhyamaṇḍalaṃ bhāvyam.
analyzed: tatra pūrva ādi koṣṭhakeṣu yathākramam kṛṣṇa rudra mahārudra devadatta kṛṣṇa karāla bībhatsa nandātīta vināyakāḥ ete kṣetrapālāḥ cāmuṇḍī ghorī prabhṛtibhiḥ dvātriṃśat yoginībhiḥ pratyekam catasṛbhiḥ catasṛbhiḥ parivṛtāḥ sva āyudha udyata pāṇayaḥ madhya koṣṭhake ca trayodaśa ātmikā jñāna ḍākinī iti bāhya maṇḍalam bhāvyam

original: [2.3.127] pṛthag gandhena m-āliptam ityādi: pṛthag ity anyatrāparibhuktena gandhādinā. pṛthag yogaṃ tu dhyāpayed iti: balidānakāle jñānaḍākinīmaṇḍalātmako bhaved iti bhāvaḥ. pṛthaktvaṃ bāhyamaṇḍalamadhyasthajñānaḍākinīmaṇḍalāt.
analyzed: pṛthak gandhena mā āliptam ityādi pṛthak iti anyatra a paribhuktena gandha ādinā pṛthak yogam tu dhyāpayet iti bali dāna kāle jñāna ḍākinī maṇḍala ātmakaḥ bhavet iti bhāvaḥ pṛthaktvam bāhya maṇḍala madhya stha jñāna ḍākinī maṇḍalāt

original: [2.3.128] pañcāmṛtasamāśritam iti: pañcāmṛtaṃ śuktyādibhājanagataṃ dadyād iti bhāvaḥ. ata āha: śuktādiṃ tu dhyāpayed iti: śuktaśabdena śuktiḥ. hakāram ityādi: hakāraṃ pañcāmṛte dhyāyāt, sa ca tasya prākṛtaṃ varṇaṃ harati. hokāraś ca dhyātas tasya prākṛtaṃ gandhaṃ nāśayati.
analyzed: pañcāmṛta samāśritam iti pañcāmṛtam śukti ādi bhājana gatam dadyāt iti bhāvaḥ atas āha śukta ādim tu dhyāpayet iti śukta śabdena śuktiḥ hakāram ityādi hakāram pañcāmṛte dhyāyāt sa ca tasya prākṛtam varṇam harati hokāraḥ ca dhyātaḥ tasya prākṛtam gandham nāśayati

original: [2.3.129] hrīkāraś ca dhyāto 'tra prākṛtaṃ vīryaṃ hanti. ebhis tribhir akṣarair varṇādinā trividhais tribhir uccārya trīn lokeśvarādīn yathākramaṃ dhyāyād iti bhāvaḥ. hakāreṇa lokeśvaraṃ, hokāreṇa vairocanaṃ, hrīkāreṇākṣobhyaṃ pañcāmṛte dhyāyād ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: hrīkāraḥ ca prākṛtam vīryam hanti ebhiḥ tribhiḥ akṣaraiḥ varṇa ādinā trividhaiḥ tribhiḥ uccārya trīn lokeśvara ādīn yathākramam dhyāyāt iti bhāvaḥ hakāreṇa lokeśvaram hokāreṇa vairocanam hrīkāreṇa akṣobhyam pañcāmṛte dhyāyāt iti arthaḥ

original: [2.3.130] tataḥ pariśuddhaṃ varṇādikaṃ syād ity āha: padmeśvaram ityādi. padmeśvaro 'mitābhaḥ, sa eva lokeśvaraḥ. sa suvarṇavarṇāṃ rūpakāntiṃ karoti. pañcāmṛtasyeti śeṣaḥ. suvarṇakāntiś ca lokeśvaro dhyeyaḥ. gandhodakaṃ bhāveti: gandhodakam iva sugandhaṃ bhāvaṃ prakṛtiṃ niṣpādayati. ko 'sāv ity āha: surocanaṃ ceti. vairocana ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: tatas pariśuddham varṇa ādikam syāt iti āha padmeśvaram ityādi padmeśvaraḥ mita ābhaḥ saḥ eva lokeśvaraḥ sa suvarṇa varṇām rūpa kāntim karoti pañcāmṛtasya iti śeṣaḥ suvarṇa kāntiḥ ca lokeśvaraḥ dhyeyaḥ gandha udakam bhāva iti gandha udakam iva sugandham bhāvam prakṛtim niṣpādayati saḥ iti āha su rocanam ca iti vairocanaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: śuklaś cāyam. āsvāda vajreśvara vajrapāṇīti: āsvādaṃ rasaṃ viśuddhaṃ niṣpādayati, vajreśvarety akṣobhyaḥ. sa ca vajrapāṇir vajrahastaḥ. kṛṣṇaś cāyam. prākṛtaṃ varṇādikaṃ hatvā viśuddham anyad eva niṣpādayanti vāgādayaḥ. etad evopasaṃharann āha: trayābhi devā trividhena jñāpayed iti. tisro devatās trividhena varṇena pītādinā bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: śuklaḥ ca ayam āsvāda vajreśvara vajrapāṇi iti āsvādam rasam viśuddham niṣpādayati vajreśvara iti akṣobhyaḥ sa ca vajrapāṇiḥ vajrahastaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ ca ayam prākṛtam varṇa ādikam hatvā viśuddham anyat eva niṣpādayanti vāc ādayaḥ etat eva upasaṃharan āha trayā abhi trividhena jñāpayet iti tisraḥ devatāḥ trividhena varṇena pīta ādinā bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.3.131] idānīṃ yoginīpūjārthaṃ madanaśodhanaṃ darśayati: vāme candra pāṇiṃ tv ityādi. vāmapāṇitale candraṃ cintayitvā tanmadhye 'mṛtākṣaraṃ sakāram. sarvavinmātrā praṇavas tena yuktaṃ cintayet. tad yathā soṃ iti. aṅguṣṭhā kṣitim eva ceti: aṅguṣṭhaḥ kṣitisvarūpaḥ.
analyzed: idānīm yoginī pūjā artham madana śodhanam darśayati vāme candra pāṇim tu ityādi vāma pāṇi tale candram cintayitvā tad madhye mṛta akṣaram sakāram sarva vid mātrā praṇavaḥ tena yuktam cintayet tat yathā soṃ iti aṅguṣṭhā kṣitim eva ca iti aṅguṣṭhaḥ kṣiti svarūpaḥ

original: [2.3.132] anāmā sumero iti: anāmā sumerusvarūpā. amṛtā iti: amṛtaṃ madanam ity arthaḥ. balineti: prajñopāyasvarūpakṣitisumerusvarūpābhyām aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ balibhyāṃ mathanetīti mathnāti. balitvaṃ cāmṛtatvotpādanāya. evaṃ kṛte madanam amṛtatāṃ yātīti balam etad vastuśaktir eṣety arthaḥ. m-ambho trividhena jñāpayed iti:
analyzed: anāmā sumero iti anāmā sumeru svarūpāḥ amṛtāḥ iti amṛtam madanam iti arthaḥ balinā iti prajñā upāya svarūpa kṣiti sumeru svarūpābhyām aṅguṣṭha anāmikābhyām balibhyām mathana iti iti mathnāti bali tvam ca amṛta tva utpādanāya evam kṛte madanam amṛta tām yāti iti balam etat vastu śaktiḥ eṣā iti arthaḥ mambho trividhena jñāpayet iti

original: tad ambho 'mṛtaṃ ha-ho-hrīty anena pūrvoktakrameṇa dhyāyād ity arthaḥ. vāmahastatale madanaṃ kṛtvā tadupari soṃkāraṃ vicintyāṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ pramathya hakārādinā ca lokeśvarādirūpaṃ cintayitvā pratyekayoginīnāmagrahaṇena tābhyo jyeṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ pṛthak pṛthaṅ madanachiḍriṅgāṃ dadyāt.
analyzed: tat ambhaḥ mṛtam hahohri iti anena pūrva ukta krameṇa dhyāyāt iti arthaḥ vāma hasta tale madanam kṛtvā tad upari soṃkāram vicintya aṅguṣṭha anāmikābhyām pramathya hakāra ādinā ca lokeśvara ādi rūpam cintayitvā pratyeka yoginī nāma grahaṇena tābhyaḥ jyeṣṭhā anāmikābhyām pṛthak pṛthak madana chiḍriṅgām dadyāt

original: [2.3.133] ata āha: pṛthag ityādi. chidriṅgā dravavikiraṇam. aṅguṣṭheti: jyeṣṭhānāmikābhyām. paścād ityādi: tadanv ātmabhāvena jñānaḍākinīsvabhāvenātmacittaṃ kuryāt.
analyzed: atas āha pṛthak ityādi chidriṅgāḥ drava vikiraṇam aṅguṣṭha iti jyeṣṭhā anāmikābhyām paścāt ityādi tadanu ātma bhāvena jñāna ḍākinī svabhāvena ātma cittam kuryāt

original: [2.3.134] pañcasphoṭaṃ tu stūpasyeti: sphuṭanti naśyantīti sphoṭāḥ skandhāḥ, pañcabhiḥ sphoṭaiḥ stūpaṃ śarīram ity arthaḥ. tat snāpayet trividhena chidriṅgātrayeṇety arthaḥ. hastagatamadanachidriṅgābhir yoginīḥ pūjayitvā jñānaḍākinīyogavān ātmānam api chidriṅgātrayeṇa pūjayed iti bhāvaḥ. ātmani chidriṅgāsthānam āha: jihvāgra ityādi.
analyzed: pañca sphoṭam tu stūpasya iti sphuṭanti naśyanti iti sphoṭāḥ skandhāḥ pañcabhiḥ sphoṭaiḥ stūpam śarīram iti arthaḥ tat snāpayet trividhena chidriṅgā trayeṇa iti arthaḥ hasta gata madana chidriṅgābhiḥ yoginīḥ pūjayitvā jñāna ḍākinī yogavān ātmānam api chidriṅgā trayeṇa pūjayet iti bhāvaḥ ātmani chidriṅgā sthānam āha jihvā agre ityādi

original: jihvāgre, bindv iti ūrṇāmadhye, ūrdhvānām iti mūrdhni. eṣu triṣu sthāneṣu chiḍriṅgām ekaikāṃ dattvātmānaṃ pūjayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: jihvā agre bindu iti ūrṇā madhye ūrdhvānām iti mūrdhni eṣu triṣu sthāneṣu chiḍriṅgām ekaikām dattvā ātmānam pūjayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.3.135] gaṇamaṇḍale madanadānagāthām āha: pecchia ityādi. dharmāḥ śodhitā dṛṣṭāḥ pecchia sohia dhammu ity asyārthaḥ. anabhiniviṣṭatvāt. etena kim ity āha: ṇahisaṃbhāvaṇu mellu iti. nāstikasaṃbhāvanām unmuñca, yataḥ santy eva sarvadharmāḥ kiṃ tu pariśuddhā iti bhāvaḥ. tataś ca brāhmaṇādibhedo 'yathārtha eva. etad evāha: bamhaṇu ityādi.
analyzed: gaṇa maṇḍale madanadāna gāthām āha ityādi dharmāḥ śodhitāḥ dṛṣṭāḥ iti asya arthaḥ anabhiniviṣṭa tvāt etena kim iti āha mellu iti nāstika saṃbhāvanām unmuñca yatas santi eva sarva dharmāḥ kim tu pariśuddhāḥ iti bhāvaḥ tatas ca brāhmaṇa ādi bhedaḥ yathārthaḥ eva etat eva āha ityādi

original: brāhmaṇakurkuracaṇḍālā ekasvabhāvena khāditāḥ. ekena svabhāvena gṛhītā ity arthaḥ. yato brāhmaṇādīnāṃ śukraśoṇitādikaṃ rāgadveṣādikaṃ cāviśiṣṭam eveti vāstavo bhedo nāsti. kiṃ tarhi? kālpanikaḥ. bamhaṇuśabdena brahmakṣatravaiśyāḥ. kukkuruśabdena sāmānyasiddhās tiryañcaḥ. caṇḍāluśabdenāntajāḥ sarve. śūdro 'nukto 'pi draṣṭavyaḥ.
analyzed: brāhmaṇa kurkura caṇḍālāḥ eka svabhāvena khāditāḥ ekena svabhāvena gṛhītāḥ iti arthaḥ yatas brāhmaṇa ādīnām śukra śoṇita ādikam rāga dveṣa ādikam ca aviśiṣṭam eva iti vāstavaḥ bhedaḥ na asti kim tarhi kālpanikaḥ bamhaṇu śabdena brahma kṣatra vaiśyāḥ kukkuru śabdena sāmānya siddhāḥ tiryañcaḥ caṇḍālu śabdena anta jāḥ sarve śūdraḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

original: so 'pi varṇatvena vyavasthito yataḥ. śuddham aśuddhaṃ vā na kiṃcid asti, tataś ca sarvaṃ vikalpam pibeti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: saḥ pi varṇa tvena vyavasthitaḥ yatas śuddham aśuddham vā na kiṃcid asti tatas ca sarvam vikalpam piba iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.3.136] ebhir ityādi: anayā gāthayā paṭhitayā madanapātraṃ yogiyoginībhyāṃ deyam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: ebhiḥ ityādi anayā gāthayā paṭhitayā madana pātram yogi yoginībhyām deyam iti arthaḥ

original: [2.3.137] kamalāvartaṃ tv ityādi (123a) pūrvam uddiṣṭaṃ nirdiśann āha: kamalāvartaṃ tu pūrvasyeti. cittasphaṭikacetaseti: sphaṭikavad vikalpamalarahitena cetasā. trisūcyetyādi subodham.
analyzed: kamala āvartam tu ityādi pūrvam uddiṣṭam nirdiśan āha kamala āvartam tu pūrvasya iti citta sphaṭika cetasā iti sphaṭika vat vikalpa mala rahitena cetasā tri sūcyā ityādi su bodham

original: [2.3.138] dānānantaraṃ madanagrahaṇagāthām āha: svāgadu ityādi. svenātmanā, āgato 'vabuddhaḥ, svasaṃvedyatvāt. ko 'sāv ity āha: dhammu iti. dharmaḥ prakṛtiḥ skandhādīnāṃ padārthānām. sa punas tathatā. eṣā cādvayajñānam. tac ca tathāgataḥ. dharmaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭa ity āha: aṇagghu ityādi. na kvacid vidyate 'rghaḥ pūjā yasya, so 'narghaḥ.
analyzed: dāna anantaram madana grahaṇa gāthām āha ityādi svena ātmanā āgataḥ sva saṃvedya tvāt saḥ iti āha iti dharmaḥ prakṛtiḥ skandha ādīnām padārthānām sa punar tathatā eṣā ca advaya jñānam tat ca tathāgataḥ dharmaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ iti āha ityādi na kvacid vidyate rghaḥ pūjā yasya saḥ na rghaḥ

original: tatpūjāyogyaṃ vastu triṣu lokeṣu nāstīty arthaḥ. bodha eva tasya satpūjeti bhāvaḥ. rāamalāgatae iti: rāgas tṛṣṇā. sa eva malaś, cittamalinīkaraṇatvāt. tasmād āgata īṣadgato bhraṣṭaḥ. viśuddharāgasadbhāvān na sarvathā bhraṣṭaḥ. nanu kathaṃ dveṣādikleśān hitvā rāgamātram uktam? satyam, sukhā vedanā saṃsārasya pradhānahetuḥ. tasyāś ca hetū rāgaḥ.
analyzed: tad pūjā yogyam vastu triṣu lokeṣu na asti iti arthaḥ bodhaḥ eva tasya sat pūjā iti bhāvaḥ iti rāgaḥ tṛṣṇā saḥ eva malaḥ citta malinīkaraṇa tvāt tasmāt āgataḥ īṣat gataḥ bhraṣṭaḥ viśuddha rāga sadbhāvāt na sarvathā bhraṣṭaḥ nanu katham dveṣa ādi kleśān hitvā rāga mātram uktam satyam sukhā vedanā saṃsārasya pradhāna hetuḥ tasyāḥ ca hetuḥ rāgaḥ

original: rāgaviśuddhyā saṃsāraḥ sāṅgaḥ samagro viśuddhaḥ syād iti. gāhetyādi: yato 'pagatarāgamalaḥ, tato grāho 'bhiniveśaḥ, agrāhas tadviparītaḥ, tābhyāṃ varjitaḥ saddharmaḥ. abhiniviṣṭo 'smy anabhiniviṣṭo 'smīty apy abhiniveśavarjita iti bhāvaḥ. evaṃviśiṣṭaṃ dharmaṃ taṃ namateti saṃbandhaḥ. kimartham ity āha: tattiae iti. tattvacintārtham.
analyzed: rāga viśuddhyā saṃsāraḥ sa aṅgaḥ samagraḥ viśuddhaḥ syāt iti gāha ityādi upagata rāga malaḥ tatas grāhaḥ bhiniveśaḥ agrāhaḥ tad viparītaḥ tābhyām varjitaḥ saddharmaḥ abhiniviṣṭaḥ smi anabhiniviṣṭaḥ smi iti api abhiniveśa varjitaḥ iti bhāvaḥ evaṃviśiṣṭam dharmam tam namata iti saṃbandhaḥ kimartham iti āha iti tattva cintā artham

original: tatpraṇāmena tattve mano vartatām iti hetuneti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: tad praṇāmena tattve manaḥ vartatām iti hetunā iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.3.139] anayā gāthayā pratigrāhako gṛhṇīyād iti madanam. ata āha: asya gāthenetyādi. dānagrahaṇahetum āha: yogasiddhyarthahetuneti. yogo 'viparītabhāvaḥ, samasamayatvam ity arthaḥ. tasya niṣpattis tayā yo 'rthaḥ khādanapānādilakṣaṇaḥ, sa eva hetuḥ. gāthayā madanapātradānagrahaṇayoḥ. yathetyādi: yathā m-ācāreti:
analyzed: anayā gāthayā pratigrāhakaḥ gṛhṇīyāt iti madanam atas āha asya gāthena ityādi dāna grahaṇa hetum āha yoga siddhi artha hetunā iti yogaḥ viparīta bhāvaḥ sama samaya tvam iti arthaḥ tasya niṣpattiḥ tayā yaḥ rthaḥ khādana pāna ādi lakṣaṇaḥ saḥ eva hetuḥ gāthayā madana pātra dāna grahaṇayoḥ yathā ityādi yathā mā ācāra iti

original: yathālābhaṃ yogī samācaret tan madanam iti bhāvaḥ. sarvam etac ca yogināṃ śuci pavitram.
analyzed: yathālābham yogī samācaret tat madanam iti bhāvaḥ sarvam etat ca yoginām śuci pavitram

original: [2.3.140] yathāsukham iti vaktavyam iti: madanaṃ dattvā yathāsukham iti yoginā vaktavyam.
analyzed: yathāsukham iti vaktavyam iti madanam dattvā yathāsukham iti yoginā vaktavyam

original: [2.3.141] bāhyamaṇḍala kalpitam ity (126d) uddiṣṭasya nirdeśam āha: raktamaṇḍaletyādi. kuṅkumena raktacandanena vā caturasraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tadbahis trikoṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ. bāhyadevatāvāhanamudrāmantraṃ cāha: vajramuṣṭītyādi. vajramuṣṭidvayaṃ kṛtvā tayoḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ pṛṣṭhena saṃyojya ...
analyzed: uddiṣṭasya nirdeśam āha rakta maṇḍala ityādi kuṅkumena raktacandanena vā catur asram maṇḍalam kṛtvā tad bahis tri koṇam maṇḍalam kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ bāhya devatā vāhana mudrā mantram ca āha vajra muṣṭi ityādi vajra muṣṭi dvayam kṛtvā tayoḥ pṛṣṭham pṛṣṭhena saṃyojya

original: [2.3.142] ... dakṣiṇakaniṣṭhayā vāmakaniṣṭhāṃ saṃveṣṭya tarjanīdvayam utthitaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇatarjanīm ākuñcya tatpṛṣṭhe vāmatarjanīṃ niveśya mudrāṃ kuryāt.
analyzed: dakṣiṇa kaniṣṭhayā vāma kaniṣṭhām saṃveṣṭya tarjanī dvayam utthitam kṛtvā dakṣiṇa tarjanīm ākuñcya tad pṛṣṭhe vāma tarjanīm niveśya mudrām kuryāt

original: [2.3.143] asyā mantraḥ: oṃ ityādi.
analyzed: asyāḥ mantraḥ om ityādi

original: [2.3.144] ata āha: āvāhanamudrāmantra iti.
analyzed: atas āha āvāhana mudrā mantraḥ iti

original: [2.3.145] raktetyādi subodham. balidravyam āha: ohāretyādi. āmamāṃsādikam ohārabaliśabdenocyate. ādiśabdāt palāṇḍulasonādikam. āmamāṃsamatsyapalāṇḍuprabhṛtiprabhūtataraṃ vastu balibhājane dātavyam.
analyzed: rakta ityādi su bodham bali dravyam āha ohāra ityādi āma māṃsa ādikam ohāra bali śabdena ucyate ādi śabdāt palāṇḍu lasona ādikam āma māṃsa matsya palāṇḍu prabhṛti prabhūtataram vastu bali bhājane dātavyam

original: [2.3.146] etat sarvaṃ khādyam. etad evāha: khādyeti. sarvāṇi dravyāṇīti madanam. tac ca sarvaṃ yathālābhaṃ deyam. tad dhi bahuprakāram. tathā cāha:
analyzed: etat sarvam khādyam etat eva āha khādya iti sarvāṇi dravyāṇi iti madanam tat ca sarvam yathālābham deyam tat hi bahu prakāram tathā ca āha

original: dhānyavalkādisaṃdhānaṃ jñeyā lokaprasiddhitaḥ |
analyzed: dhānya valka ādi saṃdhānam jñeyāḥ loka prasiddhitaḥ

original: surā maireyam ikṣvādirasasaṃdhānam iṣyate ||
analyzed: surā maireyam ikṣu ādi rasa saṃdhānam iṣyate

original: iti. pañcāmṛtasuyuñjitam iti: tatra pañcāmṛtaṃ deyam. tac ca suyuñjitaṃ nyastasvasvabījatvāt. vāmabhāgānītyādi: balibhāṇḍasya vāmabhāge vāmahastaṃ dattvā dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ samutthāpya vajramuṣṭiṃ baddhvā tarjanīṃ prasārya darśayet. etad evāha: dāyinaṃ krodha darśayed iti. krodhā tarjanī.
analyzed: iti pañcāmṛta suyuñjitam iti tatra pañcāmṛtam deyam tat ca suyuñjitam nyasta sva sva bīja tvāt vāma bhāgāni ityādi balibhāṇḍasya vāma bhāge vāma hastam dattvā dakṣiṇam bāhum samutthāpya vajra muṣṭim baddhvā tarjanīm prasārya darśayet etat eva āha dāyinam krodha darśayet iti krodhā tarjanī

original: atha vā baliṃ bhāgadvayatvena parikalpya vāmabhāgaṃ maṇḍalacakrāya dakṣiṇaṃ ca dikpālebhyo nivedayed iti. tatra bhāṇḍaśabdena maṇḍalacakraṃ, krodhaśabdena dikpālāḥ.
analyzed: atha vā balim bhāga dvaya tvena parikalpya vāma bhāgam maṇḍala cakrāya dakṣiṇam ca dikpālebhyaḥ nivedayet iti tatra bhāṇḍa śabdena maṇḍala cakram krodha śabdena dikpālāḥ

original: [2.3.147] oṃ ekavṛkṣa ityādinā dhanus tathetyantena (152d) mantreṇa lokapālān āvāhayet. bhājana iti jalādhāre. mātaṅgāṃ tv iti caṇḍālagṛhe. ekavṛkṣādinivāsinaḥ kṛṣṇarudrādayaḥ pūrvoktakoṣṭhabhāviteṣu saparivāreṣv āvāhya praveśanīyāḥ.
analyzed: om eka vṛkṣaḥ ityādinā dhanuḥ tathā iti antena mantreṇa lokapālān āvāhayet bhājane iti jalādhāre mātaṃgān tu iti caṇḍāla gṛhe eka vṛkṣa ādi nivāsinaḥ kṛṣṇa rudra ādayaḥ pūrva ukta koṣṭha bhāviteṣu sa parivāreṣu āvāhya praveśanīyāḥ

original: [2.3.148] tatra pūrve kṛṣṇarudraḥ. uttare mahārudraḥ. paścime devadattaḥ. dakṣiṇe kṛṣṇaḥ. aiśānyāṃ karālaḥ. agneyyāṃ bībhatsaḥ. nairṛtyāṃ nandātītaḥ. vāyavyāṃ vināyakaḥ. ete trinetrāś caturbhujā yathoktāyudhā vastrābharaṇabhūṣitā yathāsaṃkhyaṃ kṛṣṇapītasitaraktavarṇāḥ pūrvādidiksthāḥ, kṛṣṇapītakṛṣṇaraktaraktasitasitapītā aiśānyādisthitāḥ.
analyzed: tatra pūrve kṛṣṇarudraḥ uttare mahārudraḥ paścime devadattaḥ dakṣiṇe kṛṣṇaḥ aiśānyām karālaḥ agneyyām bībhatsaḥ nairṛtyām nandātītaḥ vāyavyām vināyakaḥ ete trinetrāḥ catur bhujāḥ yathā ukta āyudhāḥ vastra ābharaṇa bhūṣitāḥ yathāsaṃkhyam kṛṣṇa pīta sita rakta varṇāḥ pūrva ādi diś sthāḥ kṛṣṇa pīta kṛṣṇa rakta rakta sita sita pītāḥ aiśānī ādi sthitāḥ

original: [2.3.149] kṛṣṇarudrasyāgrataś cāmuṇḍī, vāmato ghorī, bībhatsā pṛṣṭhataḥ, umādevī dakṣiṇataḥ. etā yathākramaṃ ḍākinyādivarṇāḥ. mahārudrasya pūrvottarapaścimadakṣiṇasthā jayāvijayājitāparājitā dīpinyādivarṇāḥ.
analyzed: kṛṣṇa rudrasya agratas cāmuṇḍī vāmatas ghorī bībhatsā pṛṣṭhatas umā devī dakṣiṇatas etāḥ yathākramam ḍākinī ādi varṇāḥ mahārudrasya pūrva uttara paścima dakṣiṇa sthāḥ jaya avijaya ajita aparājitāḥ dīpinī ādi varṇāḥ

original: [2.3.150] devadattasya pūrvottarapaścimadakṣiṇasthā bhadrakālīmahākālīsthūlakālīndryaś cūṣiṇyādivarṇāḥ. kṛṣṇasya pūrvottarapaścimadakṣiṇasthāś candrīghorīduṣṭīlambakyaḥ kāmbojyādivarṇāḥ. karālasya pūrvottarapaścimadakṣiṇasthās tridaśeśvarī-...
analyzed: devadattasya pūrva uttara paścima dakṣiṇa sthāḥ bhadrakālī mahākālī sthūlakālī indryaḥ cūṣiṇī ādi varṇāḥ kṛṣṇasya pūrva uttara paścima dakṣiṇa sthāḥ candrī ghorī duṣṭī lambakyaḥ kāmbojī ādi varṇāḥ karālasya pūrva uttara paścima dakṣiṇa sthāḥ tridaśeśvarī ādi sthāḥ tridaśeśvarī ādi sthāḥ tridaśeśvarī ādi sthāḥ tridaśeśvarī ādi sthāḥ tridaśeśvarī ādi sthāḥ tridaśeśvarī ādi sthāḥ tridaśeśvarī

original: [2.3.151] ...-kāmbojīdīpinīcūṣiṇyaś cāmuṇḍyādivarṇāḥ. bībhatsasya pūrvottarapaścimadakṣiṇasthā ghorarūpāmahārūpādaṃṣṭrārūpākarālinyaś candryādivarṇāḥ.
analyzed: kāmbojī dīpinī cūṣiṇyaḥ cāmuṇḍī ādi varṇāḥ bībhatsasya pūrva uttara paścima dakṣiṇa sthāḥ ghorarūpā mahārūpā daṃṣṭrārūpā karālinyaḥ candrī ādi varṇāḥ

original: [2.3.152] nandātītasya pūrvottarapaścimadakṣiṇasthāḥ kapālamālāmālinīkhaṭvāṅgāyīmaharddhikā bhadrakālyādivarṇāḥ. vināyakasya pūrvottarapaścimadakṣiṇasthāḥ khaḍgahastāparaśuhastāvajrahastādhanurhastā jayādivarṇāḥ. etāś cāmuṇḍyādimaharddhikāntā vilāsinyaḥ, puṣpādipañcopacārahastāḥ. khaḍgahastādyāś catasro yathārutacihnāḥ.
analyzed: nandātītasya pūrva uttara paścima dakṣiṇa sthāḥ kapāla mālā mālinī khaṭvāṅgāyī maharddhikāḥ bhadrakālī ādi varṇāḥ vināyakasya pūrva uttara paścima dakṣiṇa sthāḥ khaḍga hastā paraśu hastā vajra hastā dhanuḥ hastāḥ jaya ādi varṇāḥ etāḥ cāmuṇḍī ādi maharddhika antāḥ vilāsinyaḥ puṣpa ādi pañca upacāra hastāḥ khaḍga hasta ādyāḥ catasraḥ yathāruta cihnāḥ

original: [2.3.153] pañca yogini mahātattve sarvakāmānusādhakā iti: dīpinyādyāḥ kathitāḥ. yogamaṇḍalamahārājñī vajreśvarīti: jñānaḍākinīmaṇḍalam. prabhus tatheti: dikpālāḥ.
analyzed: pañca yogini mahātattve sarva kāma anusādhakāḥ iti dīpinī ādyāḥ kathitāḥ yoga maṇḍala mahārājñī vajreśvarī iti jñāna ḍākinī maṇḍalam prabhuḥ tathā iti dikpālāḥ

original: [2.3.154] tathāgatamahākāyeti: ete tathāgatarūpā ity arthaḥ. katham ity āha: nirañjayogasṛṣṭiketi: añjanam añjaḥ kleśaḥ, nirgato 'ñjo yasmin sati, sa nirañjaḥ. yogaḥ samādhiḥ. sṛṣṭikāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ. nirañjena yogena sṛṣṭāḥ sādhitā iti nirañjayogasṛṣṭikāśabdārthaḥ. idaṃ vajreśvarī ājñena āvāha sarvasarvinām iti:
analyzed: tathāgata mahākāya iti ete tathāgata rūpāḥ iti arthaḥ katham iti āha nirañja yoga sṛṣṭika iti añjanam añjaḥ kleśaḥ nirgataḥ ñjaḥ yasmin sati sa nirañjaḥ yogaḥ samādhiḥ sṛṣṭikāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ nirañjena yogena sṛṣṭāḥ sādhitāḥ iti nirañja yoga sṛṣṭika śabda arthaḥ idam vajreśvarī ājñena āvāha sarva sarvinām iti

original: idam ity anayā, vajreśvarī maṇḍalanāyikā jñānaḍākinī tasyā ājñā. anayā jñānaḍākinyājñayā pūrvoktamantralakṣaṇayā sarvathā bahirdevatā āvāhya vakṣyamāṇaṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: idam iti anayā vajreśvarī maṇḍalanāyikā jñānaḍākinī tasyāḥ ājñā anayā jñānaḍākinī ājñayā pūrva ukta mantra lakṣaṇayā sarvathā bahis devatāḥ āvāhya vakṣyamāṇam kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.3.155] tad evāha: oṃ ka kketyādi.
analyzed: tat eva āha om ka kka ityādi

original: [2.3.156] amṛta mukham āpūryeti: amṛteti baliḥ. pūrvoktena mantreṇāvāhya sarvadevatā maṇḍale dṛṣṭvā, oṃ ka kketyādimantreṇa devatānāṃ mukhaṃ pūrayed iti bhāvaḥ. padakarmādi cintitam iti: etad yac cintitaṃ, tat padakarmaśabdena bhaṇyate. tac ca śreṣṭham. atha vā: amṛtena madanena svamukhaṃ pūrayitvā pīkākāreṇa tan madanaṃ balau nikṣiptavyam.
analyzed: mukham āpūrya iti amṛta iti baliḥ pūrva uktena mantreṇa āvāhya sarva devatāḥ maṇḍale dṛṣṭvā om ka kka ityādi mantreṇa devatānām mukham pūrayet iti bhāvaḥ pada karma ādi cintitam iti etat yat cintitam tat pada karma śabdena bhaṇyate tat ca śreṣṭham atha vā amṛtena madanena sva mukham pūrayitvā pīka ākāreṇa tat madanam balau nikṣiptavyam

original: etad eva padakarmety upadeśaḥ. padakarmaśabdena nṛtyam iti kecit. paścān nṛtyaṃ vajrapadena kuryād iti bhāvaḥ. bhāvayed ityādi: itthaṃbhāvanayā yoginā yoginyā vā balir deya ity upasaṃhāraḥ. tena kiṃ syād ity āha: sarvakarmābhi sidhyatīti. śāntikādikarmety arthaḥ.
analyzed: etat eva padakarma iti upadeśaḥ padakarma śabdena nṛtyam iti kecid paścāt nṛtyam vajra padena kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ bhāvayet ityādi ittham bhāvanayā yoginā yoginyā vā baliḥ deyaḥ iti upasaṃhāraḥ tena kim syāt iti āha sarva karma abhi sidhyati iti śāntika ādi karma iti arthaḥ

original: [2.3.157] idānīṃ balidānamudrām āha: vajramuṣṭītyādi subodham.
analyzed: idānīm bali dāna mudrām āha vajra muṣṭi ityādi su bodham

original: [2.3.158] oṃ bhakṣetyādir asyā mantraḥ. etau mudrāmantrau vistarapakṣe darśitau. pūrvaṃ saṃkṣiptau darśitau.
analyzed: om bhakṣa ityādiḥ asyāḥ mantraḥ etau mudrā mantrau vistara pakṣe darśitau pūrvam saṃkṣiptau darśitau

original: [2.3.159] yathākarma saṃyujyeti: yasya karmaṇaḥ saṃyogas tatraivānena vidhinā balir deyaḥ.
analyzed: yathākarma saṃyujya iti yasya karmaṇaḥ saṃyogaḥ tatra eva anena vidhinā baliḥ deyaḥ

original: [2.3.160] śāntītyādi subodham. bali bāhyasya tattveneti: bāhyabalitattvam etad ity arthaḥ. anena tattvena bāhyadevatānāṃ balir deyaḥ. tena ca sarvakarmāṇi sidhyanti. ata āha: bali karmādi sādhayed iti.
analyzed: śānti ityādi su bodham bali bāhyasya tattvena iti bāhya bali tattvam etat iti arthaḥ anena tattvena bāhya devatānām baliḥ deyaḥ tena ca sarva karmāṇi sidhyanti atas āha bali karma ādi sādhayet iti

original: [2.3.161] idānīṃ guhyapūjām āha: athetyādi. pūjā viśeṣaṃ tv iti: viśeṣaṃ viśiṣṭā pūjety arthaḥ. sā hi vairocanādibhiḥ kriyamāṇatvād viśiṣṭā. ittham api kathaṃ viśiṣṭety āha: kalpākalpavivarjitam iti. kalpyata iti kalpaḥ, śucitvādinā vidhiḥ. tadviparīto 'kalpo 'vidhiḥ. tābhyāṃ varjito yato yogī bhavati.
analyzed: idānīm guhya pūjām āha atha ityādi pūjā viśeṣam tu iti viśeṣam viśiṣṭā pūjā iti arthaḥ sā hi vairocana ādibhiḥ kriyamāṇa tvāt viśiṣṭā ittham api katham viśiṣṭā iti āha kalpa akalpa vivarjitam iti kalpyate iti kalpaḥ śuci tva ādinā vidhiḥ tad viparītaḥ kalpaḥ vidhiḥ tābhyām varjitaḥ yatas yogī bhavati

original: vairocanādyabhyāso hi prākṛtavikalpaparihārāya. pūjām āha: aṅkuśādibhīti. aṅkuśās te ca pañca. pañca tattvānīti: pañcabhir vairocanādibhis tattvabhūtair devatārūpatvāt. kārayet śodhayet.
analyzed: vairocana ādi abhyāsaḥ hi prākṛta vikalpa parihārāya pūjām āha aṅkuśa ādibhiḥ iti aṅkuśāḥ te ca pañca pañca tattvāni iti pañcabhiḥ vairocana ādibhiḥ tattva bhūtaiḥ devatā rūpatvāt kārayet śodhayet

original: [2.3.162] ke te 'ṅkuśā ity āha: mahāṅkuśetyādi. mahāṅkuśanāmānam iti: mahāṅkuśanāmā nādiḥ. jñānadevata iṣṭavān iti: jñānadevatā vairocanaḥ. mahāṅkuśo vairocana iṣṭa ity arthaḥ. vajrāṅkuśo gādiḥ, sa cākṣobhyaḥ. sthānāṅkuśe ratnavān iti: sthānāṅkuśa ādiśvaḥ, sa ca ratnasaṃbhavaḥ.
analyzed: ke te ṅkuśāḥ iti āha mahā aṅkuśa ityādi mahāṅkuśa nāmānam iti mahāṅkuśa nāmā na ādiḥ jñānadevataḥ iṣṭavān iti jñānadevatā vairocanaḥ mahāṅkuśaḥ vairocanaḥ iṣṭaḥ iti arthaḥ vajrāṅkuśaḥ ga ādiḥ sa ca akṣobhyaḥ sthānāṅkuśe ratnavān iti sthānāṅkuśaḥ sa ca ratna saṃbhavaḥ

original: [2.3.163] amogha rājamahāṅkuśeti: rājamahāṅkuśo rājāṅkuśa ity arthaḥ. sa ceha hādiḥ, amoghasiddhirūpaḥ. amitābhaṃ cala-m-aṅkuśair iti: calāṅkuśo 'ntaśvaḥ, sa cāmitābhaḥ. ete cāṅkuśā vakṣyamāṇasvasvabījapariṇatavairocanādirūpeṇopayoktavyāḥ. etad evāha: pañca-m-aṅkuśa-m-ādīni sarvatattva prayojayed iti.
analyzed: rāja mahā aṅkuśa iti rāja mahā aṅkuśaḥ rājāṅkuśaḥ iti arthaḥ sa ca iha ha ādiḥ amogha siddhi rūpaḥ amita ābham calam aṅkuśaiḥ iti calāṅkuśaḥ sa ca amita ābhaḥ ete ca aṅkuśāḥ vakṣyamāṇa sva sva bīja pariṇata vairocana ādi rūpeṇa upayoktavyāḥ etat eva āha pañcamaṅkuśam ādīni sarva tattva prayojayet iti

original: pañcasv aṅkuśeṣu sarvatattvaṃ yathāsvaṃ devatātattvaṃ bhāvayet.
analyzed: pañcasu aṅkuśeṣu sarva tattvam yathāsvam devatā tattvam bhāvayet

original: [2.3.164] yadepsetyādi: yasmād īpsitaṃ tan mahāṅkuśādikaṃ tattvādhiṣṭhitaṃ sad bhavati. keṣām īpsitam ity āha: sarvadevasyeti. sarvayoginīnām ity arthaḥ. tatas tena sarvayoginīḥ prīṇayet, tarpayed ity arthaḥ. vinā bhedena samayam ācared ity āha: na tv ityādi. kāmaratāś caiveti: kāma icchā, tatra raktāḥ. yāvadicchaṃ yatheṣṭam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: yadā īpsā ityādi yasmāt īpsitam tat mahā aṅkuśa ādikam tattva adhiṣṭhitam sat bhavati keṣām īpsitam iti āha sarva devasya iti sarva yoginīnām iti arthaḥ tatas tena sarva yoginīḥ prīṇayet tarpayet iti arthaḥ vinā bhedena samayam ācaret iti āha na tu ityādi kāma ratāḥ ca eva iti kāmaḥ icchā tatra raktāḥ yāvadiccham yatheṣṭam iti arthaḥ

original: tathā nācared

original: ekaikasyāmṛtasya pañcātmakatvāt pañcaviṃśatyātmakatvaṃ pañcāmṛtasya. pañcāmṛtāni yasmiñ jāte tat pañcāmṛtam. vajrāmbu-ātmaśodhana iti: itthaṃ vajrāmbuśodhane sati bhogād bhāvābhāvavinirmukto yogī syād iti jñeyam. vajrāmbuna upalakṣaṇatvād anyeṣām apy amṛtānām ācaraṇād bhāvābhāvavinirmukta iti siddham.

original: bhāva utpādo 'bhāvo 'nutpādaḥ, tābhyāṃ varjitaś cirāvasthitatvāt. tasmān mohāni dūrata iti: yata evaṃ tato moho 'śucijñānaṃ dūrato varjanīya iti bhāvaḥ. atha vā tathābhūtena krameṇa bodhicitte bhukte moho dūrato 'vasthita iti. evam anyatrāmṛte draṣṭavyam.
analyzed: bhāvaḥ utpādaḥ bhāvaḥ nutpādaḥ tābhyām varjitaḥ cira avasthita tvāt tasmāt mohāni dūratas iti yatas evam tatas śuci jñānam dūratas varjanīyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ atha vā tathābhūtena krameṇa bodhi citte bhukte mohaḥ dūratas vasthitaḥ iti evam anyatra amṛte draṣṭavyam

original: [2.4.9] bāhyāmṛtetyādi: yathā bāhyaṃ vastu vahnipākavikopitaṃ sad amṛtavat sudravyaṃ bhavaty evaṃ kukṣyādyā vairocanādayaḥ. kukṣisaṃbhūtatvāt kukṣir vairocanaḥ. ādiśabdād akṣobhyādayaḥ. kiṃbhūtā ete 'mṛtībhavantīty āha: jñāna-m-agniṃ tu ucchiṣṭā iti. śodhanajñānāgnijuṣṭā jñānāgninā pakvā ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: bāhya amṛta ityādi yathā bāhyam vastu vahni pāka vikopitam sat amṛta vat su dravyam bhavati evam kukṣi ādyāḥ vairocana ādayaḥ kukṣi saṃbhūta tvāt kukṣiḥ vairocanaḥ ādi śabdāt akṣobhya ādayaḥ kiṃbhūtāḥ ete mṛtībhavanti iti āha jñānam agnim tu ucchiṣṭāḥ iti śodhana jñāna agni juṣṭāḥ jñāna agninā pakvāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: yathā bāhyaṃ vastu pakvaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ bhavati tathā vairocanādayo 'pi jñānāgnipakvā muktaprakṛtirūpā viśiṣṭā bhavantīti bhāvaḥ. tathāpi ke ta ity āha: viṭ dravā iti. viḍ vairocanaḥ, dravo 'kṣobhyaḥ.
analyzed: yathā bāhyam vastu pakvam viśiṣṭam bhavati tathā vairocana ādayaḥ pi jñāna agni pakvāḥ mukta prakṛti rūpāḥ viśiṣṭāḥ bhavanti iti bhāvaḥ tathā api ke te iti āha viś dravā iti viś vairocanaḥ kṣobhyaḥ

original: [2.4.10] agnipācaṃ tu m-agnīnām iti: pūrvaṃ tāvac charīravahninā pakvā idānīṃ jñānāgnineti bhāvaḥ. bodhicittaṃ vairocanam akṣobhyaṃ ca śodhanāgnipakvaṃ bhakṣayet. etad evāha: tasya madhye tu āhuta iti. tasya śarīrasya madhye tenāhutir deyā. vajrāmbu yasya bījena japaṃ caiva sabījateti: vajrāmbu yena bījena śodhitaṃ tad eva bījaṃ japet.
analyzed: agni pācam tu m agnīnām iti pūrvam tāvat śarīra vahninā pakvāḥ idānīm jñāna agninā iti bhāvaḥ bodhi cittam vairocanam akṣobhyam ca śodhana agni pakvam bhakṣayet etat eva āha tasya madhye tu āhutaḥ iti tasya śarīrasya madhye tena āhutiḥ deyā vajra ambu yasya bījena japam ca eva sa bīja tā iti vajra ambu yena bījena śodhitam tat eva bījam japet

original: prajñopāyasamāpattau viśuddhyarthaṃ draṣṭavyam. ata āha: sabījateti. saha bījena mantrākṣareṇa vartata iti sabījo yas tasya bhāvaḥ sabījatā samāpattau. vajrābjaśodhanaṃ tatra tatra nirdekṣyati. atha vā yena bījena vajrāmbuśodhanaṃ tenaiva bhakṣaṇam iti granthārthaḥ.
analyzed: prajñā upāya samāpattau viśuddhi artham draṣṭavyam atas āha sa bīja tā iti saha bījena mantra akṣareṇa vartate iti sa bījaḥ yaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ sabīja tā samāpattau vajra abja śodhanam tatra tatra nirdekṣyati atha vā yena bījena vajra ambu śodhanam tena eva bhakṣaṇam iti grantha arthaḥ

original: [2.4.11] ata āha: tasya madhya iti. tasya bodhicittasya madhye 'kārasya japaḥ kartavya iti bhāvaḥ. na kevalam akāraḥ kiṃ tarhi kṣuṃkāro 'pīty āha: jvālārkaṃ tv ityādi. ciccākṣaraṃ kṣuṃkāraḥ. jvālāmālākulaṃ bhānusamaprabhaṃ kṣuṃkāraṃ ca japed ity arthaḥ. a kṣuṃ iti japtavyam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: atas āha tasya madhye iti tasya bodhi cittasya madhye kārasya japaḥ kartavyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ na kevalam akāraḥ kim tarhi āha jvālā arkam tu ityādi cit ca akṣaram kṣuṃkāraḥ jvālā mālā ākulam bhānu sama prabham kṣuṃkāram ca japet iti arthaḥ a kṣuṃ iti japtavyam iti arthaḥ

original: [2.4.12] padmeśvaram ityādi ...
analyzed: padmeśvaram ityādi
