analyzed: vyākhyātam eva

original: [2.4.14] amṛtodakanāmasya tribhir devābhi kīrtita iti. ete bodhicittādyā lokeśvarādirūpā amṛtanāmānas te ca traya iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: amṛtodaka nāmasya tribhiḥ kīrtitaḥ iti ete bodhi citta ādyāḥ lokeśvara ādi rūpāḥ amṛta nāmānaḥ te ca trayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.4.15] pañcāmṛtapraśnavisarjanānantaram alikālipraśnavisarjanam āha: alītyādi. akrameṇa praśnavisarjanaṃ cānabhiniveśasūcanāya. anupamaṃ sukharasaṃ lāty ādatte 'nenety alir ity asminn arthe 'yam aliśabdaḥ. śabdāpaśabdayor anāsthā, kalpitatvāt. tato 'yam alir upāya ucyate. vajram ity arthaḥ. hevajratantre tv āliśabdasyākāro dīrgha eva.
analyzed: pañcāmṛta praśna visarjana anantaram alikāli praśna visarjanam āha ali ityādi akrameṇa praśna visarjanam ca anabhiniveśa sūcanāya anupamam sukha rasam ādatte nena iti aliḥ iti asmin arthe yam ali śabdaḥ śabda apaśabdayoḥ anāsthā kalpita tvāt tatas yam aliḥ upāyaḥ ucyate vajram iti arthaḥ hevajratantre tu āli śabdasya akāraḥ dīrghaḥ eva

original: sa cāliśabdaḥ prajñāvācakaḥ. ayaṃ tv aliśabda upāyābhidhāyī. bhramareti: bhramaṃ rahayaty aneneti bhramaraḥ. bhramarā vajrabhairaveti: bahavo ramante 'neneti vajram. bhairavo bhayado bālānām advayapratītihetutvāt. ali bhramaro vajrabhairava ity upāyaparyāyāḥ. bodhicittasya saṃjñām āha: alim ākāśa paryantaṃ dharmadhātu svabhāvata iti.
analyzed: sa ca ali śabdaḥ prajñā vācakaḥ ayam tu ali śabdaḥ upāya abhidhāyī bhramara iti bhramam rahayati anena iti bhramaraḥ bhramarāḥ vajrabhairava iti bahavaḥ ramante nena iti vajram bhairavaḥ bhaya daḥ bālānām advaya pratīti hetu tvāt ali bhramaraḥ vajrabhairavaḥ iti upāya paryāyāḥ bodhi cittasya saṃjñām āha alim ākāśa paryantam dharmadhātu svabhāvataḥ iti

original: avakāśanta utpadyante sattvā asmād iti alir ākāśam. pari samantāt sukham antati badhnātīti paryantam. ati adi bandhana iti dhātuḥ. svalakṣaṇadhāraṇād dharmāḥ sattvās tān dadhāti puṣṇātīti dharmadhātuḥ. svasmin bhavatīti svabhāvaḥ. prathamārthe svabhāvata iti. alir ākāśaṃ dharmadhātuḥ svabhāva iti bodhicittasya paryāyāḥ.
analyzed: avakāśantaḥ utpadyante sattvāḥ asmāt iti aliḥ ākāśam pari samantāt sukham badhnāti iti paryantam ati bandhane iti dhātuḥ sva lakṣaṇa dhāraṇāt dharmāḥ sattvāḥ tān dadhāti puṣṇāti iti dharmadhātuḥ svasmin bhavati iti svabhāvaḥ prathama arthe svabhāvataḥ iti aliḥ ākāśam dharmadhātuḥ svabhāvaḥ iti bodhi cittasya paryāyāḥ

original: [2.4.16] katham asyeyaṃ vyutpattir ity āha: sakaletyādi. nityam atiśayena caranty akārye saṃsarantīti carāḥ pṛthagjanāḥ. nākārye nityam atiśayena carantīty acarāḥ prekṣāpūrvakāriṇaḥ. dehānām iti dehinaḥ. sakalāḥ sarvadehinaḥ. saha carācarair vartanta iti sacarācarā dharmadhātor evotpadyante.
analyzed: katham asya iyam vyutpattiḥ iti āha sakala ityādi nityam atiśayena caranti akārye saṃsaranti iti carāḥ pṛthagjanāḥ na akārye nityam atiśayena caranti iti acarāḥ prekṣā pūrva kāriṇaḥ dehānām iti dehinaḥ sakalāḥ sarva dehinaḥ saha carācaraiḥ vartante iti sacarācarāḥ dharmadhātoḥ eva utpadyante

original: na kevalam eta evotpadyante kiṃ tarhi guhyadhiyo 'pīty āha: guhyadhīr iti. guhyata iti guhyaṃ tattvaṃ prajñopāyātmakaṃ jñānaṃ, tatra dhīr yeṣāṃ te guhyadhiyo buddhabodhisattvāḥ. te 'py anabhiniviṣṭāḥ sattvārthakaraṇaṃ prati dharmadhātor evotpadyanta iti bhāvaḥ. prasaṅgād bodhicittasyāpi saṃjñākathanam: aṣṭādaśetyādi.
analyzed: na kevalam ete eva utpadyante kim tarhi guhya dhiyaḥ pi iti āha guhya dhīḥ iti guhyate iti guhyam tattvam prajñā upāya ātmakam jñānam tatra dhīḥ yeṣām te guhya dhiyaḥ buddha bodhisattvāḥ te pi anabhiniviṣṭāḥ sattva artha karaṇam prati dharmadhātoḥ eva utpadyante iti bhāvaḥ prasaṅgāt bodhi cittasya api saṃjñā kathanam aṣṭādaśa ityādi

original: stanādyaṣṭādaśasu sthāneṣu yad amṛtaṃ prāg uktaṃ bodhicittaṃ, tac ca sarati galatīti sarvaṃ, tathābhūtaṃ sad indati sukhadānaṃ praty ādhipatyaṃ karotīndriyam.
analyzed: stana ādi aṣṭādaśasu sthāneṣu yat amṛtam prāk uktam bodhi cittam tat ca sarati galati iti sarvam tathābhūtam sat indati sukha dānam prati ādhipatyam karoti indriyam

original: [2.4.17] tasya madhye tu m-ākṛṣyeti: tasyeti tat. madhye tv iti madhyaviśrāntatvān madhyam ākṛṣṭam. ālīty aliḥ. etena bodhicittam evāvartitam. madhye tu līyata iti: kamalakuliśavaraṭakamadhye līyate. tatra śliṣṭaṃ kāryam ity arthaḥ. aṣṭādaśāṅgasthaṃ yad bodhicittaṃ tad ākṛṣṭaṃ kamalakuliśavaraṭakamadhyagataṃ kāryam iti samudāyārthaḥ.
analyzed: tasya madhye tu mā ākṛṣya iti tasya iti tat madhye tu iti madhya viśrānta tvāt madhyam ākṛṣṭam āliḥ iti aliḥ etena bodhi cittam eva āvartitam madhye tu līyate iti kamala kuliśa varaṭaka madhye līyate tatra śliṣṭam kāryam iti arthaḥ aṣṭādaśa aṅga stham yat bodhi cittam tat ākṛṣṭam kamala kuliśa varaṭaka madhya gatam kāryam iti samudāya arthaḥ

original: katham ākraṣṭavyam ity āha: bhairavaṃ vajranādeneti. kuliśāsphālaneneti bhāvaḥ. utpanno dravya yogata iti: dvīndriyayogata utpannaṃ tad amṛtaṃ dravyaṃ bhavati.
analyzed: katham ākraṣṭavyam iti āha bhairavam vajra nādena iti kuliśa āsphālanena iti bhāvaḥ utpannaḥ yogataḥ iti dvi indriya yogataḥ utpannam tat amṛtam dravyam bhavati

original: [2.4.18] katham ity āha: aniletyādi. atha vā yogata iti (17d) devatāyogataḥ. yogata utpannaṃ bodhicittaṃ dravyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhavati. prakārāntareṇāpi śreṣṭhatvam ity āha: aniletyādi. anilo yakāraḥ. analo rephaḥ. arthyata ity artha upādeyaḥ. tāvat sādhanaṃ mṛgyate yāvad artho labhyate. tataḥ sādhanamārgaṇasyārtho 'nto bhavati.
analyzed: katham iti āha anila ityādi atha vā yogataḥ iti devatā yogataḥ yogataḥ utpannam bodhi cittam dravyam śreṣṭham bhavati prakāra antareṇa api śreṣṭha tvam iti āha anila ityādi anilaḥ yakāraḥ analaḥ rephaḥ arthyataḥ iti arthaḥ upādeyaḥ tāvat sādhanam mṛgyate yāvat arthaḥ labhyate tatas sādhana mārgaṇasya arthaḥ ntaḥ bhavati

original: tenārtho 'nta iti paryāyau. saptīnām ādityāśvānām artho 'ntaḥ saptamas turaga ity arthaḥ. tena saptyarthaśabdenādityaturagaḥ saptamaḥ. saptamatvena sādharmyāt saptyarthaḥ sakāro hakāraś ca, yato yakārarephayor yathāsaṃkhyaṃ tau saptamau. vajrībījaṃ sakāraḥ. sa cāmṛtasvabhāvatvād ardhacandrasya paryāyaḥ.
analyzed: tena arthaḥ ntaḥ iti paryāyau saptīnām āditya aśvānām arthaḥ ntaḥ saptamaḥ turagaḥ iti arthaḥ tena sapti artha śabdena āditya turagaḥ saptamaḥ saptama tvena sādharmyāt sapti arthaḥ sakāraḥ hakāraḥ ca yatas yakāra rephayoḥ yathāsaṃkhyam tau saptamau vajrī bījam sakāraḥ sa ca amṛta svabhāva tvāt ardhacandrasya paryāyaḥ

original: tataś ca vajrībījaṃ sakāro 'rdhacandra iti paryāyāḥ. tena yojayed dhakāram iti yojyam. hakārasya śirasy ardhacandraṃ dadyād ity arthaḥ. bindunādasamutkrāntam iti: ardhacandropari binduḥ. adhastān nāda ūkāraḥ. tābhyāṃ samutkrānta ākrānto hakāraḥ. tena hūṃ iti syāt. ayaṃ ca kuliśavaraṭakamadhye dhyātavyaḥ.
analyzed: tatas ca vajrī bījam sakāraḥ rdhacandraḥ iti paryāyāḥ tena yojayet dhakāram iti yojyam hakārasya śirasi ardhacandram dadyāt iti arthaḥ bindu nāda samutkrāntam iti ardhacandra upari binduḥ adhastāt nādaḥ ūkāraḥ tābhyām samutkrāntaḥ ākrāntaḥ hakāraḥ tena hūm iti syāt ayam ca kuliśa varaṭaka madhye dhyātavyaḥ

original: [2.4.19] tatra madhye tu candrasya amṛtākṣara madhyagam ity (7cd) uddiṣṭam akāram uddhāreṇa nirdiśann āha: svaretyādi. svarapūrvaṃ bījam akāraḥ. tac cādibhūtaṃ śreṣṭhatvāt. śeṣaṃ subodham.
analyzed: tatra madhye tu candrasya amṛta akṣara madhya gam iti uddiṣṭam akāram uddhāreṇa nirdiśan āha svara ityādi svara pūrvam bījam akāraḥ tat ca ādi bhūtam śreṣṭha tvāt śeṣam su bodham

original: [2.4.20] prajñāpraśnavisarjanam āha: kālītyādi. kaṃ sukham āleḍhi samāsvādaty asyām iti kāliḥ. strītvaṃ prajñārūpatvāt. dharmodayāyā abhidhānam etat. puṣpati vajrāsphālanena vikasatīti puṣpam. kāliḥ puṣpam iti paryāyau. ākrānta puṣpavigraha vajriṇām iti:
analyzed: āha kālī ityādi kam sukham āleḍhi samāsvādati asyām iti kāliḥ strī tvam prajñā rūpa tvāt dharmodayāyāḥ abhidhānam etat vajra āsphālanena vikasati iti puṣpam kāliḥ puṣpam iti paryāyau ākrānta puṣpa vigraha vajriṇām iti

original: tatra puṣpābhidhānāyāṃ trikoṇāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ viśvapadmavajragarbhāyāṃ dharmodayāyāṃ vajradharo mahāsukharūpa ākrāmyati viharati. tathā cāha:
analyzed: tatra puṣpa abhidhānāyām trikoṇāyām śuklāyām viśva padma vajra garbhāyām dharma udayāyām vajradharaḥ mahā sukha rūpaḥ ākrāmyati viharati tathā ca āha

analyzed: sukhasya rakṣaṇāt eva sukhāvatī iti śabditam

original: iti. na kevalaṃ mahāsukharūpīty āha: puṣpavigraheti. puṣpeti bodhicittasyāpi saṃjñā. puṣpaṃ bodhicittaṃ vigrahaḥ śarīram asyeti puṣpavigrahaḥ. tathā cāha hevajre:
analyzed: iti na kevalam mahā sukha rūpī iti āha puṣpa vigraha iti puṣpa iti bodhi cittasya api saṃjñā puṣpam bodhi cittam vigrahaḥ śarīram asya iti puṣpa vigrahaḥ tathā ca āha hevajre

original: śukrākāro bhaved bhagavān

original: iti. saṃsārotpatti sarveṣu mātaraṃ sarvabhūminam iti: sā ca kāliḥ sarveṣāṃ saṃsārotpattikāraṇam. ata eva mātā. sarvabhūminam iti: sarvāsu gatiṣu.

original: [2.4.21] jñānāmbusamudro 'sāv iti: asau kāliḥ. jñānānām ādarśādīnāṃ tāpapraśamanahetutvād ambusadṛśānām ādhārabhūtatvena samudraḥ. ata eva saiva prajñā. prapañcarahitaṃ jñānaṃ jñāyate yasyām iti prajñā. prapañcarahitajñānābhyāsād dhi sarvāṇy ādarśādijñānāny utpadyante. makaramīnakair iti: viśuddharāgādirūpā buddhās ta eva makaramīnakāḥ. tathā cāha:

original: [2.4.23] kṣuṃkārasyoddhāram āha: dviguṇetyādi. dviguṇākṣaraṃ kṣakāraḥ, kakāraṣakārayoḥ samudāyarūpatvāt. kṣakāraṃ mūrdhni bindunā mūle ca nādena yojayet. kṣuṃ iti syāt. tad akṣaraṃ bījabhūtaṃ devatānāṃ yoginīnāṃ kulamātā. atha vā devatā vahnidevatā, tasyāḥ kulamātā. tato bodhicitte tad dhyāyāt.
analyzed: kṣuṃkārasya uddhāram āha dviguṇa ityādi dviguṇa akṣaram kṣakāraḥ kakāra ṣakārayoḥ samudāya rūpa tvāt kṣakāram mūrdhni bindunā mūle ca nādena yojayet   iti syāt tat akṣaram bīja bhūtam devatānām yoginīnām kula mātā atha vā devatā vahni devatā tasyāḥ kula mātā tatas bodhi citte tat dhyāyāt

original: [2.4.24] bodhicittamadhyacandrastham akāraṃ dhyātvā kṣuṃkāram arkatejasaṃ dhyāyād ity āha: candretyādi. tatra madhye tu candrasya amṛtākṣara madhyagam ity (7cd) upasaṃhāravākyam idam. pravṛttikāle cākāraṃ padmakarṇikāyāṃ dhyāyād iti jñeyam. bhāvetyādi subodham.

original: [2.4.25] bahirupāyo 'pi yaḥ so 'py aliḥ, bahiḥprajñā ca kālir ity āha: alītyādi. tathāgatīti: tathāviparītaṃ gacchati jānāty asyām iti tathāgatī prajñaiva. ubhayor anayor bāhyayor alikālyor alikāliyogajaṃ yad bodhicittam amṛtaṃ vidhinā sevyamānam uttamaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ.

original: [2.4.26] idānīṃ vyaktidvāreṇākāram uddharati: yathetyādi. etac ca vyākhyātakalpam. kiṃ ca ḍakārasyādhastād daṇḍaṃ dattvā mantram uddharet. yathā a iti mantrabījaṃ, na tu a iti ḍakāraṣakārasamudāyaḥ. ḍakāradaṇḍayoḥ samudāyo 'tra tantre akārasya vyaktiḥ. uccāraṇaṃ tu samānam eva. vyaktiḥ paraṃ bhidyate.

original: [2.4.27] ebhir ityādi: etat pañcāmṛtaṃ tattvam, anenātmanaḥ śarīrasya kṣālanaṃ dehinām. amṛtā ityādi: pañcāmṛtaṃ ye viśeṣata itthaṃ śodhanaviśeṣeṇa jānanti bhakṣayantīti yāvat, te 'mṛtā na mṛtā iti bhāvaḥ. mṛtyumāro na bhavatīti yāvat.

original: [2.4.28] atha maraṇaṃ syāt. tadāmṛtānāṃ gatidvārāṇi devamanuṣyagatayaḥ śuddhībhavantīti. samālokyeti draṣṭavyam ity arthaḥ. kasyāṃ gatāv ity āha: kāyasya yatra ceti. kāyasya śarīrasya yasyām utpādas tasyām iti bhāvaḥ.

original: atha vā yogajam amṛtaṃ bodhicittaṃ eva kevalam ājñātam adhiṣṭhitaṃ svecchayā svādayanti ye te 'py amṛtā bhavantīti yogetyādi gāthārdhasyārthaḥ.

original: [2.4.29] aṅkuśapraśnavisarjanam āha: śṛṇv ityādi. he vajrapāṇe, pañca bhakṣyāṇi pañcāṅkuśān śṛṇv iti saṃbandhaḥ. yathātattvam ity aviparītatvena. viśeṣata iti pūrvoktakramād viśeṣeṇety arthaḥ. yenetyādi: yeṣām aṅkuśānāṃ jñānapūrvakabhakṣaṇena gatir mokṣaḥ śīghraṃ dṛṣṭaḥ, ihaiva janmani mokṣasaṃbhavāt, anyatrāsaṃkhyeyakalpadurlabhatvāt tasya.

original: [2.4.31] vijñānabījaśabdena hūṃkāraḥ, tasya japas tatra mahāṅkuśe kartavyaḥ. etad evāha: jāpānām iti. hūṃkāras tatra madhye dhyeya ity arthaḥ. bhakṣa sphaṭikacitteneti: vikalpamalavirahitena cittena bhakṣayed iti bhāvaḥ.

original: [2.4.32] ekam aṅkuśa vighnasyeti: vighnāṅkuśo hastī. mahāṅkuśavighnāṅkuśayor ekam evādhiṣṭhānam ekabījatvāt. ata āha: tasyetyādi. hūṃkāraṃ vighnāṅkuśe 'pi dhyāyād ity arthaḥ.

original: [2.4.33] sthānādhipatyam aṅkuśyā iti: sthānādhipatiḥ śvā, svasthāne balīyastvāt. prayojyaṃ tatra kāraṇād iti: tatra prayogaḥ kartavya iti bhāvaḥ. kenety āha: ghriṃkāreṇa tu bījasyeti. ghriṃbījenādhiṣṭhātavyam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: sthāna ādhipatyam aṅkuśyāḥ iti sthāna adhipatiḥ śvā sva sthāne balīyaḥ tvāt prayojyam tatra kāraṇāt iti tatra prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ kena iti āha ghriṃkāreṇa tu bījasya iti ghriṃbījena adhiṣṭhātavyam iti arthaḥ

original: [2.4.34] hayāṅkuśam adhiṣṭhetum ākṛti sarva sarvavid iti: hayāṅkuśākṛtiṃ sarvathā sarvavid yogy adhitiṣṭhet. kenety āha: jriṃkāreṇa tv iti. turagāṅkuśe jriṃbījaṃ dhyeyam iti bhāvaḥ.

analyzed: vajrāṅkuśaḥ gauḥ sa sriṃbījena adhiṣṭhātavyaḥ tatas kim syāt iti āha sriṃkāra adhiṣṭhāna pūrvakam bhakṣitena ga ādi samayena vajra kāyaḥ bhavati yogī ebhiḥ sarvaiḥ aṅkuśaiḥ pāpa kṣālanam ca bhavati ete hi atyartham siddhim kuśnanti iti aṅkusāḥ

original: [2.4.36] balikālam āha: aṣṭamyām ityādi. devatāyoginā yathāvidhānam āsu tithiṣv ebhir dravyair anyaiś ca balir deyaḥ. katham ity āha: yatneneti. niyamena.

original: [2.4.37] nityaṃ ca pūjayā siddhiḥ syād ity āha: nityetyādi. yadepsā bhuktimuktivad iti: bhuktir bhogaḥ svargādilakṣaṇaḥ. muktir mokṣo buddhatvam.
analyzed: nityam ca pūjayā siddhiḥ syāt iti āha nitya ityādi yadā īpsā bhukti mukti vat iti bhuktiḥ bhogaḥ svarga ādi lakṣaṇaḥ muktiḥ mokṣaḥ buddhatvam

original: [2.4.38] sidhyante sarvakarmāṇīti (37c) yad uktaṃ tad darśayann āha: rājakuletyādi. rājakulaṃ daśadravyakṛtāṃ gulikām āsvādya jñānaḍākinīyogavān praviśati yadi tadā śīghrataraṃ śrīyukto bhavati. priyāpriyatamam iti: anenaiva krameṇāpriyatamaḥ priyo bhavati. icched darśanaṃ cāpi sidhyatīti: īpsitadarśanaṃ sidhyati.

original: [2.4.39] daridro 'rthārthī yadi tadarddhiḥ sphītā bhavati. gṛhāṇi ca gṛhārthinām iti bhāvaḥ. cyutītyādi sugamam.
analyzed: daridraḥ ṛtha arthī yadi tadā ṛddhiḥ sphītā bhavati gṛhāṇi ca gṛha arthinām iti bhāvaḥ cyuti ityādi sugamam

original: [2.4.40] daśa dravyāṇīti: amṛtāni pañca, vairocanaratnasaṃbhavāmitābhāmoghasiddhyakṣobhyāḥ. amoghasiddhiḥ kheṭaḥ. pañca ca gokudahanāḥ. gandhena saha yojitair ebhir dhūpād ātmano jagatsaṃmohako yogī bhavati (41cd). kathaṃ kṛtvety āha: daśa-akṣaretyādi.
analyzed: daśa dravyāṇi iti amṛtāni pañca vairocana ratna saṃbhava amitābhā moghasiddhi akṣobhyāḥ amoghasiddhiḥ kheṭaḥ pañca ca gokudahanāḥ gandhena saha yojitaiḥ ebhiḥ dhūpāt ātmanaḥ jagat saṃmohakaḥ yogī bhavati katham kṛtvā iti āha daśa akṣara ityādi

original: vairocanaratnasaṃbhavāmitābhāmoghasiddhyakṣobhyāṇāṃ bījāni huṃ hūṃ kṣuṃ yuṃ suṃ iti yathākramaṃ draṣṭavyāni. gokudahanānāṃ ca sriṃ ghriṃ hūṃ jriṃ hūṃ iti bījāni. oṃ huṃ hūṃ kṣuṃ yuṃ suṃ sriṃ ghriṃ hūṃ jriṃ hūṃ svāheti mantraḥ.
analyzed: vairocana ratna saṃbhava amitābhā amoghasiddhi akṣobhyāṇām bījāni hum hūm kṣuṃ yum suṃ iti yathākramam draṣṭavyāni go ku dahanānām ca sriṃ ghriṃ hūm jriṃ hūm iti bījāni om hum hūm kṣuṃ yum sum sriṃ ghriṃ hūm jriṃ hūm svāhā iti mantraḥ

original: [2.4.41] asya mantrasya daśākṣarasya jñānaḍākinīyoginā balidānapūrvakaṃ lakṣaṃ japtvā pūrvasevā kāryā. tatas tena mantreṇāṣṭottaraśatajapto dhūpo grāhyaḥ. uttaratrāpy ayam eva mantraḥ. ata āha: lakṣetyādi. tathaiva pūrvasevā kāryety arthaḥ.
analyzed: asya mantrasya daśa akṣarasya jñāna ḍākinī yoginā bali dāna pūrvakam lakṣam japtvā pūrva sevā kāryā tatas tena mantreṇa aṣṭottaraśata japtaḥ dhūpaḥ grāhyaḥ uttaratra api ayam eva mantraḥ atas āha lakṣa ityādi tathā eva pūrva sevā kāryā iti arthaḥ

original: [2.4.42–45] ebhiḥ karmasya yoktavyam iti: ebhir dravyair yuktaṃ candanādikaṃ yathoktasādhakam iti nāsti saṃdehaḥ. etad evāha: ahaṃvākyaṃ na saṃśaya iti. mama vākyam etad ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: ebhiḥ karmasya yoktavyam iti ebhiḥ dravyaiḥ yuktam candana ādikam yathā ukta sādhakam iti na asti saṃdehaḥ etat eva āha ahaṃvākyam na saṃśayaḥ iti mama vākyam etat iti arthaḥ

original: [2.4.46] idānīm yoginīsādhanam āha: bhagavann ityādi. †...† dīpinyādicaturyoginīsādhanam. kimarthaṃ dūtīsādhanam ity āha: dūtītyādi. yoginīnām ātmīkaraṇārtham ity arthaḥ. ātmīkaraṇam eva kimartham ity āha: kim idaṃ siddhi yoginīti. kimartham idam ātmīkaraṇam? yataḥ siddhāsu satīṣu yoginīṣu sarvakarmasādhako yogī bhavati.
analyzed: idānīm yoginī sādhanam āha bhagavan ityādi dīpinī ādi catur yoginī sādhanam kimartham dūtī sādhanam iti āha dūtī ityādi yoginīnām ātmīkaraṇa artham iti arthaḥ ātmīkaraṇam eva kimartham iti āha kim idam siddhi yogini iti kimartham idam ātmīkaraṇam yatas siddhāsu satīṣu yoginīṣu sarva karma sādhakaḥ yogī bhavati

original: [2.4.47] ata āha: sarvetyādi. sarvaṃ karmābhisārapradhānaṃ, tatsiddhyarthaṃ samartho bhavatīty āśayaḥ. tato yatnena dūtīḥ sādhayet.
analyzed: atas āha sarva ityādi sarvam karma abhisāra pradhānam tad siddhi artham samarthaḥ bhavati iti āśayaḥ tatas yatnena dūtīḥ sādhayet

original: [2.4.48] sādhanam āha: ekavṛkṣasyetyādi. ekavṛkṣamūle vidhinā balidānapūrvakaṃ mantrī samayārādhanatatparo mantraṃ lakṣaṃ japtvā dūtīṃ vakṣyamāṇāṃ prasādhayed ity arthaḥ. japam evāha: pauruṣāpādetyādi. pauruṣaṃ hastamātram. pādo hastasya caturtho bhāgaḥ. sapādahastamātraṃ paṭaṃ vistārya dūtīṃ sādhayed iti saṃbandhaḥ. rūpādi cintitam iti:
analyzed: sādhanam āha eka vṛkṣasya ityādi eka vṛkṣa mūle vidhinā bali dāna pūrvakam mantrī samaya ārādhana tatparaḥ mantram lakṣam japtvā dūtīm vakṣyamāṇām prasādhayet iti arthaḥ japam eva āha pauruṣā pāda ityādi pauruṣam hasta mātram pādaḥ hastasya caturthaḥ bhāgaḥ sa pāda hasta mātram paṭam vistārya dūtīm sādhayet iti saṃbandhaḥ rūpa ādi cintitam iti

original: yathācintitaṃ dīpinīrūpaṃ lekhyam iti bhāvaḥ. avadhūtādikarpaṭe likhanīyam ity upadeśaḥ.
analyzed: yathā cintitam dīpinī rūpam lekhyam iti bhāvaḥ avadhūta ādi karpaṭe likhanīyam iti upadeśaḥ

original: [2.4.49] dīpinīrūpam āha: dvādaśetyādi. dvādaśāṅgulapramāṇā pītavarṇam ityādiviśeṣaṇā dīpinī likhanīyā. tayā paṭa ākrānta iti boddhavyam. evaṃvidhaṃ paṭam agrato vistṛtaṃ kṛtvā sādhako dīpinīṃ sādhayed iti jñeyam.
analyzed: dīpinī rūpam āha dvādaśa ityādi dvādaśa aṅgula pramāṇā pīta varṇam iti ādi viśeṣaṇā dīpinī likhanīyā tayā paṭaḥ ākrāntaḥ iti boddhavyam evaṃvidham paṭam agratas vistṛtam kṛtvā sādhakaḥ dīpinīm sādhayet iti jñeyam

original: [2.4.50] vidhipūjādīti: raktapuṣpagandhādi (51a).
analyzed: vidhi pūjā ādi iti rakta puṣpa gandha ādi

original: [2.4.51] śuṣkamāṃsādi dhūpayed iti: pūjāṃ paṭasyāgrataḥ kṛtvā śuṣkamāṃsadhūpaṃ dadyāt.
analyzed: śuṣka māṃsa ādi dhūpayet iti pūjām paṭasya agratas kṛtvā śuṣka māṃsa dhūpam dadyāt

original: [2.4.52] tato baliṃ dattvā daśavastubhiḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā lakṣamantreṇa kṛtapūrvasevaḥ punar api mantraṃ lakṣaṃ japet. pañca vastūni pañcāmṛtam. pañca dravyāṇi gokudahanāḥ.
analyzed: tatas balim dattvā daśa vastubhiḥ pūjām kṛtvā lakṣa mantreṇa kṛta pūrva sevaḥ punar api mantram lakṣam japet pañca vastūni pañca amṛtam pañca dravyāṇi goku dahanāḥ

original: [2.4.53] āgatāyā dūtyā mudrāṃ darśayed ity āha: samayetyādi.
analyzed: āgatāyāḥ dūtyāḥ mudrām darśayet iti āha samaya ityādi

original: [2.4.54] oṃ ityādimantro japyaḥ.
analyzed: om ityādi mantraḥ japyaḥ

original: [2.4.55–56] dvau hastetyādi samayamudrā. uccared iti: mudrādarśanakāle 'py amum eva mantram uccārayed ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: dvau hasta ityādi samayamudrā uccaret iti mudrā darśana kāle pi amum eva mantram uccārayet iti arthaḥ

original: [2.4.57] pañcāmṛtena pūrayitvā kapālaṃ samayodakaṃ dadyād ity āha: pañcetyādi. samayā dāpya vṛtteneti: samayodakadāne vṛtte vāmahastena tāṃ gṛhītvā ...
analyzed: pañcāmṛtena pūrayitvā kapālam samaya udakam dadyāt iti āha pañca ityādi samayāḥ dāpya vṛttena iti samaya udaka dāne vṛtte vāma hastena tām gṛhītvā

original: [2.4.58] ... siddhāsīty abhidhāya dvayobhi samadhiṣṭhayed iti dvīndriyasamāpattiṃ kuryād iti samudāyārthaḥ. śeṣaṃ subodham. bhakṣyādikaṃ sādhakāya sā dadyāt.
analyzed: siddhā asi iti abhidhāya samadhiṣṭhayet iti dvi indriya samāpattim kuryāt iti samudāya arthaḥ śeṣam su bodham bhakṣya ādikam sādhakāya sā dadyāt

original: [2.4.59] ekayāmam ekapraharaṃ tayā saha rantavyam. kuta ity āha: maithunāpriya yoginīti. yato maithunāpriyā. maithunapriyā na bhavati yataḥ, tataḥ praharād ūrdhvaṃ na kāmayitavyā. yadītthaṃ na sidhyati tadā ghoraḍākinībījena kṣuṃkāreṇa vidarbhya dīpinīmantraṃ japet. kṣuṃ oṃ dīpeśvarī hūṃ sriṃ pheṃ kṣuṃ iti vidarbhaṇaṃ, tathaiva lakṣaṃ japet.
analyzed: eka yāmam eka praharam tayā saha rantavyam kutas iti āha maithuna apriya yoginī iti yatas maithuna apriyā maithuna priyā na bhavati yatas tatas praharāt ūrdhvam na kāmayitavyā yadi ittham na sidhyati tadā ghora ḍākinī bījena kṣuṃkāreṇa vidarbhya dīpinī mantram japet kṣuṃ om dīpeśvarī hūm sriṃ pheṃ kṣuṃ iti vidarbhaṇam tathā eva lakṣam japet

original: tena bījena pīḍyamānā dīpinī sidhyati. yadi na sidhyati tadā tasyā mūrdhā sphuṭati (60b). etad evāha: yadītyādi.
analyzed: tena bījena pīḍyamānā dīpinī sidhyati yadi na sidhyati tadā tasyāḥ mūrdhā sphuṭati etat eva āha yadi ityādi

original: [2.4.60] bhāryetyādi: anena vidhānena dīpinī bhāryā siddhā syāt. sattvārthakriyātatpara iti: bhakṣyabhojyādidānena sattvārthaḥ kartavya iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: bhāryā ityādi anena vidhānena dīpinī bhāryā siddhā syāt sattva artha kriyā tatparaḥ iti bhakṣya bhojya ādi dānena sattva arthaḥ kartavyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.4.61] śṛṇv ityādinā ḍākinīsādhanam āha. aparair ity aparaṃ sādhanam ity arthaḥ. dvihastaṃ paṭayaunatvam iti: pādonadvihastaḥ paṭaḥ kārya ity arthaḥ. balidānapūjādipuraḥsaraṃ vakṣyamāṇarūpāṃ ḍākinīṃ sādhayed iti.
analyzed: śṛṇu ityādinā ḍākinī sādhanam āha aparaiḥ iti aparam sādhanam iti arthaḥ dvi hastam paṭa yauna tvam iti pāda ūna dvi hastaḥ paṭaḥ kāryaḥ iti arthaḥ bali dāna pūjā ādi puraḥsaram vakṣyamāṇa rūpām ḍākinīm sādhayet iti

original: [2.4.62–66] pṛthivībhājanam ārūḍham iti: pṛthivī śmaśānam. tatra bhājanaṃ citiḥ. ārūḍham iti: āropya. śmaśānaṃ gatvā citāyāṃ vistārya paṭam uktarūpaṃ ḍākinīṃ sādhayed iti bhāvaḥ. kiṃbhūtaṃ pṛthivībhājanam ity āha: samantād ityādi subodham. atrāpi pūrvasevāyāṃ lākṣiko japaḥ. siddhiś ca lakṣataḥ.
analyzed: pṛthivī bhājanam ārūḍham iti pṛthivī śmaśānam tatra bhājanam citiḥ ārūḍham iti āropya śmaśānam gatvā citāyām vistārya paṭam ukta rūpam ḍākinīm sādhayet iti bhāvaḥ kiṃbhūtam pṛthivī bhājanam iti āha samantāt ityādi su bodham atra api pūrva sevāyām lākṣikaḥ japaḥ siddhiḥ ca lakṣāt

original: [2.4.67] oṃ ḍākinī hūṃ aiṃ phur iti mantreṇa samayamudrāṃ darśayet. ayam eva japyaś ca.
analyzed: om ḍākinī hūm aim phur iti mantreṇa samayamudrām darśayet ayam eva japyaḥ ca

original: [2.4.68–96] vajrībījaṃ suṃkāraḥ. suṃ oṃ ḍākinī hūṃ aiṃ phuḥ suṃ iti vidarbhaṇam. atha vā suṃ oṃ caṇḍālī hūṃ ghrūṃ phuḥ suṃ iti. ittham api lakṣaṃ japet.
analyzed: vajrī bījam suṃkāraḥ sum om ḍākinī hūm aim phuḥ suṃ iti vidarbhaṇam atha vā sum om caṇḍālī hūm ghrūm phuḥ suṃ iti ittham api lakṣam japet

original: [2.4.97] asiddhā uktakarmeṇa anyatkarmeṇa kārayed iti: jñānaḍākinīrūpam ātmānaṃ cintayitvā ...
analyzed: asiddhā ukta karmeṇa anya karmeṇa kārayet iti jñāna ḍākinī rūpam ātmānam cintayitvā

original: [2.4.98] ... kāmbojīpaṭaṃ vāmapādenākramya pañcaśatajapaḥ kāmbojīmantraḥ kartavyaḥ. tataḥ sidhyati.
analyzed: kāmbojī paṭam vāma pādena ākramya pañcaśata japaḥ kāmbojīmantraḥ kartavyaḥ tatas sidhyati

original: [2.4.99] vīramadhye yoginīcakramadhye m-ānayed ānayed ity arthaḥ. anenāpi prakāreṇa yadi na sidhyati tadā kāmbojīpaṭaṃ vīramadhye drutam ānīya jriṃ phaḍ ity uccārayan khaṇḍakhaṇḍaṃ kuryād iti jñeyam. ghātaḥ phaṭkāraḥ. deḍḍhakair iti: gāḍham uccārayan khaṇḍakhaṇḍaṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ. uccakair iti pāṭhāntaram.
analyzed: vīra madhye yoginī cakra madhye mānayet ānayet iti arthaḥ anena api prakāreṇa yadi na sidhyati tadā kāmbojī paṭam vīra madhye drutam ānīya jriṃ phaṭ iti uccārayan khaṇḍa khaṇḍam kuryāt iti jñeyam ghātaḥ phaṭkāraḥ deḍḍhakaiḥ iti gāḍham uccārayan khaṇḍa khaṇḍam kuryāt iti arthaḥ uccakais iti pāṭha antaram

original: [2.4.100] sarvaṃ khaṇḍaśo vibhaktaṃ paṭaṃ tatra hūṃkāraṃ dhyātvā bhakṣayed ity āha: bhakṣayed ityādi subodham. sā kāmbojī mriyate pūrveṇa karmaṇā. ittham api sā sādhyayoginī sarvāsāṃ yoginīnāṃ madhya īśvarī nāyikā. asiddhā yadi syād anenāpi vidhinā tadāgnimadhye juhuyāt (101ab). etad evāha: sādhyayoginya ityādi subodham.
analyzed: sarvam khaṇḍaśas vibhaktam paṭam tatra hūṃkāram dhyātvā bhakṣayet iti āha bhakṣayet ityādi su bodham sā kāmbojī mriyate pūrveṇa karmaṇā ittham api sā sādhya yoginī sarvāsām yoginīnām madhye īśvarī nāyikā asiddhā yadi syāt anena api vidhinā tadā agni madhye juhuyāt etat eva āha sādhya yoginyaḥ ityādi su bodham

original: [2.4.101] kālavṛkṣo riṣṭikāvṛkṣaḥ. bhallātakakālavṛkṣayoḥ kāṣṭhenāgniṃ prajvālya sarṣaparudhireṇa kaṭutailenāloḍya taṃ khaṇḍaśo vibhaktīkṛtya paṭaṃ rājikāviṣanimbayuktaṃ hūṃkāroccāraṇapūrvakaṃ śatāṣṭakaṃ juhuyād iti (102ab). etad evāha: agnimadhye tv ityādi.
analyzed: kālavṛkṣaḥ riṣṭikā vṛkṣaḥ bhallātaka kālavṛkṣayoḥ kāṣṭhena agnim prajvālya sarṣapa rudhireṇa kaṭutailena āloḍya tam khaṇḍaśas vibhaktīkṛtya paṭam rājikā viṣa nimba yuktam hūṃkāra uccāraṇa pūrvakam śata aṣṭakam juhuyāt iti etat eva āha agni madhye tu ityādi

original: [2.4.102] itthaṃ yadi na sidhyati tadā niyataṃ mriyate. na kevalaṃ kāmbojī kiṃ tarhy anyā api ḍākinyaḥ. pūrvoktasvasvavidhānato 'siddhā yadi tadānena vidhānena sidhyantīty etad eva sakalam āha: mriyanta ityādi. ḍākinya iti: yoginyaḥ. ārtasvarabhi kranditam iti: ārtanādena krandantīty arthaḥ. avaśyaṃ siddha karmasyeti:
analyzed: ittham yadi na sidhyati tadā niyatam mriyate na kevalam kāmbojī kim tarhi anyāḥ api ḍākinyaḥ siddhāḥ yadi tadā anena vidhānena sidhyanti iti etat eva sakalam āha mriyante ityādi ḍākinyaḥ iti yoginyaḥ ārta svarabhi kranditam iti ārta nādena krandanti iti arthaḥ avaśyam siddha karmasya iti

original: ittham avaśyaṃ karma dūtīsādhanalakṣaṇaṃ sidhyatīty arthaḥ.
analyzed: ittham avaśyam karma dūtī sādhana lakṣaṇam sidhyati iti arthaḥ

original: advayādvayadharmasya bhāvābhāvavikalpitam iti (2ab) praśnasya visarjanaṃ bhāvābhāvavinirmuktas tasmān mohāni dūrata ityādinā (8cd) sūcitaṃ, yogaśāstranayapraśna(2d)visarjanaṃ daśa dravyāṇītyādinā (40c) bhagavan śrotum icchāmi caturyoginīsādhanam ityādinā ca (46ab) kathitam.
analyzed: advaya advaya dharmasya bhāva abhāva vikalpitam iti 2ab praśnasya visarjanam bhāva abhāva vinirmuktaḥ tasmāt mohāni dūratas ityādinā sūcitam yoga śāstra naya praśna dvi sarjanam daśa dravyāṇi ityādinā bhagavan śrotum icchāmi catur yoginī sādhanam ityādinā ca kathitam

original: [2.4.103] idānīṃ gaṇamaṇḍalapraveśakāle dvārapālaprārthanāgāthām āha: sohaï ityādi. he nīladaṇḍa krodha, śobhate tava samayaceṣṭā. nīladaṇḍa eva nīla ity ucyate, ekadeśenāpi samudāyapratīteḥ, yathāmoghasiddhir amogha iti, avalokiteśvaro 'valokita iti ca. sohaï nīla kodhu tuhu samayaceddhu iti vākyasyārthaḥ. kathaṃ sā śobhata ity āha:
analyzed: idānīm gaṇa maṇḍala praveśa kāle dvārapāla prārthanā gāthām āha sohañ ityādi he nīladaṇḍa krodha śobhate tava samaya ceṣṭā nīladaṇḍaḥ eva nīlaḥ iti ucyate eka deśena api samudāya pratīteḥ yathā amogha siddhiḥ amoghaḥ iti avalokiteśvaraḥ valokitaḥ iti ca sohañ nīla iti vākyasya arthaḥ katham sā śobhate iti āha

original: pāṇihi dharaï daṇḍa māṇikkehiṃ baddhu iti. pāṇihi iti pāṇau daṇḍaṃ dhārayati ceṣṭā. kīdṛśaṃ daṇḍam ity āha: māṇikkehiṃ baddhu iti. māṇikyair maṇibhir baddham. kvacit pāṇehiṃ iti pāṭhaḥ. tatra māṇikyaviśeṣaṇam. durlabhatvāt priyatvāc ca māṇikyaiḥ prāṇaiḥ prāṇasadṛśair ity arthaḥ. itthaṃ kiṃ syād ity āha: pecchavītyādi.
analyzed: pāṇihi dharañ daṇḍa māṇikkehiṃ baddhu iti pāṇihi iti pāṇau daṇḍam dhārayati ceṣṭā kīdṛśam daṇḍam iti āha baddhu iti māṇikyaiḥ maṇibhiḥ baddham kvacid iti pāṭhaḥ tatra māṇikya viśeṣaṇam durlabha tvāt priya tvāt ca māṇikyaiḥ prāṇaiḥ prāṇa sadṛśaiḥ iti arthaḥ ittham kim syāt iti āha

original: prekṣye 'haṃ yoginīmadhyam iti saṃbandhaḥ. he vīra jitakleśa, mellu tyaja. kiṃ tad ity āha: duvāra dvāram. yoginīmadhyapraveśena kiṃ syād ity āha: saṃsāra[-]uttāra jāmīti. saṃsārārṇavottāraṃ yāmi prāpnomi. tataś ca tyaja mām. etad evāha: mella mahuṃ iti. anayā gāthayā maṇḍalapraveśaṃ ca śiṣyaḥ kāryate.
analyzed: prekṣye ham yoginī madhyam iti saṃbandhaḥ he vīra jita kleśa tyaja kim tat iti āha duvāra dvāram yoginī madhya praveśena kim syāt iti āha saṃsāra auttāra jāmi iti saṃsāra arṇava uttāram yāmi prāpnomi tatas ca tyaja mām etat eva āha mella iti anayā gāthayā maṇḍala praveśam ca śiṣyaḥ kāryate

original: [2.4.104] aṅgamudrā sthāne sthāne kathitā, cihnamudrā ca. ataś ca tayoḥ praśnavisarjanaṃ siddham. idānīṃ vākyamudrāṅgamudrāpraśnavisarjanam āha: bhagavann ityādi subodham. rahasyam ityādi: rahasyaṃ gopyaṃ yogināṃ yoginīnāṃ ca yat tad guhyaguhyaṃ tu jñāpayed iti. vākyamudrālakṣaṇena jñāyata iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: aṅgamudrā sthāne sthāne kathitā cihnamudrā ca atas ca tayoḥ praśna visarjanam siddham idānīm vākyamudrā aṅgamudrā praśna visarjanam āha bhagavan ityādi su bodham rahasyam ityādi rahasyam gopyam yoginām yoginīnām ca yat tat guhya guhyam tu jñāpayet iti vākyamudrā lakṣaṇena jñāyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.4.105] yoginām ityādi: yoginā dakṣiṇena mudrā darśayitavyā, yoginyā ca vāmeneti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: yoginām ityādi yoginā dakṣiṇena mudrā darśayitavyā yoginyā ca vāmena iti bhāvaḥ

original: [2.4.106] mukhe prakṣipyetyādinā yoginīnām aṅgamudrā, cihnamudrety arthaḥ.
analyzed: mukhe prakṣipya ityādinā yoginīnām aṅgamudrā cihnamudrā iti arthaḥ

original: [2.4.107–109] gho ghu ityādi vākyamudrā.
analyzed: gho ghu ityādi vākyamudrā

original: [2.4.110–153] guravāṅguṣṭha iti madhyamāṅguliḥ.
analyzed: guravā aṅguṣṭhaḥ iti madhyama aṅguliḥ

original: [2.4.col.] ity uktakrameṇa pañcāmṛtādiḍākinīsādhanamudrāntaṃ prakriyate 'sminn itītiprakaraṇaḥ parapīṭhasya caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ. tasminn itiprakaraṇe homādiyoginīsādhanaparyantam ātmanaḥ parabhūtatvāt paraḥ. tad eva siddheḥ pīṭham. tac ca samāptam ity āha: parapīṭhaḥ samāpta iti. iti catuṣpīṭhanibandhe parapīṭhaṃ samāptam.
analyzed: iti ukta krameṇa pañcāmṛta ādi ḍākinī sādhana mudrā antam prakriyate smin iti iti prakaraṇaḥ para pīṭhasya caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ tasmin iti prakaraṇe homa ādi yoginī sādhana paryantam ātmanaḥ para bhū tva paraḥ tad eva siddheḥ pīṭham tad ca samāptam iti āha para pīṭha samāp iti iti catuṣpīṭha nibandhe para pīṭham samāptam

original: [3.1.1] idānīṃ yogapīṭham adhikṛtyāha: bhagavann ityādi. aparair ity aparam. kiṃ tad ity āha: lakṣyalakṣaṇam iti. lakṣyāṇi catvāri vajrādīni, teṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ tattvaṃ śrotum icchāmīti saṃbandhaḥ. bhedena pṛcchann āha: catus tattvam ityādi. vajraṃ, ghaṇṭā, akṣasūtraṃ, pañcagatisaṃsārajñānaṃ ceti catvāri, teṣāṃ tattvam.
analyzed: idānīm yogapīṭham adhikṛtya āha bhagavan ityādi aparaiḥ iti aparam kim tat iti āha lakṣya lakṣaṇam iti lakṣyāṇi catvāri vajra ādīni teṣām lakṣaṇam svarūpam tattvam śrotum icchāmi iti saṃbandhaḥ bhedena pṛcchan āha catuḥ tattvam ityādi vajram ghaṇṭā akṣasūtram pañcagati saṃsāra jñānam ca iti catvāri teṣām tattvam

original: kathaṃ jñātvā prayojayed iti: tattvaṃ jñātvā vajradhāraṇādikriyāṃ kathaṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: katham jñātvā prayojayet iti tattvam jñātvā vajra dhāraṇa ādi kriyām katham kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.1.2] saṃsārottāralakṣaṇam iti: lakṣaṇaṃ vajrādisvarūpaṃ śṛṇv iti saṃbandhaḥ. tac ca saṃsārād uttīryate 'neneti saṃsārottāraḥ. tad evāha: vajra tattvasyetyādi. pūrvaṃ vajraṃ, dvitīyā ghaṇṭā, ...
analyzed: saṃsāra uttāra lakṣaṇam iti lakṣaṇam vajra ādi svarūpam śṛṇu iti saṃbandhaḥ tat ca saṃsārāt uttīryate nena iti saṃsāra uttāraḥ tat eva āha vajra tattvasya ityādi pūrvam vajram dvitīyā ghaṇṭā

original: [3.1.3] ... tṛtīyam akṣasūtraṃ, caturthaṃ ca jñānalakṣaṇaṃ, pañcagatikasaṃsārajñānalakṣaṇam ity arthaḥ. saṃsārottāram ity (2b) uddiṣṭaṃ nirdiśati: catur ityādi. caturṇāṃ vajrādīnāṃ tattvena vikalpataraṅgān ativāhya sattvasamūho nīyate  saṃsārapāraṃ mokṣam ity arthaḥ. īpsitam iti: yatheccham ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: tṛtīyam akṣasūtram caturtham ca jñāna lakṣaṇam pañca gatika saṃsāra jñāna lakṣaṇam iti arthaḥ saṃsāra uttāram iti uddiṣṭam nirdiśati catuḥ ityādi caturṇām vajra ādīnām tattvena vikalpa taraṅgān ativāhya sattva samūhaḥ nīyate saṃsāra pāram mokṣam iti arthaḥ īpsitam iti yatheccham iti arthaḥ

original: [3.1.4] tatra prathamaṃ vajrasya tattvam āha: madhya ityādi. vajramadhyaśūke pṛthivyādarśajñānādisvarūpaṃ vairocanaṃ dhyātvā, pūrvādiśūkeṣu yathākramaṃ jalādisuviśuddhādijñānasvarūpān akṣobhyādīṃś caturo dhyāyāt. sarvapūrva iti: sarvathā pūrvaḥ prathamaḥ kālaḥ sarvapūrvaḥ. ratnasaṃbhavādīn apekṣya sarvapūrvatvam.
analyzed: tatra prathamam vajrasya tattvam āha madhye ityādi vajra madhya śūke pṛthivī ādarśa jñāna ādi svarūpam vairocanam dhyātvā pūrva ādi śūkeṣu yathākramam jala ādi su viśuddha ādi jñāna svarūpān akṣobhya ādīn caturaḥ dhyāyāt sarva pūrvaḥ iti sarvathā pūrvaḥ prathamaḥ kālaḥ sarva pūrvaḥ ratna saṃbhava ādīn apekṣya sarva pūrva tvam

original: [3.1.5] vajrasya śūkādhastān muṣṭiparyante padmam aṣṭadalaṃ, tatra padmapāṇyādīṃś cintayet. etad evāha: padme aṣṭetyādi. padme aṣṭeti: aṣṭadalapadme. saṃbodhyaṅgam iti: saṃbodher aṅgam upāyaḥ. yathābhūmyaṃ yathāsthānam. saṃbodhyupāyabhūtān padmapāṇyādīn pūrvādidaleṣu cintayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: vajrasya śūkā adhastāt muṣṭi paryante padmam aṣṭadalam tatra padma pāṇi ādīn cintayet etat eva āha padme aṣṭa ityādi padme aṣṭa iti aṣṭadala padme saṃbodhi aṅgam iti saṃbodheḥ aṅgam upāyaḥ yathābhūmyam yathāsthānam saṃbodhi upāya bhūtān padma pāṇi ādīn pūrva ādi daleṣu cintayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.1.6] padmapāṇim iti lokeśvaram. gaganaṃ gaganagañjam, ākāśagarbham ity arthaḥ. yakṣādhipatiṃ vajrapāṇim. kṣitiṃ kṣitigarbham. sthāpayec cintayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: padmapāṇim iti lokeśvaram gaganam gaganagañjam ākāśagarbham iti arthaḥ yakṣa adhipatim vajrapāṇim kṣitim kṣitigarbham sthāpayet cintayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.1.7] amūn aṣṭau sthāpayed ity upasaṃhāraḥ. madhye tridaśa aṇḍānām iti: vajrasya muṣṭau devānām aṇḍaṃ sthānam. tatra jñānadevaṃ tu cintayed iti jñānaḍākinīm.
analyzed: amūn aṣṭau sthāpayet iti upasaṃhāraḥ madhye tri daśa aṇḍānām iti vajrasya muṣṭau devānām aṇḍam sthānam tatra jñānadevam tu cintayet iti jñānaḍākinīm

original: [3.1.8] aparasmin muṣṭyante sāṣṭadalapadme pūrvādidigdaleṣu vajrāṅkuśyādayo devyo vidigdaleṣu cundādayo 'pi bhāvyā iti padme aṣṭa devatītyādinoktam.
analyzed: aparasmin muṣṭi ante sa aṣṭadala padme pūrva ādi diś daleṣu vajrāṅkuśī ādayaḥ devyaḥ vidiś daleṣu cunda ādayaḥ bhāvyāḥ iti padme aṣṭa devatī ityādinā uktam

original: [3.1.9–11] aparāntasūcīṣu jñānaḍākinyādayo madhyādivibhāgena draṣṭavyāḥ. etad evāha: sūcyām ityādi.
analyzed: apara anta sūcīṣu jñāna ḍākinī ādayaḥ madhya ādi vibhāgena draṣṭavyāḥ etat eva āha sūcyām ityādi

original: [3.1.12] vajratattveti devasyeti: devatārūpeṇa vajratattvaṃ vicakṣaṇo jānīyād iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: vajra tattva iti devasya iti devatā rūpeṇa vajra tattvam vicakṣaṇaḥ jānīyāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.1.13] tribhāgetyādi subodham. utpalaṃ kudmalam iti: utpalakudmalākāraḥ śūkasamudāyaḥ.
analyzed: tri bhāga ityādi su bodham utpalam kudmalam iti utpala kudmala ākāraḥ śūka samudāyaḥ

original: [3.1.14] diśādītyādinā navaśūkavajratattvam āha. nava śūkeṣu pūrvādiṣu padmapāṇyādaya evam aparāntaśūkeṣv api. śeṣaṃ pūrvavat.
analyzed: diśā ādi ityādinā nava śūka vajra tattvam āha nava śūkeṣu pūrva ādiṣu padmapāṇi ādayaḥ evam apara anta śūkeṣu api śeṣam pūrvavat

original: [3.1.15] makarāsyanirgataṃ sūcīti: madhyasūcīṃ vinā pūrvādisūcyo makaramukhanirgatāḥ kāryāḥ. raśmicandrādiyuktāś ca draṣṭavyā iti sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇam. anyatra vajrasya ghaṇṭāyāś ca lakṣaṇaṃ viśeṣeṇa jñeyam. nava sūcyeti: navāṅgasaddharmaviśuddhyā navaśūkatvaṃ, pañcajñānaviśuddhyā pañcaśūkatvaṃ ceti jñātavyam. ata āha: jñāneti.
analyzed: makara āsya nirgatam sūcī iti madhya sūcīm vinā pūrva ādi sūcyaḥ makara mukha nirgatāḥ kāryāḥ raśmi candra ādi yuktāḥ ca draṣṭavyāḥ iti sāmānyam lakṣaṇam anyatra vajrasya ghaṇṭāyāḥ ca lakṣaṇam viśeṣeṇa jñeyam nava sūcyā iti navāṅga saddharma viśuddhyā nava śūkatvam pañcajñāna viśuddhyā pañca śūkatvam ca iti jñātavyam atas āha jñāna iti

original: ādarśādipañcajñānaviśuddhyā pañcaśūkatvam ity arthaḥ. jagad eva vajram, uttaraṃ viśuddhaṃ sat.
analyzed: ādarśa ādi pañca jñāna viśuddhyā pañcaśūka tvam iti arthaḥ jagat eva vajram uttaram viśuddham sat

original: [3.1.16] kuta ity āha: yato tattvānītyādi. yato vajrasya tattvaṃ svarūpaṃ, kiṃ tad ity āha: vajrātma ātma cetaneti. vajrasyātmā svarūpaṃ saḥ, ya ātmā paraparikalpitaḥ. yata ātmā nāmamātrārūḍhaḥ paramārthato 'dvayatathatārūpa eva, tataḥ sa vajraṃ cetaneti jñātavya ity arthaḥ. vajra sārasyeti: vajraṃ cittasya sārabhūtaṃ yogicetasi dṛśyata iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: kutas iti āha tattvāni ityādi yatas vajrasya tattvam svarūpam kim tat iti āha vajra ātmā ātma cetanā iti vajrasya ātmā svarūpam saḥ yaḥ ātmā para parikalpitaḥ yatas ātmā nāma mātra ārūḍhaḥ paramārthāt dvaya tathatā rūpaḥ eva tatas sa vajram cetanā iti jñātavyaḥ iti arthaḥ vajra sārasya iti vajram cittasya sāra bhūtam yogi cetasi dṛśyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: kāraṇād ityādi: yato yogicittasārabhūtaṃ vajraṃ sakalātmakaṃ ca, ...
analyzed: kāraṇāt ityādi yatas yogi citta sāra bhūtam vajram sakala ātmakam ca

original: [3.1.17] ... tato vajraśuddhiṃ dṛḍhīkuryāt: vajraśuddhāḥ sarvadharmā vajraśuddho 'ham iti. kuta evam ity āha: vajretyādi. sarve dharmā vajram eva. kathaṃ tathā ta ity āha: vajretyādi. sarve dharmā advayajñānanirjātatvād abhedyā vajraṃ ca tadvat. śāntikādikarma vajram. abhisārata iti: dharmadhāturūpatayā sarvagatvāt.
analyzed: tatas vajra śuddhim dṛḍhīkuryāt vajra śuddhāḥ sarva dharmāḥ vajra śuddhaḥ ham iti kutas evam iti āha vajra ityādi sarve dharmāḥ vajram eva katham tathā te iti āha vajra ityādi sarve dharmāḥ advaya jñāna nirjāta tvāt abhedyāḥ vajram ca tadvat śāntika ādi karma vajram abhisārāt iti dharmadhātu rūpatayā sarvaga tvāt

original: [3.1.18] devatārūpaspharaṇena vajraṃ saṃsārād uttārakam. śeṣaṃ subodham.
analyzed: devatā rūpa spharaṇena vajram saṃsārāt uttārakam śeṣam su bodham

original: [3.1.19] andhakāraṃ yathā dīpikā ghātayed dhanyāt, tathā viśiṣṭaṃ jñānaṃ vajrasvarūpaṃ kleśāndhakāraṃ hanti. tataś ca jñānavajreṇa dīpikābhūtena diśa ālokam āpnuvanti. jñānena sarvaṃ nirāvaraṇaṃ dṛśyata iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: andhakāram yathā dīpikā ghātayet dhanyāt tathā viśiṣṭam jñānam vajra svarūpam kleśa andhakāram hanti tatas ca jñāna vajreṇa dīpikā bhūtena diśaḥ ālokam āpnuvanti jñānena sarvam nirāvaraṇam dṛśyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.1.20] sādhyam api vajrasvarūpam ity āha: vajra sādhitetyādi. kleśabandhanamokṣo 'pi vajram ity āha: vajra dharmasyetyādi.
analyzed: sādhyam api vajra svarūpam iti āha vajra sādhita ityādi vajram iti āha vajra dharmasya ityādi

original: [3.1.21] prajñopāyābhyāṃ jagat sādhayed ity āha: vajreṇetyādi. vajre dhṛte sarvaṃ laukikalokottaraṃ jagad dhriyata iti vajram ācāryeṇa dhriyate. vairocanādīnāṃ bījāni vā kevalaṃ bhāvayed iti.
analyzed: prajñā upāyābhyām jagat sādhayet iti āha vajreṇa ityādi vajre dhṛte sarvam laukika lokottaram jagat dhriyate iti vajram ācāryeṇa dhriyate vairocana ādīnām bījāni vā kevalam bhāvayet iti

original: [3.1.22] idānīṃ ghaṇṭātattvam āha: śṛṇu vajradhara ityādi. vajradhara iti vajrapāṇe ity asminn arthe. rājeti rājann ity asminn arthe. prajñācoditatattvānām iti: prajñāpāramitāviśuddhyā ghaṇṭātattvaṃ, śṛṇu tāṃ bhava-m-uttare iti: tāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ śṛṇu, tato bhavottāro bhavatīty arthaḥ.
analyzed: idānīm ghaṇṭā tattvam āha śṛṇu vajradharaḥ ityādi vajradharaḥ iti vajrapāṇe iti asmin arthe rājā iti rājan iti asmin arthe prajñā codita tattvānām iti prajñāpāramitā viśuddhyā ghaṇṭā tattvam śṛṇu tām bhavam uttare iti tām ghaṇṭām śṛṇu tatas bhava uttāraḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: [3.1.23] śūnyāḥ sarvadharmā anabhisaṃskārāḥ sarvadharmāḥ prakṛtinirvṛtāḥ sarvadharmā ityādidhvaninākāśadhātuṃ vyāpya yāvadbodhimaṇḍavyavasthānakālaṃ ca vyāpya prajñāpāramitātattvaṃ ghaṇṭā dhvanantī vivṛṇotīty āha:
analyzed: śūnyāḥ sarva dharmāḥ an abhisaṃskārāḥ sarva dharmāḥ prakṛti nirvṛtāḥ sarva dharmāḥ ityādi dhvaninā ākāśa dhātum vyāpya yāvat bodhimaṇḍa vyavasthāna kālam ca vyāpya prajñāpāramitā tattvam ghaṇṭā dhvanantī vivṛṇoti iti āha

original: ākāśadhātvityādi. ākāśadhātuparyantaṃ nirdiśann āha: daśadig ityādi.
analyzed: ākāśa dhātu ityādi ākāśa dhātu paryantam nirdiśan āha daśa diś ityādi

original: [3.1.24] aṣṭeṣu pārśveṣv aṣṭa devīs tadbījāni vā cintayed ity āha: diśe ityādi.
analyzed: aṣṭeṣu pārśveṣu aṣṭa devīḥ tad bījāni vā cintayet iti āha diśe ityādi

original: [3.1.25–26] sauvarṇī vasudhārā. madhurā cundā. kāntī bhṛkuṭī. vajramāleti yathārthanāmnī.
analyzed: sauvarṇī vasudhārā madhurā cundā kāntī bhṛkuṭī vajramālā iti yathārtha nāmnī

original: [3.1.27–29] śūkeṣu vajravad vairocanādayo draṣṭavyāḥ: ūrdhvaṃ padmaṃ vajrāṇām iti śūkāḥ. yathāpūrvam iti: vajrasyeva. madhyaṃ jñānadaṇḍarūpam.
analyzed: śūkeṣu vajra vat vairocana ādayaḥ draṣṭavyāḥ ūrdhvam padmam vajrāṇām iti śūkāḥ yathāpūrvam iti vajrasya iva madhyam jñāna daṇḍa rūpam

original: [3.1.30] cālayed aṣṭadiśaṃ tv iti: ghaṇṭām ādāya vṛddhānāmikābhyāṃ saṃyamyāṣṭasu pūrvādidikṣu cālayet. aṣṭasu dikṣv aṣṭau dhvanīn kṛtvā ghaṇṭāṃ sthāpayed ity arthaḥ. nādhikaṃ dhvānayatīti jñeyam. kathaṃ cālayed ity āha: ālikāliprayojitam iti. ālir vajram. kālir ghaṇṭā. jyeṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ vajraṃ dakṣiṇenādāya ghaṇṭāṃ nādayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: cālayet aṣṭa diśam tu iti ghaṇṭām ādāya vṛddhā anāmikābhyām saṃyamya aṣṭasu pūrva ādi dikṣu cālayet aṣṭasu dikṣu aṣṭau dhvanīn kṛtvā ghaṇṭām sthāpayet iti arthaḥ na adhikam dhvānayati iti jñeyam katham cālayet iti āha āli kāli prayojitam iti āliḥ vajram kāliḥ ghaṇṭā jyeṣṭhā anāmikābhyām vajram dakṣiṇena ādāya ghaṇṭām nādayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: kuta evam ity āha: ālītyādi. prajñopāyayogena hi saṃsāraṃ chinatti.
analyzed: kutas evam iti āha āli ityādi prajñā upāya yogena hi saṃsāram chinatti

original: [3.1.31] vajrāṅkitā ghaṇṭā vajraghaṇṭā. sā copāyam. upaiti vajram upāyam ity upāyaḥ. upaiti prajñāṃ ghaṇṭām ity upāyo vajram. balyādidānakāle na kevalā ghaṇṭā, na kevalaṃ vajraṃ ca, kiṃ tarhi tayor yaugapadyena dhāraṇam. ittham anyonyānugamaḥ. madhyam eva ceti: muṣṭau dhāraṇaṃ pratipādayati. dhāraṇaviśuddhim āha: pāṇau dvāv ityādi subodham.
analyzed: vajra aṅkitā ghaṇṭā vajraghaṇṭā sā ca upāyam upaiti vajram upāyam iti upāyaḥ upaiti prajñām ghaṇṭām iti upāyaḥ vajram bali ādi dāna kāle na kevalā ghaṇṭā na kevalam vajram ca kim tarhi tayoḥ yaugapadyena dhāraṇam ittham anyonya anugamaḥ madhyam eva ca iti muṣṭau dhāraṇam pratipādayati dhāraṇa viśuddhim āha pāṇau dvau ityādi su bodham

original: [3.1.32] upāyaśabdena ghaṇṭāvyutpādadvāreṇa svadehe dhārayed iti. svecchetyādi: dakṣiṇe kare sūryaṃ vāme candraṃ ca cintayitvā yathākramaṃ vajraṃ ghaṇṭāṃ ca dhārayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: upāya śabdena ghaṇṭā vyutpāda dvāreṇa sva dehe dhārayet iti svecchā ityādi dakṣiṇe kare sūryam vāme candram ca cintayitvā yathākramam vajram ghaṇṭām ca dhārayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.1.33] dhāraṇagāthādvayam āha: hūṃkāretyādi. hūṃkāroccāraṇapūrvakaṃ ...
analyzed: dhāraṇa gāthā dvayam āha hūṃkāra ityādi hūṃkāra uccāraṇa pūrvakam

original: [3.1.34] ... sohia ityādigāthāṃ vajrollālena paṭhet. vajrasyollālaḥ kiṃbhūtaḥ? tāritāḥ sattvā yena, sa tāritasattva iti parārthaṃ darśayati. vimokkheti: vikalpān mokṣata iti vimokṣo vajrollālaḥ. ata eva sattvān uttārayatīti siddham. kuta evam ity āha: dhammavimokkhe kajju iti. vajrasya dharmaḥ prakṛtiḥ, yato vikalpamokṣaḥ.

original: [3.1.52–63] akṣasūtraśodhanamantram āha: akkharu ityādi. akkharu kāraṇu rūvu iti: akṣarāṇy akārādikakārādīni kāraṇāni yasya rūpasya, tad akṣarakāraṇam. akṣarakāraṇaṃ rūpaṃ svarūpaṃ yasya, so 'kṣara kāraṇarūpo mantraḥ, sohia iti śodhitaḥ. manta vīti mantra eva. śodhito mantra eva sāraḥ. śodhanaṃ ca nairātmyādinā. etad evāha: gaṇiasaṃkhu alikku iti.
analyzed: akṣasūtra śodhana mantram āha ityādi iti akṣarāṇi akāra ādi kakāra ādīni kāraṇāni yasya rūpasya tat akṣara kāraṇam akṣara kāraṇam rūpam svarūpam yasya tat kāraṇa rūpaḥ mantraḥ iti śodhitaḥ mantraḥ eva śodhitaḥ mantraḥ eva sāraḥ śodhanam ca nairātmya ādinā etat eva āha iti

original: gaṇitā saṃkhyā yasya, sa gaṇitasaṃkhyo, mantraḥ. alīkaś ca. alīkatvena nirūpaṇam viśodhanam. evaṃviśiṣṭo mantraḥ sidhyati, yoginīnāṃ sāro hṛdayam. bamhaṇetyādi (?) subodham. kiṃ ca brāhmaṇaḥ kāyaḥ. śūdro vāk. kṣatriyaś cittam. eṣām ekatvena sidhyati, yoginījālaṃ mantraḥ. śeṣaṃ subodham. akkharu-ādisvāhānto (63) mantraḥ.

original: [3.1.64] anenākṣasūtrasya śodhanam. akṣarāṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ sūtraṇāt saṃkhyākaraṇād akṣasūtraḥ. tatas tena japyamāno mantra īpsitāṃ devatāṃ sādhayen nānyatheti bhāvaḥ.

original: [3.1.65] idānīṃ pañcagatikasaṃsāratattvam āha: śṛṇv ityādi. jñānabhedena karmabhedena dūrasthāḥ sattvāḥ paraspareṇa bhinnāḥ. kiṃ tv anyad ity āha: sāmānyajñānavākyata iti. sāmānyājñānatveneti bhāvaḥ. jñānamātraṃ jagad iti nyāyāt.

analyzed: daitya adaitya param daitya iti daityāḥ iti bhāvaḥ yakṣāḥ prasiddhāḥ asurāḥ rākṣasāḥ siddhakaiḥ iti devāḥ

analyzed: avīcyāḥ ekavidhāḥ rūpāḥ iti avīcyāḥ iti avīci gatāḥ sattvāḥ sūkṣma iti sūkṣmāḥ prāṇinaḥ aṇḍāḥ iti aṇḍa jāḥ dhāraṇāḥ iti avadhāryatām

original: [3.1.71–72] devabhedam āha: viṃśetyādi. viṃśeti viṃśatiḥ. triketi: tryadhikā viṃśatir devānāṃ sthānāni. dvigu ūrdhvaṃ tu ūrdhvaśa iti: ūrdhvam ūrdhvaṃ dviguṇam āyur devānām. tatrāyaṃ kramaḥ. ṣaṭ kāmāvacarāḥ: catur mahārājakāyikaḥ, trāyastriṃśaḥ, yāmaḥ, tuṣitaḥ, nirmāṇaratiḥ, paranirmitavaśavarttī ceti. ete ṣaṭ kāmadhātoḥ. ata ūrdhvaṃ rūpadhātuḥ:
analyzed: deva bhedam āha viṃśa ityādi viṃśa iti viṃśatiḥ trikā iti tri adhikā viṃśatiḥ devānām sthānāni dvigu ūrdhvam tu ūrdhvaśas iti ūrdhvam ūrdhvam dviguṇam āyuḥ devānām tatra ayam kramaḥ ṣaṭ kāmāvacarāḥ catuḥ mahārājakāyikaḥ trāyastriṃśaḥ yāmaḥ tuṣitaḥ nirmāṇaratiḥ paranirmitavaśavartī ca iti ete ṣaṭ kāmadhātoḥ atas ūrdhvam rūpadhātuḥ

original: saptadaśa sthānāntarāṇi. prathamadhyānasya sthānadvayaṃ bhūmidvayaṃ ca: brahmakāyikāḥ, brahmapurohitāḥ. dvitīye dhyāne trīṇī sthānāntarāṇi, tisro bhūmayaḥ: parīttābhāḥ, apramāṇābhāḥ, ābhāsvarāḥ. tṛtīye dhyāne trīṇi sthānāntarāṇi: parīttaśubhāḥ, apramāṇaśubhāḥ, śubhakṛtsnāḥ. caturthe dhyāne 'ṣṭau sthānāntarāṇi:

original: anabhrakāḥ, puṇyaprasavāḥ, bṛhatphalāḥ, abṛhāḥ, atapāḥ, sudṛśāḥ, sudarśanāḥ, akaniṣṭhāḥ. mahābrahmāṇo 'saṃjñisattvāś ca navamaṃ bhūmyantaram. sthānaśabdena bhūmaya uktāḥ. etena trayoviṃśati devasthānāni devabhūmayaḥ. nṝṇāṃ pañcāśad varṣaiḥ ṣaṭ kāmāvacarāṇāṃ devānām ahorātram. evaṃbhūtair ahorātrair māsasamvatsarāḥ saṃkhyāyante.

original: [3.2.1] idānīṃ cakrādinā śāntikādisādhanapaṭalam āha: śṛṇv ityādi. cakrasādhya viśeṣata iti: cakreṇa sādhyaṃ śāntikādikarma tac cakrasādhyam. viśeṣata iti: pūrvoktaśāntyādikarmaṇo viśeṣata iti bhāvaḥ. sādhyam evāha: śāntītyādi.

original: [3.2.2] navakoṣṭhādicakrasyeti: aṣṭābhir arair varaṭakena ca yuktam aṣṭāram eva navakoṣṭhaṃ cakraṃ bhavati. bāhya nimnaṃ tu kārayed iti: bāhyato nemir bhāvyā. karmavarṇādi cakrasyeti: karmāṇurūpaṃ varṇabhāvanam iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: nava koṣṭha ādi cakrasya iti aṣṭābhiḥ araiḥ varaṭakena ca yuktam aṣṭa āram eva nava koṣṭham cakram bhavati nimnam tu kārayet iti bāhyatas nemiḥ bhāvyā karma varṇa ādi cakrasya iti karma aṇu rūpam varṇa bhāvanam iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.2.4] asya bījaṃ tu sarveṣām iti: etāni bījāni madhyādikoṣṭheṣu cintanīyāni. koṣṭheṣu pūrvādiṣv aṣṭasu tākārādīny aṣṭāv akṣarāṇi, oṃkārahākārau madhye. ata āha: praṇamā anta madhyaketi. praṇameti: praṇava oṃkāraḥ. anteti: mantrānto hākāraḥ. madhyaketi: madhyagau tau dvau bhāvyāv iti bhāvaḥ. yojayen madhya nāmaṃ tv iti:

original: oṃkārahākārayor madhye sādhyanāmeti bhāvaḥ. rakṣāvākyaṃ tv iti: ādiśabdo 'tra draṣṭavyaḥ. tena rakṣādivākyayuktaṃ sādhyanāma praṇavahākārayor madhye bhāvyaṃ jñeyam. oṃ devadattaṃ rakṣa hetyādiyogaḥ.

original: [3.2.5] etac cakraṃ kathaṃ bhāvayitavyam ity āha: samatetyādi. samatayā śūnyatājñānaṃ samatājñānaśūnyeṣv ity asyārthaḥ. na prādeśikī śūnyateti bhāvaḥ. ātmanaḥ prākṛtaṃ rūpaṃ śūnyatājñānāmbunā kṣālayet. samatā sarvavit sthānair iti: samatayā sarvavedanaṃ sarvajñajñānaṃ śūnyatājñānam ity arthaḥ. sthānair iti sthānasya.

original: [3.2.39] etac cakraṃ nemīcaturthapuṭaṃ Jñānaḍākinīmūrtyā bhāvayed iti jñeyam. etad eva sūcayann āha: pūrvalakṣaṇetyādi. bhāvayed iti: devatām iti śeṣaḥ. asya cakrata iti: asya cakrasya bhāvanārthaṃ jñānaḍākinīṃ bhāvayed ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: etat cakram nemī caturtha puṭam jñāna ḍākinī mūrtyā bhāvayet iti jñeyam etat eva sūcayan āha pūrva lakṣaṇa ityādi bhāvayet iti devatām iti śeṣaḥ asya cakrataḥ iti asya cakrasya bhāvanā artham jñāna ḍākinīm bhāvayet iti arthaḥ

original: [3.2.40] samāhitam ityādi: samāhito yogī, bhāvabhāvenātiśayabhāvanayety arthaḥ. jvalitam ityādi: jvalitaṃ sac cakraṃ sarvaprakāreṇāvidyādīndhanaṃ dahati vahnivad ity arthaḥ. dahyanti sarvamārāṇāṃ jñānacakrasya bhāvanā |
analyzed: samāhitam ityādi samāhitaḥ yogī bhāva bhāvena atiśaya bhāvanayā iti arthaḥ jvalitam ityādi jvalitam sat cakram sarva prakāreṇa avidyā ādi indhanam dahati vahni vat iti arthaḥ dahyanti sarva mārāṇām jñānacakrasya bhāvanā

original: [3.2.41] asya jñānacakrasya bhāvanātaḥ sarve mārā dahyanti naśyanti. kleśāvṛtānām api cakram idaṃ bhāvayatāṃ buddhatvaphalaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: asya jñāna cakrasya bhāvanātaḥ sarve mārāḥ dahyanti naśyanti kleśa āvṛtānām api cakram idam bhāvayatām buddhatva phalam bhavati iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.2.42] bhāvanāntaram āha: samatājñānetyādi. ātmānaṃ khasamaṃ vibhāvya Jñānaḍākinīṃ bhāvayan vakṣyamāṇaṃ bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ. tad evāha: sūryetyādi. hṛdi sūryamaṇḍalaṃ dṛṣṭvā ...
analyzed: bhāvanā antaram āha samatā jñāna ityādi ātmānam khasamam vibhāvya Jñānaḍākinīm bhāvayan vakṣyamāṇam bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ tat eva āha sūrya ityādi hṛdi sūrya maṇḍalam dṛṣṭvā

original: [3.2.43] ... tatra bījaṃ bhāvayet. bījam evāha: yathetyādi. vargasya prathamasya pūrvam akṣaraṃ kakāraḥ.
analyzed: tatra bījam bhāvayet bījam eva āha yathā ityādi vargasya prathamasya pūrvam akṣaram kakāraḥ

original: [3.2.44] aṅkuśena tu pīḍasyeti: aṅkuśa ikāraḥ. sa copari. mūla rephaṃ tv iti: adho rephaṃ dadyāt. amṛtāmṛtam. candra ity arthaḥ. ūrdhvaṃ ca binduḥ. tataḥ kriṃ iti bījaṃ syāt.
analyzed: aṅkuśena tu pīḍasya iti aṅkuśaḥ ikāraḥ sa ca upari mūla repham tu iti adhas repham dadyāt amṛta amṛtam candraḥ iti arthaḥ ūrdhvam ca binduḥ tatas kriṃ iti bījam syāt

original: [3.2.45] evaṃbhūtaṃ bījaṃ sūryaprabhākulaṃ bhāvayed iti. rājā prasiddhaḥ. rājapuro iti: rājapuram. nagaram ity arthaḥ. svahṛdi sūrye kriṃbījaṃ vīkṣya tadraśmibhir ātmānaṃ rañjayitvā paraṃ ca sādhyaṃ rājādikaṃ rañjayati. tato rājā sapura eva vaśībhavatīti bhāvaḥ. manyaketi: yogī.
analyzed: evaṃbhūtam bījam sūrya prabhā ākulam bhāvayet iti rājā prasiddhaḥ iti rājapuram nagaram iti arthaḥ sva hṛdi sūrye kriṃbījam vīkṣya tad raśmibhiḥ ātmānam rañjayitvā param ca sādhyam rāja ādikam rañjayati tatas rājā sa puraḥ eva vaśībhavati iti bhāvaḥ manyakā iti yogī

original: [3.2.46] idānīṃ nārīvaśīkaraṇam āha: dviguṇetyādi. dviguṇākṣaraṃ kṣakāraḥ. nāda ukāraḥ. yady api dīrgho 'pi nāda ity ucyate, atropadeśād dhrasva eva. tena kṣuṃ iti syāt. yathā hrasvo dīrgho 'pīkāro 'ṅkuśa iti. prastāvena dvayor eka upadeśād gṛhyate. amṛtā-antikānāmeti: amṛtasyānto nāśas tena vyavaharatīty amṛtāntikaḥ kṣuṃkāraḥ, asyāgnisvarūpatvāt.
analyzed: idānīm nārī vaśīkaraṇam āha dviguṇa ityādi dviguṇa akṣaram kṣakāraḥ nādaḥ ukāraḥ yadi api dīrghaḥ nādaḥ iti ucyate atra upadeśāt dhrasvaḥ eva tena kṣuṃ iti syāt yathā hrasvaḥ dīrghaḥ pīkāraḥ ṅkuśaḥ iti prastāvena dvayoḥ ekaḥ upadeśāt gṛhyate amṛtāantikā nāma iti amṛtasya antaḥ nāśaḥ tena vyavaharati iti amṛtāntikaḥ kṣuṃkāraḥ asya agni svarūpa tvāt

original: anye punar evaṃ vyācakṣate: amṛtā-nāmā svāhākāraḥ. sa cāntiko 'vasāne yojya ity arthaḥ. kiṃ cānyathāpi praṇavasvāhākārāv upadeśād draṣṭavyau. tata oṃ kṣuṃ svāheti mantraḥ. raktavarṇajñānaḍākinīyogināṃ lakṣaṃ mantram amuṃ japtvā pūrvasevāṃ kṛtavatāṃ vaśyaṃ bhavati. ata āha: vaśyetyādi.
analyzed: anye punar evam vyācakṣate amṛtā nāmā svāhākāraḥ sa ca antikaḥ vasāne yojyaḥ iti arthaḥ kim ca anyathā api praṇava svāhākārau upadeśāt draṣṭavyau tatas om kṣuṃ svāhā iti mantraḥ rakta varṇa jñāna ḍākinī yoginām lakṣam mantram amum japtvā pūrva sevām kṛtavatām vaśyam bhavati atas āha vaśyā ityādi

original: paścān nāmagrahaṇapūrvakaṃ yadarthaṃ raktavarṇajñānaḍākinīyogī japati, taṃ niyataṃ vaśīkaroti. oṃ kṣuṃ devadattaṃ me vaśam ānaya svāheti vidarbhaṇaṃ sādhyasādhanakāle.
analyzed: paścāt nāma grahaṇa pūrvakam yad artham rakta varṇa jñāna ḍākinī yogī japati tam niyatam vaśīkaroti om kṣuṃ devadattam me vaśam ānaya svāhā iti vidarbhaṇam sādhya sādhana kāle

original: [3.2.47] punar apīdānīṃ kriṃkārasya prayogāntaram āha: yaś cintayatītyādi. yo nārīṇāṃ dharmodayāyāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ hṛdaye kriṃkāraṃ bhāvayati, sa nārīpuruṣān vaśayati. pūrvasevāyāṃ kriṃkāro 'pi devatāyoginā lakṣaṃ japyaḥ.
analyzed: punar api idānīm kriṃkārasya prayoga antaram āha yaḥ cintayati ityādi yaḥ nārīṇām dharma udayāyām puruṣāṇām hṛdaye kriṃkāram bhāvayati sa nārī puruṣān vaśayati pūrva sevāyām devatā yoginā lakṣam japyaḥ

original: [3.2.48] prayogāntaram āha: pūrvalakṣaṇetyādi. śūnyatānantaraṃ pītajñānaḍākinīyogī pītacandramaṇḍale vakṣyamāṇaṃ bhāvayed iti śeṣaḥ. bhāvanām āha: amṛtā sakāraḥ. sarvavinmātrair iti: sarvavinmātro praṇavaḥ. ubhayayogena soṃ iti syāt. raśmijvālām anekaśa iti: soṃkāro raśmisamākulaḥ. ayam api pūrvasevāyāṃ lakṣaṃ japyaḥ.
analyzed: prayoga antaram āha pūrva lakṣaṇa ityādi śūnyatā anantaram pīta jñāna ḍākinī yogī pīta candra maṇḍale vakṣyamāṇam bhāvayet iti śeṣaḥ bhāvanām āha amṛtā sakāraḥ sarva vinmātraiḥ iti praṇavaḥ ubhaya yogena soṃ iti syāt raśmi jvālām anekaśas iti soṃkāraḥ raśmi samākulaḥ ayam api pūrva sevāyām lakṣam japyaḥ

original: jñānaḍākinīyogī strīṇāṃ nābher adhaś candrasthaṃ raktasoṃkāraṃ vīkṣya, yonau ca kriṃkāraṃ bhāvayan drāvayati.
analyzed: jñāna ḍākinī yogī strīṇām nābheḥ adhas candra stham rakta soṃkāram vīkṣya yonau ca kriṃkāram bhāvayan drāvayati

original: [3.2.49] dravyākṛṣṭim āha: varṇapītetyādi. varṇaśabdena rakto varṇaḥ, pīteti pīto varṇaḥ, dravyākṛṣṭāv iti draṣṭavyam. etad evāha: śvāsākarṣitetyādi. etenaitad uktaṃ bhavati: svahṛccandramaṇḍalopari pītasoṃkāraṃ dhyātvā ratnādau cākraṣṭavyadravye [rakta?]soṃkāraṃ vīkṣya svaśvāsena svahṛccandrasthasoṃkāraraśminā ca ratnādikam ākarṣayatīti.
analyzed: dravya ākṛṣṭim āha varṇa pīta ityādi varṇa śabdena raktaḥ varṇaḥ pīta iti pītaḥ varṇaḥ dravya ākṛṣṭau iti draṣṭavyam etat eva āha śvāsa ākarṣita ityādi etena etat uktam bhavati sva hṛd candra maṇḍala upari pīta soṃkāram dhyātvā ratna ādau ca ākraṣṭavya dravye rakta soṃkāram vīkṣya sva śvāsena sva hṛd candra stha soṃkāra raśminā ca ratna ādikam ākarṣayati iti

original: [3.2.50] prayogāntaram āha: sādhakasya tv ityādi. sādhakaśabdena sādhya eva. dehānām iti hṛdaye. sādhyahṛdaye sūryasthaṃ kriṃkāraṃ raktavarṇaṃ cittasvarūpaṃ yuṃkāraveṣṭitaṃ cintayet.
analyzed: prayoga antaram āha sādhakasya tu ityādi sādhaka śabdena sādhye eva dehānām iti hṛdaye sādhya hṛdaye sūrya stham kriṃkāram rakta varṇam citta svarūpam yuṃkāra veṣṭitam cintayet

original: [3.2.51] candramaṇḍalopari raktavarṇaṃ jñānaḍākinīrūpam ...
analyzed: candra maṇḍala upari rakta varṇam jñāna ḍākinī rūpam

original: [3.2.52–53] ... aṅkuśagrāhivāmakaraṃ sūryasthakriṃkārāgradakṣiṇatarjanīkam ātmānaṃ cintayitvā, sādhyasya galam aṅkuśena viddhvā sādhyahṛdgataṃ kriṃkāraṃ kriṃkārayuktena dakṣiṇatarjanyagreṇa cālyamānaṃ cintayan kṣuṃbījaṃ japet. oṃ kṣuṃ devadattasya mana ākarṣaya svāheti japaḥ. dviguṇetyādi vyākhyātam eva.
analyzed: aṅkuśa grāhi vāma karam sūrya stha kriṃkāra agra dakṣiṇa tarjanīkam ātmānam cintayitvā sādhyasya galam aṅkuśena viddhvā sādhya hṛd gatam kriṃkāram kriṃkāra yuktena dakṣiṇa tarjanī agreṇa cālyamānam cintayan   bījam japet om   devadattasya manaḥ ākarṣaya svāhā iti japaḥ dviguṇa ityādi vyākhyātam eva

original: [3.2.54] vaśa lakṣeṇeti pūrvasevāyāṃ, sādhyasādhanakāle tv aniyamaḥ. ebhir ityādi: kṣuṃkāreṇa japtena kriṃkāreṇa bhāvitena kriṃkārasahitena tarjanyagreṇa manaś cālayet. itthaṃ sādhyasya manaś calati. ākṛṣṭaṃ syād ity arthaḥ. lakṣam ekena sidhyatīti: pūrvasevāyāṃ lakṣajapo 'yaṃ kriṃkāraḥ. kṣuṃkārasya vaśa lakṣeṇeti pūrvasevoktā.
analyzed: vaśa lakṣeṇa iti pūrva sevāyām sādhya sādhana kāle tu aniyamaḥ ebhiḥ ityādi kṣuṃkāreṇa japtena kriṃkāreṇa bhāvitena kriṃkāra sahitena tarjanī agreṇa manaḥ cālayet ittham sādhyasya manaḥ calati ākṛṣṭam syāt iti arthaḥ lakṣam ekena sidhyati iti pūrva sevāyām lakṣa japaḥ yam kriṃkāraḥ kṣuṃkārasya vaśa lakṣeṇa iti pūrva sevā uktā

original: [3.2.55] idānīṃ puṣṭim adhikṛtyāha: aṣṭadalasyetyādi. aṣṭāraṃ cakraṃ sanemikaṃ dhyātvā nemyāṃ svarā draṣṭavyāḥ. ata āha: nimnakā svaretyādi.
analyzed: idānīm puṣṭim adhikṛtya āha aṣṭadalasya ityādi aṣṭa aram cakram sa nemikam dhyātvā nemyām svarāḥ draṣṭavyāḥ atas āha nimnakā svara ityādi

original: [3.2.56] yathāvargasya pañcasyeti: pañcamavargasya bakāro grāhyaḥ, tribhir akṣara gṛhyata iti (57d) vakṣyamāṇavacanāt. sa ikārarephābhyāṃ yuktaḥ. upadesād bindunāpi. tataś ca briṃ iti rūpaṃ syāt. sa cakramadhye draṣṭavyaḥ. asya bījasyeti: idaṃ bījam. draṣṭavyam iti śeṣaḥ. kenety āha: jñāninām iti. jñāninety arthaḥ.
analyzed: yathā vargasya pañcasya iti pañcama vargasya bakāraḥ grāhyaḥ tribhiḥ gṛhyate iti vakṣyamāṇa vacanāt saḥ ikāra rephābhyām yuktaḥ upadesāt bindunā api tatas ca briṃ iti rūpam syāt sa cakra madhye draṣṭavyaḥ asya bījasya iti idam bījam draṣṭavyam iti śeṣaḥ kena iti āha jñāninām iti jñāninā iti arthaḥ

original: [3.2.57] saptanādasyetyādi: saptamo nāda ṛkāraḥ, tena yuktaḥ sa eva bakāraḥ. pañcamasya tu vargasya tṛbhir akṣara gṛhyata iti samatvāt. (?) upadeśād bindunāpi yojyaḥ. tena bṛṃ iti syāt. dalasevam iti: daleṣv areṣu sevā yasya sa dalasevo bṛṃkāraḥ. taṃ dalasevaṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ. areṣu bṛṃkāro draṣṭavya ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: saptanādasya ityādi saptamaḥ nādaḥ ṛkāraḥ tena yuktaḥ saḥ eva bakāraḥ pañcamasya tu vargasya gṛhyate iti sama tvāt upadeśāt bindunā api yojyaḥ tena bṛṃ iti syāt dala sevam iti daleṣu areṣu sevā yasya sa dala sevaḥ bṛṃkāraḥ tam dala sevam kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ areṣu bṛṃkāraḥ draṣṭavyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [3.2.58] dalasevam ity (57b) asya nirdeśam āha: dale atraivetyādi. saptamanāda ekāra iti kecit. breṃ iti syāt. bhāvayed ityādi: pītavarṇaṃ cakraṃ hṛdi bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: dala sa ivam iti asya nirdeśam āha dale atra eva ityādi saptama nādaḥ ekāraḥ iti kecid breṃ iti syāt bhāvayet ityādi pīta varṇam cakram hṛdi bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.2.59] kathaṃ bhāvayed ity āha: pūrvoktair ityādi. pūrvoktāṃ śūnyatāṃ bhāvayed ity arthaḥ. paścāc candramaṇḍale briṃkārapariṇatatadadhiṣṭhitadhānyamañjarīniṣpannaṃ pītam ...
analyzed: katham bhāvayet iti āha pūrva uktaiḥ ityādi pūrva uktām śūnyatām bhāvayet iti arthaḥ paścāt candra maṇḍale briṃkāra pariṇata tad adhiṣṭhita dhānya mañjarī niṣpannam pītam

original: [3.2.60] ... abhayavāmakaraṃ dhānyamañjarīdharadakṣiṇakaraṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ ratnamakuṭaṃ vajrasattvādhiṣṭhitamurdhānaṃ vasudhārārūpam ātmānaṃ vibhāvyātmahṛdi prāguktaṃ cakraṃ bhāvayet. bhāvanākhinno mantraṃ japed ity āha: madhya uktetyādi. oṃ briṃ svāheti japyo mantraḥ. madhye cakramadhye yad uktaṃ bījaṃ tad briṃkāra eva. śeṣaṃ subodham.
analyzed: abhaya vāma karam dhānya mañjarī dhara dakṣiṇa karam sarva ābharaṇa bhūṣitam ratna makuṭam vajra sattva adhiṣṭhita murdhānam vasudhārā rūpam ātmānam vibhāvya ātma hṛdi prāc uktam cakram bhāvayet bhāvanā khinnaḥ mantram japet iti āha madhye ukta ityādi om briṃ svāhā iti japyaḥ mantraḥ madhye cakra madhye yat uktam bījam tat briṃkāraḥ eva śeṣam su bodham

original: [3.2.61–62] aparaṃ prayogam āha: aparo bhedam ātmānam ityādi. ātmano bhedam aparaṃ vakṣya ity arthaḥ. sarvasaṃsthānam eva ceti: pūrvoktasaṃsthānaṃ cakraṃ sāṣṭāratvāt. pūrvetyādinā śūnyatādipūrvakaJñānaḍākinībhāvanoktā.
analyzed: aparam prayogam āha aparaḥ bhedam ātmānam ityādi ātmanaḥ bhedam aparam vakṣye iti arthaḥ sarva saṃsthānam eva ca iti pūrva ukta saṃsthānam cakram sāṣṭāra tvāt pūrva ityādinā śūnyatā ādi pūrvaka jñāna ḍākinī bhāvanā uktā

original: [3.2.63] tataś ca jñānaḍākinīyogī hṛdaye padmopari sūryacandropari sāṣṭāracakraṃ tac ca jñānavijñānena hūṃkāreṇa bhāvanāṃ bhāvitaṃ ceṣṭitam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: tatas ca jñāna ḍākinī yogī hṛdaye padma upari sūrya candra upari sa aṣṭāra cakram tat ca jñāna vijñānena hūṃkāreṇa bhāvanām bhāvitam ceṣṭitam iti arthaḥ

original: [3.2.64] madhye bījam iti: cakramadhye hūṃkāraṃ bhāvayet. punar nirdiśann āha: veṣṭitam iti. nemyāṃ svarāḥ.
analyzed: madhye bījam iti cakra madhye hūṃkāram bhāvayet punar nirdiśan āha veṣṭitam iti nemyām svarāḥ

original: [3.2.65] diśe amṛta catvāra iti: digareṣu catvāry amṛtāni a ā ā3 aṃ ity etāni bījāni vāmāvartena pūrvādiṣu nyasanīyāni. vidigareṣu pañcabuddhābhimaṇḍito hūṃkāraḥ.
analyzed: diśe amṛta catvāraḥ iti digareṣu catvāri amṛtāni iti etāni bījāni vāma āvartena pūrva ādiṣu nyasanīyāni vidigareṣu pañca buddha abhimaṇḍitaḥ hūṃkāraḥ

original: [3.2.66] cintayed ātmadehaṃ tv iti: svahṛdaye cakram idaṃ candrasthaṃ bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ. amṛtebhyo nisṛtya raśmayo daśa diśo gatvā hastyādisaptaratnayuktaṃ jagat kṛtvā ...
analyzed: cintayet ātma deham tu iti sva hṛdaye cakram idam candra stham bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ amṛtebhyaḥ nisṛtya raśmayaḥ daśa diśaḥ gatvā hasti ādi sapta ratna yuktam jagat kṛtvā

original: [3.2.67] ... punar ātmamanasi svecchayā viśanto dhyeyā iti. bhāvayed iti: atiśayena bhāvayan yogī niṣkampo nirupadravo bhavati.
analyzed: punar ātma manasi sva icchayā viśantaḥ dhyeyāḥ iti bhāvayet iti atiśayena bhāvayan yogī niṣkampaḥ nirupadravaḥ bhavati

original: [3.2.68] durmedhā dūravartitam iti: yad uktaṃ durmedhādikaṃ tena dūrād eva varjitaḥ syāc cakraṃ bhāvayan yogī.
analyzed: durmedhāḥ dūra vartitam iti yat uktam durmedha ādikam tena dūrāt eva varjitaḥ syāt cakram bhāvayan yogī

original: [3.2.69] yadāsamāhito yogī bhāvanāśaktas tadā sitaṃ cakrād reṇuṃ daśasu dikṣu gatvā ...
analyzed: yadā asamāhitaḥ yogī bhāvanā aśaktaḥ tadā sitam cakrāt reṇum daśasu dikṣu gatvā

original: [3.2.70] ... punar āgatya svacetasi viśantaṃ bhāvayet. tena paracittaṃ jānāti: jñānacetādītyādi. atyarthaṃ cakram idaṃ bhāvayan saṃsārān mokṣaṃ prāpnotīty āha: samāhitaṃ cakra ityādi.
analyzed: punar āgatya sva cetasi viśantam bhāvayet tena para cittam jānāti jñāna cetā ādi ityādi atyartham cakram idam bhāvayan saṃsārāt mokṣam prāpnoti iti āha samāhitam cakre ityādi

original: [3.2.71] yogāntaram āha: candretyādi. padmacandropari jñānabījena nirmitam iti: svacittamātram eva bījaṃ tato niṣpannaṃ vairocanaṃ bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ. atha vā: aḥkārabījaṃ jñānabījaṃ, tato niṣpannaṃ pūrvavat.
analyzed: yoga antaram āha candra ityādi padma candra upari jñāna bījena nirmitam iti sva citta mātram eva bījam tatas niṣpannam vairocanam bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ atha vā aḥkāra bījam jñāna bījam tatas niṣpannam pūrvavat

original: [3.2.72] pāṇidvayena mudrāliṅganābhinayasthitena hṛdisaktena yuktaṃ vairocanaṃ bhāvayed iti.
analyzed: pāṇi dvayena mudrā liṅgana abhinaya sthitena hṛdisaktena yuktam vairocanam bhāvayet iti

original: [3.2.73] sphurantam ityādi: pañca buddhāḥ svaśarīrāt sphuranto dhyeyāḥ sarvalokadhātuṣv iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: sphurantam ityādi pañca buddhāḥ sva śarīrāt sphurantaḥ dhyeyāḥ sarva lokadhātuṣu iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.2.74] sphurantaṃ vividhatīkṣṇānām iti: vividhā raśmayaḥ svaśarīrāt sphuranto draṣṭavyā iti bhāvaḥ. etadbhāvanayā kiṃ syād ity āha: prajñā vajra jagottareti. abhedyā prajñā jagaduttāraṇasamarthā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ. asya mantroddhāram āha: svaretyādi. svarapūrvādibījam akāraḥ. sa ca visargeṇa bindudvayena yoktavyaḥ.
analyzed: sphurantam vividha tīkṣṇānām iti vividhāḥ raśmayaḥ sva śarīrāt sphurantaḥ draṣṭavyāḥ iti bhāvaḥ etad bhāvanayā kim syāt iti āha prajñā vajra jaga uttara iti abhedyā prajñā jagat uttāraṇa samarthā bhavati iti bhāvaḥ asya mantra uddhāram āha svara ityādi svara pūrva ādi bījam akāraḥ sa ca visargeṇa bindu dvayena yoktavyaḥ

original: [3.2.75] praṇametyādi: oṃ aḥ svāheti mantraḥ. asya bījaṃ tv iti: asmād bījād bhagavato niṣpattir iti bhāvaḥ. samāhito yogī japaṃ bhāvanāṃ ca kurvan sidhyatīti. abhicāras tu ṣoḍaśāracakram eva kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ bhāvayatā sādhyaḥ.
analyzed: praṇama ityādi om aḥ svāhā iti mantraḥ asya bījam tu iti asmāt bījāt bhagavataḥ niṣpattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ samāhitaḥ yogī japam bhāvanām ca kurvan sidhyati iti abhicāraḥ tu ṣoḍaśa ara cakram eva kṛṣṇa varṇam bhāvayatā sādhyaḥ

original: [3.2.col.] ity uktakrameṇa rakṣāprajñādikaṃ prakriyate 'sminn itītiprakaraṇaṃ yogapīṭhe. iti catuṣpīṭhanibandhe yogapīṭhe dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ.
analyzed: iti ukta krameṇa rakṣā prajñā ādikam prakriyate smin iti iti prakaraṇam yogapīṭhe iti catuṣpīṭha nibandhe yogapīṭhe dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ

original: [3.3.1] idānīm āveśādikapaṭalam āha: śrutam ityādi. he deva, śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama. kiṃ tad ity āha: adhiṣṭhānakrama kīdṛśam iti. adhiṣṭhānakramo 'dhiṣṭhānavidhānam āveśavidhir ity arthaḥ. adhiṣṭhānakramaḥ kīdṛśa iti bhāvaḥ. ko 'sāv ity āha: yenetyādi. yenādhiṣṭhānakrameṇa darśitena sattvānāṃ vineyānām āveśo bhavati. katham ity āha:
analyzed: idānīm āveśa ādika paṭalam āha śrutam ityādi he deva śrotum kautūhalam mama kim tat iti āha adhiṣṭhāna krama kīdṛśam iti adhiṣṭhāna kramaḥ dhiṣṭhāna vidhānam āveśa vidhiḥ iti arthaḥ adhiṣṭhāna kramaḥ kīdṛśaḥ iti bhāvaḥ saḥ iti āha yena ityādi yena adhiṣṭhāna krameṇa darśitena sattvānām vineyānām āveśaḥ bhavati katham iti āha

original: yogabhāvata iti. āveśayogabhāvanayā yogavihitayety arthaḥ. taṃ bhagavan kathayeti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: yoga bhāvataḥ iti āveśa yoga bhāvanayā yoga vihitayā iti arthaḥ tam bhagavan kathaya iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.3.2] yathātattvam ity aviparītam. samyak saṃsāra-m-uttaram iti: saṃsārād uttārayatīti saṃsārottāram āveśavidhiṃ śṛṇv iti saṃbandhaḥ. cikitsā mohitasattvānām iti: mohasāgarapatitānām āveśāc cikitsā kleśacikitsā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ. āveśāc chraddhotpādyate. śraddhayā devatāṃ bhāvayatāṃ cikitsā syād ity ato 'dhiṣṭhānavidhiḥ kartavyaḥ.
analyzed: yathātattvam iti aviparītam samyak saṃsāram uttaram iti saṃsārāt uttārayati iti saṃsāra uttāram āveśa vidhim śṛṇu iti saṃbandhaḥ cikitsā mohita sattvānām iti moha sāgara patitānām āveśāt cikitsā kleśa cikitsā bhavati iti bhāvaḥ āveśāt śraddhā utpādyate śraddhayā devatām bhāvayatām cikitsā syāt iti atas dhiṣṭhāna vidhiḥ kartavyaḥ

original: adhiṣṭhādharma deśayed iti: adhiṣṭhānalakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ darśayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: deśayet iti adhiṣṭhāna lakṣaṇam dharmam darśayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.3.3] hṛdaya iti svahṛdaye. tatra candramaṇḍale hūṃkāraṃ vīkṣya tadraśmisaṃsparśād viśvaṃ khasamaṃ bhāvayet pūrvalakṣaṇetyādivacanāt (5a). agnītyādi: sādhyahṛdaye 'pi vahnimaṇḍalaṃ rephayuktamadhyaṃ tryaśraṃ dhyātvā ...
analyzed: hṛdaye iti sva hṛdaye tatra candra maṇḍale hūṃkāram vīkṣya tad raśmi saṃsparśāt viśvam kha samam bhāvayet pūrva lakṣaṇa ityādi vacanāt agni ityādi sādhya hṛdaye vahni maṇḍalam repha yukta madhyam tri asram dhyātvā

original: [3.3.4] ... tadraśminā sādhyaṃ dagdhaṃ vibhāvayet. sarvasaṃsthānajvālanam iti: sarvasaṃsthānam aṅgapratyaṅgaṃ tad api dagdham iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: tad raśminā sādhyam dagdham vibhāvayet sarva saṃsthāna jvālanam iti sarva saṃsthānam aṅga pratyaṅgam tat api dagdham iti bhāvaḥ

original: jñānaḍākinīyogī svahṛccandrasthahūṃkāraraśmisaṃsparśād viśvaśūnyatāṃ vibhāvya sādhyam api pūrvoktakrameṇa vahnidagdhaṃ bhasmapuñjamātrāvaśeṣaṃ hūṃkārayogāt punar utthāpya, tasya hṛdi vahnimaṇḍalaṃ, tasya madhye padmaṃ, tanmadhye ca sūryaṃ vīkṣya, tatra hūṃkāraṃ pañcabuddhābhidhaṃ cintayed iti.
analyzed: jñāna ḍākinī yogī sva hṛd candra stha hūṃkāra raśmi saṃsparśāt viśva śūnyatām vibhāvya sādhyam api pūrva ukta krameṇa vahni dagdham bhasma puñja mātra avaśeṣam hūṃkāra yogāt punar utthāpya tasya hṛdi vahni maṇḍalam tasya madhye padmam tad madhye ca sūryam vīkṣya tatra hūṃkāram pañca buddha abhidham cintayet iti

original: [3.3.5] pūrvetyādinā śūnyatāṃ smārayati. agnītyādinā cāgnimaṇḍalamātram. tatra padmaṃ tūpadeśāt.
analyzed: pūrva ityādinā śūnyatām smārayati agni ityādinā ca agni maṇḍala mātram tatra padmam tu upadeśāt

original: [3.3.6] hūṃkāraṃ lokeśvaretyādinā pratipādayati.
analyzed: hūṃkāram lokeśvara ityādinā pratipādayati

original: [3.3.7] punar āha: bhāvayed ityādi. asya bījaṃ: idaṃ hūṃbījam.
analyzed: punar āha bhāvayet ityādi asya bījam idam hūm bījam

original: [3.3.8] jñānaḍākinībhāvanāpūrvakam āveśaḥ kartavya iti darśayann āha: sūryetyādi. padmopari sūrye hūṃkāras tannirmitaṃ jñānaḍākinīrūpam. ata āha: jñāna-m-ātmeti. jñānātmā hūṃkāras tannirmitaṃ jñānaḍākinīrūpam ātmānaṃ bhāvayed ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: jñāna ḍākinī bhāvanā pūrvakam āveśaḥ kartavyaḥ iti darśayan āha sūrya ityādi padma upari sūrye hūṃkāraḥ tad nirmitam jñāna ḍākinī rūpam atas āha jñānam ātmā iti jñāna ātmā hūṃkāraḥ tad nirmitam jñāna ḍākinī rūpam ātmānam bhāvayet iti arthaḥ

original: [3.3.9] etadviśeṣaṇam āha: dvibhujetyādi. kirīṭasthāḥ pañca tathāgatāḥ. kirīṭasya pūrve vairocanaḥ, uttare ratnasaṃbhavaḥ, paścime 'mitābhaḥ, dakṣiṇe 'moghasiddhiḥ, madhye 'kṣobhyaḥ, kirīṭāgre pañcaśūkavajram iti kirīṭītyādinoktam.
analyzed: etad viśeṣaṇam āha dvi bhuja ityādi kirīṭa sthāḥ pañca tathāgatāḥ kirīṭasya pūrve vairocanaḥ uttare ratnasaṃbhavaḥ paścime mitābhaḥ dakṣiṇe moghasiddhiḥ madhye kṣobhyaḥ kirīṭa agre pañcaśūka vajram iti kirīṭi ityādinā uktam

original: [3.3.10] vāme yogapātraṃ, dakṣiṇe cordhvakhaṭvāṅgaṃ bhāvayed iti. śvāsaniścalam iti: sthiraṃ cittaṃ yāvat syāt, tāvad bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: vāme yogapātram dakṣiṇe ca ūrdhva khaṭvāṅgam bhāvayet iti śvāsa niścalam iti sthiram cittam yāvat syāt tāvat bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.3.11] mantroddhāram āha: yathetyādi subodham.
analyzed: mantra uddhāram āha yathā ityādi su bodham

original: [3.3.12] jñānaḍākinīyoginā mantraḥ pūrvasevāyāṃ lakṣatrayaṃ japtavyaḥ. oṃ a svāheti. paścād ityādi: pūrvasevānantaraṃ jñānaḍākinīyogī hṛdaye candra saṃcintyetyādyarthaṃ (3a) vidhāyāmunā mantreṇa sarṣapān abhijapya balidānapūrvakaṃ taiḥ sādhyaṃ hanyāt. tata āviṣṭo bhavati. karmam ākṛtyeti: karmāveśakriyā. ākṛtyeti: kartavyam. adaityeti:
analyzed: jñāna ḍākinī yoginā mantraḥ pūrva sevāyām lakṣa trayam japtavyaḥ om svāhā iti paścāt ityādi pūrva sevā anantaram jñāna ḍākinī yogī hṛdaye candra vidhāya amunā mantreṇa sarṣapān abhijapya bali dāna pūrvakam taiḥ sādhyam hanyāt tatas āviṣṭaḥ bhavati karmam ākṛtya iti karma āveśa kriyāḥ ākṛtya iti kartavyam adaitya iti iti kartavyam adaitya iti iti kartavyam adaitya iti iti kartavyam adaitya iti iti

original: baliṃ darśayati.
analyzed: balim darśayati

original: [3.3.13] aparaṃ prayogam āha: pañcetyādi. madanam ity adhyāhāryam upadeśāt. pañcāmṛtayuktaṃ madanaṃ tenaiva mantreṇāṣṭottaraśatajaptaṃ pūrvoktavidhisaṃpādanapūrvakaṃ sādhyāya dadyāt. tatpānād āviṣṭaḥ syāt. śatam aṣṭam iti: aṣṭottaraṃ śatam. vidhineti: pūrvoktaṃ sarvaṃ vidhānaṃ kṛtvā madanaṃ dadyād ity arthaḥ. sa āviṣṭaḥ svayaṃ vajragītaṃ gāyet.
analyzed: aparam prayogam āha pañca ityādi madanam iti adhyāhāryam upadeśāt pañcāmṛta yuktam madanam tena eva mantreṇa aṣṭottaraśata japtam pūrva ukta vidhi saṃpādana pūrvakam sādhyāya dadyāt tad pānāt āviṣṭaḥ syāt śatam aṣṭam iti aṣṭa uttaram śatam vidhinā iti pūrva uktam sarvam vidhānam kṛtvā madanam dadyāt iti arthaḥ saḥ āviṣṭaḥ svayam vajragītam gāyet

original: [3.3.14] gītam āha: rama rametyādi. ramasva ramasvety arthaḥ. harṣe dviruktiḥ. ho saṃbodhane. vajjeti: saṃbodhanaṃ vajradharasya. sarvair dharmaiḥ samasthaiḥ pariśuddhai ramasva ramasveti saṃbandhaḥ. khaddhu tuhuṃ: tvaṃ khāda. kiṃ tad ity āha: dīaṇḍa dāaṇḍa iti. dattam apuṇyaṃ dāpitaṃ cāpuṇyaṃ taddvayam api khādeti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: gītam āha rama rama ityādi ramasva ramasva iti arthaḥ harṣe dviruktiḥ ho sambodhane vajja iti saṃbodhanam vajradharasya sarvaiḥ dharmaiḥ samasthaiḥ pariśuddhaiḥ ramasva ramasva iti saṃbandhaḥ khaddhu tuhum tvam khāda kim tat iti āha dīaṇḍa dāaṇḍa iti dattam apuṇyam dāpitam ca apuṇyam tat dvayam api khāda iti bhāvaḥ

original: apuṇyasya hi nāśa iṣyate. khāditaṃ ca naśyati. tac ca sarvasattvānām iti draṣṭavyam. jovu tuhuṃ: yogas tava. sa māṃ saṃsārād uttārayatu. kṣaṇād ihaiva janmani buddhatvāvāhakatvāt. tava samāpattyā sarvam idaṃ †bhagavata eva prajñāṅge. bhagavantam āha:† mahuṃ saṃsāru uttāru khaṇu padasyārthaḥ.
analyzed: apuṇyasya hi nāśaḥ iṣyate khāditam ca naśyati tat ca sarva sattvānām iti draṣṭavyam yogaḥ tava sa mām saṃsārāt uttārayatu kṣaṇāt iha eva janmani buddha tva āvāhaka tvāt tava samāpattyā sarvam idam bhagavataḥ eva prajñāṅge bhagavantam āha mahum saṃsāru uttāru padasya arthaḥ

original: [3.3.15] anena gītena vajraghaṇṭābhinadanād āviṣṭo nṛtyati.
analyzed: anena gītena vajra ghaṇṭā abhinadanāt āviṣṭaḥ nṛtyati

original: [3.3.16] tata oṃ tiṣṭhetyādimantreṇa taṃ svasthīkuryāt.
analyzed: tatas om tiṣṭha ityādi mantreṇa tam svasthīkuryāt

original: [3.3.17] paścāt saṃtarpaṇārthaṃ taṃ madanaṃ pāyayet. etad evāha: prīṇayed iti. etat sarvam andhapaṭaṃ baddhvā maṇḍalasamīpaṃ nītvā sādhyaṃ samanuṣṭheyam ity ata āha: sarveṣām iti. svasthatānantaraṃ tasmai yoginīcakraṃ darśayed ity āha: yoginī sarva darśayed iti. andhapaṭam udghāṭya darśayed ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: paścāt saṃtarpaṇa artham tam madanam pāyayet etat eva āha prīṇayet iti etat sarvam andhapaṭam baddhvā maṇḍala samīpam nītvā sādhyam samanuṣṭheyam iti atas āha sarveṣām iti svastha tā anantaram tasmai yoginīcakram darśayet iti āha yoginī sarva darśayet iti andhapaṭam udghāṭya darśayet iti arthaḥ

original: tadanu puṣpapātaṃ jñātvā mṛdumadhyādhimātrakrameṇa dharmadeśanāṃ kuryāt. etad evāha: tatra dharmāṇi kartavyaṃ hīna madhyama uccakair iti. etac ca sekavidhau vistarato jñeyam.
analyzed: tadanu puṣpapātam jñātvā mṛdu madhya adhimātra krameṇa dharma deśanām kuryāt etat eva āha tatra dharmāṇi kartavyam hīna madhyama uccakais iti etat ca seka vidhau vistarataḥ jñeyam

original: [3.3.18] idānīṃ mantrapāṭhamātreṇāveśaṃ darśayati: oṃ yogāveśa aḥ ityādi.
analyzed: idānīm mantra pāṭha mātreṇa āveśam darśayati om yoga āveśa aḥ ityādi

original: [3.3.19] imaṃ mantraṃ pūrvasevārthaṃ lakṣaṃ jñānaḍākinīyogī japtvāveśayet. etad evāha: samāhitam ityādi. āveśam āha: tena pūrvasevāsiddhena mantreṇa sarṣapān abhimantrya balidānapūrvakaṃ sādhyaṃ hanyāt. tata āviṣṭaḥ syāt. ata āha: sarṣapena tv ityādi.
analyzed: imam mantram pūrva sevā artham lakṣam jñāna ḍākinī yogī japtvā āveśayet etat eva āha samāhitam ityādi āveśam āha tena pūrva sevā siddhena mantreṇa sarṣapān abhimantrya bali dāna pūrvakam sādhyam hanyāt tatas āviṣṭaḥ syāt atas āha sarṣapena tu ityādi

original: [3.3.20] hūṃkāranādabhīṣaṇam iti: hūṃkāram uccārayan pūrvamantrābhimantritaiḥ sarṣapais tāḍayed iti bhāvaḥ. asya svasthīkaraṇārthaṃ pūrvokto mantra ity āha: asyetyādi. sa ca oṃ tiṣṭhetyādi (16).
analyzed: hūṃkāra nāda bhīṣaṇam iti hūṃkāram uccārayan pūrva mantra abhimantritaiḥ sarṣapaiḥ tāḍayet iti bhāvaḥ asya svasthīkaraṇa artham pūrva uktaḥ mantraḥ iti āha asya ityādi sa ca om tiṣṭha ityādi

original: [3.3.21] idānīṃ dṛṣṭyāveśam āha: oṃ maṇetyādi. oṃ maṇa ghuru ghuru dṛṣṭi cili 2 hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaḍ iti mantraṃ ...
analyzed: idānīm dṛṣṭi āveśam āha om maṇa ityādi om maṇa ghuru ghuru dṛṣṭi cili hūm hūm hūm phaṭ iti mantram

original: [3.3.22] ... jñānaḍākinīyogī lakṣaṃ japtvā paścāt sakṛd uccārayan yaṃ paśyati, sa tatkṣaṇād āviṣṭo bhaved ity āha: lakṣam ekam ityādi. dṛṣṭiveśam iti: dṛṣṭyāveśaḥ. yaṃ yaṃ paśyati pūjānām iti: maṇḍalakhādanapānādikāle yaṃ paśyati, sa āviṣṭaḥ san nṛtyati. svasthīkaraṇārthaṃ pūrvoktasvasthīkaraṇamantraḥ (16).
analyzed: jñāna ḍākinī yogī lakṣam japtvā paścāt sakṛt uccārayan yam paśyati sa tad kṣaṇāt āviṣṭaḥ bhavet iti āha lakṣam ekam ityādi dṛṣṭi veśam iti dṛṣṭi āveśaḥ yam yam paśyati pūjānām iti maṇḍala khādana pāna ādi kāle yam paśyati saḥ āviṣṭaḥ san nṛtyati svasthīkaraṇa artham pūrva ukta svasthīkaraṇa mantraḥ

original: [3.3.33] idānīṃ likhanoccāṭanam āha: bhūrjetyādi. ādiśabdād avadhūtādikarpaṭam. rudhirakair iti: tarjanīrudhiraṃ, rājikā lavaṇaṃ ca. ebhir bhūrjādau pūrvoktaṃ savidarbhaṇaṃ mantraṃ likhet. kathaṃ likhed ity āha: agre dhāritayogasyeti. pūrvoktavajraḍākinīyogenety arthaḥ. sarvasaṃsthitam iti: sādhyam api pūrvavad dhyātvā likhed iti bhāvaḥ.

original: [3.3.34] paścād anena mantreṇa raktasūtram aṣṭaśatajaptaṃ kṛtvā tena tatpatraṃ baddhvā, taru uccādi m-ālambyeti: uccataror agre 'valambayed iti bhāvaḥ. agre 'pi kutrety āha: vātāpīḍyasya bhāvanam iti. yad agraṃ vātena pīḍyate tasminn agre tad avalambayed ity arthaḥ.

original: sūtrāvalambanānantaram api pūrvavad vāyunā preryamāṇaṃ sādhyaṃ bhāvayed iti bhāvanam iti padasyārthaḥ.

original: [3.3.35] yaṃ prerayatītyādi: yasyāṃ diśi tat patraṃ vātena preryate, tasyāṃ sādhyo 'pi gamanotsuko gacchaty evety arthaḥ. uccāṭanaṃ tu yogīnām iti: devatāyogena japtamantrasyoccāṭanaṃ sidhyati niyameneti bhāvaḥ.

original: [3.3.36] idānīm ākṛṣṭiprayogāntaram āha: candretyādi. pūrvoktaśūnyatādikrameṇa candrasthaṃ vajraḍākinīrūpam ātmānaṃ vicintya balidānapuraḥsaraṃ pūrvasevāyāṃ kṛtalakṣamantrajapo yogī, tasya madhye tu yuñjitam iti: raktagandhena gocarmapramāṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kāryaṃ raktamaṇḍala kārata iti (38b) vakṣyamāṇavacanāt, tasya madhya iti boddhavyam.
analyzed: idānīm ākṛṣṭi prayoga antaram āha candra ityādi pūrva ukta śūnyatā ādi krameṇa candra stham vajra ḍākinī rūpam ātmānam vicintya bali dāna puraḥsaram pūrva sevāyām kṛta lakṣa mantra japaḥ yogī tasya madhye tu iti rakta gandhena gocarma pramāṇam maṇḍalam kāryam rakta maṇḍala kārataḥ iti vakṣyamāṇa vacanāt tasya madhye iti boddhavyam

original: tatra sādhyanāma yoktavyaṃ madhye nāmaṃ tu m-ālikhed iti (38d) vakṣyamāṇavacanāt.

original: [3.3.37] yathā: oṃ Vvajraḍākini diśam ākarṣayākarṣaya oṃ hrīḥ hūṃ phreṃ phruṃ phuḥ devadattam ākarṣaya svāheti vidarbhaṇam.

original: [3.3.38] khadiretyādi: tasya gocarmapramāṇasya raktagandhamaṇḍalasyāṣṭasu dikṣu khādirā aṣṭāṅgulapramāṇā ekaśūkavajrākārā aṣṭau kīlakā nikhātavyāḥ. kārata iti maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvety arthaḥ. paripūrṇabalisaṃyuktam iti: sarvam idaṃ balidānapūrvakaṃ kartavyam iti bhāvaḥ.
