analyzed: kukkura romabhiḥ pūrayitvā tathā eva vakṣyamāṇam mantram vidarbhaṇa yutam tatra prakṣipet pūrvavat mantram japet sarvatra pūrva sevā lakṣa jāpāt

original: [3.3.56] oṃ krodheśvari phuḥ phiṃ devadattāyā bhagaṃ dūṣaya phaḍ iti vidarbhaṇam.
analyzed: om krodheśvari phuḥ phim devadattāyāḥ bhagam dūṣaya phaṭ iti vidarbhaṇam

original: [3.3.57] sādhanakāle sāṣṭaśato japaḥ. vajra guhyābhi nikṣiped iti: abhedyo 'yaṃ mantra ity arthaḥ. asmin karmaṇi kṛte bhagavivartaḥ pīḍā ca mahatī syāt.
analyzed: sādhana kāle sa aṣṭaśataḥ japaḥ vajra guhya abhi nikṣipet iti abhedyaḥ yam mantraḥ iti arthaḥ asmin karmaṇi kṛte bhaga vivartaḥ pīḍā ca mahatī syāt

original: [3.3.58] uddhṛte tatra mokṣaḥ.
analyzed: uddhṛte tatra mokṣaḥ

original: [3.3.59] nāḍīdrāvaṇaprayogāntaram āha: candretyādi. sādhyāyāḥ kukṣau candropari amṛtākṣaraṃ suṃkāraṃ bhāvayet. kiṃbhūtam ity āha: †...† nijaraśminā coditāt sarvāṅgasthanāḍīcakrād amṛtaṃ śukraṃ srāvayantaṃ suṃkāraṃ bhāvayed ity arthaḥ. amṛtāmbuṣa iti śukram.
analyzed: nāḍī drāvaṇa prayoga antaram āha candra ityādi sādhyāyāḥ kukṣau candra upari amṛtākṣaram suṃkāram bhāvayet kiṃbhūtam iti āha nija raśminā coditāt sarva aṅga stha nāḍī cakrāt amṛtam śukram srāvayantam suṃkāram bhāvayet iti arthaḥ amṛta ambuṣaḥ iti śukram

original: [3.3.60] tataḥ kiṃ kuryād ity āha: vikasad ityādi. vikasadbandhūkakusumākāram aṅkuśākṣaraṃ kriṃkāraṃ madhye ceti bhagamadhye gūḍha gūḍhaṃ tv iti khagamukhānāḍīmukhagataṃ cintayet. gūḍha khagamukhānāḍī. tasyāṃ gūḍhaṃ kriṃkāraṃ bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: tatas kim kuryāt iti āha vikasat ityādi vikasat bandhūka kusuma ākāram aṅkuśa akṣaram kriṃkāram madhye ca iti bhaga madhye gūḍha gūḍham tu iti khaga mukhā nāḍī mukha gatam cintayet gūḍha khaga mukhā nāḍī tasyām gūḍham kriṃkāram bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.3.61] tataḥ kiṃ kuryād ity āha: krodhetyādi. krodhāṅguṣṭhasya tarjanyā agre suṃkāraṃ vicintya tayā khagamukhāṃ cālayan bhāvayet. tasya maṅguṣṭham iti: tāṃ khagamukhāṃ cālayed iti bhāvaḥ. piṇḍārthaṃ darśayann āha: tribhir yogaṃ tu cetaneti. triṣu sthāneṣu yogam akṣaranyāsaṃ cetaneti cintayed iti bhāvaḥ. kukṣibhagatarjanyagrāṇi trīṇi sthānāni.
analyzed: tatas kim kuryāt iti āha krodha ityādi krodhāṅguṣṭhasya tarjanyāḥ agre suṃkāram vicintya tayā khaga mukhām cālayan bhāvayet tasya iti tām khaga mukhām cālayet iti bhāvaḥ piṇḍa artham darśayan āha tribhiḥ yogam tu cetanā iti triṣu sthāneṣu yogam akṣara nyāsam cetanā iti cintayet iti bhāvaḥ kukṣi bhaga tarjanī agrāṇi trīṇi sthānāni

original: [3.3.62] sravanta iti: sarvāvayavasthitaṃ śukraṃ sravantīṃ bhagam iti bhagavatīṃ nārīm ity arthaḥ. cintayed iti śeṣaḥ. ambuṣa iti śukram. atyantaduṣṭastrībhagākoṭanam.
analyzed: sravantaḥ iti sarva avayava sthitam śukram sravantīm bhagam iti bhagavatīm nārīm iti arthaḥ cintayet iti śeṣaḥ ambuṣaḥ iti śukram atyanta duṣṭa strī bhaga ākoṭanam

original: [3.3.63] bhaiṣajyonmattīkaraṇam āha: jyotiketyādi. jyotikā jyotiṣmatī tailam. gurava iti guñjāphalam. unmattapañca-m-aṅgikam iti: dhuttūrakasya pañcāṅgāni, patrapuṣpaphalamūlavalkalāni. mahāgugguluṃ naramastiṣkam. naratailaṃ narājyam.
analyzed: bhaiṣajya unmattī karaṇam āha jyotikā ityādi jyotikā jyotiṣmatī tailam guravaḥ iti guñjā phalam unmatta pañcamaṅgikam iti dhuttūrakasya pañcāṅgāni patra puṣpa phala mūla valkalāni mahāguggulum nara mastiṣkam nara tailam nara ājyam

original: [3.3.64] amṛtodakaṃ madyam. jyotikādivastu madye prakṣipya tan madyaṃ yaḥ pibati sa unmatto bhavati. ata āha: jihvendriyaṃ tu svādayed iti. gurubuddhādyapakāriṇe tat kartavyam. ghṛtapānān nivartate.
analyzed: amṛta udakam madyam jyotikā ādi vastu madye prakṣipya tat madyam yaḥ pibati saḥ unmattaḥ bhavati atas āha jihvā indriyam tu svādayet iti guru buddha ādi apakāriṇe tat kartavyam ghṛta pānāt nivartate

original: [3.3.65] añjanam āha: apatitetyādi. yāvat skandhān nāvatāryate bhūmau śavas tāvad eva tasya vastram ādāya vartiḥ kāryā. nāgendraṃ śīśakaṃ tasya mallikā.
analyzed: añjanam āha apatita ityādi yāvat skandhāt na avatāryate bhūmau śavaḥ tāvat eva tasya vastram ādāya vartiḥ kāryā nāga indram śīśakam tasya mallikā

original: [3.3.66] balisthānaṃ śmasānam. ḍākinīhṛdayaṃ jñānaḍākinīmantram.
analyzed: bali sthānam śmasānam ḍākinī hṛdayam jñāna ḍākinī mantram

original: [3.3.67] śmasānabalikā: āmamatsyādibaliḥ. catvare śmaśāne śmaśāne gatvā kapālatrayopari śīśakamallikāyāṃ naratailena prāguktavartim (65b) ādāya dīpaṃ prajvālya kapālam aparaṃ tadupari dattvā, jñānaḍākinīmantram aṣṭaśatam āvartayan (66d) balidānapuraḥsaraṃ kajjalaṃ pātayet. baliś ca deyaḥ śmaśāne, ekavṛkṣe vā. tenāñjitanayanaḥ sarvā dākinīḥ paśyati.
analyzed: śmasāna balikā āma matsya ādi baliḥ catvare śmaśāne śmaśāne gatvā kapāla traya upari śīśaka mallikāyām nara tailena prāc ukta vartim ādāya dīpam prajvālya kapālam aparam tad upari dattvā jñāna ḍākinī mantram aṣṭaśatam āvartayan bali dāna puraḥsaram kajjalam pātayet baliḥ ca deyaḥ śmaśāne eka vṛkṣe vā tena añjita nayanaḥ sarvāḥ dākinīḥ paśyati

original: [3.3.68] kalikaraṇam āha: ucchiṣṭetyādi. ucchiṣṭabhāṇḍadvaye śmaśānāṅgārarājikāviṣarudhirādimasyā kākapakṣalekhanyā ...
analyzed: kali karaṇam āha ucchiṣṭa ityādi ucchiṣṭa bhāṇḍa dvaye śmaśāna aṅgāra rājikā viṣa rudhira ādi masyā kākapakṣa lekhanyā

original: [3.3.69] ... prāṇidvayasya nāmasahitaṃ oṃ kirītyādimantraṃ likhitvā ...
analyzed: prāṇi dvayasya nāma sahitam om kiri ityādi mantram likhitvā

original: [3.3.70] ... krodhacittena tad bhāṇḍadvayaṃ jñānaḍākinīyogī gharṣet. balidānapūrvakam etat kartavyam.
analyzed: krodha cittena tat bhāṇḍa dvayam jñāna ḍākinī yogī gharṣet bali dāna pūrvakam etat kartavyam

original: [3.3.71] oṃ kalītyādimantram ...
analyzed: om kalī ityādi mantram

original: [3.3.72] ... aṣṭottaraśataṃ japan kaliṃ kārayati. tacchāntim āha: adaityetyādi. balidānapūrvakaṃ jñānaḍākinīyogī śāntacittas tayoḥ svadehanirgataraśmimukhagataiḥ kalaśair amṛtāmbupūrṇair abhiṣekaṃ bhāvayet. tataḥ kaliśāntiḥ syāt.
analyzed: aṣṭottaraśatam japan kalim kārayati tad śāntim āha adaitya ityādi bali dāna pūrvakam jñāna ḍākinī yogī śānta cittaḥ tayoḥ sva deha nirgata raśmi mukha gataiḥ kalaśaiḥ amṛta ambu pūrṇaiḥ abhiṣekam bhāvayet tatas kali śāntiḥ syāt

original: [3.3.col.] ity uktakrameṇāveśābhakṣyīkaraṇaśṛgālīkaraṇoccāṭanādikaṃ prakriyate 'sminn itīti prakaraṇaṃ yogapīṭham.
analyzed: iti ukta krameṇa āveśa abhakṣyīkaraṇa śṛgālīkaraṇa uccāṭana ādikam prakriyate smin iti iti prakaraṇam yogapīṭham

original: iti catuṣpīṭhanibandhe yogapīṭhe tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ.
analyzed: iti catuṣpīṭha nibandhe yogapīṭhe tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ

original: [3.4.1] idānīṃ prajñopāyādinā vajrādiviśuddhiṃ darśayitum āha: kautūhalam ityādi. śrotum āpanneti: śrotuṃ kautūhalam āpanno 'smīti bhāvaḥ. kiṃ tac chrotum ity āha: advayo yogasārata iti. sāram advayayogam ity arthaḥ. saṃjñā advayavākyānāṃ kathaṃ yogaṃ tu m-ārabhed iti:
analyzed: idānīm prajñā upāya ādinā vajra ādi viśuddhim darśayitum āha kautūhalam ityādi śrotum āpannā iti śrotum kautūhalam smi iti bhāvaḥ kim tat śrotum iti āha advayaḥ yoga sārataḥ iti sāram advaya yogam iti arthaḥ saṃjñā advaya vākyānām katham yogam tu mā ārabhet iti

original: advayayogasya saṃjñāvākyaṃ saṃjñāvacanaṃ kathaṃ syād iti śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ prāpto 'smi. advayayogaś ca saṃvṛtiparamārthābhedarūpaḥ. taṃ ca yogaṃ katham ārabheteti śrotuṃ kautūhalam āpanno 'smīti saṃbandhaḥ.
analyzed: advaya yogasya saṃjñā vākyam saṃjñā vacanam katham syāt iti śrotum kautūhalam smi advaya yogaḥ ca saṃvṛti paramārtha abheda rūpaḥ tam ca yogam katham ārabheta iti śrotum kautūhalam āpannaḥ smi iti saṃbandhaḥ

original: [3.4.2] visarjanam āha: śṛṇv ityādi. vajreti vajrapāṇe. samyag aviparītam. kiṃ tad ity āha: advayayogatattvata iti. advayayogatattvam advayayogasvarūpam iti yāvat. tad evāha: vajraghaṇṭāś ca mudrāś ca pratidhāreti tattvata iti. prajñāpāramitānādaviśuddhis tattvam. saṃvṛter abhinnarūpatvaṃ vā paramārthasya. tato vajraghaṇṭā dhārayitavyā.
analyzed: visarjanam āha śṛṇu ityādi vajra iti vajrapāṇe samyak aviparītam kim tat iti āha advaya yoga tattvataḥ iti advaya yoga tattvam advaya yoga svarūpam iti yāvat tat eva āha vajraghaṇṭāḥ ca mudrāḥ ca pratidhāra iti tattvataḥ iti prajñāpāramitā nāda viśuddhiḥ tattvam saṃvṛteḥ abhinna rūpa tvam vā paramārthasya tatas vajraghaṇṭā dhārayitavyā

original: mudrā prajñā. sā ca ghaṇṭāviśuddhyā dhārayitavyā. bhāvaś cāyam: prajñāpāramitānādaviśuddhyā saṃvṛtyabhinnarūpatvaviśuddhyā vā ghaṇṭā dhāryā. tattvaviśuddhaghaṇṭāviśuddhyā mudrā bahiḥprajñā, antaḥprajñā ca. bahirupāyaprajñayoḥ karuṇāśūnyatālakṣaṇayoś ca saṃvṛtiparamārtharūpayor yogas tatra buddhibhedānavagraha iti.
analyzed: mudrā prajñā sā ca ghaṇṭā viśuddhyā dhārayitavyā bhāvaḥ ca ayam prajñāpāramitā nāda viśuddhyā saṃvṛti abhinna rūpatva viśuddhyā vā ghaṇṭā dhāryā tattva viśuddha ghaṇṭā viśuddhyā mudrā bahis prajñā antar prajñā ca bahis upāya prajñayoḥ karuṇā śūnyatā lakṣaṇayoḥ ca saṃvṛti paramārtha rūpayoḥ yogaḥ tatra buddhi bheda anavagrahaḥ iti

original: atha vā vajreti vajram upāyaviśuddhyā, ghaṇṭā ca prajñāviśuddhyā. etayor yogo mudrā. mudaṃ rāto gṛhṇītaḥ prajñopāyāv asyām iti vyutpattyā mudrā prajñopāyayogaḥ. atha ca ghaṇṭāyā upari vajraṃ yat, tat prajñopāyasamāpattiviśuddhyā. anyac ca: tadubhayasamāpattijasukhaviśuddhyā yasya sukhasya sahajam iti vyavasthā.
analyzed: atha vā vajra iti vajram upāya viśuddhyā ghaṇṭā ca prajñā viśuddhyā etayoḥ yogaḥ mudrā mudam rātaḥ gṛhṇītaḥ prajñā upāyau asyām iti vyutpattyā mudrā prajñā upāya yogaḥ atha ca ghaṇṭāyāḥ upari vajram yat tat prajñā upāya samāpatti viśuddhyā anyat ca tad ubhaya samāpatti ja sukha viśuddhyā yasya sukhasya sahajam iti vyavasthā

original: [3.4.3] etad eva sakalam āha: vajram ityādi. tasyopāyasya bhāvas tattvaṃ, tena vajraṃ, vajraṃ cātmā. prajñāyāḥ parabhūtāyāḥ sakāśād upāyasya śarīram ātmeti. vajratvaṃ cābhedyatvāt. prajñāyāḥ sakāśād abhedasūcanārtham upāyasya vajrasaṃjñeti. tattvetīti tattvam iti kṛtvā vajram iti bhāvaḥ. bahu rajaty anena prajñeti vajram upāyaḥ.
analyzed: etat eva sakalam āha vajram ityādi tasya upāyasya bhāvaḥ tattvam tena vajram vajram ca ātmā prajñāyāḥ para bhūtāyāḥ sakāśāt upāyasya śarīram ātmā iti vajra tvam ca abhedya tvāt prajñāyāḥ sakāśāt abheda sūcana artham upāyasya vajra saṃjñā iti tattva iti iti tattvam iti kṛtvā vajram iti bhāvaḥ bahu rajati anena prajñā iti vajram upāyaḥ

original: vajraṃ saṃvṛtiḥ, paramārthād abhinnarūpatvenābhedyasādharmyāt. bahavo rajanty aneneti vajram. saṃvriyate paramārtho 'nayeti saṃvṛtir bhāvāṅgaḥ. bhāvāṅga eva vicāryamāṇaḥ paramārthatām upaiti. bhāvāṅgo 'pi prakṛtipariśuddhaḥ paramārthe 'pi. yathoktam:
analyzed: vajram saṃvṛtiḥ paramārthāt abhinna rūpa tvena abhedya sādharmyāt bahavaḥ rajanti anena iti vajram saṃvriyate paramārthaḥ naya iti saṃvṛtiḥ bhāva aṅgaḥ bhāva aṅgaḥ eva vicāryamāṇaḥ paramārtha tām upaiti prakṛti pariśuddhaḥ paramārthe yathā uktam

original: śūnyataiva hi saṃvṛtir
analyzed: śūnyatā eva hi saṃvṛtiḥ

original: iti. tataś ca yad vajraṃ yoginā dhriyate, tat prajñādirūpāyā abhedaviśuddhisūcanāya. ghaṇṭā dharmeti devatīti: svasāmānyalakṣaṇadhāraṇād dharmāḥ skandhādayaḥ. kṣaṇikatvādiyogāt paramārthataḥ saṃketato dharmāṇāṃ prakṛtipariśuddhiṃ pratipādayantī dhvanati ghaṇṭā. sā prajñāviśuddhyā dhāryā. ata āha: devatīti. dīvyanty asyāṃ yogina iti devatī prajñā.
analyzed: iti tatas ca yat vajram yoginā dhriyate tat prajñā ādi rūpāyāḥ abheda viśuddhi sūcanāya ghaṇṭā dharma iti devatī iti sva sāmānya lakṣaṇa dhāraṇāt dharmāḥ skandha ādayaḥ kṣaṇika tva ādi yogāt paramārthataḥ saṃketataḥ dharmāṇām prakṛti pariśuddhim pratipādayantī dhvanati ghaṇṭā sā prajñā viśuddhyā dhāryā atas āha devatī iti dīvyanti asyām yoginaḥ iti devatī prajñā

original: dīvyanty asyāṃ sarvadharmā iti. tathatā ca devatī. dharmeti dharmā eva ghaṇṭety arthaḥ. mudrā saṃpuṭayogasyeti: tayor vajraghaṇṭayor upāyaprajñārūpayoḥ saṃvṛtiparamārtharūpayoś ca saṃpuṭayogaḥ samāpattir ekatvaṃ mudrety abhidhīyate. saṃpuṭapaṭayor iva yogaḥ saṃpuṭayogaḥ. etenātyantam abhedaṃ sūcayati. etad evāha: upāyaṃ tasya līyata iti.
analyzed: dīvyanti asyām sarva dharmāḥ iti tathatā ca devatī dharma iti dharmāḥ eva ghaṇṭā iti arthaḥ mudrā saṃpuṭa yogasya iti tayoḥ vajra ghaṇṭayoḥ upāya prajñā rūpayoḥ saṃvṛti paramārtha rūpayoḥ ca saṃpuṭa yogaḥ samāpattiḥ eka tvam mudrā iti abhidhīyate saṃpuṭa paṭayoḥ iva yogaḥ saṃpuṭa yogaḥ etena atyantam abhedam sūcayati etat eva āha upāyam tasya līyate iti

original: tasyāṃ prajñāyām upāyo līyate. śarīreṇa samāpattijena sukhena copāyo 'syāṃ śleṣaṃ gacchati. sahaje hi jñāne saṃvṛtte parātmabhedo na syāt. śūnyatākaruṇābhinnatvāt saṃvṛtiḥ paramārthe līyate. ghaṇṭayā vinā na kevalasya vajrasya dhāraṇaṃ, tatas tasyāṃ vajraṃ līyate tāṃ śliṣyati pratibadhnātīti yāvat.
analyzed: tasyām prajñāyām upāyaḥ līyate śarīreṇa samāpatti jena sukhena śleṣam gacchati sahaje hi jñāne saṃvṛtte parātma bhedaḥ na syāt śūnyatā karuṇā bhinna tvāt saṃvṛtiḥ paramārthe līyate ghaṇṭayā vinā na kevalasya vajrasya dhāraṇam tatas tasyām vajram līyate tām śliṣyati pratibadhnāti iti yāvat

original: [3.4.4] advayam idam ittham, asya cādvayatvam iti pratipādyādvayasyaiva devatāyogarūpasaṃvṛtiparamārtharūpasyādau yat kartavyaṃ tad āha: ādau tāvad ityādi. triviśuddham iti: yadā yogī prathamaṃ dhyānam ārabhate, tadā triviśuddhiṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ. vajrāñjalītyādi subodham. anye punar anyad vyācakṣate. ādau tāvad idaṃ kathyate:
analyzed: advayam idam ittham asya ca advaya tvam iti pratipādya advayasya eva devatā yoga rūpa saṃvṛti paramārtha rūpasya ādau yat kartavyam tat āha ādau tāvat ityādi tri viśuddham iti yadā yogī prathamam dhyānam ārabhate tadā tri viśuddhim kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ vajrāñjali ityādi su bodham anye punar anyat vyācakṣate ādau tāvat idam kathyate

original: tāvacchabdaḥ prākārādiviśuddhim apekṣya kathanīyam āha triviśuddhim iti. tribhir mantrapadair viśuddhis triviśuddhiḥ. tatraivaṃ bodhavyam:
analyzed: tāvat śabdaḥ prākāra ādi viśuddhim apekṣya kathanīyam āha tri viśuddhim iti tribhiḥ mantra padaiḥ viśuddhiḥ tri viśuddhiḥ tatra evam bodhavyam

original: [3.4.5] śūnyatāṃ bhāvayitvā oṃ svabhāvetyādimantra uccārayitavyaḥ.
analyzed: śūnyatām bhāvayitvā om svabhāva ityādi mantraḥ uccārayitavyaḥ

original: [3.4.6] bījaniṣpanne vajre oṃ vajretyādi.
analyzed: bīja niṣpanne vajre om vajra ityādi

original: [3.4.7] devatāyāṃ niṣpannāyāṃ oṃ yogetyādir iti.
analyzed: devatāyām niṣpannāyām om yoga ityādiḥ iti

original: [3.4.8] idānīṃ pariśuddhasantānasya yoginaḥ prākārādiviśuddhim āha: †...† sarvatra śūnyatā paramārthaḥ, mantradevatādilakṣaṇā saṃvṛtiḥ. advayam eva kāryavaśān nirmāṇena dvaidham āpadyate. grāhyatvādimuktatvaṃ paramārthaḥ. dānaṃ saṃvṛtiḥ. tadviśuddhaḥ prākāraś ca. kīdṛgdānaviśuddhyā prākāra ity āha: tyāgetyādi.
analyzed: idānīm pariśuddha santānasya yoginaḥ prākāra ādi viśuddhim āha sarvatra śūnyatā paramārthaḥ mantradevatā ādi lakṣaṇā saṃvṛtiḥ advayam eva kārya vaśāt nirmāṇena dvaidham āpadyate grāhya tva ādi mukta tvam paramārthaḥ dānam saṃvṛtiḥ tad viśuddhaḥ prākāraḥ ca kīdṛś dāna viśuddhyā prākāraḥ iti āha tyāga ityādi

original: tyāgasaṃpattir deyadāpakapratigrāhakānupalambhena dānam. tyāgena deyādyanupalambhena dānena saṃpannaṃ cittaṃ yasya sa tathā. sarva iti: arthātyarthāṅgātyaṅgalakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ vastv ity arthaḥ. tṛṇādivad iti: ādiśabdāc cuṣacarcitanirmālyādikam. tṛṇādiṣu yathānavagrahas, tathārthādiṣu. tṛṇādyanavagraheṇa dānaṃ yat, tadviśuddhyā prākāra iti śeṣaḥ.
analyzed: tyāga saṃpattiḥ deya dāpaka pratigrāhaka anupalambhena dānam tyāgena deya ādi anupalambhena dānena saṃpannam cittam yasya sa tathā sarvaḥ iti artha atyartha aṅga atyaṅga lakṣaṇam sarvam vastu iti arthaḥ tṛṇa ādi vat iti ādi śabdāt cuṣa carcita nirmālya ādikam tṛṇa ādiṣu yathā anavagrahaḥ tathā artha ādiṣu tṛṇa ādi anavagraheṇa dānam yat tad viśuddhyā prākāraḥ iti śeṣaḥ

original: [3.4.9] pañjaraviśuddhim āha: śīletyādi. pañjaram ūrdhvaṃ yat, tac chīlam. śīlam eva kiṃ tad ity āha: abhayam ityādi. abhayaṃ bhītebhyaḥ sarvebhya eva tattvata ity eṣa phalakāṅkṣayā pravṛttatvāt. etena kuśalapravṛttir dānāṅge 'pi sūcitā. akuśalanivṛttiṃ sūcayann āha: ahiṃsetyādi. ahiṃsā janto m-ādīnām iti: ādiśabdād itarākuśalanivṛttiḥ sūcitā.
analyzed: pañjara viśuddhim āha śīla ityādi pañjaram ūrdhvam yat tat śīlam śīlam eva kim tat iti āha abhayam ityādi abhayam bhītebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ eva tattvataḥ iti eṣa phala kāṅkṣayā pravṛtta tvāt etena kuśala pravṛttiḥ dāna aṅge sūcitā akuśala nivṛttim sūcayan āha ahiṃsā ityādi ahiṃsā janto mā ādīnām iti ādi śabdāt itara akuśala nivṛttiḥ sūcitā

original: parārthacaryāṃ sūcayann āha: mā tvaṃ sattvārthapīḍaketi. sattvārthasya pīḍako mā tvaṃ syā iti. akuśalanivṛttikuśalapravṛttiparārthacaryālakṣaṇaṃ trividhaṃ śīlaṃ darśitam.
analyzed: parārtha caryām sūcayan āha mā tvam sattva artha pīḍakā iti sattva arthasya pīḍakaḥ mā tvam syāḥ iti akuśala nivṛtti kuśala pravṛtti parārtha caryā lakṣaṇam trividham śīlam darśitam

original: [3.4.10] kīlakaviśuddhim āha: kṣānti kīlena nimnasyeti. parāpakāramarṣaduḥkhādhivāsanādharmanidhyānalakṣaṇā kṣāntiḥ. tadviśuddhyā kīlakā nimnasya nikhātavyā ity arthaḥ. parapīḍānurodhaketi: kṣāntiviśeṣaṇam. parapīḍā parāpakāraḥ. ādiśabdo 'tra draṣṭavyaḥ. tato duḥkhādhivāsanā labdhā.
analyzed: kīlaka viśuddhim āha kṣānti kīlena nimnasya iti para apakāra marṣa duḥkha adhivāsana dharma nidhyāna lakṣaṇā kṣāntiḥ tad viśuddhyā kīlakāḥ nimnasya nikhātavyāḥ iti arthaḥ para pīḍā anurodhakā iti kṣānti viśeṣaṇam para pīḍā para apakāraḥ ādi śabdaḥ tra draṣṭavyaḥ tatas duḥkha adhivāsanā labdhā

original: parapīḍāduḥkhādhivāsanayor anurodhakaṃ nirākaraṇaṃ yasyāṃ, sā parapīḍānurodhikā kṣāntiḥ. paścād ikārakṣayaḥ. anurodhakaṃ ca dharmanidhyānam. pañjarādikaṃ kimartham ity āha: pañjaram ityādi. dūṣayanti vikṛtaṃ kāyādikaṃ kurvantīti duṣṭāḥ kleśaskandhamṛtyudevaputrāḥ, ta eva mārās teṣām ādicchāraṇaṃ nirākaraṇaṃ tadarthaṃ pañjarādikam.
analyzed: para pīḍā duḥkha adhivāsanayoḥ anurodhakam nirākaraṇam yasyām sā para pīḍā anurodhikā kṣāntiḥ paścāt ikāra kṣayaḥ anurodhakam ca dharma nidhyānam pañjara ādikam kimartham iti āha pañjaram ityādi dūṣayanti vikṛtam kāya ādikam kurvanti iti duṣṭāḥ kleśa skandha mṛtyu devaputrāḥ te eva mārāḥ teṣām ādi chāraṇam nirākaraṇam tad artham pañjara ādikam

original: [3.4.11] pañjarādike cetasā nirmite kathaṃ māranirāsa ity āha: na māra ityādi. na māro nāma kaścid asti. yady evaṃ kathaṃ tarhi māreṇa pīḍā kriyata ity āha: na ca māreṇeti. māreṇa pīḍā ca na kriyata iti bhāvaḥ. pīḍālakṣaṇaṃ mārakāryam anubhūyamānam api nāstīty atisubhāṣitam etad ity āha: ātmacetaṃ tv iti. svacittam idam evety arthaḥ.
analyzed: pañjara ādike cetasā nirmite katham māra nirāsaḥ iti āha na māraḥ ityādi na māraḥ nāma kaścid asti yadi evam katham tarhi māreṇa pīḍā kriyate iti āha na ca māreṇa iti māreṇa pīḍā ca na kriyate iti bhāvaḥ pīḍā lakṣaṇam māra kāryam anubhūyamānam api na asti iti ati subhāṣitam etat iti āha ātma cetam tu iti sva cittam idam eva iti arthaḥ

original: pīḍānubhūyata ity api cittavikalpa iti bhāvaḥ. yathā cittena kalpyamānā mārāḥ sidhyanti, tathā pañjarādikaṃ tannirākarttanaṃ kiṃ syād ity etad evāha: bandhavad iti. badhyate bahir nirudhyate 'neneti bandhaḥ pañjarādikam. vad ity apiśabdārthe. yathā mārāḥ svacittena bhāvyamānā anubhūyante, tathā tannirākaraṇaṃ pañjarādikam apy astv iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: pīḍā anubhūyate iti api citta vikalpaḥ iti bhāvaḥ yathā cittena kalpyamānāḥ mārāḥ sidhyanti tathā pañjara ādikam tad nirākarttanam kim syāt iti etat eva āha bandha vat iti badhyate bahis nirudhyate nena iti bandhaḥ pañjara ādikam vat iti apiśabda arthe yathā mārāḥ sva cittena bhāvyamānāḥ anubhūyante tathā tad nirākaraṇam pañjara ādikam api astu iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.14] dīpaviśuddhim āha: prajñādīpenetyādi. prajñāviśuddhyā dīpa ity arthaḥ. prajñayā tridhātugatam andhakāraṃ moho hanyate. ālokyeti: ālokaḥ syāt. etad evāha: hanyanta ityādi. āloka patha svecchayeti: pathi sanmārge svecchayāloko bhavatīty arthaḥ. bhāvanārambhe sarvam idam itthaṃ viśuddhaṃ kāryam iti bhāvaḥ.

original: [3.4.16] bhāvanārthaṃ sthānasaṃpattim āha: manaïtyādi subodham. ayaṃ sāmānyena yogārambha uktaḥ. idānīm advayayogasvarūpaprajñopāyasamāpattijaṃ sahajajñānaṃ yat, tad apy advayayoga ity ucyate. tatpratipattyupāyadvāreṇa vajrasattvayogam āha: vajram ātmetītyādi.
analyzed: bhāvanā artham sthāna saṃpattim āha manaḥ ityādi su bodham ayam sāmānyena yoga ārambhaḥ uktaḥ idānīm advaya yoga svarūpa prajñā upāya samāpatti jam sahaja jñānam yat tat api advaya yogaḥ iti ucyate tad pratipatti upāya dvāreṇa vajra sattva yogam āha vajram ātmā iti ityādi

original: prāgukte sthāne niṣadya, vajrāñjaliṃ hṛdi nidhāya, triśuddhim uccārya, śūnyatāṃ bhāvayitvā, sumerūpari siṃhāsanacandrastham ātmānaṃ hūṃkārajavajrākāreṇa niṣpādya, akārajaghaṇṭākāreṇa prajñāṃ nirmimīta. etad evāha: ghaṇṭā prajñeti nirmitam iti.

original: [3.4.17] samadṛṣṭiṃ tu m-āsthānam iti: prajñā bhāvyamānā tv ātmano 'grataḥ sthāpayitavyā. etad evāha: āsthānam iti. sthāpayitavyety arthaḥ. pauruṣam ātmakam antaram iti: pauruṣam iti hastamātram. ātmabimbāt purato bhāvyamānāpi hastāntarasthā bhāvayitavyā. hṛdaye hūṃkārabhāvanām iti:

original: prathamato yoginā śūnyatābhāvanārthaṃ pūjāditriśaraṇagamanādyanantaraṃ candramaṇḍalopari hūṃkārabhāvanā kāryeti. etad evāha: śūnyatetyādi. hṛdi candropari hūṃkāraṃ vicintya tadraśmisaṃsparśāt traidhātukaṃ khasamaṃ nirūpaṇīyam. sarva sarvavid iti: sarvaprakāreṇety arthaḥ.
analyzed: prathamatas yoginā śūnyatā bhāvanā artham pūjā ādi triśaraṇa gamana ādi anantaram candra maṇḍala upari hūṃkāra bhāvanā kāryā iti etat eva āha śūnyatā ityādi hṛdi candra upari hūṃkāram vicintya tad raśmi saṃsparśāt traidhātukam kha samam nirūpaṇīyam sarva sarva vid iti sarva prakāreṇa iti arthaḥ

original: [3.4.18] śūnyateti (17d) nirdiśann āha: kṣayaṃ kṛtveti. trijāṃ dhātum iti traidhātukam. pūrvetyādinā skandhādiśūnyatāṃ smārayati. śūnyacetaneti śūnyacittam. svaparaṃ jagac chūnyaṃ bhāvyam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: śūnyatā iti nirdiśan āha kṣayam kṛtvā iti tri jām dhātum iti traidhātukam pūrva ityādinā skandha ādi śūnyatām smārayati śūnya cetanā iti śūnya cittam sva param jagat śūnyam bhāvyam iti arthaḥ

original: [3.4.19] kūṭāgāraṃ darśayann āha: merumūrdhni tv ityādi. merumūrdhni vimānaṃ kūṭāgāraṃ svecchayā kṛtaparimāṇaṃ, yāvadiṣṭaṃ tāvatparimāṇam ity arthaḥ. prāguktaṃ candropari hūṃkārajaṃ vajrabimbaṃ kiṃbhūtam ity āha:
analyzed: kūṭāgāram darśayan āha meru mūrdhni tu ityādi meru mūrdhni vimānam kūṭāgāram sva icchayā kṛta parimāṇam yāvat iṣṭam tāvat parimāṇam iti arthaḥ prāk uktam candra upari hūṃkāra jam vajra bimbam kiṃbhūtam iti āha

original: [3.4.20] pūrva uktasya vajrasya aṣṭāviṃśati devateti: pūrvoktaṃ vajram aṣṭāviṃśatidevatāyuktaṃ draṣṭavyam iti bhāvaḥ. hūṃkārabinduniḥsṛtā raśmayo 'pi traidhātukaṃ saṃspṛśya punar atraiva praviṣṭā iti vicintya, tato hūṃkāraniṣpannaṃ vajrabimbaṃ bhāvyam iti darśayann āha: raśmijvālām ityādi. vajrabimbe 'pi hūṃkāro jñeyaḥ.
analyzed: pūrve uktasya vajrasya aṣṭāviṃśati devatā iti pūrva uktam vajram aṣṭāviṃśati devatā yuktam draṣṭavyam iti bhāvaḥ hūṃkāra bindu niḥsṛtāḥ raśmayaḥ traidhātukam saṃspṛśya punar atra eva praviṣṭāḥ iti vicintya tatas hūṃkāra niṣpannam vajra bimbam bhāvyam iti darśayan āha raśmi jvālām ityādi vajra bimbe pi hūṃkāraḥ jñeyaḥ

original: [3.4.21] vajrasattvādirūpasya tata ātmeti vinirmitam iti: tadvajrabimbapariṇatam ātmānaṃ vajrasattvarūpaṃ bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ. varṇabhujādi vakṣyati. aṣṭāṅgakavacanam āha: nyased ityādi. tālucakṣurdvayavaktragrīvāskandhadvayahṛdayanābhiguhyeṣu ...
analyzed: vajra sattva ādi rūpasya tatas ātmā iti vinirmitam iti tad vajra bimba pariṇatam ātmānam vajra sattva rūpam bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ varṇa bhuja ādi vakṣyati aṣṭāṅgaka vacanam āha nyaset ityādi tālu cakṣuḥ dvaya vaktra grīvā skandha dvaya hṛdaya nābhi guhyeṣu

original: [3.4.22] ... kundendudhavalo hūṃkāro draṣṭavyaḥ. himakundenduvarṇasyeti: bījasya vajrasattvasya ca viśeṣaṇam. bījaṃ tu śukram eva. vajrasattvaḥ kiṃciddhavalaḥ kiṃcidraktavarṇaḥ, taptakāñcanasamaprabham iti (25b) vakṣyamāṇavacanāt. pañcabuddhābhimaṇḍitam iti: pañcabuddhamakuṭaṃ bhagavantaṃ bhāvayed iti saṃbandhaḥ.
analyzed: kunda indu dhavalaḥ hūṃkāraḥ draṣṭavyaḥ hima kunda indu varṇasya iti bījasya vajra sattvasya ca viśeṣaṇam bījam tu śukram eva vajra sattvaḥ kiṃcid dhavalaḥ kiṃcid rakta varṇaḥ tapta kāñcana sama prabham iti vakṣyamāṇa vacanāt pañca buddha abhimaṇḍitam iti pañca buddha makuṭam bhagavantam bhāvayet iti saṃbandhaḥ

original: [3.4.23] mahāmudrā hṛdiṃ caiveti: mudrāliṅganābhinayena hṛdinyastavajravajraghaṇṭādharaṃ hastadvayaṃ bhagavantam bhāvayet. kiṃbhūtam ity āha: paramaṃ padam iti. paramaṃ svārthasaṃpattyā, padaṃ parārthasaṃpattyāśrayabhūtatvāt, spharatyaṃ ca tathāgatam. etad evāha: sphurantam ityādi.
analyzed: mahāmudrā hṛdim ca eva iti mudrā liṅgana abhinayena hṛdi nyasta vajra vajra ghaṇṭā dharam hasta dvayam bhagavantam bhāvayet kiṃbhūtam iti āha paramam padam iti paramam svārtha saṃpattyā padam parārtha saṃpatti āśraya bhūta tvāt ca tathāgatam etat eva āha sphurantam ityādi

original: [3.4.24] bhāvayed bhāvabhāveneti: tam evaṃvidhaṃ bhagavantaṃ bhāvayet. bhāvabhāvenātiśayena. hūṃkāroccāraṇātmakam atiśayena bhāvayed ity āha: hūṃkāretyādi. yadīcchati japtuṃ, tadā yogī hūṃkāraṃ praṇavādisvāhāntaṃ japed ity āha: jñānabījam ityādi. jñānabījaṃ hūṃkāraḥ. yadepsā ātmacetaneti:yadi cetasyātmecchā syād ity arthaḥ. oṃ hūṃ svāheti mantraḥ.
analyzed: bhāvayet bhāva bhāvena iti tam evaṃvidham bhagavantam bhāvayet bhāva bhāvena atiśayena hūṃkāra uccāraṇa ātmakam atiśayena bhāvayet iti āha hūṃkāra ityādi yadi icchati japtum tadā yogī hūṃkāram praṇava ādi svāhā antam japet iti āha jñāna bījam ityādi jñāna bījam hūṃkāraḥ yadā īpsā ātma cetanā iti yadi cetasya ātma icchā syāt iti arthaḥ om hūm svāhā iti mantraḥ

original: [3.4.25] sattvārtharāgam utpannaṃ taptakāñcanasamaprabham iti: sattvo 'tra prajñā, tasyārthaḥ sukhaṃ, tadartho rāgaḥ sattvārtharāgaḥ. atha vā sattvānām artho nirmokṣaḥ, tatra rāgaḥ saṅgaḥ, tadviśuddhyā taptakāñcanavarṇo bhāgavān. bhāvaś cāyam:
analyzed: sattva artha rāgam utpannam tapta kāñcana sama prabham iti prajñā tasya arthaḥ sukham tad arthaḥ rāgaḥ sattva artha rāgaḥ atha vā sattvānām arthaḥ nirmokṣaḥ tatra rāgaḥ saṅgaḥ tad viśuddhyā tapta kāñcana varṇaḥ bhāgavān bhāvaḥ ca ayam

original: yady api śuklo dharmadhāturūpatvāt, tathāpi sattvārtharāgaviśuddhyā raktavarṇānuviddhaḥ śukla iti kāñcanasya taptatvena raktatvaṃ darśayati. atiśayayīta eva rakto 'bhipretaḥ. idānīṃ prajñāniṣpādanam āha: tato lakṣaṇetyādi. pūrvavat sarvaṃ śūnyaṃ svaparasantānaṃ vibhāvya vakṣyamāṇam bhāvayed ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: yadi api śuklaḥ dharmadhātu rūpatvāt tathā api sattva artha rāga viśuddhyā rakta varṇa anuviddhaḥ śuklaḥ iti kāñcanasya tapta tvena rakta tvam darśayati eva raktaḥ bhipretaḥ idānīm prajñā niṣpādanam āha tatas lakṣaṇa ityādi pūrvavat sarvam śūnyam sva para santānam vibhāvya vakṣyamāṇam bhāvayet iti arthaḥ

original: [3.4.26] etad evāha: candretyādi. candramaṇḍalamadhyasthām aṃkāraniṣpannāṃ tadadhiṣṭhitāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ niṣpādya tanniṣpannāṃ prajñāṃ bhāvayet. kiṃbhūtām ity āha: triketyādi. sarvavid yogī, pūrvavad vajravat, trayoviṃśatidevatāyuktāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ bhāvayet. tanniṣpannāṃ prajñāṃ ca bhāvayed ity arthaḥ, ...
analyzed: etat eva āha candra ityādi candra maṇḍala madhya sthām aṃkāra niṣpannām tad adhiṣṭhitām ghaṇṭām niṣpādya tad niṣpannām prajñām bhāvayet kiṃbhūtām iti āha trika ityādi sarva vid yogī pūrvavat vajra vat trayoviṃśati devatā yuktām ghaṇṭām bhāvayet tad niṣpannām prajñām ca bhāvayet iti arthaḥ

original: [3.4.27] ... buddhātmakaraśmiyuktāṃ prajñāpāramitātmakadehāṃ, ...
analyzed: buddha ātmaka raśmi yuktām prajñāpāramitā ātmaka dehām

original: [3.4.28] ... yogaparyaṅkam iti sattvaparyaṅkasthāṃ, varṇaśleṣakagātrāṇām iti raktānuviddhasitām ity arthaḥ, pañcabuddhābhimaṇḍitam iti pañcabuddhamakuṭinīm.
analyzed: yoga paryaṅkam iti sattva paryaṅka sthām varṇa śleṣaka gātrāṇām iti rakta anuviddha sitām iti arthaḥ pañca buddha abhimaṇḍitam iti pañca buddha makuṭinīm

original: [3.4.29] aṣṭāṅgakalanam āha: aṣṭākṣaretyādi subodham. asyā api bhagavata iva mahāmudrāṃ dvāv ityādināha. etac ca vyākhyātam eva.
analyzed: aṣṭāṅgakalanam āha aṣṭa akṣara ityādi su bodham asyāḥ api bhagavataḥ iva mahāmudrām dvau ityādinā āha etat ca vyākhyātam eva

original: [3.4.30] uddhṛta ityādi: asyā bījam akāraḥ, sa ca prajñopāyasvabhāvaḥ. uddhṛta iti prāktanaṃ smārayati. aṃkāra ity arthaḥ. ālikāli tv iti: ukāraḥ kāliḥ. daṇḍa ālir iti kecit. tasya bījaṃ tu jāpata iti: tadbījaṃ japed ity arthaḥ. oṃ aṃ svāheti mantrasamudāyaḥ. rāgetyādipūrvavat.
analyzed: uddhṛtaḥ ityādi asyāḥ bījam akāraḥ sa ca prajñā upāya svabhāvaḥ uddhṛtaḥ iti prāktanam smārayati aṃkāraḥ iti arthaḥ tu iti ukāraḥ kāliḥ daṇḍaḥ āliḥ iti kecid tasya bījam tu jāpate iti tad bījam japet iti arthaḥ om aṃ svāhā iti mantra samudāyaḥ rāga ityādi pūrvavat

original: [3.4.31] sattva-m-uttaretyādi: sattvottaraṇaviśuddhyāliṅganamudrety arthaḥ. vajretyādi: pūrvapaṭaloddiṣṭasya krodhāṅguṣṭhasya agrasya amṛtākṣara cintitam ityāder (3.3.61ab) nirdeśo 'yam. khagamukhāyā vāmapārśvāgraṃ cālayet. kiṃ kṛtvety āha: vajretyādi. tarjanyagre suṃkāram amṛtākṣaraṃ cintayitvā tayā khagamukhāṃ cālayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: sattvam uttara ityādi sattva uttaraṇa viśuddhi āliṅgana mudrā iti arthaḥ vajra ityādi pūrva paṭala uddiṣṭasya krodhāṅguṣṭhasya agrasya amṛta akṣara cintitam ityādeḥ nirdeśaḥ yam khaga mukhāyāḥ vāma pārśva agram cālayet kim kṛtvā iti āha vajra ityādi tarjanī agre suṃkāram amṛta akṣaram cintayitvā tayā khaga mukhām cālayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.32] aṣṭādaśasthānastham amṛtaṃ cālanāc chravatīti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: aṣṭādaśa sthāna stham amṛtam cālanāt śravati iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.33] idānīṃ tasyā rāgajananārthaṃ karaṇāny āha: dvandvetyādi. dvandvāliṅganam utsṛjyeti: prajñopāyasamāpattyavasthāṃ tyaktvā pūrvasyāṃ diśi karaṇaṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ. kutrety āha: pūrvābhimukha sthāpayed iti. pūrvābhimukhīṃ prajñāṃ sthāpayed iti bhāvaḥ. pūrvadiksthitasattvoddharaṇaviśuddhyā pūrvābhimukhatvam.
analyzed: idānīm tasyāḥ rāga janana artham karaṇāni āha dvandva ityādi dvandva āliṅganam utsṛjya iti prajñā upāya samāpatti avasthām tyaktvā pūrvasyām diśi karaṇam kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ kutra iti āha pūrva abhimukha sthāpayet iti pūrva abhimukhīm prajñām sthāpayet iti bhāvaḥ pūrva diś sthita sattva uddharaṇa viśuddhyā pūrva abhimukha tvam

original: [3.4.34] karaṇam āha: lalitākṣepetyādi. lalitākṣepo vāmacaraṇanikuñcanam. devyānāṃ vajraṃpādena pādata iti: vajraṃpādena vajrasattvasya pādena, devyāḥ pādata iti devyāḥ pādatalam iti saṃbandhaḥ. vajrasattvasya dakṣiṇacaraṇena devyā vāmacaraṇam ākrāntam iti draṣṭavyam. vāmasya ghaṇṭā ūruṃ tv iti: vajrasattvo 'nuvarttate pādaś ca.
analyzed: karaṇam āha lalitā ākṣepa ityādi lalitā ākṣepaḥ vāma caraṇa nikuñcanam devyānām vajraṃpādena pādāt iti vajraṃpādena vajrasattvasya pādena devyāḥ pādatas iti devyāḥ pāda talam iti saṃbandhaḥ vajra sattvasya dakṣiṇa caraṇena devyāḥ vāma caraṇam ākrāntam iti draṣṭavyam vāmasya ghaṇṭāḥ ūrum tu iti vajrasattvaḥ nuvarttate pādaḥ ca

original: vajrasattvasya vāmapādo ghaṇṭāyāḥ prajñāyā dakṣiṇorūpari draṣṭavyaḥ. kucadvaye hastapāṇināv iti: prajñāyāḥ kucadvayaṃ vajrasattvasya pāṇidvayena grahītavyam iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: vajra sattvasya vāma pādaḥ ghaṇṭāyāḥ prajñāyāḥ dakṣiṇa ūru upari draṣṭavyaḥ kuca dvaye hasta pāṇinau iti prajñāyāḥ kuca dvayam vajra sattvasya pāṇi dvayena grahītavyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.35] śṛṅgāro hasitabhāveneti: śṛṅgāreṇa hasanādikriyā kāryeti bhāvaḥ. adho tīkṣṇāni pīḍayed iti: adho 'dharaṃ, tīkṣṇāni dantās, taiḥ pīḍayed iti bhāvaḥ. ayam vajrasattvasya vyāpāraḥ. ghaṇṭā pāṇidvi guhyasyeti: prajñāyāḥ pāṇidvayena vajrasattvasya grīvā grahītavyā. guhyaśabdena grīvocyate. guhyasya vajrasattvasya kaṇṭho grahītavyaḥ.
analyzed: śṛṅgāraḥ hasita bhāvena iti śṛṅgāreṇa hasana ādi kriyā kāryā iti bhāvaḥ adho tīkṣṇāni pīḍayet iti adhas dharam tīkṣṇāni dantāḥ taiḥ pīḍayet iti bhāvaḥ ayam vajra sattvasya vyāpāraḥ ghaṇṭā guhyasya iti prajñāyāḥ pāṇi dvayena vajra sattvasya grīvā grahītavyā guhya śabdena grīvā ucyate guhyasya vajra sattvasya kaṇṭhaḥ grahītavyaḥ

original: upadeśata iti kecit. japed bījam advayam iti: svabījam aṃkāraṃ prajñoccārayet. advayam iti vajrasattvaḥ, so 'pi bījākṣaraṃ hūṃkāram uccārayed iti bhāvaḥ. prajñopāyādvayayogaṃ bhāvayed iti vā japed bījam advayaṃ tathety asyārthaḥ.
analyzed: upadeśataḥ iti kecid japet bījam advayam iti sva bījam aṃkāram prajñā uccārayet advayam iti vajra sattvaḥ bīja akṣaram hūṃkāram uccārayet iti bhāvaḥ prajñā upāya advaya yogam bhāvayet iti vā japet bījam advayam tathā iti asya arthaḥ

original: [3.4.36] pūrvadiksthitān sattvān uttārayituṃ saṃsārapāraṃ netuṃ karaṇam idam ārabdham iti bhāvaḥ. ākṣepeti karaṇam. idānīṃ dakṣiṇadigavasthitasattvottāraṇārthaṃ karaṇam āha: vāmetyādi. vāmākṣepo dakṣiṇajaṅghākuñcanaṃ vāmajaṅghāprasāraṇam. devyā kartavyam etat. dakṣiṇamukham eva ceti: dakṣiṇābhimukhatvaṃ prajñāyāḥ,
analyzed: pūrva diś sthitān sattvān uttārayitum saṃsāra pāram netum karaṇam idam ārabdham iti bhāvaḥ ākṣepa iti karaṇam idānīm dakṣiṇa diś avasthita sattva uttāraṇa artham karaṇam āha vāma ityādi vāma ākṣepaḥ dakṣiṇa jaṅghā ākuñcanam vāma jaṅghā prasāraṇam devyā kartavyam etat dakṣiṇa mukham eva ca iti dakṣiṇa abhimukha tvam prajñāyāḥ

original: tasyāḥ prādhānyaṃ hi yoginītantre, rataviṣaye vā.
analyzed: tasyāḥ prādhānyam hi yoginītantre rata viṣaye vā

original: [3.4.37] vajraṃ so 'pi vikṣepeti: vajradharasya dakṣiṇapādaprasāraṇaṃ devyā vāmapādopari. talābhyāṃ dvaubhi pīḍayed iti: prajñopāyau parasparaṃ pādataladvayaṃ pādataladvayena pīḍayetām iti bhāvaḥ. prajñāyā dakṣiṇena pādatalenopāyasya vāmapādatalasya pīḍanaṃ yoga iti bhāvaḥ. ghaṇṭā dvaubhi pāṇasya kaṭisandhiṃ tu pīḍayed iti:
analyzed: vajram vikṣepa iti vajradharasya dakṣiṇa pāda prasāraṇam devyāḥ vāma pāda upari talābhyām pīḍayet iti prajñā upāyau parasparam pāda tala dvayam pāda tala dvayena pīḍayetām iti bhāvaḥ prajñāyāḥ dakṣiṇena pāda talena upāyasya vāma pāda talasya pīḍanam yogaḥ iti bhāvaḥ ghaṇṭā pāṇasya kaṭi sandhim tu pīḍayet iti

original: prajñayā svaṃ pāṇidvayam upāyasya kaṭidvaye dhartavyam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: prajñayā svam pāṇi dvayam upāyasya kaṭi dvaye dhartavyam iti arthaḥ

original: [3.4.38] vajram ekaṃ tu guhyaṃ tu dakṣiṇaṃ kucam eva ceti: vajrasattva ekena kareṇa vāmena guhyaṃ grīvāṃ prajñāyā dhārayet. dakṣiṇena kucaṃ gṛhnīyāt. ghaṇṭā vajrasya mūrtīnām iti: prajñopāyau parasparamukhaṃ pratikṣanaṃ cumbeyātām iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: vajram ekam tu guhyam tu dakṣiṇam kucam eva ca iti vajra sattvaḥ ekena kareṇa vāmena guhyam grīvām prajñāyāḥ dhārayet dakṣiṇena kucam gṛhnīyāt ghaṇṭā vajrasya mūrtīnām iti prajñā upāyau paraspara mukham pratikṣanam cumbeyātām iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.39] ubhayarāgajananārthaṃ prajñopāyau svabījaṃ japantau karaṇenānena dakṣiṇadiggatān sattvān uttārayetām iti bhāvaḥ. idānīṃ paścimadiśi karaṇam āha: paścimam ityādi. paścimadiggatā satī samapadaṃ hastāntaraṃ vidhāya, devyā devī paścimadṛṣṭiketi paścimasattvottāraṇārthaṃ paścimadṛṣṭiḥ syāt.
analyzed: ubhaya rāga janana artham prajñā upāyau sva bījam japantau karaṇena anena dakṣiṇa diś gatān sattvān uttārayetām iti bhāvaḥ idānīm paścima diśi karaṇam āha paścimam ityādi paścima diś gatā satī sama padam hasta antaram vidhāya devyāḥ devī paścima dṛṣṭikā iti paścima sattva uttāraṇa artham paścima dṛṣṭiḥ syāt

original: [3.4.40] vajram ekapārśvasthaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ jānu pīḍitam iti: vajraṃ vajrasattva ekapārśvasthaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ devyā jānu vāmena kareṇa pīḍayet. jaghanabāhūparisthena dakṣiṇena saṃveṣṭya pṛṣṭhaṃ grīvāṃ vā saṃyogaṃ kuryād iti. ghaṇṭā jihvena lālayet.
analyzed: vajram eka pārśva stham dakṣiṇam jānu pīḍitam iti vajram vajra sattvaḥ eka pārśva stham dakṣiṇam devyāḥ jānu vāmena kareṇa pīḍayet jaghana bāhu upari sthena dakṣiṇena saṃveṣṭya pṛṣṭham grīvām vā saṃyogam kuryāt iti ghaṇṭāḥ jihvena lālayet

original: [3.4.41] vajrajihvāṃ tu saṃspṛśyeti: devī svajihvayā vajradharasya jihvāṃ spṛśed ity arthaḥ. etac ca cumbanakāle draṣṭavyam. jāpa yoga dvayaṃ tatheti: samāpattau pūrvavaj japa ity arthaḥ. idānīm uttaradiggatasattvottāraṇārthaṃ karaṇam āha: vajram ityādi. vajraṃ vajrasattvaḥ. sama madhyaṃ tv iti:
analyzed: vajra jihvām tu saṃspṛśya iti devī sva jihvayā vajradharasya jihvām spṛśet iti arthaḥ etat ca cumbana kāle draṣṭavyam jāpa yoga dvayam tathā iti samāpattau pūrvavat japa iti arthaḥ idānīm uttara diggata sattva uttāraṇa artham karaṇam āha vajram ityādi vajram vajra sattvaḥ sama madhyam tu iti

original: prajñāyā jaghanamadhye samenopaviśya bāhubhyāṃ tasyā madhyaṃ pīḍayeta. etad evāha: bāhu dvau madhya pīḍayed iti.
analyzed: prajñāyāḥ jaghana madhye samena upaviśya bāhubhyām tasyāḥ madhyam pīḍayeta etat eva āha bāhu dvau pīḍayet iti

original: [3.4.42] ghaṇṭā dvaubhi pāṇasya karṇamūle tu dhārayed iti: prajñāpi karābhyām upāyasya karṇamūle nakhakṣataṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ. saṃlagnādharau dvau prajñopāyau cumbanakāle 'mṛtam ivādharapānaṃ kuryātām ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: ghaṇṭā pāṇasya karṇa mūle tu dhārayet iti prajñā api karābhyām upāyasya karṇa mūle nakha kṣatam kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ saṃlagna adharau dvau prajñā upāyau cumbana kāle mṛtam iva adharapānam kuryātām iti arthaḥ

original: [3.4.43] pūrvavan mantrasya japaṃ darśayann āha: japed ityādi. vajraghaṇṭābhi krīḍanam iti: vajrasattvadevyoḥ krīḍanam ittham iti bhāvaḥ. asyāḥ krīḍāyāḥ saṃbhūtaṃ yat puṇyaṃ, tena sarve sattvāḥ sukhino bhavantv iti praṇidhānam āha: sarva ityādi.
analyzed: pūrvavat mantrasya japam darśayan āha japet ityādi vajra ghaṇṭā abhi krīḍanam iti vajra sattva devyoḥ krīḍanam ittham iti bhāvaḥ asyāḥ krīḍāyāḥ saṃbhūtam yat puṇyam tena sarve sattvāḥ sukhinaḥ bhavantu iti praṇidhānam āha sarve ityādi

original: [3.4.44] yena mārgeṇa buddhatvaṃ labhante, tena gacchantu. kurv iti: svacittakriyānumatau, yena sattvāḥ sukhinaḥ santi nirāmayāś ca, he citta tat tvam api kuru: anutiṣṭhety arthaḥ. prajñopāyasamāpattau jhaṭiti devatāyogaḥ kārya ity āha: jhaṭitākāre tyādi.
analyzed: yena mārgeṇa buddha tvam labhante tena gacchantu kuru iti sva citta kriyā anumatau yena sattvāḥ sukhinaḥ santi nirāmayāḥ ca he citta tat tvam api kuru anutiṣṭha iti arthaḥ prajñā upāya samāpattau jhaṭiti devatā yogaḥ kāryaḥ iti āha jhaṭiti ākāre tyādi

original: [3.4.45] etad evāha: ghaṇṭā devasya yogīnām iti. yadā prajñāyogo devasya vajradharasya syāt, tadā jhaṭiti devatāmudrāmantrādikaṃ kāryam. bhāvayed vicakṣaṇa iti: evaṃprakāreṇa vicakṣaṇo yogī vajrasattvarūpeṇātmānaṃ devīrūpeṇa prajñāṃ bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: etat eva āha ghaṇṭā devasya yogīnām iti yadā prajñā yogaḥ devasya vajradharasya syāt tadā jhaṭiti devatā mudrā mantra ādikam kāryam bhāvayet vicakṣaṇaḥ iti evaṃprakāreṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ yogī vajra sattva rūpeṇa ātmānam devī rūpeṇa prajñām bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.46] devyāḥ śarīre 'ṣṭākṣaranyāsam āha: aṣṭākṣarasyetyādi. aṣṭāv akṣarāṇi devatāsvarūpāṇi devyāḥ śarīre bhagavaccharīravan nyastavyānīti bhāvaḥ. eṣa ca pūrvoddiṣṭasya kalanasya nirdeśaḥ. etad evāha: devyā ityādi. devyāḥ śarīre cetanā cittaṃ kalanadvāreṇa kuryād iti bhāvaḥ. punar eveti: kalanam uktam api punar ucyate smaraṇārtham iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: devyāḥ śarīre ṣṭa akṣara nyāsam āha aṣṭa akṣarasya ityādi aṣṭau akṣarāṇi devatā svarūpāṇi devyāḥ śarīre bhagavat śarīra vat nyastavyāni iti bhāvaḥ eṣa ca pūrva uddiṣṭasya kalanasya nirdeśaḥ etat eva āha devyāḥ ityādi devyāḥ śarīre cetanā cittam kalana dvāreṇa kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ punar eva iti kalanam uktam api punar ucyate smaraṇa artham iti bhāvaḥ

original: anye tv evaṃ varṇayanti: naṣṭarāgonnayanārthaṃ devyām ātmaceto vyāpārayituṃ yadi syād yogī, tadā punaḥ kalanam iti.
analyzed: anye tu evam varṇayanti naṣṭa rāga unnayana artham devyām ātma cetaḥ vyāpārayitum yadi syāt yogī tadā punar kalanam iti

original: [3.4.47] tata ityādi: tata iti kalanānantaram. vajrasyeti vajrasattvaḥ. m-āliṅgyeti: svayaṃ devīm āliṅgya svayam anuraktaṃ cittaṃ devyām utpādayet. atha vajrasyetyādi: itthaṃ cittam utpādayan ...
analyzed: tatas ityādi tatas iti kalanā anantaram vajrasya iti vajra sattvaḥ mā āliṅgya iti svayam devīm āliṅgya svayam anuraktam cittam devyām utpādayet atha vajrasya ityādi ittham cittam utpādayan

original: [3.4.48] ... vajrasattvo 'ham ity ātmany ahaṃkāraṃ kuryāt. etad evāha: aham ityādi. atha vā tata iti (47a) karaṇāvasthānantaram. vajrasya (47a) vajrasattvasya. m-āliṅgyety (47a) āliṅganādikriyā. svem iti (47b) svayam. anuraktasya ceta neti (47b): anuraktasyety anuraktam. ceteti cittam. nā iti pratiṣedhe. etad uktaṃ syāt:
analyzed: vajra sattvaḥ ham iti ātmani ahaṃkāram kuryāt etat eva āha aham ityādi atha vā tatas iti karaṇa avasthā anantaram vajrasya 47a vajra sattvasya mā āliṅgya iti 47a āliṅgana ādi kriyā iti 47b svayam anuraktasya ceta na iti 47b anuraktasya iti anuraktam cetā iti cittam na iti pratiṣedhe etat uktam syāt

original: karaṇāvasthāyām api prajñāyāś cittaṃ nānuraktaṃ bhavatīti lakṣyate, tadā svayaṃ vajrasattvayogī tasyā āliṅganādikaṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ. athety (47c) adhaḥ. kvacid adheti pāṭhaḥ. prajñāyā adhogatam ātmānaṃ yogī kuryāt. kathaṃ kuryād ity āha: cetanā saheti (47d). cittena saha. yadā nānuraktaṃ tasyāś cittaṃ lakṣyate, tadaitad api kartavyam iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: karaṇa avasthāyām api prajñāyāḥ cittam na anuraktam bhavati iti lakṣyate tadā svayam vajra sattva yogī tasyāḥ āliṅgana ādikam kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ atha iti adhas kvacid adha iti pāṭhaḥ prajñāyāḥ adhas gatam ātmānam yogī kuryāt katham kuryāt iti āha cetanā saha iti cittena saha yadā na anuraktam tasyāḥ cittam lakṣyate tadā etat api kartavyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: viparītaratam apy anena darśitam. tasyām avasthāyāṃ vajrasattvāhaṃkāraceto 'nyathā mā bhūd ity ahaṃkārādi vajrasyety (48a) uktam. vajrasattvam ahaṃ paṭhed ity (48b) uddiṣṭasya nirdeśaḥ.
analyzed: viparīta ratam api anena darśitam tasyām avasthāyām vajra sattva ahaṃkāra cetaḥ nyathā mā bhūt iti ahaṃkāra ādi vajrasya iti uktam vajra sattvam aham paṭhet iti uddiṣṭasya nirdeśaḥ

original: [3.4.49] idānīṃ khagamukhāyā nāḍyāḥ svarūpam āha: ambhodbhavasyetyādi. ambhodbhavasya puṣpāṇām iti: padmapuṣpasya dharmodayāyā ity arthaḥ. tasya kim ity āha: antargūḍhasya lakṣaṇam iti. tasya padmasyābhyantare gūḍhaṃ guptaṃ, tac ca khagamukhaiva lakṣyata iti lakṣaṇam. dharmodayāntargūḍhā khagamukhā nāḍīti bhāvaḥ. kim ivety āha:
analyzed: idānīm khaga mukhāyāḥ nāḍyāḥ svarūpam āha ambhodbhavasya ityādi ambhodbhavasya puṣpāṇām iti padma puṣpasya dharmodayāyāḥ iti arthaḥ tasya kim iti āha antar gūḍhasya lakṣaṇam iti tasya padmasya abhyantare gūḍham guptam tat ca khaga mukhā eva lakṣyate iti lakṣaṇam dharma udaya antar gūḍhā khaga mukhā nāḍī iti bhāvaḥ kim iva iti āha

original: aṅkurā mūla puṣpāṇām iti. yathāṅkuro mūlaṃ puṣpāṇāṃ, tathā nāḍī dharmodayāyā mūlam. śeṣaṃ subodham.
analyzed: iti yathā aṅkuraḥ mūlam puṣpāṇām tathā nāḍī dharmodayāyāḥ mūlam śeṣam su bodham

original: [3.4.50] idānīṃ pūrvoktam eva kalanaṃ sthāpanadvāreṇa vyaktīkurvvann āha: uradvayasyetyādi. uradvayaṃ skandhadvayam. bījānām iti: bahuvacananirdeśāt kaṇṭhamūlahṛdayanābhimūlāny api gṛhyante. nyasanīyabāhulyān nyāsasthānabāhulyam. bījaśabdena kūṭabījāny abhimatāni. tataś ca skandhadvaye smryuṃ, kaṇṭhamūle hmryuṃ, hṛdaye ymryuṃ, nābhimūle kṣmryuṃ.
analyzed: idānīm pūrva uktam eva kalanam sthāpana dvāreṇa vyaktīkurvan āha ura dvayasya ityādi ura dvayam skandha dvayam bījānām iti bahuvacana nirdeśāt kaṇṭha mūla hṛdaya nābhimūlāni api gṛhyante nyasanīya bāhulyāt nyāsa sthāna bāhulyam bīja śabdena kūṭa bījāni abhimatāni tatas ca skandha dvaye kaṇṭha mūle hṛdaye nābhimūle

original: pṛthivyeti hūṃkāraḥ, sa ca cakṣuṣoḥ. vāyur yuṃkāraḥ, sa ca karṇanāsayoḥ. nimna āpasvabhāvasyeti: nimne jihvāyāṃ, apsvabhāvaḥ suṃkāraḥ. aṅkura agnibījavad iti: aṅkure tāluni kṣuṃ. idaṃ cāgnibījam.
analyzed: pṛthivyā iti hūṃkāraḥ sa ca cakṣuṣoḥ vāyuḥ yuṃkāraḥ sa ca karṇa nāsayoḥ nimne āpa svabhāvasya iti nimne jihvāyām ap svabhāvaḥ suṃkāraḥ aṅkura agni bīja vat iti aṅkure tāluni kṣuṃ idam ca agni bījam

original: [3.4.51] yathetyādi subodham.
analyzed: yathā ityādi su bodham

original: [3.4.52] devyā rūpa saṃcintyeti: tenoddhṛtenāṃkāreṇadevyā rūpaṃ niṣpādya, pṛthivyā madhya līyata iti: pṛthivī dharmodayā, tasyā madhye ca sa hūṃkāro līyate śliṣyate. etac ca prāg evoktaṃ smārayati. khagamukhāyām aṃkāro nyasanīya iti bhāvaḥ. kālāgni preta agnisyeti: kālāgnir dakṣiṇa ucyate, pretāgnir vāmaś ca.
analyzed: devyāḥ saṃcintya iti tena uddhṛtena aṃkāreṇa devyāḥ rūpam niṣpādya pṛthivyāḥ līyate iti pṛthivī dharma udayā tasyāḥ madhye ca sa hūṃkāraḥ līyate śliṣyate etat ca prāk eva uktam smārayati khaga mukhāyām aṃkāraḥ nyasanīyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ kālāgni iti kālāgniḥ dakṣiṇaḥ ucyate preta agniḥ vāmaḥ ca

original: tataś ca kālāgninā dakṣiṇena kareṇa prathamam upāya āliṅgati, paścād vāmena kareṇeti bhāvaḥ. idānīṃ prajñāyā āliṅganam āha: pretāgni kālāgnivad iti. pretāgninā vāmena kareṇa prathamaṃ prajñāliṅgati, paścād dakṣiṇena kareṇeti bhāvaḥ. tenopāyasya dakṣiṇabhāgaḥ pradhānaḥ, prajñāyā vāmabhāga iti sūcitaṃ syāt.
analyzed: tatas ca kālāgninā dakṣiṇena kareṇa prathamam upāyaḥ āliṅgati paścāt vāmena kareṇa iti bhāvaḥ idānīm prajñāyāḥ āliṅganam āha preta agni kālāgni vat iti preta agninā vāmena kareṇa prathamam prajñā āliṅgati paścāt dakṣiṇena kareṇa iti bhāvaḥ tena upāyasya dakṣiṇa bhāgaḥ pradhānaḥ prajñāyāḥ vāma bhāgaḥ iti sūcitam syāt

original: [3.4.53] dvayasaṃpuṭapāṇasyeti: dvayoḥ prajñopāyayoḥ saṃpuṭe pāṇayaḥ kīdṛśā ity āha: trisūcyā vajram ucchrita iti. triśūkavajrākāreṇa pāṇayas tayor ucchritā bhavantīti bhāvaḥ. triśūkavajrākāratvam eva katham ity āha: kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭha dvau veṣṭyeti:
analyzed: dvaya saṃpuṭa pāṇasya iti dvayoḥ prajñā upāyayoḥ saṃpuṭe pāṇayaḥ kīdṛśāḥ iti āha tri sūcyā vajram ucchritaḥ iti triśūka vajra ākāreṇa pāṇayaḥ tayoḥ ucchritāḥ bhavanti iti bhāvaḥ triśūka vajra ākāra tvam eva katham iti āha kaniṣṭhā aṅguṣṭha dvau veṣṭya iti

original: vṛddhāṅguṣṭhena kanīyasīṃ samākramya śeṣāṅgulitrayam utthitaṃ kāryaṃ, tatas triśūkavajrākāraḥ syād iti bhāvaḥ. evaṃ saty api kutra te pāṇayo dhāryā ity āha: dvayamudrādi pārśvata iti. prajñopāyayor viniyamena pārśvadvaye dhāryā iti bhāvaḥ. tataś ca triśūkavajramudrā syād iti mudrety asyārthaḥ.
analyzed: vṛddha aṅguṣṭhena kanīyasīm samākramya śeṣa aṅguli trayam utthitam kāryam tatas triśūka vajra ākāraḥ syāt iti bhāvaḥ evam sati api kutra te pāṇayaḥ dhāryāḥ iti āha dvayamudrā ādi pārśvatas iti prajñā upāyayoḥ viniyamena pārśva dvaye dhāryāḥ iti bhāvaḥ tatas ca triśūka vajra mudrā syāt iti mudrā iti asya arthaḥ

original: [3.4.54] adharo tīkṣṇa saṃpīḍya amṛtāhāra cetaneti: adharaṃ tīkṣṇair dantaiḥ saṃdaśyādharamadhu pibed iti bhāvaḥ. amṛtam adharamadhu. āhāreti: āharet. ādadītety arthaḥ. cetaneti yogī. aṣṭādaśabhītyādinā bodhicittacodanāṃ smārayati. ghaṇṭā codaneti: prajñāyā amṛtaṃ codayed ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: tīkṣṇa saṃpīḍya amṛta āhāra cetanā iti adharam tīkṣṇaiḥ dantaiḥ saṃdaśya adhara madhu pibet iti bhāvaḥ amṛtam adhara madhu āhāra iti āharet ādadīta iti arthaḥ cetanā iti yogī aṣṭādaśabhīti ādinā bodhi citta codanām smārayati ghaṇṭā codanā iti prajñāyāḥ amṛtam codayet iti arthaḥ

original: [3.4.55] bandhūka vāmabhāga iti: bandhūkakusumasadṛśī khagamukhā nāḍī, sā ca dharmodayāvāmabhāge. ata āha: kharatāpeti m-ākṛtīti. kharatāpaṃ khagamukhā. m-ākṛtīti: ākṛtā vyaktety arthaḥ. punaḥ kīdṛśīty āha: khagacañcukam ākāram iti. pakṣicañcunibhety arthaḥ. anenākṛtiḥ kathitā. kharatāpeti svarūpākhyānam. tasya mudreṇa codayed iti:
analyzed: bandhūka vāma bhāgaḥ iti bandhūka kusuma sadṛśī khagamukhā nāḍī sā ca dharmodayā vāma bhāge atas āha khara tāpa iti mā ākṛti iti khara tāpam khagamukhā mā ākṛti iti ākṛtā vyaktā iti arthaḥ punar kīdṛśā iti āha khaga cañcukam ākāram iti pakṣi cañcu nibhā iti arthaḥ anena ākṛtiḥ kathitā khara tāpā iti svarūpa ākhyānam tasya mudreṇa codayet iti

original: tāṃ nāḍīṃ mudrayā bhāvitakriṃkārayā tarjanyā codayet. atha vā gajahastādinā.
analyzed: tām nāḍīm mudrayā bhāvita kriṃkārayā tarjanyā codayet atha vā gajahasta ādinā

original: [3.4.56] dāyiṇaṃ vajram ambūnām iti: samāpattau dakṣiṇabalitena vajreṇa padmenāpi vāmabalitena gharṣaṇaṃ prajñopāyau kuryātām iti bhāvaḥ. ambūnām iti: ambujaṃ padmaṃ dharmodayety arthaḥ. vajrasya dakṣiṇatvena padmasya yuktyā vāmatvam. samakārānurūpavad iti: samaṃ prajñopāyayor gharṣaṇam iti bhāvaḥ. pulakaṃ dadyād urasyā sarva saṃsthitam iti:
analyzed: vajram ambūnām iti samāpattau dakṣiṇa balitena vajreṇa padmena api vāma balitena gharṣaṇam prajñā upāyau kuryātām iti bhāvaḥ ambūnām iti ambujam padmam dharma udaya iti arthaḥ vajrasya dakṣiṇa tvena padmasya yuktyā vāma tvam samakāra anurūpa vat iti samam prajñā upāyayoḥ gharṣaṇam iti bhāvaḥ pulakam dadyāt iti

original: tarjanyā pulakaṃ dadyād urasi stanayor ity arthaḥ. tena sarvāṅgasaṃsthitaṃ bodhicittaṃ sravatīti kriyā draṣṭavyā. urasyety upalakṣaṇamātratvāt. varāṅgādau ca pulakaṃ dadyāt.
analyzed: tarjanyā pulakam dadyāt urasi stanayoḥ iti arthaḥ tena sarva aṅga saṃsthitam bodhi cittam sravati iti kriyā draṣṭavyā urasya iti upalakṣaṇa mātra tvāt varāṅga ādau ca pulakam dadyāt

original: [3.4.57] ata vajrasūcyādimudrāṇāṃ pārśvasthānaṃ tu yojayed iti. ateti: ata ity arthaḥ. ato bodhicittacodanāhetoḥ pūrvaṃ vajrasūcīmudrā prajñopāyayor āliṅganaprastāve darśiteti bhāvaḥ. gharṣaṇam māṃsalayann āha: dvaubhi lagnam ākārau padma vajreṇa codayed iti.
analyzed: vajrasūci ādi mudrāṇām pārśva sthānam tu yojayet iti ata iti atas iti arthaḥ atas bodhi citta codanā hetoḥ pūrvam vajrasūcī mudrā prajñā upāyayoḥ āliṅgana prastāve darśitā iti bhāvaḥ gharṣaṇam māṃsalayan āha lagnam ākārau vajreṇa codayet iti

original: dvau prajñopāyau lagnākārau parasparaṃ padmaṃ vajreṇa dakṣiṇabalitena, vajraṃ padmena vāmabalitena gharṣaṇaṃ kurvāṇau codayātām iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: dvau prajñā upāyau lagna ākārau parasparam padmam vajreṇa dakṣiṇa balitena vajram padmena vāma balitena gharṣaṇam kurvāṇau codayātām iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.58] japaṃ smarayann āha: hūṃkāretyādi. hūṃkāradhvaniṃ kurvāṇo vajradharo 'dvayabījam advayajñānam eva japet. svadehe sarvadevatāḥ satsukhena prīṇayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: japam smarayan āha hūṃkāra ityādi hūṃkāra dhvanim kurvāṇaḥ vajradharaḥ dvaya bījam advaya jñānam eva japet sva dehe sarva devatāḥ sat sukhena prīṇayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.59] ghaṇṭāpy aṃkāraṃ japed ity āha: ghaṇṭetyādi. vajrāgre jñānabījaṃ tv iti: vajrāgre hūṃkāraṃ vīkṣyātmānaṃ prīṇayet. saṃyogakāle vajrāgre hūṃkāro dhyeya ity arthaḥ. kiṃ ca prajñāyāḥ padme 'py aṃkāro dhyeyaḥ.
analyzed: ghaṇṭā api aṃkāram japet iti āha ghaṇṭā ityādi vajra agre jñāna bījam tu iti vajra agre hūṃkāram vīkṣya ātmānam prīṇayet saṃyoga kāle vajra agre hūṃkāraḥ dhyeyaḥ iti arthaḥ kim ca prajñāyāḥ padme pi aṃkāraḥ dhyeyaḥ

original: [3.4.60] vajretyādi: vajro vajradharaḥ. ghaṇṭā prajñā. itthaṃ tayoḥ svadehasaṃpuṭaṃ mudreti bhāvaḥ. itthaṃ tattvāvabodhena vajravajraghaṇṭāmudrādhāraṇam iti darśayann āha: vajra ghaṇṭāṃ cetyādi. bahirvajraṃ ghaṇṭāṃ mudrāṃ ca tadviśuddhyaiva dhārayed yogīty arthaḥ.
analyzed: vajra ityādi vajraḥ vajradharaḥ ghaṇṭā prajñā ittham tayoḥ sva deha saṃpuṭam mudrā iti bhāvaḥ ittham tattva avabodhena vajra vajra ghaṇṭā mudrā dhāraṇam iti darśayan āha vajra ghaṇṭām ca ityādi bahis vajram ghaṇṭām mudrām ca tad viśuddhyā eva dhārayet yogī iti arthaḥ

original: [3.4.61] vajram ityādi. tattveneti: hūṃkāreṇa. hūṃkāroccāraṇenety arthaḥ. hūṃkāram uccārayan vajreṇa gharṣayed ity arthaḥ. evaṃ padmam utthāpya prajñāpy aṃ kāram uccārayantī vajraṃ pratīcched ity āha: ghaṇṭā svecchena nādayed iti. itthaṃ vajraghaṇṭāsaṃyogaparamārthajñānenātmānaṃ saṃtoṣya dehasthā devatāḥ prīṇayed ity etad evāha:
analyzed: vajram ityādi tattvena iti hūṃkāreṇa hūṃkāra uccāraṇena iti arthaḥ hūṃkāram uccārayan vajreṇa gharṣayet iti arthaḥ evam padmam utthāpya prajñāpī aṃ kāram uccārayantī vajram pratīcchet iti āha ghaṇṭā svecchena nādayet iti ittham vajra ghaṇṭā saṃyoga paramārtha jñānena ātmānam saṃtoṣya deha sthāḥ devatāḥ prīṇayet iti etat eva āha

original: vajraghaṇṭetyādi subodham.
analyzed: vajraghaṇṭā ityādi su bodham

original: [3.4.62] adhiṣṭhayed ityādi: adhiṣṭhayed bhakṣayed ity arthaḥ. kiṃ tad ity āha: tasya m-ambūnām iti. tadubhayayogajaṃ bodhicittam. tac ca svacittarūpam. dvaubhir ātmakair iti: ubhayātmajam iti bhāvaḥ. etac cobhayabodhicittam ubhayābhyām āsvādyam iti ca jñeyam.
analyzed: adhiṣṭhayet ityādi adhiṣṭhayet bhakṣayet iti arthaḥ kim tat iti āha tasya iti tad ubhaya yoga jam bodhi cittam tat ca sva citta rūpam dvaubhiḥ ātmakaiḥ iti ubhaya ātma jam iti bhāvaḥ etat ca ubhaya bodhi cittam ubhayābhyām āsvādyam iti ca jñeyam

original: [3.4.63] pūrvaṃ prajñāyāḥ pradhānyena karaṇaṃ darśitam. idānīm upāyasya nāyakatvena karaṇam āha: śṛṅgārākṣepetyādi. śṛṅgārasaṃsthānayukto yogī pradhānam ātmānaṃ gaṇayan sukhāsane niṣadya vajrasattvarūpam āsthāya kiṃ kuryād ity āha: lalitetyādi. lalitapādatvaṃ dakṣiṇacaraṇasaṃkocaḥ. vāma urusya ghaṇṭata iti: prajñāyā vāmacaraṇasaṃkoca iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: pūrvam prajñāyāḥ pradhānyena karaṇam darśitam idānīm upāyasya nāyaka tvena karaṇam āha śṛṅgāra ākṣepa ityādi śṛṅgāra saṃsthāna yuktaḥ yogī pradhānam ātmānam gaṇayan sukha āsane niṣadya vajra sattva rūpam āsthāya kim kuryāt iti āha lalita ityādi lalita pāda tvam dakṣiṇa caraṇa saṃkocaḥ vāmaḥ ghaṇṭate iti prajñāyāḥ vāma caraṇa saṃkocaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: etenaitad uktaṃ: vajradharo dakṣiṇaṃ caraṇaṃ saṃkocya vāmaṃ prasārayet. prajñā vāmaṃ caraṇaṃ saṃkocya dakṣiṇaṃ prasārayed iti.
analyzed: etena etat uktam vajradharaḥ dakṣiṇam caraṇam saṃkocya vāmam prasārayet prajñā vāmam caraṇam saṃkocya dakṣiṇam prasārayet iti

original: [3.4.64] vāmāliṅgaṃ tu kucapāṇāv iti: vāmena kareṇāliṅgya kucaṃ pīḍayed iti bhāvaḥ. dāyiṇaṃ vajra lālitam iti: dakṣiṇena kareṇa vajram upāyena kamale prakṣepaṇīyam iti bhāvaḥ. evaṃ sarvaṃ vidhāya hasitādikriyāṃ kurvaṃś cumben muhur muhuḥ.
analyzed: vāma āliṅgam tu kuca pāṇau iti vāmena kareṇa āliṅgya kucam pīḍayet iti bhāvaḥ vajra lālitam iti dakṣiṇena kareṇa vajram upāyena kamale prakṣepaṇīyam iti bhāvaḥ evam sarvam vidhāya hasita ādi kriyām kurvan cumbet muhur muhur

original: [3.4.65] idānīṃ karaṇāntaram āha: ghaṇṭetyādi. prajñāyā dakṣiṇacaraṇakuñcanaṃ lalitam ākāram ity asyārthaḥ. upāyasya vāmacaraṇakuñcanam iti draṣṭavyam. urum āsanam āsinam iti: upāyasyorūpari prajñāsīnety arthaḥ. dakṣiṇena caraṇena prajñā kaṭideśam āveṣṭya dhārayet.
analyzed: idānīm karaṇa antaram āha ghaṇṭā ityādi prajñāyāḥ dakṣiṇa caraṇa kuñcanam lalitam ākāram iti asya arthaḥ upāyasya vāma caraṇa kuñcanam iti draṣṭavyam urum āsanam āsinam iti upāyasya ūru upari prajñā āsīnā iti arthaḥ dakṣiṇena caraṇena prajñā kaṭi deśam āveṣṭya dhārayet

original: [3.4.66] ekāliṅgana grīvaṃ tv iti: ekena dakṣiṇena kareṇa prajñāyā grīvām āliṅgya veṣṭayet. vāma ghaṇṭābhi nāditam iti: vāmena kareṇa prajñāyāḥ padmaṃ prasārayed iti bhāvaḥ. atha vā cālayed ity āśayaḥ. śeṣaṃ subodham. karaṇadvayaṃ darśitaṃ tāvad anyad apy ūhanīyam.
analyzed: tu iti ekena dakṣiṇena kareṇa prajñāyāḥ grīvām āliṅgya veṣṭayet vāma ghaṇṭā abhi nāditam iti vāmena kareṇa prajñāyāḥ padmam prasārayet iti bhāvaḥ atha vā cālayet iti āśayaḥ śeṣam su bodham karaṇa dvayam darśitam tāvat anyat api ūhanīyam

original: [3.4.67] vajragītam ityādi: vajram advayaṃ guhyam ity arthaḥ. tadanvitaṃ gītaṃ karaṇādyanantaraṃ gāyed iti bhāvaḥ. paścān madanaṃ pītvā gāyed ity āha: amṛtetyādi. amṛtodakaṃ madanam. etac ca śramāpanayanārthaṃ, prajñāsaṃtoṣaṇārthaṃ ca gānaṃ pānaṃ ca kāryam. ubhayor api hi pānam.
analyzed: vajragītam ityādi vajram advayam guhyam iti arthaḥ tad anvitam gītam karaṇa ādi anantaram gāyet iti bhāvaḥ paścāt madanam pītvā gāyet iti āha amṛta ityādi amṛta udakam madanam etat ca śrama apanayana artham prajñā saṃtoṣaṇa artham ca gānam pānam ca kāryam ubhayoḥ api hi pānam

original: [3.4.68] vajragītam āha: sāretyādi. sāra samuccaa pāviaï iti: sāram apratiṣṭhitanirvāṇaṃ taṃ samuccinoti sādhayaty aneneti sārasamuccayaḥ. tādṛśo 'pi śūnya iti viruddhālaṅkāraḥ. tattvato grāhyādinā śūnyo jalādinā ghaṭavat. ko 'sāv evam ity āha: saṃsāru iti. saṃsāraḥ pañca skandhāḥ.
analyzed: āha sāra ityādi sāra iti sāram apratiṣṭhita nirvāṇam tam samuccinoti sādhayati anena iti sāra samuccayaḥ śūnyaḥ iti viruddha alaṅkāraḥ tattvataḥ grāhya ādinā śūnyaḥ jala ādinā ghaṭa vat asau evam iti āha iti saṃsāraḥ pañca skandhāḥ

original: skandhapañcakaṃ hi devatātmakaṃ, niḥsvabhāvaṃ ca bhāvyamānam anāsaṅgād apratiṣṭhitanirvāṇaṃ sādhayati. asāru iti: na vidyate sāraḥ sthirāṅgo nityatā lakṣaṇo yasya so 'sāraḥ saṃsāraḥ. yadi grāhyādirahitaḥ saṃsāras, tataḥ katham apratiṣṭhitanirvāṇam api syād ity āha: bhāvetyādi. bhāvaḥ svabhāvo grāhyādilakṣaṇaḥ.
analyzed: skandha pañcakam hi devatā ātmakam niḥsvabhāvam ca bhāvyamānam anāsaṅgāt apratiṣṭhita nirvāṇam sādhayati iti na vidyate sāraḥ sthira aṅgaḥ nitya tā lakṣaṇaḥ yasya saḥ sāraḥ saṃsāraḥ yadi grāhya ādi rahitaḥ saṃsāraḥ tatas katham apratiṣṭhita nirvāṇam api syāt iti āha bhāva ityādi bhāvaḥ svabhāvaḥ grāhya ādi lakṣaṇaḥ
