original: atha vā sad asannityānityādi bhavati pratibhāty asminn iti bhāvo dvayākāraṃ cittaṃ tena vimuktā siddhir api, apratiṣṭhitanirvāṇaniṣpattir apīty arthaḥ. sadṛśāt sadṛśaṃ kāryam iti bhāvaḥ. paryāyeṇārthakathanam āha: mokkheti. apratiṣṭhitanirvāṇaṃ mokṣa iti paryāyāv iti bhāvaḥ. tat kimartham ity āha: tāraṇeeṇeti. sattvatāraṇārtham ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: atha vā sat asat nitya anitya ādi bhavati pratibhāti asmin iti bhāvaḥ dvaya ākāram cittam tena vimuktā siddhiḥ api apratiṣṭhita nirvāṇa niṣpattiḥ api iti arthaḥ sadṛśāt sadṛśam kāryam iti bhāvaḥ paryāyeṇa artha kathanam āha mokkha iti apratiṣṭhita nirvāṇam mokṣaḥ iti paryāyau iti bhāvaḥ tat kimartham iti āha tāraṇeeṇa iti sattva tāraṇa artham iti arthaḥ

original: [3.4.69] etad evāha: dondāliṅgaṇajou saala kājjieṇeti. śūnyatākaruṇāsvarūpo devatāyogo dvandvāliṅganayogaḥ sa nikhilajanakāryārtham. ṇāhi saṃsāru asāru iti: dvandvāliṅganayogam abhyasyatāṃ nāsty asāraḥ saṃsāraḥ pariśuddhatvena nirvāṇarūpatvād iti bhāvaḥ. tasmād yoginyo 'pi magnā eva pariśuddhā evety arthaḥ.
analyzed: etat eva āha sa ala iti śūnyatā karuṇā sva rūpaḥ devatā yogaḥ dvandva āliṅgana yogaḥ sa nikhila jana kārya artham saṃsāru asāru iti dvandva āliṅgana yogam abhyasyatām na asti asāraḥ saṃsāraḥ pariśuddha tvena nirvāṇa rūpa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ tasmāt yoginyaḥ api magnāḥ eva pariśuddhāḥ eva iti arthaḥ

original: sarvatra padānte te nā hūṃ te nā hūṃ te nā te te hūṃ iti draṣṭavyam. ata evoktam: hūṃkāra vividhaṃ mateti (67b).
analyzed: sarvatra pada ante te nā hūm te nā hūm te nā te te hūm iti draṣṭavyam atas eva uktam hūṃkāra vividham matā iti

original: [3.4.70] ghaṇṭāṃ vādayitvā punar gāyed iti. tad evāha: vajraghaṇṭetyādi. itthaṃ yogī japan bhāvayan sidhyatīti darśayann āha: samāhitam ityādi. evaṃbhūtasya yogino yad yac cintitaṃ kāryaṃ, tat sarvaṃ sidhyatīti darśayann āha: yad ācintitetyādi.
analyzed: ghaṇṭām vādayitvā punar gāyet iti tat eva āha vajraghaṇṭā ityādi ittham yogī japan bhāvayan sidhyati iti darśayan āha samāhitam ityādi evaṃbhūtasya yoginaḥ yat yat cintitam kāryam tat sarvam sidhyati iti darśayan āha yat ācintita ityādi

original: [3.4.71] idānīṃ vaśīkaraṇārthaṃ yogam āha: ākṣepetyādi. ākṣipyate svavaśīkriyate yena, sa ākṣepo bhaiṣajyādi. tasya yoktavyam iti: mukhyatvena prajñāyāṃ tāvad yoktavyam oṣadham iti bhāvaḥ. śeṣaṃ subodham.
analyzed: idānīm vaśīkaraṇa artham yogam āha ākṣepa ityādi ākṣipyate sva vaśīkriyate yena saḥ ākṣepaḥ bhaiṣajya ādi tasya yoktavyam iti mukhya tvena prajñāyām tāvat yoktavyam oṣadham iti bhāvaḥ śeṣam su bodham

original: [3.4.72] yogasthāna gṛhyata iti: sarveṣāṃ samo bhāga ity arthaḥ. bhāvayet tasya dravyeṇeti: tena bodhicittena tāni dravyāṇi bhāvayitavyānīti bhāvaḥ. bodhicittaṃ ca dvīndriyasamāpattijaṃ grāhyam. yogasthānaśabdena bodhicittam ity eke.
analyzed: gṛhyate iti sarveṣām samaḥ bhāgaḥ iti arthaḥ bhāvayet tasya dravyeṇa iti tena bodhi cittena tāni dravyāṇi bhāvayitavyāni iti bhāvaḥ bodhi cittam ca dvīndriya samāpatti jam grāhyam yogasthāna śabdena bodhi cittam iti eke

original: [3.4.73] indrahastādītyādinā yogāntaram āha. indrahastākṛti mūlaṃ yasya, tad indrahastam. mohanī vaṭaparṇikā. stambhanī śālaparṇī. ātmapañcikam iti pañcāmṛtam. pañcāṅgam iti cakṣuḥśrotraghrāṇajihvāvajrāṇāṃ malaḥ pañcāṅgam ity ucyate. samabhāgaṃ kārayed iti: indrahastādīnāṃ samo bhāgo grāhyaḥ. anyeṣāṃ yathālābhaṃ grahaṇam.
analyzed: indrahasta ādi ityādinā yoga antaram āha indrahasta ākṛti mūlam yasya tat indrahastam mohanī vaṭaparṇikā stambhanī śālaparṇī ātmapañcikam iti pañcāmṛtam pañcāṅgam iti cakṣuḥ śrotra ghrāṇa jihvā vajrāṇām malaḥ pañcāṅgam iti ucyate sama bhāgam kārayet iti indrahasta ādīnām samaḥ bhāgaḥ grāhyaḥ anyeṣām yathālābham grahaṇam

original: [3.4.74] pāna iti madirādipāne. tāmbūlabhakṣasyeti: guvākabhakṣaṇe cūrṇena dātavyam iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: pāne iti madirā ādi pāne tāmbūla bhakṣasya iti guvāka bhakṣaṇe cūrṇena dātavyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.75] rajaḥsphulitayogena vaśakarmādi sidhyatīti: strīrajasā raktadevatāyogena ca vaśyaṃ karma sidhyatīti saṃbandhaḥ. mantralakṣeṇa ca sidhyatīty āha: mantretyādi.
analyzed: rajaḥ sphulita yogena vaśa karma ādi sidhyati iti strī rajasā raktadevatā yogena ca vaśyam karma sidhyati iti saṃbandhaḥ mantra lakṣeṇa ca sidhyati iti āha mantra ityādi

original: [3.4.76] visarjya bodhicittaṃ tac cātmadehasya, pūrvoktena rajasā svadehajena ca bodhicittena, dvābhyāṃ miśrībhūtābhyām ity arthaḥ. raktadevatāyogī sarvaṃ vaśayatīti bhāvaḥ. ata āha: svecchābhi kārayed iti. rajo bodhicittaṃ ca japtalakṣamantro raktavarṇadevatāyogī yasmai dadāti, sa vaśī syād iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: visarjya bodhi cittam tat ca ātma dehasya pūrva uktena rajasā sva deha jena ca bodhi cittena dvābhyām miśrībhūtābhyām iti arthaḥ rakta devatā yogī sarvam vaśayati iti bhāvaḥ atas āha sva icchā abhi kārayet iti rajaḥ bodhi cittam ca japta lakṣa mantraḥ rakta varṇa devatā yogī yasmai dadāti sa vaśī syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.77] śāntikādikāle mudrāṇām upayogam āha: vratītyādi. vratīti vratinī kāpālikīty arthaḥ. jñātīnām iti jñāninī, kāṇḍakāriṇī daivajñety arthaḥ. jñānīnām iti pāṭhe 'py evam. rājñīti kṣatriyā. guravaguhyeti brāhmaṇī. guraveti brāhmaṇī. guhyeti naṭī kecit.
analyzed: śāntika ādi kāle mudrāṇām upayogam āha vrati ityādi vratī iti vratinī kāpālikā iti arthaḥ jñātīnām iti jñāninī kāṇḍa kāriṇī daivajñā iti arthaḥ jñānīnām iti pāṭhe evam rājñī iti kṣatriyā gurava guhya iti brāhmaṇī guravā iti brāhmaṇī guhya iti naṭī kecid

original: [3.4.78] cirmiketi carmakārī. māṃsiketi māṃsavikrayaṇī. khaṭṭikādikanyety arthaḥ. mīneti kaivartī.
analyzed: cirmikā iti carmakārī māṃsikā iti māṃsa vikrayaṇī khaṭṭika ādi kanyā iti arthaḥ mīna iti kaivartī

original: [3.4.79] rajakī prasiddhā. rajanīti pāṭhe 'pi rajakī. tasmād ityādi: yogaḥ śāntikādikarma. śāstreṇa mantraśāstreṇa. dhīyatāṃ sādhyatām. mantranaye yataḥ kathito mudrāgrāmaḥ, sa śāntikādisiddhyarthaṃ yatnena sādhyatām iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: rajakī prasiddhā rajanī iti pāṭhe rajakī tasmāt ityādi yogaḥ śāntika ādi karma śāstreṇa mantra śāstreṇa dhīyatām sādhyatām mantra naye yatas kathitaḥ mudrā grāmaḥ sa śāntika ādi siddhi artham yatnena sādhyatām iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.80] idānīṃ bandhaprakāram āha: aparaivetyādi. apara ākṣepaḥ kathyata iti jñeyam. bandhena sattvottāraṇaṃ padam iti: sattvottāraṇārthaṃ padaṃ samapadādikam. dvaya saṃlagnam ākṣepa tattvamudreti bandhayed iti: padadvayaṃ samatayā saṃlagnaṃ samapadaṃ syād iti samapadasya lakṣaṇam. tad eva vighnākṣepakatvād ākṣepaḥ. tattvamudreti:
analyzed: idānīm bandha prakāram āha aparā eva ityādi aparaḥ ākṣepaḥ kathyate iti jñeyam bandhena sattva uttāraṇam padam iti sattva uttāraṇa artham padam sama pada ādikam dvaya saṃlagnam ākṣepa tattvamudrā iti bandhayet iti pada dvayam samatayā saṃlagnam sama padam syāt iti sama padasya lakṣaṇam tat eva vighna ākṣepaka tvāt ākṣepaḥ tattvamudrā iti

original: samapadabandho mudrātattvam ity arthaḥ. anye tu dvaya saṃlagnam ākṣepeti: dvayoḥ prajñopāyayoḥ saṃlagnaṃ saṃparko bandhādirūpaḥ. sa evākṣepaḥ pūrvavat. tattvam aviparītam advayajñānam ity arthaḥ. tasya mudrā rūpaṃ yataḥ samapadādikaṃ, tato badhnīyād iti nedaṃ samapadasya lakṣaṇam. samapadaṃ tu prasiddham eva.
analyzed: sama pada bandhaḥ mudrā tattvam iti arthaḥ anye tu saṃlagnam ākṣepa iti dvayoḥ prajñā upāyayoḥ saṃlagnam saṃparkaḥ bandha ādi rūpaḥ saḥ eva ākṣepaḥ pūrvavat tattvam aviparītam advaya jñānam iti arthaḥ tasya mudrā rūpam yatas sama pada ādikam tatas badhnīyāt iti na idam sama padasya lakṣaṇam sama padam tu prasiddham eva

original: [3.4.81] samatvena padadvayaṃ samapadam. dakṣiṇāgram ekaṃ caraṇam aparaṃ vāmāgraṃ dhārayed iti samapadam iti kecit. prajñopāyayos tu parasparapādāṅgulīnāṃ samena saṃsparśaḥ samapadam.
analyzed: sama tvena pada dvayam sama padam dakṣiṇa agram ekam caraṇam aparam vāma agram dhārayet iti sama padam iti kecid prajñā upāyayoḥ tu paraspara pāda aṅgulīnām samena saṃsparśaḥ sama padam

original: [3.4.82] tathābhūtāyām evāvasthāyāṃ nāryā ekacaraṇa saṃkocād bhinnapadam.
analyzed: tathābhūtāyām eva avasthāyām nāryāḥ eka caraṇa saṃkocāt bhinna padam

original: [3.4.83] samapadaṃ kṛtvā jānunī samaṃ vistārayed iti maṇḍalapadam.
analyzed: sama padam kṛtvā jānunī samam vistārayet iti maṇḍala padam

original: [3.4.84] samāpattau nāryā ekasya caraṇasyordhvam utthāpanāt trivikramapadam.
analyzed: samāpattau nāryāḥ ekasya caraṇasya ūrdhvam utthāpanāt trivikrama padam

original: [3.4.85] dakṣiṇacaraṇena vāmasyākramaṇāt kūrmapadam.
analyzed: dakṣiṇa caraṇena vāmasya ākramaṇāt kūrmapadam

original: [3.4.86] vāmacaraṇakuñcanād dakṣiṇacaraṇaprasāraṇād ālīḍhapadam.
analyzed: vāma caraṇa kuñcanāt dakṣiṇa caraṇa prasāraṇāt ālīḍha padam

original: [3.4.87] vāmadakṣiṇacaraṇaprasāraṇasaṃkocābhyāṃ pratyālīḍhapadam.
analyzed: vāma dakṣiṇa caraṇa prasāraṇa saṃkocābhyām pratyālīḍha padam

original: [3.4.88] caraṇam ekam utkṣipyānyena sthitvā cakrākāraṃ bhramayed ity ekasthānam. samāpattau citrakaraṇam etat.
analyzed: caraṇam ekam utkṣipya anyena sthitvā cakra ākāram bhramayet iti eka sthānam samāpattau citra karaṇam etat

original: [3.4.89] niṣadyeti lalitākṣepādaya eva niṣadyam. sukhena niṣīdataḥ prajñopāyāv asminn iti niṣadyam.
analyzed: niṣadya iti lalitā kṣepa ādayaḥ eva niṣadyam sukhena niṣīdataḥ prajñā upāyau asmin iti niṣadyam

original: [3.4.90] yatheṣṭaṃ pādavikṣepāt pādavikṣepaḥ.
analyzed: yatheṣṭam pāda vikṣepāt pāda vikṣepaḥ

original: [3.4.91] khedāpanayanārtham adharottarakrameṇa praguṇīkṛtya jaṅghe suptayoḥ prajñopāyayoḥ samāpattir yūpākāreti yūpākāraḥ.
analyzed: kheda apanayana artham adhara uttara krameṇa praguṇīkṛtya jaṅghe suptayoḥ prajñā upāyayoḥ samāpattiḥ yūpa ākāra iti yūpa ākāraḥ

original: [3.4.92] upaviśyaikaṃ jānu saṃkocya grīvādhāraṇapūrvakaṃ pravartanād añcupīḍanam. jānusaṃkoca ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: upaviśya ekam jānu saṃkocya grīvā dhāraṇa pūrvakam pravartanāt añcu pīḍanam jānu saṃkocaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [3.4.93] ekasyoror upari dvitīyam ūrum āropya prajñāyā jaghanayor madhye pravartanān saṃyamīkṛtam. anye tu prajñāyā jaṅghe kakṣayor nikṣipya bāhubhyāṃ saṃveṣṭya grīvāṃ dhṛtvā samāpattiṃ kuryād iti saṃyamīkṛtaṃ vyācakṣate.
analyzed: ekasya ūroḥ upari dvitīyam ūrum āropya prajñāyāḥ jaghanayoḥ madhye saṃyamīkṛtam anye tu prajñāyāḥ jaṅghe kakṣayoḥ nikṣipya bāhubhyām saṃveṣṭya grīvām dhṛtvā samāpattim kuryāt iti saṃyamīkṛtam vyācakṣate

original: [3.4.94] ubhayor apy anatidūram ūrū prasāryopaviśya pravṛtteḥ samasthānam.
analyzed: ubhayoḥ api anatidūram ūrū prasārya upaviśya pravṛttyāḥ sama sthānam

original: [3.4.95] prajñāyā dakṣiṇaṃ caraṇaṃ svahṛdayenākramya pravartanāt kālāgniḥ.
analyzed: prajñāyāḥ dakṣiṇam caraṇam sva hṛdayena ākramya pravartanāt kālāgniḥ

original: [3.4.96] prajñāyā ūrudvayaṃ nijajaṅghayor abhyantarīkṛtya tasyāś caraṇau svahṛdaye samāropya pravṛtter hṛdayasphoṭamudrā hṛdayaśabdenocyate.
analyzed: prajñāyāḥ ūru dvayam nija jaṅghayoḥ abhyantarīkṛtya tasyāḥ caraṇau sva hṛdaye samāropya pravṛtteḥ hṛdaya sphoṭa mudrā hṛdaya śabdena ucyate

original: [3.4.97] prajñāyā ūrvor upary upaviśya pravṛttir nandāsanam ucyate.
analyzed: prajñāyāḥ ūrvoḥ upari upaviśya pravṛttiḥ nandāsanam ucyate

original: [3.4.98] ekaṃ caraṇaṃ saṃkocya pravṛtter ekasaṃyatam.
analyzed: ekam caraṇam saṃkocya pravṛtteḥ eka saṃyatam

original: [3.4.99] eta ākṣepaprakārā aṣṭādaśa samāpattau prayoktavyāḥ. saṃbhave guṇa sarvatra yogīnāṃ tu vilakṣayed iti: eteṣāṃ guṇānāṃ saṃbhavo yasyāṃ, tasyām eva bandhaviśeṣā yojanīyā iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: ete ākṣepa prakārāḥ aṣṭādaśa samāpattau prayoktavyāḥ saṃbhave sarvatra tu vilakṣayet iti eteṣām guṇānām saṃbhavaḥ yasyām tasyām eva bandha viśeṣāḥ yojanīyāḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.100] idānīm abhinayaviśeṣān āha: hṛdītyādi. prajñāṃ bāhubhyāṃ pṛṣṭhe saṃveṣṭya hṛdaye hṛdayena saṃpīḍya pravṛtter hṛdayapīḍanam.
analyzed: idānīm abhinaya viśeṣān āha hṛdi ityādi prajñām bāhubhyām pṛṣṭhe saṃveṣṭya hṛdaye hṛdayena saṃpīḍya pravṛtteḥ hṛdaya pīḍanam

original: [3.4.101] prajñāyāś caraṇau hṛdaye saṃsthāpya pravṛtteḥ pādasaṃlagnam. atha vā prajñāyāḥ padbhyāṃ svapādadvayaṃ saṃyojya pravṛtteḥ pādasaṃlagnam.
analyzed: prajñāyāḥ caraṇau hṛdaye saṃsthāpya pravṛtteḥ pāda saṃlagnam atha vā prajñāyāḥ padbhyām sva pāda dvayam saṃyojya pravṛtteḥ pāda saṃlagnam

original: [3.4.102] sragdāmābhinayapūrvakam āliṅganaṃ sragdāmābhinayaḥ.
analyzed: sragdāma abhinaya pūrvakam āliṅganam sragdāma abhinayaḥ

original: [3.4.103] kucasparśāt kucābhinayaḥ.
analyzed: kuca sparśāt kuca abhinayaḥ

original: [3.4.104] prajñāyāḥ kamalam upāyo leḍhi, upāyasya ca vajraṃ prajñā. tac cādharottarabhāvena draṣṭavyam iti lagnadvaubhakṣaṇasyārthaḥ. lagnadvibhakṣaṇam iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: prajñāyāḥ kamalam upāyaḥ leḍhi upāyasya ca vajram prajñā tat ca adhara uttara bhāvena draṣṭavyam iti lagna dvau bhakṣaṇasya arthaḥ lagna dvi bhakṣaṇam iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.105] ardhenāṅgenāliṅganād ardhāliṅganam.
analyzed: ardhena aṅgena āliṅganāt ardha āliṅganam

original: [3.4.106] anyonyaguhya sparśāt pāṇibhyām iti adho dvau pāṇayaṃ guhyasparśanasyārthaḥ. ardha dvau pāṇayaṃ guhyasparśaneti pāṭhasyāpy ayam evārthaḥ.
analyzed: sparśāt pāṇibhyām iti adhas dvau guhya sparśanasya arthaḥ dvau pāṇayam guhya sparśana iti pāṭhasya api ayam eva arthaḥ

original: [3.4.107] tarjanīmadhyamābhyāṃ cibukasyotthāpanaṃ cibutolanam.
analyzed: tarjanī madhyamābhyām cibukasya utthāpanam cibu tolanam

original: [3.4.108] śarīrasparśād aṅgasparśanam.
analyzed: śarīra sparśāt aṅga sparśanam

original: [3.4.109] śṛṅgāreṇa hasitānanaḥ syād iti śṛṅgāro hasitānanasyārthaḥ. śṛṅgārahasitam abhinaya ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: śṛṅgāreṇa hasita ānanaḥ syāt iti śṛṅgāraḥ hasita ānanasya arthaḥ śṛṅgāra hasitam abhinayaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [3.4.110] na kevalam ete daśābhinayāḥ kāryāḥ, kiṃ tarhi daśanacchedādayo 'pi kāryā iti darśayann āha: vividhā ityādi. vajrādidhāraṇaniyamam upasaṃharann āha: vajretyādi. vajraghaṇṭā mudrā ca yathoktā yoginā yogānuraktena sadā dhartavyāḥ.
analyzed: na kevalam ete daśa abhinayāḥ kāryāḥ kim tarhi daśanaccheda ādayaḥ api kāryāḥ iti darśayan āha vividhāḥ ityādi vajra ādi dhāraṇa niyamam upasaṃharan āha vajra ityādi vajraghaṇṭā mudrā ca yathā uktā yoginā yoga anuraktena sadā dhartavyāḥ

original: [3.4.111] prajñopāyayor anyonyarahitatvena siddhir na syād ity āha: rahitetyādi. vajraguhyam upāyaḥ. ghaṇṭasyeti prajñā. ghaṇṭārahitasyopāyasya phalaṃ kīdṛśam? na kim api phalam iti bhāvaḥ. upāyarahitāyā ghaṇṭāyā api sādhyaṃ dūrata iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: prajñā upāyayoḥ anyonya rahita tvena siddhiḥ na syāt iti āha rahita ityādi vajra guhyam upāyaḥ ghaṇṭasya iti prajñā ghaṇṭā rahitasya upāyasya phalam kīdṛśam na kim api phalam iti bhāvaḥ upāya rahitāyāḥ ghaṇṭāyāḥ api sādhyam dūratas iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.112] vyatirekam uktvānvayam āha: vajraghaṇṭāś ca mudrāś ca m-ālambya pāram uttareti. prajñopāyayor militayor eva siddhir ity arthaḥ. dṛṣṭāntam āha: rajanyetyādi. rajanī candravikalā kīdṛśī jyotsnāvaikalyāt? svārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca kartum aśaktety arthaḥ. candrasya dina kīdṛśam iti:
analyzed: vyatirekam uktvā anvayam āha vajraghaṇṭāḥ ca mudrāḥ ca m ālambya pāram uttarā iti prajñā upāyayoḥ militayoḥ eva siddhiḥ iti arthaḥ dṛṣṭāntam āha rajanyā ityādi rajanī candra vikalā kīdṛśī jyotsnā vaikalyāt sva artham para artham ca kartum aśaktā iti arthaḥ candrasya dina kīdṛśam iti

original: divābhāge candro 'pi rajanīvaikalyāt kīdṛśaḥ syāt? jyotsnārahitatvān na kam api svārthaṃ parārthaṃ vā kartuṃ śakta ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: divābhāge rajanī vaikalyāt kīdṛśaḥ syāt jyotsnā rahita tvāt na kam api sva artham para artham vā kartum śaktaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [3.4.113] dārṣṭāntikam upasaṃharann āha: tata ityādi. yathā rajanīrajanīpatyoḥ samakālabhāvitvaṃ svaparārthakṣamaṃ, tathā vajrasya ghaṇṭāyāś ca samatā samakālabhāvitvaṃ samāpattir iti yāvat. tattvaṃ jyohuye iti: tattvaṃ svarūpaṃ, jyohuye iti jyotsnāyuktaṃ karoti prakāśayatīti bhāvaḥ. svarūpaṃ ca mahāmudrāsiddhir eva. prakāśanaṃ sādhanam.
analyzed: dārṣṭāntikam upasaṃharan āha tatas ityādi yathā rajanī rajanī patyoḥ sama kāla bhāvi tvam sva para artha kṣamam tathā vajrasya ghaṇṭāyāḥ ca samatā sama kāla bhāvi tvam samāpattiḥ iti yāvat tattvam jyohuye iti tattvam sva rūpam iti jyotsnā yuktam karoti prakāśayati iti bhāvaḥ sva rūpam ca mahāmudrā siddhiḥ eva prakāśanam sādhanam

original: kvacit sarva jyotsnayed iti pāṭhaḥ. tatra sarvaṃsādhyam ity arthaḥ. ālīkālītyādi: prajñopāyayogaṃ pura iti prathamaṃ dhyātvā mahāyogena pūrvoktaśūnyatāmantracihnādiniṣpattikrameṇa sādhaketi yogī sarvakarmāṇi sādhayed iti saṃbandhaḥ.
analyzed: kvacid jyotsnayet iti pāṭhaḥ tatra sarvaṃsādhyam iti arthaḥ ālīkālī ityādi prajñā upāya yogam puras iti prathamam dhyātvā mahā yogena pūrva ukta śūnyatā mantra cihna ādi niṣpatti krameṇa sādhaka iti yogī sarva karmāṇi sādhayet iti saṃbandhaḥ

original: [3.4.114] ālikālyor artham āha: ālītyādi subodham.
analyzed: āli kālyoḥ artham āha āli ityādi su bodham

original: [3.4.115] sattvārthaṃ sakalaṃ ca prajñopāyayogena devatārūpeṇa sādhayed ity āha: sattvārthetyādi. prajñopāyayogena nirvāṇam apīty āha: prajñā-mupāyabāhyānām ityādi. prajñopāyabahirbhūtānāṃ kuta upāyāt saṃsārottaraṇam? enaṃ prajñopāyasvarūpasyopāyaṃ vihāya saṃsārottāropāyo nānyo 'stīti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: sattva artham sakalam ca prajñā upāya yogena devatā rūpeṇa sādhayet iti āha sattva artha ityādi prajñā upāya yogena nirvāṇam api iti āha prajñām upāya bāhyānām ityādi prajñā upāya bahirbhūtānām kutas upāyāt saṃsāra uttaraṇam enam prajñā upāya svarūpasya upāyam vihāya saṃsāra uttāra upāyaḥ na anyaḥ sti iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.116] samayasya devatādirūpasya yatheṣṭam akathyatvam āha: mūrkhā bāhyādicetasya tasya samaya darśitam. mūrkhasya bahirartharaktasya ca samaya darśitam iti samayo na kathyaḥ. samayo darśitaḥ kim? na darśita iti śiraścālena gamyate. guhyetyādi subodham.
analyzed: samayasya devatā ādi rūpasya yatheṣṭam a kathya tvam āha mūrkhāḥ bāhya ādi cetasya tasya samaya darśitam mūrkhasya bahis artha raktasya ca samaya darśitam iti samayaḥ na kathyaḥ samayaḥ darśitaḥ kim na darśitaḥ iti śiraḥ cālena gamyate guhya ityādi su bodham

original: [3.4.117] yato āgametyādi: yaḥ khalv āgamaṃ jñātum icchati, tato yogī sa eva yogīty arthaḥ. śuddhasphaṭikacittasya tasya dharmān deśayed iti: śuddhasphaṭikanirmalaṃ yasya cittaṃ, tasmai dharmaṃ deśayed ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: yatas āgama ityādi yaḥ khalu āgamam jñātum icchati tatas yogī saḥ eva yogī iti arthaḥ śuddha sphaṭika cittasya tasya dharmān deśayet iti śuddha sphaṭika nirmalam yasya cittam tasmai dharmam deśayet iti arthaḥ

original: [3.4.118] kuta evam ity āha: yadītyādi. yadi mano vicikitsā kim idam uta neti saṃśayaḥ, maṇavicikitsāyaśabdasyārthaḥ. yadi guror bhagavato 'pi vacane saṃśayo yasya syāt, tadā so 'vīcyādau patatīti gurvāgamavacanapratikṣepāt. tataḥ śuddhasphaṭikacittatvena śraddhāprajñāvatām evāsya dharmasya śravaṇādhikāra iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: kutas evam iti āha yadi ityādi yadi manaḥ vicikitsā kim idam uta na iti saṃśayaḥ yadi guroḥ vacane saṃśayaḥ yasya syāt tadā saḥ vīci ādau patati iti guru āgama vacana pratikṣepāt tatas śuddha sphaṭika citta tvena śraddhā prajñāvatām eva asya dharmasya śravaṇa adhikāraḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: kāmādisaktāya na deśyo dharma ity āha: na tv ityādi.
analyzed: kāma ādi saktāya na deśyaḥ dharmaḥ iti āha na tu ityādi

original: [3.4.119] tattvam ālambya: tattvaṃ nairātmyaśūnyatāṅgam iti yāvat. yaḥ pāramitānayaṃ jñātvā sattvārthaṃ kartum icchati, tasmai tantram idaṃ deśyam iti bhāvaḥ. yogino viṣayopabhogam āha: yadītyādi. yadi kāmarato yogī kāmopabhogam icchati, tadā tasyaika evopāya ity upāyam ekalakṣaṇam ity asyārthaḥ.
analyzed: tattvam ālambya tattvam nairātmya śūnyatā aṅgam iti yāvat yaḥ pāramitā nayam jñātvā sattva artham kartum icchati tasmai tantram idam deśyam iti bhāvaḥ yoginaḥ viṣaya upabhogam āha yadi ityādi yadi kāma rataḥ yogī kāma upabhogam icchati tadā tasya ekaḥ eva upāyaḥ iti upāyam eka lakṣaṇam iti asya arthaḥ

original: [3.4.120] upāyam evāha: saṃbhava ityādi. svacchair iti: viṣayāḥ. kṣanikair ity avasaraprāptāḥ. strīviṣayā iti viśeṣeṇa draṣṭavyam. viṣayāṇāṃ saṃbhave sati lābhe siddhe kāmam upabhujyate yadi, tadā ghaṇṭāvajrādiyogata iti
analyzed: upāyam eva āha saṃbhavaḥ ityādi svacchaiḥ iti viṣayāḥ kṣanikaiḥ iti avasara prāptāḥ strī viṣayāḥ iti viśeṣeṇa draṣṭavyam viṣayāṇām saṃbhave sati lābhe siddhe kāmam upabhujyate yadi tadā ghaṇṭā vajra ādi yogataḥ iti

original: vajrapadmayogenopabhuñjīteti bhāvaḥ. vajrapadmayoga eva kathaṃ sādhyata ity āha: jhaṭitākāretyādi. jhaṭitiniṣpanno vajradharo 'ham ity ahaṃkāram āropayet.
analyzed: vajra padma yogena upabhuñjīta iti bhāvaḥ vajra padma yogaḥ eva katham sādhyate iti āha jhaṭita ākāra ityādi jhaṭiti niṣpannaḥ vajradharaḥ ham iti ahaṃkāram āropayet

original: [3.4.121] antardhetyādinā khagamukhāyāṃ aṃkāro dhyātavya iti smāritam. ātmakṣaṇika yogānāṃ hūṃkṛtam iti: kṣaṇikaṃ kuliśam. ātmanaḥ kuliśe hūṃkāraṃ yuñjītety arthaḥ. jāpya tatparam iti: ubhayor japaḥ smāritaḥ.
analyzed: antardhā ityādinā khaga mukhāyām aṃkāraḥ dhyātavyaḥ iti smāritam ātma kṣaṇika yogānām hūṃkṛtam iti kṣaṇikam kuliśam ātmanaḥ kuliśe hūṃkāram yuñjīta iti arthaḥ jāpya tatparam iti ubhayoḥ japaḥ smāritaḥ

original: [3.4.122] etat sarvaṃ prajñopāyādikam upasaṃhāre darśitam. bhāvanālakṣaṇaś cetovyāpāraḥ. tatra kāyavācor vyāpāro līyata iti darśayann āha: yadītyādi. yaḥ kaścit kāyavācor vyāpāraḥ, sa devatāyoge layaṃ gacchati. bhāvaś cāyam: yaḥ sādaranirantaraṃ dīrghakālaṃ ca devatāyogī, sa kiṃ stavādipāṭhacaityavandanādikaṃ kuryād iti.
analyzed: etat sarvam prajñā upāya ādikam upasaṃhāre darśitam bhāvanā lakṣaṇaḥ cetaḥ vyāpāraḥ tatra kāya vācoḥ vyāpāraḥ līyate iti darśayan āha yadi ityādi yaḥ kaścid kāya vācoḥ vyāpāraḥ sa devatā yoge layam gacchati bhāvaḥ ca ayam yaḥ sādara nirantaram dīrgha kālam ca devatā yogī sa kim stava ādi pāṭha caitya vandana ādikam kuryāt iti

original: deśanāmāhātmyam upadarśayann āha: añjalyetyādi. sarvāsu dikṣu sthitā ye yogā yogino vajrapāṇiprabhṛtayaḥ, yogīśvarīti yoginyo ḍākinyaḥ, śrutaṃ śrutvā dharmatām iti śeṣaḥ, añjaliṃ kurvanto ...
analyzed: deśanā māhātmyam upadarśayan āha añjali ityādi sarvāsu dikṣu sthitāḥ ye yogāḥ yoginaḥ vajrapāṇi prabhṛtayaḥ yogīśvarī iti yoginyaḥ ḍākinyaḥ śrutam śrutvā dharmatām iti śeṣaḥ añjalim kurvantaḥ

original: [3.4.123] ... bhagavantaṃ prītiprahlādayuktahṛdayāḥ stuvantīti draṣṭavyam. stavam āha: adyetyādi. yo 'yam upāyo bhagavatā deśitas, tenādyetīhaiva janmani mokṣaṃ vrajej, jagad iti jātyādiniyamābhāvaṃ darśayati. aho vismaye. dharma paraṃ mārga iti:
analyzed: bhagavantam prīti prahlāda yukta hṛdayāḥ stuvanti iti draṣṭavyam stavam āha adya ityādi yaḥ yam upāyaḥ bhagavatā deśitaḥ tena adya iti iha eva janmani mokṣam vrajet jagat iti jāti ādi niyama abhāvam darśayati aho vismaye dharma param mārgaḥ iti

original: yato 'yaṃ mārgaḥ paraḥ śreṣṭho dharmaś ca, dharmaḥ prakṛtiśūnyatety arthaḥ, tadrūpatvād dharmo 'yaṃ mārgas, tato vismayaḥ. kuta evaṃbhūta ity āha: aho saṃsāracchedaketi. niyamena saṃsāracchedakatvād iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: yatas yam mārgaḥ paraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ dharmaḥ ca dharmaḥ prakṛti śūnyatā iti arthaḥ tad rūpa tvāt dharmaḥ yam mārgaḥ tatas vismayaḥ kutas evaṃbhūtaḥ iti āha aho saṃsāra chedaka iti niyamena saṃsāra chedaka tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.124] aho muktipadam iti: kutaḥ saṃsāracchedakaḥ? yato mukteḥ padam upāya iti. tato yogināṃ buddhānām api yogeti yuñjīta. vismayeti vismayam. mārgaḥ karttā(?). mārgasya sulabhatvam āha: na tithir ityādi. śeṣaṃ subodham.
analyzed: aho mukti padam iti kutas saṃsāra chedakaḥ yatas mukteḥ padam upāyaḥ iti tatas yoginām buddhānām api yoga iti yuñjīta vismaya iti vismayam mārgaḥ karttā mārgasya sulabha tvam āha na tithiḥ ityādi śeṣam su bodham

original: [3.4.125] karmaprasaram āha: karmacakravidhānaṃ tv ityādi. sādhakānāṃ vividhamatavaśāt karmacakravidhānaṃ vakṣyate. karmacakraṃ karmaprasaraḥ. candretyādi. evaṃviśiṣṭāṃ vettālīṃ vibhāvya ...
analyzed: karma prasaram āha karma cakra vidhānam tu ityādi sādhakānām vividha mata vaśāt karma cakra vidhānam vakṣyate karma cakram karma prasaraḥ candra ityādi evaṃviśiṣṭām vettālīm vibhāvya

original: [3.4.126] ... japel lakṣatriketi: lakṣatrayam.
analyzed: japet lakṣatrikā iti lakṣa trayam

original: [3.4.127] mantram āha: dviguṇākṣaretyādi subodham. yady api kṣuṃkāro ghorībījaṃ, tathāpi vettālyāḥ praṇavādiyuto mantro 'yam. tattva karma sādhyetīti: karmatattvaṃ prasādhayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: mantram āha dviguṇa akṣara ityādi su bodham yadi api kṣuṃkāraḥ ghorī bījam tathā api vettālyāḥ praṇava ādi yutaḥ mantraḥ yam karma sādhya iti iti karma tattvam prasādhayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [3.4.128] pretavastretyādi: śavavastre subhaṭavastre prasūtavastre vā siṃghinīṃ citrayet. dvibhujam ityādi subodham.
analyzed: preta vastra ityādi śava vastre su bhaṭa vastre prasūta vastre vā siṃghinīm citrayet dvi bhujam ityādi su bodham

original: [3.4.129–132] pṛthvīmadhyādīti: śmaśānamadhye. pūrvokto 'daityābalis taṃ dattvā karma kuryāt.
analyzed: pṛthvī madhya ādi iti śmaśāna madhye pūrva uktaḥ daityābaliḥ tam dattvā karma kuryāt

original: [3.4.133] śmaśāne pretāgniṃ prajvālya caṇḍālāgniṃ vā, homaṃ kuryād iti śeṣaḥ. samidhāna devadāruṇām iti: devadārusamidhaḥ. pañca kṣīrādīti: aśvatthādikṣīravṛkṣajāḥ pañca samidhaḥ.
analyzed: śmaśāne preta agnim prajvālya caṇḍāla agnim vā homam kuryāt iti śeṣaḥ samidhāna devadāruṇām iti devadāru samidhaḥ pañca kṣīra ādi iti aśvattha ādi kṣīravṛkṣa jāḥ pañca samidhaḥ

original: [3.4.134] udārāṃ pūjāṃ baliṃ ca kṛtvā yathoktamāṃsenāhutiṃ dadyāt. rudhiramadhum āloḍyeti: madhu mahātailam. rudhiramadhubhyāṃ mrakṣayitvā nṛmāṃsam aṣṭaśatasaṃkhyaṃ juhuyāt.
analyzed: udārām pūjām balim ca kṛtvā yathā ukta māṃsena āhutim dadyāt rudhira madhum āloḍya iti madhu mahātailam rudhira madhubhyām mrakṣayitvā nṛ māṃsam aṣṭaśata saṃkhyam juhuyāt

original: [3.4.135] oṃ ityādi ...
analyzed: om ityādi

original: [3.4.136] ... homamantraḥ.
analyzed: homa mantraḥ

original: [3.4.137] sarve yuktādi pūrvavad iti: pūrvakrameṇa hotavyam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: sarve yukta ādi pūrvavat iti pūrva krameṇa hotavyam iti arthaḥ

original: [3.4.138] nimittam āha: prathamam ityādi.
analyzed: nimittam āha prathamam ityādi

original: [3.4.139] pañcamena sahāyasya m-āveśa siṃgha-m-ākṛtim iti: uttarasādhake siṃghākṛtir dṛśyate. sa siṃghīva dṛśyata ity arthaḥ. siṃghyā āveśāt.
analyzed: pañcamena sahāyasya siṃgham ākṛtim iti uttarasādhake siṃgha ākṛtiḥ dṛśyate sa siṃghī iva dṛśyate iti arthaḥ siṃghyāḥ āveśāt

original: [3.4.140] pratīccha yathāsthāne āsanaṃ kuru m-ātmanam iti: svasthāna āsanaṃ karotu bhagavatīty ukte sāsaneniṣaṇṇā syād iti tasyārthaḥ.
analyzed: pratīccha yathāsthāne āsanam kuru mā ātmanam iti sva sthāne āsanam karotu bhagavatī iti ukte sā āsaneniṣaṇṇā syāt iti tasya arthaḥ

original: [3.4.141–142] uttarasādhakaṃ hitvā darśanaṃ kuru devīty ukte tataḥ sā bhagavatī vatsa kiṃ mayā kartavyam iti vadati. kimarthaṃ sādhitāsmīti yāvat. śeṣaṃ subodham.
analyzed: uttarasādhakam hitvā darśanam kuru devi iti ukte tatas sā bhagavatī vatsa kim mayā kartavyam iti vadati kimartham sādhitā asmi iti yāvat śeṣam su bodham

original: [3.4.143] oṃ ityādi mantraṃ paṭhitvā ...
analyzed: om ityādi mantram paṭhitvā

original: [3.4.144] ... śirasi hastaṃ dadyāt.
analyzed: śirasi hastam dadyāt

original: [3.4.145] pretayāneneti: vāmāvartena. śeṣaṃ subodham.
analyzed: preta yānena iti vāma āvartena śeṣam su bodham

original: [3.4.146–149] vyāghrīśivyulūkīnāṃ tu tasya karmeṇa sādhayed iti: siṃghīvad vyāghryādīnāṃ sādhanam iti bhāvaḥ. kiṃ tu vyāghryā oṃ hmyruṃ svāheti mantraḥ. śivīti jambukī. tasyā oṃ ymyruṃ svāheti mantraḥ. ulūkyā oṃ kṣmryuṃ svāheti mantraḥ.
analyzed: vyāghrī śivī ulūkīnām tu tasya karmeṇa sādhayet iti siṃghī vat vyāghrī ādīnām sādhanam iti bhāvaḥ kim tu vyāghryāḥ om hmyrum svāhā iti mantraḥ śivī iti jambukī tasyāḥ om svāhā iti mantraḥ ulūkyāḥ om svāhā iti mantraḥ

original: [3.4.150] sarvatra prajñopāyayogena siddhir iti darśayann āha: vajraghaṇṭāś cetyādi subodham.
analyzed: sarvatra prajñā upāya yogena siddhiḥ iti darśayan āha vajraghaṇṭāḥ ca ityādi su bodham

original: [3.4.col.] ity uktakrameṇa prajñopāyādvayayogaprākārādiviśuddhiprajñopāyadevatārūpaniṣpādanakhagamukhācālanabandhaviśeṣagānabhāvanānuśaṃsāvaśīkaraṇabhaiṣajyakarmaprasarasiṃghyādisādhanāni prakriyante yasmin paṭale sa itiprakaraṇaḥ, sa ca caturthaḥ. tatra yogapīṭhaṃ samāptam. iti catuṣpīṭhanibandhe yogapīṭhaṃ samāptam.
analyzed: iti ukta krameṇa iti ukta krameṇa prajñopāya advaya yoga prākāra ādi viśuddhi prajñopāya devatā rūpa niṣpādana khaga mukha ācālana bandha viśeṣa gāna bhāvanā anuśaṃsā vaśīkaraṇa bhaiṣajya karma prasara siṃghī ādi sādhanāni prakriyante yasmin paṭale saḥ iti prakaraṇaḥ sa ca caturthaḥ tatra yogapīṭham samāptam iti catuṣpīṭha nibandhe yogapīṭham samāptam

original: [4.1.1] idānīṃ guhyapīṭham āha: śṛṇu vajretyādi. vajreti vajrapāṇe, saṃsārottāralakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇv iti sambandhaḥ. saṃsārād uttaraty aneneti saṃsārottāro gurus, tasya lakṣaṇaṃ svarūpam. tat kathaṃ śrotavyam ity āha: yathāmārgam iti. mṛgyate 'neneti mārgaḥ śāstram. tasyānatikramo yathāmārgaḥ. yathāmārgam iti yathāmārgeṇety arthaḥ.
analyzed: idānīm guhyapīṭham āha śṛṇu vajra ityādi vajra iti vajrapāṇe saṃsāra uttāra lakṣaṇam śṛṇu iti sambandhaḥ saṃsārāt uttarati anena iti saṃsāra uttāraḥ guruḥ tasya lakṣaṇam svarūpam tat katham śrotavyam iti āha yathāmārgam iti mṛgyate nena iti mārgaḥ śāstram tasya anatikramaḥ yathāmārgaḥ yathāmārgam iti yathāmārgeṇa iti arthaḥ

original: vajrapāṇer vacanam āha: ācāryaṃ ca grahīṣyāmīti. siddhyupāyaśikṣaṇārthaṃ grahīṣyāmi jñāsyāmīty arthaḥ. kīdṛśaṃ tam ity āha: mantramudrādiyogavid iti. mantreti śāntikādimantrāḥ. yogeti samādhiḥ. ādiśabdān maṇḍalādikam. mudreti kāyādimudrā. kāyamudrā karamudrā. vāṅmudrā vacasā yā kriyate, vākchommakam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: vajrapāṇeḥ vacanam āha ācāryam ca grahīṣyāmi iti siddhi upāya śikṣaṇa artham grahīṣyāmi jñāsyāmi iti arthaḥ kīdṛśam tam iti āha mantra mudrā ādi yoga vid iti mantra iti śāntika ādi mantrāḥ yoga iti samādhiḥ ādi śabdāt maṇḍala ādikam mudrā iti kāya ādi mudrā kāya mudrā kara mudrā vāc mudrā vacasā yā kriyate iti arthaḥ

original: cittamudrā bhāvanayā yā dṛśyate varṇabhujādisaṃsthānaviśeṣaḥ. kāyādimudraivaṃ yadā bhāvyate, tadā cittagatatvāc cittamudrā. mantrādivijña ācāryaḥ syāt, tasya lakṣaṇam idānīṃ śrotum icchāmīti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: citta mudrā bhāvanayā yā dṛśyate varṇa bhuja ādi saṃsthāna viśeṣaḥ kāya ādi mudrā evam yadā bhāvyate tadā citta gata tvāt citta mudrā mantra ādi vijñaḥ ācāryaḥ syāt tasya lakṣaṇam idānīm śrotum icchāmi iti bhāvaḥ

original: [4.1.2] bhagavan kena draṣṭavyeti: kīdṛśa ācāryo draṣṭavya iti bhāvaḥ. guṇa kīdṛśam iti: tasya guṇāḥ kīdṛśā ity arthaḥ. katham ācārya yoktavyam iti: ācāryakaṃ kathaṃ yoktavyam iti bhāvaḥ. gurusaṃjñeti kīdṛśam iti: tasya gurusaṃjñā kīdṛśīti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: bhagavan kena draṣṭavyā iti kīdṛśaḥ ācāryaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ guṇa kīdṛśam iti tasya guṇāḥ kīdṛśāḥ iti arthaḥ katham ācārya yoktavyam iti ācāryakam katham yoktavyam iti bhāvaḥ guru saṃjñā iti kīdṛśam iti tasya guru saṃjñā kīdṛśā iti bhāvaḥ

original: [4.1.3] tattvaṃ sarvasaṃbodhi lakṣaṇam iti. tattvaṃ śṛṇv iti saṃbandhaḥ. tac cācāryasya prakṛtatvāt. sarvasaṃbodhi lakṣaṇam iti: lakṣyate 'neneti lakṣaṇaṃ saṃjñā. tasyācāryasya yan nāma, tat sarvāḥ sarvajñatāmārgajñatāsarvākārajñatālakṣaṇāḥ saṃbodhayaḥ. nāma cābhiṣekanāma. sarvāḥ saṃbodhaya eva tasya nāmeti bhāvaḥ. sarvabuddhasya kāyasyeti:
analyzed: tattvam sarva saṃbodhi lakṣaṇam iti tattvam śṛṇu iti saṃbandhaḥ tat ca ācāryasya prakṛta tvāt sarva saṃbodhi lakṣaṇam iti lakṣyate nena iti lakṣaṇam saṃjñā tasya ācāryasya yat nāma tat sarvāḥ sarvajña tā mārga jña tā sarva ākāra jña tā lakṣaṇāḥ saṃbodhayaḥ nāma ca abhiṣeka nāma sarvāḥ saṃbodhayaḥ eva tasya nāma iti bhāvaḥ sarva buddhasya kāyasya iti

original: ācāryasya yaḥ kāyaḥ, sa sarvabuddhamayaḥ. sarvabuddho mahāvajradharaḥ. bodhyaṅgāvayavasthitam iti: sapta bodhyaṅgāni tasyāvayavā ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: ācāryasya yaḥ kāyaḥ sa sarva buddha mayaḥ sarva buddhaḥ mahā vajra dharaḥ bodhyaṅga avayava sthitam iti sapta bodhyaṅgāni tasya avayavāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: [4.1.4] arhantas tasya romāṇīti: arhanto buddhā lakṣakoṭyādisaṃkhyās, te tasya romāṇi. kuletyādi: trīṇi kulāni pañca ṣaḍ vā tasya makuṭam. laukikā laukikyo devatā brahmādayaḥ pādapīṭhasyeti pādau. raśmi yakṣādiguhyakam iti: guhyakam iti gandharvāḥ. tasya kāyaraśmayo yakṣabhūtagandharvāḥ.
analyzed: arhantaḥ tasya romāṇi iti arhantaḥ buddhāḥ lakṣa koṭi ādi saṃkhyāḥ te tasya romāṇi kula ityādi trīṇi kulāni pañca ṣaḍ vā tasya makuṭam laukikāḥ laukikyaḥ devatāḥ brahma ādayaḥ pāda pīṭhasya iti pādau raśmi yakṣa ādi guhyakam iti guhyakam iti gandharvāḥ tasya kāya raśmayaḥ yakṣa bhūta gandharvāḥ

original: [4.1.5] evam ityādi: uktaguṇo deho yoginām ācāryāṇām. guṇa kīdṛśam iti (2b) praśnaṃ visṛjann āha: yasyetyādi. ko 'sāv ācārya evaṃguṇamaya ity āha: yasya lakṣaṇayoktavyam iti. yasya jñānina ācāryasya lakṣaṇayogo jñeyalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇarūpaḥ, tasyaivaṃguṇamayo deha iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ.
analyzed: evam ityādi ukta guṇaḥ dehaḥ yoginām ācāryāṇām guṇa kīdṛśam iti praśnam visṛjan āha yasya ityādi kaḥ saḥ ācāryaḥ evaṃguṇa mayaḥ iti āha yasya lakṣaṇayā uktavyam iti yasya jñāninaḥ ācāryasya lakṣaṇa yogaḥ jñeya lakṣaṇam vakṣyamāṇa rūpaḥ tasya evaṃguṇa mayaḥ dehaḥ iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ

original: [4.1.6] lakṣaṇam āha: vinītetyādi. vinīto jitendriyaḥ. śāntaveśo laukikaveśaparihārāt. mantratantraprayogajñeti: mantraḥ śāntikādimantras, tantraṃ śāntikādicakraṃ, tayoḥ prayogo japalikhanādilakṣaṇas, tajjña ācāryaḥ. yogaśilpakalādiveti: yogo vāyavyādiyogaḥ, śilpaṃ citrakarmādi, kalā vaidyaśāstrādi, ādiśabdāc chabdaśāstrādikam.
analyzed: lakṣaṇam āha vinīta ityādi vinītaḥ jita indriyaḥ śānta veśaḥ laukika veśa parihārāt mantra tantra prayoga jña iti mantraḥ śāntika ādi mantraḥ tantram śāntika ādi cakram tayoḥ prayogaḥ japa likhana ādi lakṣaṇaḥ tad jñaḥ ācāryaḥ yoga śilpa kalā divā iti yogaḥ vāyavya ādi yogaḥ śilpam citrakarma ādi kalā vaidya śāstra ādi ādi śabdāt śabda śāstra ādikam

original: yogādikaṃ vāti jānātīti yoga śilpa kalādi veti nirvibhaktikam.
analyzed: yoga ādikam vāti jānāti iti yoga śilpa kalā ādi vā iti nirvibhaktikam

original: [4.1.7] mādhuryam ityādi: priyavāk sattveṣv ity arthaḥ. sarvasattvaikaputravad iti: maitrīyukta ity arthaḥ. dānetyādi: dānaśīlakṣāntyādiyukta ity arthaḥ. yogaḥ prajñopāyayogaḥ. dhyānaṃ devatābhāvanā.
analyzed: mādhuryam ityādi priya vāc sattveṣu iti arthaḥ sarva sattva eka putra vat iti maitrī yuktaḥ iti arthaḥ dāna ityādi dāna śīla kṣānti ādi yuktaḥ iti arthaḥ yogaḥ prajñā upāya yogaḥ dhyānam devatā bhāvanā

original: [4.1.8] samatetyādi: śatrumitrodāsīnābhedena samatayā sattveṣu nāthabhūtaḥ. daśatattvetyādi:
analyzed: samatā ityādi śatru mitra udāsīna abhedena samatayā sattveṣu nātha bhūtaḥ daśa tattva ityādi

original: maṇḍalaṃ svasamādhiś ca mudrā karaṇam āsanam |
analyzed: maṇḍalam sva samādhiḥ ca mudrā karaṇam āsanam

original: japahomau tathā pūjā karmayogopasaṃhṛtī ||
analyzed: japa homau tathā pūjā karma yoga upasaṃhṛtī

original: iti daśatattvaparijñātā. ete vinayādayaḥ śreyo'rthibhir guṇyante, abhyasyanta iti guṇāḥ. ebhir yogād ācāryakaṃ syād, gurusaṃjñā ca, yathoktaguṇācaraṇāt. yad āha:
analyzed: iti daśa tattva parijñātāḥ ete vinaya ādayaḥ śreyaḥ ṛthibhiḥ guṇyante abhyasyante iti guṇāḥ ebhiḥ yogāt ācāryakam syāt guru saṃjñā ca yathā ukta guṇa ācaraṇāt yat āha

analyzed: guruḥ ācārya śabdena paṇḍitaiḥ parigadyate

original: iti.
analyzed: iti

original: [4.1.9] aparair ityādinā śiṣyakarmāha. aparam anyat. tac ca śiṣyāṇāṃ karma. śṛṇv iti saṃbandhaḥ. nindām ācāryaguhyānām iti: ācārya eva guhyo mahāvajradharas, tasya nindāṃ nindako 'vīcau patatīti saṃbandhaḥ. āha ca:
analyzed: aparaiḥ ityādinā śiṣya karma āha aparam anyat tat ca śiṣyāṇām karma śṛṇu iti saṃbandhaḥ nindām ācārya guhyānām iti ācāryaḥ eva guhyaḥ mahā vajradharaḥ tasya nindām nindakaḥ vīcau patati iti saṃbandhaḥ āha ca

original: bodhicittavajraś cācāryaś cādvayam advaidhīkāram
analyzed: bodhi citta vajraḥ ca ācāryaḥ ca advayam a dvaidhīkāram

original: iti. anyac ca:
analyzed: iti anyat ca

original: nānātvaṃ naiva kurvīta guror Vajradharasya ca |
analyzed: nānātvam nā eva kurvīta guroḥ Vajradharasya ca

original: iti. punaḥ kīdṛśasyety āha: yoginītyādi. yoginyo jñānaḍākinyādayaḥ. yogadevateti: prajñopāyasamāpannā devatāḥ. etatsvarūpasyācāryasyeti bhāvaḥ.

original: [4.1.10] samayācāradevasyeti: pañcāṅkuśapañcāmṛtalakṣaṇaḥ samayaḥ. tadācāreṇa dīvyatīti krīḍatīti samayācāradeva ācāryaḥ. baliguhyādiyaugiketi: balihomāditattve yuktasya nindakaḥ. kadā patatīty āha: śīghram iti. ihaiva janmani maraṇasamanantaram iti bhāvaḥ.

original: [4.2.12] kathaṃ kathayed ity āha: pratijñetyādi. jñānaṃ kīdṛśam iti saṃbandhaḥ. kiṃbhūtam ity āha: pratijñeti. prati prati jānātīti pratijñam. keṣām ity āha: bhāveti. bhāvānāṃ padārthānām ity arthaḥ. tad eva na jānātīty ajñānaṃ, tattvato 'grāhakam. kasyety āha: bhāvasyeti. bhāvasya padārthasya cittāntarasya vā.
analyzed: katham kathayet iti āha pratijñā ityādi jñānam kīdṛśam iti saṃbandhaḥ kiṃbhūtam iti āha pratijñā iti prati prati jānāti iti pratijñam keṣām iti āha bhāva iti bhāvānām padārthānām iti arthaḥ tat eva na jānāti iti ajñānam tattvataḥ grāhakam kasya iti āha bhāvasya iti bhāvasya padārthasya citta antarasya vā

original: evaṃbhūtasya vijñānasya svaṃ rūpaṃ kim anyad iti bhāvaḥ. śrotu saṃdeha bhāvasyeti: saṃdehāc chrotuṃ bhāvo 'bhiprāyo me vartata iti bhāvaḥ. vijñānaṃ jñānalakṣaṇam iti: viṣayaṃ jānātīti vijñānam iti pratijñety asya nirdeśaḥ. jñānalakṣaṇam iti: jñāyata iti jñānam avabodhas tallakṣaṇam. yena vijñā bhave bhāva iti pāṭhāntaram.
analyzed: evaṃbhūtasya vijñānasya svam rūpam kim anyat iti bhāvaḥ śrotu saṃdeha bhāvasya iti saṃdehāt śrotum bhāvaḥ bhiprāyaḥ me vartate iti bhāvaḥ vijñānam jñāna lakṣaṇam iti viṣayam jānāti iti vijñānam iti pratijñā iti asya nirdeśaḥ jñāna lakṣaṇam iti jñāyate iti jñānam avabodhaḥ tad lakṣaṇam yena vijñā bhave bhāvaḥ iti pāṭha antaram

original: [4.2.13] pratijñetyādy (12a) adhyeṣaṇāvākyam. praśnavisarjanam āha: sphaṭiketyādi. sphaṭikavan nirmalatvād ākāraḥ svarūpam asyeti tat sphaṭikākāram. kiṃ tad ity āha: cetasyeti. cittaṃ vijñānam. tad bhavadoṣeṇa rañjayed iti saṃbandhaḥ. viṣayaṃ prāpya bhavantīti bhavāḥ kleśāḥ. ta eva doṣā dūṣayanti vikurvantīti kṛtvā bhavadoṣāḥ.
analyzed: pratijñā ityādi adhyeṣaṇā vākyam praśna visarjanam āha sphaṭika ityādi sphaṭika vat nirmala tvāt ākāraḥ svarūpam asya iti tat sphaṭika ākāram kim tat iti āha cetasya iti cittam vijñānam tat bhava doṣeṇa rañjayet iti saṃbandhaḥ viṣayam prāpya bhavanti iti bhavāḥ kleśāḥ te eva doṣāḥ dūṣayanti vikurvanti iti kṛtvā bhava doṣāḥ

analyzed: sphaṭika vat nirmalam cittam rañjayanti vikurvanti nānātvam nayanti malinayanti iti yāvat kutas evam iti āha saṃparka viṣayāṇām tu iti rūpa ādīnām saṃyogāt cittam rūpa ādi vijñāna rūpeṇa kleśa vaśāt bhāti iti bhāvaḥ nija doṣaḥ eva katham na asya iti āha guṇa doṣāḥ na hi cetasā iti guṇāḥ doṣāḥ vā na hi cetasi saṃbhavanti iti bhāvaḥ

original: iti. guṇadoṣaparihārāvasthitasya ca cittasya yad rūpaṃ, tad gurucaraṇārādhanagamyam. yathāsthānaṃ tu yoktavyam iti: rūpādiṣu ṣaṭsu viṣayeṣu cakṣurādibhir indriyaiḥ ṣaḍbhir yathākramaṃ cakṣurādivijñānāni ṣaḍ bhavantīti yathāsthānayogaḥ. etenāṣṭādaśa dhātavo 'tra kathitāḥ. pīḍayec chiṣyaputravad iti:

original: viṣayebhya indriyeṣv anavagrahaṇanivāriteṣv indriyajñānāny api nivāritāni syuḥ. etad eva pīḍanam. kiṃvat pīḍayed ity āha: śiṣyaputravad iti. guruḥ śiṣyam avinayamārgān nivārayaṃs tajjñānalakṣaṇam arthaṃ sādhayet, tathā yogī viṣayagrāmād anavagṛhnann indriyagrāmaṃ tajjñānaṃ ca nivārayan svasaṃvedyaṃ jñānam āsādayatīti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: viṣayebhyaḥ indriyeṣu anavagrahaṇa nivāriteṣu indriya jñānāni api nivāritāni syuḥ etat eva pīḍanam kiṃvat pīḍayet iti āha śiṣya putra vat iti guruḥ śiṣyam avinaya mārgāt nivārayan tad jñāna lakṣaṇam artham sādhayet tathā yogī viṣaya grāmāt an avagṛhnan indriya grāmam tad jñānam ca nivārayan sva saṃvedyam jñānam āsādayati iti bhāvaḥ

original: atha vā vajramaṇimadhye bodhicittaṃ saṃyojya pīḍayed vārayet. yathā śiṣyaputraṃ pīḍayed eva, tathā maṇimadhye bodhicittaṃ pīḍayed eva.
analyzed: atha vā vajra maṇi madhye bodhi cittam saṃyojya pīḍayet vārayet yathā śiṣya putram pīḍayet eva tathā maṇi madhye bodhi cittam pīḍayet eva

original: [4.2.15] tasmin sati kiṃ syād ity āha: tasyetyādi. tatra pīḍane sati vijñānaṃ jñātavyam avaboddhavyam. kutra jñātavyam ity āha: madhye tv iti. rāgavirāgayor madhye. na rāgo na virāgo 'tra jñāne sta iti bhāvaḥ. atha vā: maraṇād ūrdhvaṃ nāstīty ucchedāntaḥ. nirhetukān nitya iti śāśvatāntaḥ.
analyzed: tasmin sati kim syāt iti āha tasya ityādi tatra pīḍane sati vijñānam jñātavyam avaboddhavyam kutra jñātavyam iti āha madhye tu iti rāga virāgayoḥ madhye na rāgaḥ na virāgaḥ jñāne staḥ iti bhāvaḥ atha vā maraṇāt ūrdhvam na asti iti uccheda antaḥ nirhetukāt nityaḥ iti śāśvata antaḥ

original: tayor madhye nocchede na śāśvatabhāve 'vasthitaṃ, tadubhayāvikalpakatvāt. kim ivety āha: vijñānaṃ kham iva sadeti. viśiṣṭam asādhāraṇaṃ jñānaṃ vijñānaṃ, svayam eva saṃvedyatvāt. kham iva sadā nirmalatvāt. prāguktam eva sphaṭiketyādinā (13a) avarṇetyādinā punar viśinaṣṭi. na vidyante śuklapītādayo varṇā yasyeti tad avarṇaṃ jñānam ākāśaṃ ca.
analyzed: tayoḥ madhye na ucchede na śāśvata bhāve vasthitam tad ubhaya avikalpaka tvāt kim iva iti āha vijñānam kham iva sadā iti viśiṣṭam asādhāraṇam jñānam vijñānam svayam eva saṃvedya tvāt kham iva sadā nirmala tvāt prāguktam eva sphaṭika ityādinā avarṇa ityādinā punar viśinaṣṭi na vidyante śukla pīta ādayaḥ varṇāḥ yasya iti tat avarṇam jñānam ākāśam ca

original: sarve rāgā āgantukā yasyeti tat sarvarāgaṃ jñānam ākāśaṃ ca. kevalatvān na kenāpi yujyata ity ayuktaṃ jñānam ākāśaṃ ca. yuktaṃ ca dehibhiḥ padārthaiḥ sarvagatvāj jñānam ākāśaṃ ca. atha vā: ayuktam anyair dharmair anāvṛtatvāt. yuktaṃ cānyān āvṛṇoti yataḥ.
analyzed: sarve rāgāḥ āgantukāḥ yasya iti tat sarva rāgam jñānam ākāśam ca kevala tvāt na kena api yujyate iti ayuktam jñānam ākāśam ca yuktam ca dehibhiḥ padārthaiḥ sarvaga tvāt jñānam ākāśam ca atha vā ayuktam anyaiḥ dharmaiḥ anāvṛta tvāt yuktam ca anyān āvṛṇoti yatas

original: [4.2.16] rūpyate bādhyata iti rūpam. tadanyad arūpaṃ jñānam ākāśaṃ ca. sarvaṃ rūpaṃ bādhyaṃ yasya, tat sarvarūpam. nirvikāratvād vikāriyogāc ca tathābhūtam ity arthaḥ. adīrghahrasvam eva ceti: dīrghaṃ ca tad dhrasvaṃ ceti dīrghahrasvam. na tathādīrghahrasvaṃ jñānam ākāśaṃ ca nirvikāratvāt. etena prajñājñānaṃ sūcitam.
analyzed: rūpyate bādhyate iti rūpam tad anyat arūpam jñānam ākāśam ca sarvam rūpam bādhyam yasya tat sarva rūpam nirvikāra tvāt vikāri yogāt ca tathābhūtam iti arthaḥ a dīrgha hrasvam eva ca iti dīrgham ca tat hrasvam ca iti dīrgha hrasvam na tathā a dīrgha hrasvam jñānam ākāśam ca nirvikāra tvāt etena prajñā jñānam sūcitam

original: yady evam ṛddhyādikaṃ kathaṃ syād ity āha: abhāvetyādi. na bhāti dvayam asminn ity abhāvo 'dvayaṃ jñānam. tata eva sidhyati ṛddhyādikam iti bhāvaḥ. paramārthaḥ ka ity āha: tattvam eva tu cetaneti. cittam eva tattvaṃ paramārthaḥ, akṛtrimarūpatvāt.
analyzed: yadi evam ṛddhi ādikam katham syāt iti āha abhāva ityādi na bhāti dvayam asmin iti abhāvaḥ dvayam jñānam tatas eva sidhyati ṛddhi ādikam iti bhāvaḥ paramārthaḥ kaḥ iti āha tattvam eva tu cetanā iti cittam eva tattvam paramārthaḥ akṛtrima rūpa tvāt

original: [4.2.17] tataś ca tattvarūpasya cittasyotpādādilakṣaṇaṃ nāstīti. etad evāha: na tu lakṣaṇa cetasyeti. tattvasyeti pāṭhāntaram. sarvalakṣaṇadāyaka iti: sarvāṇi lakṣaṇāni dāyati śodhayatīti sarvalakṣaṇadāyakaṃ tac cittam. evaṃbhūtaṃ cittam avabudhya devatā bhāvayitavyety āha: abhāvetyādi.
analyzed: tatas ca tattva rūpasya cittasya utpāda ādi lakṣaṇam na asti iti etat eva āha na tu cetasya iti tattvasya iti pāṭha antaram sarva lakṣaṇa dāyakaḥ iti sarvāṇi lakṣaṇāni śodhayati iti sarva lakṣaṇa dāyakam tat cittam evaṃbhūtam cittam avabudhya devatā bhāvayitavyā iti āha abhāva ityādi

original: abhāve 'dvayākāre citte bhāvanāyā devatākāracetanāyā bhāvaḥ sattā, tasya bhāvanam abhyāsas, tad api lakṣayet. nairātmyānuviddhā devatā bhāvayitavyety arthaḥ.
analyzed: abhāve dvaya ākāre citte bhāvanāyāḥ devatā ākāra cetanāyāḥ bhāvaḥ sattā tasya bhāvanam abhyāsaḥ tat api lakṣayet nairātmya anuviddhā devatā bhāvayitavyā iti arthaḥ

original: [4.2.18] rūpetyādi prāg eva. subodham. ālambyetyādi: sarveṇa prakāreṇa yogakāyaṃ śūnyatākaruṇābhinnarūpaṃ nirāmayeti niḥkleśaṃ sarveti devatākāram ālambyety ālambayet. etac ca bhāvanāśikṣaṇam.
analyzed: rūpa ityādi prāk eva su bodham ālambya ityādi sarveṇa prakāreṇa yogakāyam śūnyatā karuṇā bhinna rūpam nirāmaya iti niḥkleśam sarva iti devatā ākāram ālambya iti ālambayet etat ca bhāvanā śikṣaṇam

original: [4.2.19] punaḥ kīdṛśam ity āha: gūḍhetyādi. gūḍhānīndriyāṇi tebhyo 'pi gūḍhaṃ tebhyo 'nyad ity arthaḥ. mahāgūḍham iti: viṣayāgocaratvāt. jñānagūḍhata iti: cakṣurādijñānebhyo 'pi grāhyādyabhiniviṣṭebhyo gūḍham iti bhāvaḥ. etenāntarabodharūpaṃ svasaṃvedyam indriyādirahitam eveti darśitam. śāstrapāṭhādigūḍhānām iti:
analyzed: punar kīdṛśam iti āha gūḍha ityādi gūḍhāni indriyāṇi tebhyaḥ pi gūḍham tebhyaḥ iti arthaḥ mahā gūḍham iti viṣaya agocara tvāt jñāna gūḍhataḥ iti cakṣuḥ ādi jñānebhyaḥ pi grāhya ādi abhiniviṣṭebhyaḥ gūḍham iti bhāvaḥ etena antara bodha rūpam sva saṃvedyam indriya ādi rahitam eva iti darśitam śāstra pāṭha ādi gūḍhānām iti

original: śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ cāviṣayāl lakṣyam advayaṃ jñānaṃ dūraṃ syāt.
analyzed: śṛṇvatām paṭhatām ca aviṣayāt lakṣyam advayam jñānam dūram syāt

original: [4.2.20] guravo 'pi mārgamātradeśakā iti darśayann āha: lakṣyetyādi. lakṣyatattvasya yal lakṣaṇaṃ, tasya mārgaṃ gurur darśayatīti bhāvaḥ. samacetetyādi: samacittasya dehino na śarīre pīḍety arthaḥ. sukham upādeyaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca heyam. samatayā hi sukham eva.
analyzed: guravaḥ api mārga mātra deśakāḥ iti darśayan āha lakṣya ityādi lakṣya tattvasya yat lakṣaṇam tasya mārgam guruḥ darśayati iti bhāvaḥ sama cetā ityādi sama cittasya dehinaḥ na śarīre pīḍā iti arthaḥ sukham upādeyam duḥkham ca heyam samatayā hi sukham eva

original: [4.2.21] evaṃbhūtaṃ cittaṃ sādhayitum upāyam ādarśayitum āha: mana ityādi. evaṃbhūte pradeśe sukhacittaḥ san sukhāsanopaviṣṭaḥ ...

original: [4.2.22] ... sattvaparyaṅkastho dakṣiṇakaropari vāmakaraṃ dattvā paryaṅke nidhāya, cakṣurbhyāṃ nāsāgraṃ paśyan, niśvāsaṃ praveśavāyuṃ nābhau dhārayan, ...

original: [4.2.25] pītetyādinā navadvāramantranyāsam āha. pūrvoktaṃ sarvaṃ vidhāya hṛdi dvādaśasvaraveṣṭitaṃ hūṃkārasoṃkāramadhyaṃ candramaṇḍalaṃ vīkṣya, bhrūmadhye hūṃkāram amṛtena sarvāṅgāni plāvayantaṃ sitaṃ dhyāyatāṃ yathoktaṃ syāt. oṃ hūṃ svāheti ca japtavyo mantraḥ. tatra ca vajrasattvāhaṃkāraḥ kāryaḥ.
analyzed: pīta ityādinā nava dvāra mantra nyāsam āha pūrva uktam sarvam vidhāya hṛdi dvādaśa svara veṣṭitam hūṃkāra soṃkāra madhyam candra maṇḍalam vīkṣya bhrū madhye hūṃkāram amṛtena sarva aṅgāni plāvayantam sitam dhyāyatām yathā uktam syāt om   svāhā iti ca japtavyaḥ mantraḥ tatra ca vajra sattva ahaṃkāraḥ kāryaḥ

original: [4.2.26–42] amṛtāmūlam ālambyeti: akāro 'mṛtaṃ tad eva mūlaṃ kāraṇaṃ vajradharotpatteḥ. ata āha: aṅkurotpattisaṃbhava iti. aṅkuro vajradharaḥ. vṛddhyante tasya tasyaiva rūpa jñāno mahātmana iti: tasyaiva vajradharasya rūpam akārabījajam ātmano vīkṣya prāg uktāṃ bhāvanāṃ japaṃ ca kuryād iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: ālambya iti akāraḥ mṛtam tat eva mūlam kāraṇam vajradhara utpatteḥ atas āha aṅkura utpatti saṃbhave iti aṅkuraḥ vajradharaḥ vṛddhi ante tasya tasya eva jñānaḥ mahātmanaḥ iti tasya eva vajradharasya rūpam akāra bīja jam ātmanaḥ vīkṣya prāk uktām bhāvanām japam ca kuryāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: [4.2.43] sthānasaṃpattim āha: tasya yogāni m-āśritya śailādisamāśritam iti. śailādau yogam imaṃ sādhayed iti bhāvaḥ.

original: [4.2.44] idānīṃ vajrasattvabhāvanām āha: śrotum icchāmītyādi. subodham.
analyzed: idānīm vajra sattva bhāvanām āha śrotum icchāmi ityādi su bodham

original: [4.2.45] śūnyatādikaṃ vibhāvyākārajaṃ bhagavantaṃ bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: śūnyatā ādikam vibhāvya ākāra jam bhagavantam bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [4.2.46–57] hṛdītyādinā yogāntaram āha. hṛdi candrasthaṃ hūṃkāraṃ vīkṣya, śūnyatāṃ vibhāvya, ...

original: [4.2.58] ... vāyumaṇḍalopari candramaṇḍale hūṃkārajāṃ ...
analyzed: vāyu maṇḍala upari candra maṇḍale hūṃkāra jām

original: [4.2.59] ... jñānaḍākinīṃ pūrvoktabhujādikāṃ vibhāvya, candrasthaṃ hūṃkāraṃ bhāvayan pūrvoktānuśaṃso bhavati.
analyzed: jñāna ḍākinīm pūrva ukta bhuja ādikām vibhāvya candra stham hūṃkāram bhāvayan pūrva ukta anuśaṃsaḥ bhavati

original: [4.2.60–62] paretyādinā vajrasattvasya yogāntaram āha. paraṃ raktavarṇaṃ candramaṇḍalamadhyagataṃ svayaṃ ca raktavarṇo vajrasattvarūpo bhāvayet.
analyzed: para ityādinā vajra sattvasya yoga antaram āha param rakta varṇam candra maṇḍala madhya gatam svayam ca rakta varṇaḥ vajra sattva rūpaḥ bhāvayet

original: [4.2.63] svahṛdayapadmacandramadhyagataṃ raktahūṃkāraṃ vijñānaśabdenoktaṃ bhāvayet. tasya ca parasya hṛdaye svahṛdayān niṣkāśya praveśayet. tato 'py ātmahṛdaye.
analyzed: sva hṛdaya padma candra madhya gatam rakta hūṃkāram vijñāna śabdena uktam bhāvayet tasya ca parasya hṛdaye sva hṛdayāt niṣkāśya praveśayet ātma hṛdaye

original: [4.2.64] itthaṃ paśyan hūṃkāraṃ raktavarṇaṃ japann aṣṭaśatavārān niyataṃ jānāti paracittam. etad evāha: samatetyādi. subodham.
analyzed: ittham paśyan hūṃkāram rakta varṇam japan aṣṭaśata vārān niyatam jānāti para cittam etat eva āha samatā ityādi su bodham

original: [4.2.65–67] idānīṃ guhyahomam āha: athāgnītyādi. subodham.
analyzed: idānīm guhya homam āha atha agni ityādi su bodham

original: [4.2.68–69] giṇṭhā nābhasyeti: nābhigranthiḥ. sa ca sūtradvayena pāśākāreṇa veṣṭitaḥ paraspareṇādhaūrdhvaṃgatena nābhimadhye draṣṭavyaḥ. sa ca pārśvasthasaptarekhaḥ. nābhigranthau aṃkārasya madhyasthasya bindusakāśān nirgatena sūtreṇa saptadhā veṣṭanāt saptarekho nābhigranthiḥ. nābhigranther abhyantarapārśvasthatvād eva pārśvasthāḥ sapta rekhāḥ.
analyzed: giṇṭhā nābhasya iti nābhigranthiḥ sa ca sūtra dvayena pāśa ākāreṇa veṣṭitaḥ paraspareṇa adhas ūrdhvaṃgatena nābhi madhye draṣṭavyaḥ sa ca pārśva stha sapta rekhaḥ nābhigranthau aṃkārasya madhya sthasya bindu sakāśāt nirgatena sūtreṇa saptadhā veṣṭanāt sapta rekhaḥ nābhigranthiḥ nābhigrantheḥ abhyantara pārśva stha tvāt eva pārśva sthāḥ sapta rekhāḥ

original: aṅgulaśabdena rekhāḥ.
analyzed: aṅgula śabdena rekhāḥ

original: [4.2.70] nābhigranthir evāgnikuṇḍam. veṣṭanaṃ viśinaṣṭi: nāgendretyādi. sarpaśarīravat kuṇḍalībhūtarekho nābhigranthir iti bhāvaḥ. aṃkāro vahniḥ. granther adho vāyumaṇḍalam. jvalitā sarvavarṇasyeti: rekhāsu svaravyañjanāni draṣṭavyānīti bhāvaḥ. tasya madhye tu padmavad iti: nābhigranther upari padmam ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: nābhigranthiḥ eva agnikuṇḍam veṣṭanam viśinaṣṭi nāga indra ityādi sarpa śarīra vat kuṇḍalībhūta rekhaḥ nābhigranthiḥ iti bhāvaḥ aṃkāraḥ vahniḥ grantheḥ adhas vāyu maṇḍalam jvalitā sarva varṇasya iti rekhāsu svara vyañjanāni draṣṭavyāni iti bhāvaḥ tasya madhye tu padma vat iti nābhigrantheḥ upari padmam iti arthaḥ

original: [4.2.71] padmavaraṭake sūryasthā jñānaḍākinī tadbījaṃ vā. giṇṭhā sitabhi jvālaiva vajraḍākinī nīyatām iti: pūrvadale vajraḍākinī śvetā tadbījaṃ vā.
analyzed: padma varaṭake sūrya sthā jñāna ḍākinī tad bījam vā jvālā eva vajra ḍākinī nīyatām iti pūrva dale vajra ḍākinī śvetā tad bījam vā

original: [4.2.72] dakṣiṇe ghorī pītā tadbījaṃ vā. paścime raktā vettālī tadbījaṃ vā.
analyzed: dakṣiṇe ghorī pītā tad bījam vā paścime raktā vettālī tad bījam vā

original: [4.2.73] vāme caṇḍālī tadbījaṃ vā. pañca m-agniṃ tu ātmānam iti: ātmā pañcamas tatrāgnau. sa ca jñānaḍākiny eva. gurūpamam iti: gurur aṅguṣṭho buddhiḥ.
analyzed: vāme caṇḍālī tad bījam vā tu ātmānam iti ātmā pañcamaḥ tatra agnau sa ca jñānaḍākinī eva guru upamam iti guruḥ aṅguṣṭhaḥ buddhiḥ

original: [4.2.74] apaḥ pūrve, tejo dakṣiṇe, vāyuḥ paścime, pṛthvī cottare. ākāśaviśuddhyā jñānaḍākinī pañcamī madhye. nābhikuṇḍāgnau devatā bhāvayann āhutīr amṛtadhārā hūṃkārān sravatīr asakṛd bhāvayet.
analyzed: apaḥ pūrve tejaḥ dakṣiṇe vāyuḥ paścime pṛthvī ca uttare ākāśa viśuddhyā jñāna ḍākinī pañcamī madhye nābhikuṇḍa agnau devatāḥ bhāvayan āhutīḥ amṛta dhārāḥ hūṃkārān sravatīḥ asakṛt bhāvayet

original: [4.2.75] amṛtalambakālayam iti: amṛtam aṣṭādaśasthānam avalambamānaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ vahnau patad bhāvayet. gavākṣoraṃ tv iti: bhrūmadhyagatahūṃkāram adhomukham āhuḥ.
analyzed: amṛta lambaka ālayam iti amṛtam aṣṭādaśa sthānam avalambamānam pratikṣaṇam vahnau patat bhāvayet gavākṣoram tu iti bhrū madhya gata hūṃkāram adhomukham āhuḥ

original: [4.2.76] agnītyādinā aṃkāram eva darśayati. sa cāgnyādhāre. tasya cādhovāyunā preryamāṇasya tejasā hūṃkārabinduḥ sravann āhutiḥ syād iti bhāvaḥ. itthaṃ bhāvayatāṃ pauṣṭikaṃ rasāyanaṃ syāt.
analyzed: agni ityādinā aṃkāram eva darśayati sa ca agni ādhāre tasya ca adhas vāyunā preryamāṇasya tejasā hūṃkāra binduḥ sravan āhutiḥ syāt iti bhāvaḥ ittham bhāvayatām pauṣṭikam rasāyanam syāt

analyzed: idānīm vāyu abhyāsa viśeṣa bhūtapramāṇa ādi jñānāya tṛtīya paṭalam āha śrutam ityādi he deva śarīre vāyunā citta yogaḥ tasya lakṣaṇam śrotum icchāmi iti bhāvaḥ citta samatā katham yoktavyā katham cittena samam vāyoḥ saṃbandhaḥ iti arthaḥ asthitam markaṭa upamam iti yatas vāyuḥ cittam ca asthitaḥ sthiraḥ tatas katham tayoḥ yogaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: sukhair harṣaiś ca sidhyante prajñopāyādibhiḥ sadā ||
analyzed: sukhaiḥ harṣaiḥ ca sidhyante prajñā upāya ādibhiḥ sadā

original: iti. asminn abhyāsaprakarṣaparyantagamanād daśabalādiguṇāḥ syur ity upadeśaḥ. gurutaś ca sphuṭībhaviṣyati.
analyzed: iti asmin abhyāsa prakarṣa paryanta gamanāt daśa bala ādi guṇāḥ syuḥ iti upadeśaḥ gurutaḥ ca sphuṭībhaviṣyati

original: [4.3.3] āpa sarve pramāṇasyeti: sarvaśarīre 'pām astitve pramāṇam. kiṃ tad ity āha: aṅkurodbhavam iti. aṅkurā romāṇi. snehād dhi bījāṅkurāḥ prarohanti. na tu āpasya dehānāṃ pramāṇeti: śarīre 'pāṃ pramāṇam iyatā nāsti. kuta ity āha: apa dehakam ityādi. †...†
analyzed: sarve pramāṇasya iti sarva śarīre pām astitve pramāṇam kim tat iti āha aṅkura udbhavam iti aṅkurāḥ romāṇi snehāt hi bīja aṅkurāḥ prarohanti na tu āpasya dehānām pramāṇa iti śarīre pām pramāṇam iyatā na asti kutas iti āha apa dehakam ityādi

original: [4.3.4] sarvadehe vyāpikā āpaḥ. pramāṇā āpa buddhimān ity upasaṃhāraḥ. etat tāvad apām astitve pramāṇaṃ buddhimān jānātv iti bhāvaḥ. vajrī ca jalasvabhāveti darśayann āha: vajrītyādi. pramāṇetyādi: appramāṇā vajrīti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: sarva dehe   apaḥ pramāṇāḥ āpa buddhimān iti upasaṃhāraḥ etat tāvat apām astitve pramāṇam buddhimān jānātu iti bhāvaḥ vajrī ca jala svabhāvā iti darśayan āha vajrī ityādi pramāṇa ityādi appramāṇā vajrī iti bhāvaḥ

original: [4.3.5] agnir api coṣṇatvāt khāditapītādipākāc cānumīyata iti bhāvaḥ. ata evāha: agnītyādi.
analyzed: agniḥ api ca uṣṇa tvāt khādita pīta ādi pākāt ca anumīyate iti bhāvaḥ atas eva āha agni ityādi

original: [4.3.6] ghorī cāgnisvabhāvā.
analyzed: ghorī ca agni svabhāvā

original: [4.3.7] chidrer antara ṛṇṇivad iti: nāsārandhrādiś chidriśabdena. chidrer evāntara ṛṇṇiḥ. tena śvāsādinirgamapraveśāder vāyur anumīyate.
analyzed: chidreḥ antare iti nāsā randhra ādiḥ chidri śabdena chidreḥ eva antare tena śvāsa ādi nirgama praveśa ādeḥ vāyuḥ anumīyate

original: [4.3.8] vāyusvabhāvā vettālī.
analyzed: vāyu svabhāvā vettālī

original: [4.3.9] pṛthivyām ityādi. sarvam āsthānam iti: sarve jalādayaḥ padārthās tiṣṭhanty asminn iti sarvasthānaṃ pṛthvī. anyathā jalādeḥ śarīre sthitir na syāt. rūpāṇi viṣayā indriyāṇi ca prasiddhāni. rūpendriyāṇy eva guṇā āśritatvāt. tair bhūṣitā pradhānīkṛtā pṛthvīti rūpendriyaguṇabhūṣitam ity asyārthaḥ. pramāṇaṃ ālambya bhūtam iti:
analyzed: pṛthivyām ityādi sarvam āsthānam iti sarve jala ādayaḥ padārthāḥ tiṣṭhanti asmin iti sarva sthānam pṛthvī anyathā jala ādeḥ śarīre sthitiḥ na syāt rūpāṇi viṣayāḥ indriyāṇi ca prasiddhāni rūpa indriyāṇi eva guṇāḥ āśrita tvāt taiḥ bhūṣitā pradhānīkṛtā pṛthvī iti rūpa indriya guṇa bhūṣitam iti asya arthaḥ pramāṇam ālambya bhūtam iti

original: śarīre pṛthivyastitve pramāṇam ālayabhāva iti bhāvaḥ. etat pṛthivyā rūpaṃ khakkhaṭatvādikaṃ ca dṛśyate.
analyzed: śarīre pṛthivī astitve pramāṇam ālaya bhāvaḥ iti bhāvaḥ etat pṛthivyāḥ rūpam khakkhaṭa tva ādikam ca dṛśyate

original: [4.3.10] tato 'pi tatra tasyā astitvaṃ, guṇasaṃyogāc ca pṛthvī sundarīti bhaṇyata iti nāmākhyānam. caṇḍālī ca pṛthvīsvabhāvā.
analyzed: tatas tatra tasyāḥ astitvam guṇa saṃyogāt ca pṛthvī sundarī iti bhaṇyate iti nāma ākhyānam caṇḍālī ca pṛthvī svabhāvā

original: [4.3.11] idānīṃ śarīre vijñānāstitve pramāṇam āha: hartetyādi. hartākarteti: śubhāśubhavyāmiśrakarmakartā. kadācic chubhaṃ karoti kadācid aśubhaṃ kadācid vyāmiśraṃ ceti hartā. akaraṇe sati hi na karmaharaṇam. yadi vijñānaṃ nāsti śubhāśubhādivyāpāro 'pi tadā śarīre na syāt. sa cāsti, tataḥ kartā. bhokteti tatphalasya.
analyzed: idānīm śarīre vijñāna astitve pramāṇam āha hartā ityādi hartā akartā iti śubha aśubha vyāmiśra karma kartā kadācid śubham karoti kadācid aśubham kadācid vyāmiśram ca iti hartā akaraṇe sati hi na karma haraṇam yadi vijñānam na asti śubha aśubha ādi vyāpāraḥ tadā śarīre na syāt sa ca asti tatas kartā bhoktā iti tad phalasya

original: saṃśayaṃ ca chinatti, tataś ca mano 'sti. vijñānam ity arthaḥ. indriyaṃ sarva cetasyeti: indriyāṇi sarvāṇi, cetasyeti: vijñānasya. lakṣya lakṣaṇajñātaya iti: lakṣyeti viṣayā lakṣaṇajñātaya iti vijñānāni. etāni śarīre vijñānāstitve pramāṇam iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: saṃśayam ca chinatti tatas ca manaḥ sti vijñānam iti arthaḥ indriyam cetasyā iti indriyāṇi sarvāṇi cetasyā iti vijñānasya lakṣya lakṣaṇa jñātayaḥ iti lakṣya iti viṣayāḥ lakṣaṇa jñātayaḥ iti vijñānāni etāni śarīre vijñāna astitve pramāṇam iti bhāvaḥ

original: [4.3.12] viṣayendriyasaṃyogād rājendravad viṣayasukham anubhavatīti dehīty api pramāṇam. itthaṃ tāvad dehe vijñānaṃ rājate pramāṇāt. evaṃ ca yogī budhyate, jñānetyāder ayam arthaḥ.
analyzed: viṣaya indriya saṃyogāt rāja indra vat viṣaya sukham anubhavati iti dehī iti api pramāṇam ittham tāvat dehe vijñānam rājate pramāṇāt evam ca yogī budhyate jñāna ityādeḥ ayam arthaḥ

original: [4.3.13] idānīṃ pramāṇāntaram āha: vijñānam ityādi. abdhātor astitve śarīre vijñānāstitvam. yadi vijñānābhāve 'pi jalaṃ śarīre syāt, tadā cyutasya mṛtasya kiṃ nāpaḥ syuḥ?
analyzed: idānīm pramāṇa antaram āha vijñānam ityādi ap dhātoḥ astitve śarīre vijñāna astitvam yadi vijñāna abhāve jalam śarīre syāt tadā cyutasya mṛtasya kim na apaḥ syuḥ

original: [4.3.14] yadi vijñānābhāve 'pi vahniḥ syāt, tadā gatajñānasyoṣṇatā kathaṃ na syāt?
analyzed: yadi vijñāna abhāve vahniḥ syāt tadā gata jñānasya uṣṇa tā katham na syāt

original: [4.3.15] yady asati vijñāne śarīre vāyus tadā gatavijñānasya śvāsasphurtiḥ kathaṃ na syāt?
analyzed: yadi asati vijñāne śarīre vāyuḥ tadā gata vijñānasya śvāsa sphurtiḥ katham na syāt

original: [4.3.16] yadi gatavijñānasya śarīrasya pṛthvīyogas tadā mṛtasya lāghavaṃ kutaḥ? etac ca katham ity āha: udake plavanāyata iti. udake mṛtaṃ śarīraṃ plavate tarati yataḥ.
analyzed: yadi gata vijñānasya śarīrasya pṛthvī yogaḥ tadā mṛtasya lāghavam kutas etat ca katham iti āha udake plavanāyataḥ iti udake mṛtam śarīram plavate tarati yatas

original: [4.3.17] pramāṇaṃ pañca dehasya pañcasya m-ekabhāvateti: śarīre vijñānāstitve pramāṇam idam, pañceti prapañcataḥ. prapañcasyāpy ekabhāvataikarūpatā. etad evāha: eketyādi. yogibhir ekatvena vijñānagatir īkṣyate.
analyzed: pramāṇam pañca dehasya pañcasya m eka bhāva tā iti śarīre vijñāna astitve pramāṇam idam pañca iti prapañcataḥ prapañcasya api eka bhāva tā ekarūpa tā etat eva āha eka ityādi yogibhiḥ eka tvena vijñāna gatiḥ īkṣyate

original: [4.3.18] tad evaṃ ca jñātuṃ kalyāṇamitrasya sevā guror upāsanā kāryā.
analyzed: tat evam ca jñātum kalyāṇa mitrasya sevā guroḥ upāsanā kāryā

original: [4.3.19] indriyam ityādi: viṣayebhyo 'pīndriyāṇi tadvijñānāny api pīḍayatāṃ bandhanaṃ saṃsāraḥ syāt. niyamavratādinā na śarīrapīḍā kāryeti nirdiśati. vijñānabandhanān muktir evety āha: bandhayed ityādi. madhyasthānaṃ tv iti: hṛdaye vijñānaṃ badhnīyāt. aṇḍajāgṛhaśabdenāṇḍam eva.
analyzed: indriyam ityādi viṣayebhyaḥ api indriyāṇi tad vijñānāni api pīḍayatām bandhanam saṃsāraḥ syāt niyama vrata ādinā na śarīra pīḍā kāryā iti nirdiśati vijñāna bandhanāt muktiḥ eva iti āha bandhayet ityādi madhya sthānam tu iti hṛdaye vijñānam badhnīyāt aṇḍajā gṛha śabdena aṇḍam eva

original: tatra yathā vijñānam ālīyata ity ālayaṃ karmakleśair badhyate, tathā yogināpi bandhanīyaṃ vijñānam.
analyzed: tatra yathā vijñānam ālīyate iti ālayam karma kleśaiḥ badhyate tathā yoginā api bandhanīyam vijñānam

original: [4.3.20] bandhanayogam evāha: calitetyādi. calitā vāyus, tasya veṣṭenābhyāsena badhnīyād iti śeṣaḥ. kathaṃ ca vāyor abhyāsa ity āha: dolādolāya cetaneti. dolānilanirgamaḥ. dolāyeti praveśaḥ. taccintayābhyāsaḥ kārya iti bhāvaḥ. cetaneti vijñānam evaivaṃ bhāvyam iti bhāvaḥ. āsanetyādi: sukhāsane padmāsanāsīno bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: bandhana yogam eva āha calita ityādi calitā vāyuḥ tasya veṣṭena abhyāsena badhnīyāt iti śeṣaḥ katham ca vāyoḥ abhyāsaḥ iti āha dolā dolāya cetanā iti dolā anila nirgamaḥ dolāya iti praveśaḥ tad cintayā abhyāsaḥ kāryaḥ iti bhāvaḥ cetanā iti vijñānam eva evam bhāvyam iti bhāvaḥ āsana ityādi sukha āsane padmāsana āsīnaḥ bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [4.3.21] hetum ityādi: hetusvabhāvapraṇidhānaśūnyatā sūcitā. yoginām iti yogī. vijñānaṃ vijñānamātraṃ sarvam. rūpādikaṃ na syāt, tat kathaṃ bhāvanā syād ity āha: rūpasaṃjñetyādi. rūpādīnāṃ bhāvaḥ prajñopāyasaṃbandhasiddhaye rūpādyāropa iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: hetum ityādi hetu svabhāva praṇidhāna śūnyatā sūcitā yoginām iti yogī vijñānam vijñāna mātram sarvam rūpa ādikam na syāt tat katham bhāvanā syāt iti āha rūpa saṃjñā ityādi rūpa ādīnām bhāvaḥ prajñā upāya saṃbandha siddhaye rūpa ādi āropaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: [4.3.22] dolājapam āha: kadalītyādi. kadalīpuṣpākāraṃ nābhau sthitaṃ bhāvayed iti śeṣaḥ. nābhipadme kadalīpuṣpākāram aṃkāraṃ bhāvayed iti samudāyārthaḥ. ucchrite hṛdayavasthitam iti: upari hṛdaye 'py adhomukhaṃ padmam aṣṭadalam. riktamukham iti: kiṃcidvivṛtamukhapadmam. āvarttam ity adhomukhatvaṃ darśayati. śeṣaṃ subodham.
analyzed: dolājapam āha kadala ityādi kadala puṣpa ākāram nābhau sthitam bhāvayet iti śeṣaḥ nābhi padme kadala puṣpa ākāram aṃkāram bhāvayet iti samudāya arthaḥ ucchrite hṛdaya avasthitam iti upari hṛdaye pi adhomukham padmam aṣṭadalam rikta mukham iti kiṃcid vivṛta mukha padmam āvartam iti adhomukha tvam darśayati śeṣam su bodham

original: [4.3.23] uktakesarachādanam iti: prasiddhakesarānvitam. uparipadmavaraṭakamadhye jñānavijñānaṃ hūṃkāraṃ yojayet.
analyzed: ukta kesara chādanam iti prasiddha kesara anvitam upari padma varaṭaka madhye jñāna vijñānam hūṃkāram yojayet

original: [4.3.24] nābhisthitasya padmasyopari saṃyoga pūrvabhāgaḥ. tatra vahniraśmayaḥ ṣaḍaṅgulāḥ. nābhipadmasyādhobhāge giṇṭhā paścimabhāgaḥ. tatra pañcāṅgulā raśmayaḥ.
analyzed: nābhi sthitasya padmasya upari saṃyoga pūrva bhāgaḥ tatra vahni raśmayaḥ ṣaṣ aṅgulāḥ nābhi padmasya adhobhāge giṇṭhā paścima bhāgaḥ tatra pañca aṅgulāḥ raśmayaḥ

original: [4.3.25] tasya kṣetrasyeti: yathā kṣetre bījāṅkurās tathā raśmaya iti bhāvaḥ. tasya bījasyetyādi: tatrāpy uparipadme hūṃkārabījam adhomukhaṃ kadalīpuṣpavat. raśmīnāṃ āvartteti: raśmiyuktam ity arthaḥ. kecit kadalīpuṣpā sthitā nābheti (22a): hṛdayāt kadalīpuṣpavat kadalīkalikevādhomukhaṃ padmaṃ nābhyuparisamīpagataṃ kiṃcidvivṛtamukham.
analyzed: tasya kṣetrasya iti yathā kṣetre bīja aṅkurāḥ tathā raśmayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ tasya bījasya ityādi tatra api upari padme hūṃkāra bījam adhomukham kadalī puṣpa vat raśmīnām āvartā iti raśmi yuktam iti arthaḥ kecid kadalīpuṣpā sthitā nābhā iti hṛdayāt kadalī puṣpa vat kadala kalikā iva adhomukham padmam nābhi upari samīpa gatam kiṃcid vivṛta mukham

original: uktakesarachādanam iti (23b): adhaḥ keśarachannaṃ nābhau ca padmaṃ draṣṭavyam. tasyāṣṭadalasya varaṭake aṃkāras, tadraśminā kiṃcidvivṛtamukham ūrdhvapadmam iti. śeṣaṃ pūrvavat.
analyzed: ukta kesara chādanam iti adhas keśara channam nābhau ca padmam draṣṭavyam tasya aṣṭadalasya varaṭake aṃkāraḥ tad raśminā kiṃcid vivṛta mukham ūrdhva padmam iti śeṣam pūrvavat

original: [4.3.26] aṃkāraraśminā sūkṣmeṇādhomukhaṃ hūṃkāraṃ hṛdayasthitapadmasthaṃ hanyād iti darśayann āha: pañcetyādi. pañcasphoṭikabījaṃ hūṃkāraḥ. nimnam iti: adhobījaraśminā. padmakāntiṃ sphālayed vikāsayet. śeṣaṃ subodham.
analyzed: aṃkāra raśminā sūkṣmeṇa adhomukham hūṃkāram hṛdaya sthita padma stham hanyāt iti darśayan āha pañca ityādi pañca sphoṭika bījam hūṃkāraḥ nimnam iti adhas bīja raśminā padma kāntim sphālayet vikāsayet śeṣam su bodham

original: [4.3.27–28] adhaḥpadmasya pūrvādidiggatadalacatuṣṭaye krameṇa vāmāvarttataḥ suṃkṣuṃ-yuṃ-huṃ-bījāni. svaretyādināpy aṃkāra evoktaḥ, sa ca madhya eva.
analyzed: adhas padmasya pūrva ādi diś gata dala catuṣṭaye krameṇa vāma āvartataḥ suṃ kṣuṃ yuṃ huṃ bījāni svara ityādinā api aṃkāraḥ eva uktaḥ sa ca madhye eva

original: [4.3.29] aiśānādividigdaleṣu smyruṃ-ymyruṃ-hmyruṃ-kṣmyruṃ-bījāni. nemibhāge ṛ-ṝ-ḷ-ḹ-bījāni sarvato draṣṭavyāni. uparipadme 'py evaṃ bījānāṃ vinyāsaḥ. evaṃ hṛdaye 'pi padmagatam akṣaraṃ hūṃkāro dṛśyo draṣṭavyaḥ.
analyzed: aiśāna ādi vidiś daleṣu nemi bhāge ṛṝ ḷḥ bījāni sarvatas draṣṭavyāni upari padme pi evam bījānām vinyāsaḥ evam hṛdaye pi padma gatam akṣaram hūṃkāraḥ dṛśyaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

original: [4.3.30] aṃkāraraśminā codyamāno hūṃkāro 'mṛtaṃ tathā varṣayati yathā sarvam adho'ṅgaṃ snapayitvā sarvam ūrdhvam api snapatīty ata āha: gavākṣyoraṃ tv ityādi. gavākṣyoraṃ śarīram. navadhārateti: nava dvāraṇāni paripūrya snapayatīti bhāvaḥ. pratiromachidranirgatair amṛtaiḥ sarvāṅgaṃ snapayed dhūṃkāra iti.
analyzed: aṃkāra raśminā codyamānaḥ hūṃkāraḥ mṛtam tathā varṣayati yathā sarvam adhas aṅgam snapayitvā sarvam ūrdhvam api snapati iti atas āha gavākṣyoḥ uram tu ityādi gavākṣyoḥ śarīram nava dhārata iti nava dvāraṇāni paripūrya snapayati iti bhāvaḥ prati roma chidra nirgataiḥ amṛtaiḥ sarva aṅgam snapayet dhūṃkāraḥ iti

original: [4.4.25–26] tasya madhye tv iti: nābhipadmamadhye aṃkārabījam. tasya raśminā bālāgraśatāṃśaparimāṇena ...

original: [4.4.27–28] ... hṛtpadmabhrūmadhyakanakadvāragatena tadbījāmṛtaṃ pradrāvya sarvam aṅgaṃ siñced iti punaḥ punar bhāvayet. śeṣaṃ subodham.
analyzed: hṛd padma bhrū madhya kanaka dvāra gatena tad bīja amṛtam pradrāvya sarvam aṅgam siñcet iti punar punar bhāvayet śeṣam su bodham

original: [4.4.29–31] mana ityādi: mana eva bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: manaḥ ityādi manaḥ eva bhāvayet iti bhāvaḥ

original: [4.4.32–38] evaṃ bhāvayatāṃ puṃsāṃ nimittaṃ darśayann āha: pradīpetyādi.
analyzed: evam bhāvayatām puṃsām nimittam darśayan āha pradīpa ityādi

original: [4.4.39] kleśoddhṛtam iti: kleśatānavam.
analyzed: kleśa uddhṛtam iti kleśa tānavam

original: [4.4.40–43] śūnyatāṃ bhāvayituṃ sarvatra prathamaṃ hūṃkāraṃ hṛdi bhāvayed ity etad evāha: hṛdayetyādi subodham.
analyzed: śūnyatām bhāvayitum sarvatra prathamam hūṃkāram hṛdi bhāvayet iti etat eva āha hṛdaya ityādi su bodham

original: [4.4.44] hūṃkāreṇa sarvaśarīraṃ kṣayaṃ nītvā tato hūṃkāraṃ bhasmapuñje dṛṣṭvā tadamṛtamayena raśminā punar utpādayet.
analyzed: hūṃkāreṇa sarva śarīram kṣayam nītvā tatas hūṃkāram bhasma puñje dṛṣṭvā tad amṛta mayena raśminā punar utpādayet

original: [4.4.45–46] kṣiti kuṭilam ity āhu diśa-r-aṣṭamadhātukair iti: kṣitigarbhavajrapāṇyādayaḥ prathamapīṭhaprathamapaṭaloktās tasyotpāditasya śarīrastūpasya pūrvādidikṣu vimoktavyāḥ. śeṣaṃ subodham.
analyzed: kṣiti kuṭilam iti āhuḥ diśa raṣṭama dhātukaiḥ iti kṣitigarbha vajrapāṇi ādayaḥ prathama pīṭha prathama paṭala uktāḥ tasya utpāditasya śarīra stūpasya pūrva ādi dikṣu vimoktavyāḥ śeṣam su bodham

original: [4.4.47–57] itthaṃ śarīram eva pūjayed yogī. bahiścaityavandanā caivam abhiprāyeṇa niṣiddhā. dharmadhātuyoga iti: dharmāṇāṃ skandhādīnāṃ dhātur āśrayaḥ śarīraṃ tasya yogaḥ śūnyatayā saṃbandhaḥ. atha vā dharmadhātuḥ śūnyatā tayā śarīrasya yogaḥ. dharmadhātuśabdena caityaṃ śarīraṃ cocyate.
analyzed: ittham śarīram eva pūjayet yogī bahis caitya vandanā ca evam abhiprāyeṇa niṣiddhā dharmadhātu yogaḥ iti dharmāṇām skandha ādīnām dhātuḥ āśrayaḥ śarīram tasya yogaḥ śūnyatayā saṃbandhaḥ atha vā dharmadhātuḥ śūnyatā tayā śarīrasya yogaḥ dharmadhātu śabdena caityam śarīram ca ucyate

original: [4.4.58–60] ādāv ityādinā pūrvoktam eva nirdiśati.
analyzed: ādau ityādinā pūrva uktam eva nirdiśati

original: [4.4.61–85] asya yogasya bhāvanārthaṃ sthānasampattim āha: vana ityādi. subodham.
analyzed: asya yogasya bhāvanā artham sthāna sampattim āha vane ityādi su bodham

original: [4.4.86] īdṛśe sthāne bhaktādirahite kathaṃ yogaṃ yuñjītety āha: nāgetyādi. nāgeti nāgabalā, gorakṣataṇḍuleti yasya prasiddhiḥ, tasya mūlam. †...† palāśapuṣpam. kuṣṭheti kuṣṭham. tṛtīyabhāgata iti: pratyekaṃ palatrayam. māgadhe palam ekaṃ tv iti: pippalīpalam ekam. sarvam etat pratyekaṃ sūkṣmacūrṇīkartavyam. samabhāgaṃ tv iti: ekīkṛtya.
analyzed: īdṛśe sthāne bhakta ādi rahite katham yogam yuñjīta iti āha nāga ityādi nāga iti nāgabalā gorakṣa taṇḍula iti yasya prasiddhiḥ tasya mūlam palāśa puṣpam kuṣṭha iti kuṣṭham tṛtīya bhāgataḥ iti pratyekam pala trayam māgadhe palam ekam tu iti pippalī palam ekam sarvam etat pratyekam sūkṣma cūrṇīkartavyam sama bhāgam tu iti ekīkṛtya

original: [4.4.87] tasmāt karṣam ekam ādāya gokṣīreṇa pibeta ṣaṇmāsān yāvat.
analyzed: tasmāt karṣam ekam ādāya go kṣīreṇa pibeta ṣaṣ māsān yāvat

original: [4.4.88] varśaṣataṃ yāvat kṣutpipāsādinā na bādhyate yogī tadbhaiṣajyabhogata iti bhāvaḥ.
analyzed: varśa ṣatam yāvat kṣudh pipāsā ādinā na bādhyate yogī tad bhaiṣajya bhogataḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: [4.4.89] bhaiṣajyaṃ kurvan vinīto bhogavarjitaḥ syāt. tataḥ śarīraṃ rakṣati. atha vā bhaiṣajye kṛte vinayādikaṃ syād iti.
analyzed: bhaiṣajyam kurvan vinītaḥ bhoga varjitaḥ syāt tatas śarīram rakṣati atha vā bhaiṣajye kṛte vinaya ādikam syāt iti

original: [4.4.90] mantramudrādevatādikaṃ mithyāpratyayena bhāvanājapādinā sākṣātkartavyam ity āha: yathāṅganetyādi. yathā nārībālādijanakathāyāṃ prekṣāvān na yatnaṃ karoti śṛṇoti tacchravaṇāt sukhādikam anubhavati ca tathā tad anumodate taiḥ saha †...† saṃparkaṃ kathāṃ ca kathayati na ca sajyate tatra, tathaiva mārgo deśayitavyaḥ.
analyzed: mantra mudrā devatā ādikam mithyāpratyayena bhāvanā japa ādinā sākṣātkartavyam iti āha yathā aṅganā ityādi yathā nārī bāla ādi jana kathāyām prekṣāvān na yatnam karoti śṛṇoti tad śravaṇāt sukha ādikam anubhavati ca tathā tat anumodate taiḥ saha saṃparkam kathām ca kathayati na ca sajyate tatra tathā eva mārgaḥ deśayitavyaḥ

original: tato mārgābhyāsān na ca bandhanaṃ syāt. evaṃvidha eva yogaḥ. ito 'nyathā kumārgo darśyata iti bhāvaḥ. atha vā: yathā bālāṅganādikathāvac chrotum icchati tantram idaṃ tasmai na mārgaḥ kathyata iti bhāvaḥ. tasya bandhanam eva, yataḥ sa kumārgadarśī.
analyzed: tatas mārga abhyāsāt na ca bandhanam syāt evaṃvidhaḥ eva yogaḥ itas nyathā ku mārgaḥ darśyate iti bhāvaḥ atha vā yathā bāla aṅganā ādi kathā vat śrotum icchati tantram idam tasmai na mārgaḥ kathyate iti bhāvaḥ tasya bandhanam eva yatas sa ku mārga darśī

original: [4.4.91] bauddhena vedādimantrābhimantritaṃ dūrvādikaṃ na śirasi dhāryaṃ, na tīrthikadevatā vandyā, yato 'bhiṣekamantrādipavitratāhāniḥ syāt. etad evāha: bauddhenetyādi. bauddhācāryeṇety arthaḥ. bhiṣekety abhiṣekaḥ.
analyzed: bauddhena veda ādi mantra abhimantritam dūrvā ādikam na śirasi dhāryam na tīrthika devatāḥ vandyāḥ yatas bhiṣeka mantra ādi pavitra tā hāniḥ syāt etat eva āha bauddhena ityādi bauddha ācāryeṇa iti arthaḥ bhiṣeka iti abhiṣekaḥ

original: [4.4.92–93] te nā hūṃ te nā hūṃ te nā te te hūṃ iti: te kāyavākcittātmakāḥ skandhadhātvāyatanalakṣaṇāḥpadārthāḥ. neti pratiṣedhe. grāhyagrāhakādirūpeṇa te na santi prakṛtiprabhāsvaratayā santīti bhāvaḥ. kuta ity āha: hūṃ iti. hūṃ iti: cittamātraṃ sarvaṃ yata ity arthaḥ. ayaṃ mantro kāyādiviśuddhyā vāratrayam uccārayitavyaḥ.
analyzed: te nā hūm te nā hūm te nā te te hūm iti te kāya vāc citta ātmakāḥ skandha dhātu āyatana lakṣaṇāḥ padārthāḥ na iti pratiṣedhe grāhya grāhaka ādi rūpeṇa te na santi prakṛti prabhāsvara tayā santi iti bhāvaḥ kutas iti āha hūm iti hūm iti cittamātram sarvam yatas iti arthaḥ ayam mantraḥ kāya ādi viśuddhyā vāra trayam uccārayitavyaḥ

original: svecchavi satta-uttāru iti: svecchayā sattvottārakaḥ.
analyzed: iti sva icchayā sattva uttārakaḥ

original: [4.4.94–99] akṣaram ityādinā tantrasya puṇyamaheśākhyatvaṃ darśitam.
analyzed: akṣaram ityādinā tantrasya puṇya maheśākhya tvam darśitam

original: [4.4.100] likhanādikriyāṃ kurvatāṃ cyutyanantaram arūpadhātāv utpattiḥ syāt. yogābhiratānāṃ tu saṃbodhiḥ śīghram eva.
analyzed: likhana ādi kriyām kurvatām cyuti anantaram arūpadhātau utpattiḥ syāt yoga abhiratānām tu saṃbodhiḥ śīghram eva

original: [4.4.101] kuta ity āha: abhinandann itītyanto 'tra caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ. caturbhiś cāmībhiḥ paṭalair guhyapīṭham. atroktaṃ yat tat sarvaṃ sugopyatvād guhyaṃ tasya pīṭham. anyat subodham iti.
analyzed: kutas iti āha abhinandan iti ityantaḥ caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ caturbhiḥ ca amībhiḥ paṭalaiḥ guhya pīṭham atra uktam yat tat sarvam su gopya tvāt guhyam tasya pīṭham anyat su bodham iti
